questions.en: A positive statement is always true. is refutable with facts. may contain a value judgment. may be the same as a normative statement if certain values are shared by many people.
questions.zh: 一項實證的陳述 永遠是對的。 可以被事實推翻。 可能包含了價值判斷。 對擁有某些相同價值取向的大眾而言，可能等同於一項規範性陳述。

questions.en: Which of the following statements are positive statements? More workers will be employed on a part-time basis after the imposition of a minimum wage. Less low skilled workers will be unemployed after the imposition of a minimum wage. Meal times should be counted as working time in the calculation of a minimum wage. The imposition of a minimum wage widens the income gap between the rich and the poor. (2) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (1), (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些是實證性陳述？ 最低工資實施後，更多工人會以兼職的形式獲聘。 最低工資實施後，低技術工人會有較少人失業。 在計算最低工資時，膳食時間應被計入工作時間。 最低工資的實施擴大貧富的收入差距。 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (4)

questions.en: Which of the following are positive statements? Importation of labour from the mainland would result in a rise in job vacancies in Hong Kong. It would be better to import labour from the Guangdong province because they can speak Cantonese. Productivity of labour from China is higher than that from other Southeast Asian countries. Unemployment rate in Hong Kong would rise by 1% as a result of labour importation of 30 000 from the mainland. (1) and (2) only (3) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些是實證性陳述？ 從內地輸入勞工會增加本港的職位空缺。 從廣東省輸入勞工會較佳，因為他們能操粵語。 來自中國的勞工的生產力比來自其他東南亞國家的勞工高。 從內地輸入 30 000 名勞工會令本港的失業率上升 1%。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (3)、(4) 只有 (1)、(3)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: The following statements are adapted from the 2017-18 Budget Speech by the Financial Secretary of Hong Kong. Statement (1): The global economy in 2016 recorded the slowest growth since the global financial crisis. Statement (2): For 2016 as a whole, there was a growth of 1.9%, consistent with the 1% to 2% economic growth as forecast in last year’s Budget. Statement (3): While recognising the effect of market forces, the Government should play an active role as a facilitator by taking forward appropriate policies with good use of public resources. Which of the above is a normative statement / are normative statements? (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下列陳述是取材自香港財政司司長的 2017-18 年度財政預算案演詞。 陳述 (1): 2016 年環球經濟錄得自環球金融危機以來最慢的增長。 陳述 (2): 2016 年全年經濟增長率為 1.9%，符合去年預算案所估算的 1% 至 2%。 陳述 (3): 在認同市場力量的同時，政府應積極發揮促進者的角色，善用公共資源，推出合宜的政策。 以上哪 (些) 項是規範性陳述？ 只有 (1) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: Refer to the following statements made by Peter and Mary. Peter: As a developed economy, Hong Kong’s Gini coefficient is too high. Mary: Hong Kong’s Gini coefficient is the highest in Asia. ______________ statement is ______________ because _________________________. Peter’s ... positive ... most people agree with it Peter’s ... normative ... it is inconsistent with the real world data Mary’s ... positive ... it can be rejected by fact Mary’s ... normative ... value judgment is involved in the statement
questions.zh: 參閱下列彼得和瑪莉所作的陳述。 彼得：香港作為一已發展經濟體，它的堅尼系數太高了。 瑪莉：香港的堅尼系數是全亞洲最高的。 _________________ 的陳述屬 ____________________ 因為 ____________________。 彼得 ... 實證性 ... 大部分人認同該陳述 彼得 ... 規範性 ... 該陳述和現實世界的數據並不相符 瑪莉 ... 實證性 ... 該陳述可以被事實推翻 瑪莉 ... 規範性 ... 該陳述涉及價值判斷

questions.en: Which of the following is a normative statement / are normative statements? Launching consumption voucher schemes will lead to inflation. Promoting tourism is the most appropriate way to stimulate economic growth. The government should continue to attract Mainland enterprises to invest in Hong Kong. (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 以下哪項／哪些是規範性陳述？ 推行消費券計劃會導致通脹。 宣傳旅遊業是刺激經濟增長的最適切的途徑。 政府應繼續吸引內地企業來港投資。 只有(1) 只有(3) 只有(1)、(2) 只有(2)、(3)

questions.en: Owing to the problem of scarcity in a society, we have to impose price controls. make choices. adopt a planned economic system. compete against one another. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 鑒於社會上的「稀少性」問題，我們須要 實施價格管制。 作出選擇。 採用計劃經濟。 互相競爭。 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: Scarcity of commodity X will NOT occur when there is a great supply of it. Nobody wants it. It is free of charge. Only one person wants it.
questions.zh: 在哪一種情況下，商品 X 不會有「稀少性」？ 它有大量供應。 沒有人想得到它。 它是免費的。 只有一個人想得到它。

questions.en: A scarce resource has the following characteristic: Its supply is fixed. It is difficult to find. It is in great demand. It has a price on the market.
questions.zh: 「稀少性」資源有以下的特性： 供應固定 不容易找到 需求很大 在市場上有價

questions.en: Even though Japan is one of the richest economies in the world, it still has to face the problem of scarcity. This statement is false, because scarcity only exists in developing countries. false, because Japan has a high gross national product (GNP). true, because what the Japanese have cannot satisfy all their wants. true, because Japan’s income is unevenly distributed.
questions.zh: “雖然日本是全世界最富裕的國家之一，它仍要面對「稀少性」的問題。” 這句子是 錯的，因為「稀少性」只存在於發展中的國家。 錯的，因為日本國民生產總值高。 對的，因為日本人所擁有的不能滿足他們的全部慾望。 對的，因為日本收入分配不平均。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about scarcity is true? Once a choice is made, the problem of scarcity is solved. A good is scarce if not everyone has it. Scarcity means unlimited human wants. Both rich people and poor people face the problem of scarcity.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於「稀少性」的描述是正確的？ 在作出選擇後，稀少性的問題便獲得解決。 一物品若不是每個人都擁有，便是「稀少」的。 稀少性的意思是：人類有無窮的欲望。 富者與貧者都面對稀少性的問題。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about choice is INCORRECT? People have to choose in order to avoid competition. People have to choose if there is scarcity People choose to option with the least cost. People choose the most preferred option.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於選擇的描述不是正確的？ 因為要避免競爭，我們須作出選擇。 因為「稀少性」問題，我們須作出選擇。 我們所選擇的，都是代價最低的。 我們所選擇的，都是最偏好的。

questions.en: The existence of scarcity implies that the economy is planned economy. there is competition for the good. effective price control is imposed on that good. wealth is not evenly distributed.
questions.zh: 存在「稀少性」的問題是意味著 該經濟是計劃經濟。 為了獲得某物品而出現競爭。 對某物品實施了有效的物價管制。 財富並未平均分配。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about scarcity and shortage is correct? Scarcity implies shortage. The existence of market prices implies scarcity. Shortages are caused by reduction in supply. There is no scarcity in a one-man economy.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於稀少性和短缺的陳述是正確的？ 稀少性意味著短缺。 市場價格的存在意味著稀少性。 短缺是由供應減少所引致的。 在一人經濟體系中，不存在稀少性。

questions.en: The existence of scarcity implies that resources will be allocated by the price mechanism. all markets are perfectly competitive. the quantity supplied of all goods is fixed. people need to pay for what they want.
questions.zh: 「稀少性」的存在，意味着 資源會由價格機制配置。 所有市場都是完全競爭的。 所有物品的供應量都是固定的。 人們需付出代價以獲取他們想要的東西。

questions.en: Scarcity implies everything is not enough. there is a shortage, and without a shortage there will be no price. that an individual is willing to sacrifice something for something else. a market will emerge.
questions.zh: 稀少性意味著 所有東西都不足夠。 存在短缺，而沒有短缺就不會有價格。 個人願意為了某些事物而犧牲其他事物。 市場將會出現。

questions.en: The existence of scarcity implies that there is no such thing as free goods. human wants are unlimited. each and every economic good has a positive money price. there is a cost in obtaining some goods.
questions.zh: 「稀少性」的存在，意味着 沒有「免費物品」這種東西。 人類慾望無窮。 每項經濟物品都有一個大於零的金錢價格。 要獲得某些物品是有代價的。

questions.en: In a one-man economy, there will still be property rights. shortage. exchange. scarcity.
questions.zh: 在一人經濟體系中，仍然會有 產權。 短缺。 交換。 稀少性。

questions.en: Scarcity implies the market is the most efficient place for allocating resources. shortage if the market does not exist. the concept of equilibrium is essential. some people must be discriminated against in a society.
questions.zh: 稀少性意味著 市場是分配資源最有效率的地方。 若市場不存在，便會出現短缺。 均衡的概念是必要的。 社會中某些人必然會被歧視。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of society, people will not compete for free goods. money price is the only criterion of competition for scarce goods. resources with alternative uses are scarce. there is no scarcity in a barter economy.
questions.zh: 從社會的角度出發， 人們不會為「免費物品」而競爭。 金錢價格是「稀少性物品」的唯一競爭準則。 有其他用途的資源都是「稀少」的。 以物易物的經濟是沒有「稀少性」的。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about scarcity and shortage is correct? Whenever there is shortage, there must be scarcity. In a one-man economy, there may be shortage. Whenever there is scarcity, there must be shortage. Scarcity necessarily implies competition.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於稀少性與短缺的陳述是正確的？ 每當有短缺，就必然有稀少性。 在一人經濟體系中，可能會出現短缺。 每當有稀少性，就必然有短缺。 稀少性必然意指競爭。

questions.en: Which one of the following statements about scarcity is correct? A good is scarce when only a small quantity of it is available. A good is scarce when people want to have more of it. There is no scarcity in a planned economy. The problem of scarcity can be solved by adjusting prices.
questions.zh: 下列哪項關於「稀少性」的說法是正確的？ 若一種物品只有少量供應，它便是「稀少」的。 若人們想獲得更多某種物品，它便是「稀少」的。 計劃經濟中沒有「稀少性」這回事。 「稀少性」的問題可透過調節價格來解決。

questions.en: The existence of scarcity implies that human wants are unlimited. all goods are economic goods. there is a cost in obtaining some goods. each and every economic good must have a market price.
questions.zh: 「稀少性」的存在意味着 人類慾望無窮。 所有物品都是經濟物品。 要獲得某些物品是有代價的。 每一經濟物品都必定有一個市價。

questions.en: In the absence of scarcity, there will be no discrimination. there will be no market price. there will be no goods. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 沒有稀少性， 歧視不會存在。 市價不會存在。 物品不會存在。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following situations imply the existence of scarcity? People need to choose between two options. People can obtain what they want by paying the market price. People cannot obtain what they want even after queuing up for hours. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些情況意味着稀少性的存在？ 人們須從兩個選項中擇其一。 人們可支付市價以獲得想要的東西。 人們即使排隊輪候數小時仍未能獲得想要的東西。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: In the absence of scarcity, ______ does NOT exist. interest comparative advantage shortage (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
Basic economic problems in a market economy are mainly solved by the government. the price mechanism. the entrepreneurs. the consumers.
questions.zh: 在市場經濟中，基本經濟問題主要由 政府解決。 價格機制解決。 企業家解決。 消費者解決。

questions.en: In a market economy, the allocation of goods and services among consumers is basically determined by the preference of the government. the preference of sellers. the controlled prices. the price mechanism.
questions.zh: 在市場經濟裏，消費者中誰會獲得貨物及勞務基本上是由______所決定的。 政府的偏好 供應者的偏好 受控制的價格 價格機制

questions.en: In the New Territories, an indigenous female resident (女性原居民) cannot inherit her father's property if her father dies without leaving a will. This is an example of resource allocation by government rationing. Market mechanism. Violence Social custom.
questions.zh: 新界的女性原居民，若父親死時沒有立下遺囑便不能繼承他的物業。這資源分配的準則是 政府配給。 市場機制。 暴力。 社會習俗。

questions.en: Hong Kong is considered to be market economy because it has a high per capita real gross domestic product (GDP). Price is used as a means to allocate resources in Hong Kong. It has a system of low taxes. Most of its resources are privately owned. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 香港被視為一市場經濟體系，因為 它的實質人均本地生產總值高。 在本港，價格是分配資源的工具。 它有一個低稅制度。 它的資源大部分是私人擁有的。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: As compared to a market economy, a planned economy has a less even income distribution. must have a lower inflation rate. must have a lower unemployment rate. has a smaller proportion of privately-owned resources.
questions.zh: 與市場經濟比較，計劃經濟的 收入分配較不平均。 通脹率必然較低。 失業率必然較低。 資源屬私有的佔較小比例。

questions.en: In a market-oriented economy, the living standard is higher than in a command economy. the unemployment rate is lower than in a command economy. resources are mostly allocated according to price signals. all infrastructure is privately owned.
questions.zh: 在一個市場導向的經濟裏， 人民的生活水準較在一個指令經濟裏為高。 失業率較在一個指令經濟裏為低。 資源分配多數由價格訊息所引導。 全部基建都是私人擁有的。

questions.en: Which of the following markets in Hong Kong rely heavily on price mechanism to solve the three basic economic problems? medical service education bank loans electrical appliances (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 在香港，下列哪一個市場非常依賴價格機制去解決三個基本經濟問題？ 醫療 教育 銀行貸款 電器用品 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a market economy is correct? All markets in the economy are perfectly competitive. Most resources in the economy are owned and controlled by individuals and private firms. Income is less evenly distributed in a market economy than in a command economy. The unemployment rate is higher in a market economy than in a command economy.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於市場經濟的描述是正確的？ 在市場經濟內，所有市場都是完全競爭的。 在市場經濟內，個人和私有廠商擁有和控制大部分資源。 與指令經濟相比，市場經濟的收入分配較不平均。 與指令經濟相比，市場經濟的失業率較高。

questions.en: An economy is considered as a market economy when the profits tax rate is low. prices are used to allocate resources. there is competition in all industries. there are no restrictions on the entry and exit of firms to all markets.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，一個經濟被視為市場經濟？ 它的利得稅率低。 它用價格來分配資源。 全部行業都有競爭。 在所有市場中，廠商加入或退出都沒有限制。

questions.en: Compared to a command economy, a market-oriented economy has a less even income distribution. keener competition for goods and services. more production guided by price signals. no problem of scarcity.
questions.zh: 與指令經濟相比，在市場主導經濟裏 收入分配較不平均。 為獲取物品和勞務的競爭更為激烈。 有更多生產是由價格訊息指導的。 沒有「稀少性」的問題。

questions.en: Which of the following statements is a correct description of a market-oriented economy? Most resources are privately owned. All economic problems are solved by the price mechanism. Income is less evenly distributed than in a command economy. There is no non-price competition.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項關於市場主導經濟的描述是正確的？ 大部分資源由私人擁有。 所有經濟問題均依賴價格機制解決。 相對於指令經濟，收入分配較不平均。 不存在非價格競爭。

questions.en: In a market economy, which of the following are guided by price signals? resource allocation production decisions consumption decisions (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在市場經濟裏，下列哪些是由價格訊息所指導的？ 資源分配 生產的決定 消費的決定 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Compared to a planned economy, a market economy must have a larger income gap between the rich and the poor. have higher inflationary pressure. have a higher unemployment rate. have a greater proportion of resources directed by the price mechanism.
questions.zh: 與計劃經濟比較，市場經濟必然 有更大的貧富之間的收入差距。 有更大的通脹壓力。 有更高的失業率。 有更高比例的資源是由價格機制指導的。

questions.en: An economy is considered as market-oriented when most of the markets are perfectly competitive. most of the resources are allocated by the price mechanism. most of the goods are economic goods. most of the public utilities are privately owned.
questions.zh: 在下列哪情況下，一個經濟會被視爲由市場主導的？ 多數市場是完全競爭市場。 多數資源由價格機制分配其用途。 多數物品是經濟物品。 多數公用事業是私人擁有的。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a market-oriented economy is correct? People who live in a market economy are richer than those in a planned economy. Most resources are used for producing consumer goods. Most markets are perfectly competitive. Most resources are privately owned.
questions.zh: 下列哪句關於市場導向經濟的描述是正確的？ 與在計劃經濟裏生活的人相比，在市場經濟裏生活的人較富有。 多數資源用於生產消費品。 多數市場是完全競爭的。 多數資源由私人擁有。

questions.en: In a market-oriented economy, most markets are perfectly competitive. most resources are allocated by prices. most production plans are made by the central authority. most firms produce consumer goods.
questions.zh: 在市場主導的經濟裏， 多數市場屬完全競爭。 多數資源是由價格分配的。 多數生產計劃是由中央政府決策的。 多數廠商都是生產消費者物品的。

questions.en: Hong Kong is regarded as a market-oriented economy because ________. the per capita real gross domestic product (GDP) is relatively high income is unevenly distributed most of the resources are allocated by the price mechanism most of the infrastructure is owned and controlled by private individuals
questions.zh: 香港被視爲市場主導的經濟，因爲 ________。 她的人均實質本地生產總值相對地高 收入分配不平均 大部分資源都是由價格機制來分配的 大部分基建都是私人擁有及控制的

questions.en: Which of the following is a characteristic of a market economy? Income distribution is uneven in the economy. The government has no role in regulating business activities in the economy. Most factors of production in the economy are privately owned. There is only price competition in the economy.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是市場經濟的一個特點？ 該經濟的收入分配不平均。 政府在調控該經濟內的商業活動中沒有角色。 該經濟的生產要素大多是私人擁有的。 該經濟內只有價格競爭。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a planned economy is correct? The quantity of public goods in the economy is greater than that in a market-oriented economy. Most production activities are carried out by government officials. All resources are allocated by government commands. Competitions still exist in the economy.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關計劃經濟的陳述是正確的？ 該經濟中共用品的數量比市場導向經濟的多。 大部分生產活動是由政府官員進行。 所有資源由政府指揮分配。 在該經濟中，競爭仍然存在。

questions.en: If a command economy turns into a market-oriented economy, the income distribution of the economy will be more uneven. more resources will be allocated by price mechanism. people will have private property rights over all resources. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 若一計劃經濟轉變為市場主導經濟， 該經濟的收入分佈會更不均。 更多的資源會以價格機制分配。 人們擁有全部資源的私有產權。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Compared to a planned economy, _____. individuals in a market economy tend to have higher freedom when deciding the allocation of resources interest rate in a market economy tends to be higher resource allocation in a market economy tends to rely less on non-price competition (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 與計劃經濟相比，______。 個人在市場經濟中決定資源分配時傾向有較高自由度 利率在市場經濟中傾向較高 資源分配在市場經濟中傾向較少依賴非價格競爭 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A free good is a good which nobody wants. is provided by the government free of charge. is not scarce. is plentiful in supply.
questions.zh: 免費物品是指 沒有人想要的物品。 由政府免費提供的物品。 並非「稀少」的物品。 供應充足的物品。

questions.en: Which of the following statements is correct? Scarcity exists only in poor countries. If there were plenty of rainwater in Hong Kong, the cost of the domestic water supply would be zero. The 9 years free education provided by the Hong Kong government is a scarce good. Economics is concerned with how free goods are distributed.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項陳述是正確的？ 稀少性只存在於貧窮國家。 若香港有充足的雨水，家居用水供應的成本將會是零。 香港政府提供的九年免費教育是一種稀少物品。 經濟學關注免費物品如何分配。

questions.en: Which of the following are economic goods? social welfare provided by the government gifts from parents flowers in a garden (1) and (2) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only (1),(2) and (3)
questions.zh: 以下哪幾項是「經濟財貨」？ 政府提供的社會福利 父母給予的禮物 花園裏的花朵 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(2) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: To society, used aluminium Coca-Cola cans are ________ because free goods; nobody wants them free goods; there are plenty of them economic goods; they have alternative uses economic goods; they were produced from scarce resources
questions.zh: 對社會而言，飲用後的可口可樂鋁罐是______，因為______。 自由財貨；沒有人想得到它們 自由財貨；它們為數不少 經濟財貨；它們有其他用途 經濟財貨；它們是「稀少性」資源製成的

questions.en: In Nathan Road one day, samples of a new brand of shampoo were given away free to passers-by. Within an hour, all available samples were gone. These free samples are ______ because ______. free goods; they are free of charge free goods; they are used for advertising purposes economic goods; the passers-by want them economic goods; they are limited in supply relative to people's wants
questions.zh: 某天在彌敦道上，路人獲免費送贈一新牌子洗頭水樣本。樣本在一小時之內全部送出。這些免費樣本是________因為________。 免費物品；它們是免費的 免費物品；它們是用來宣傳的 經濟物品；路過的人想得到這些樣本 經濟物品；相對於人的欲望來說，它們的供給有限

questions.en: To society, used paper for recycling is ______ because ______. a free good, it is free of charge a free good, it has no alternative uses an economic good, more than one people want it an economic good, people prefer to have more of it
questions.zh: 從社會觀點而言，將會循環再造的紙是 ________ 因為 ________ 。 免費物品……它是免費的 免費物品……它沒有其他用途 經濟物品……不只一人想獲得它 經濟物品……人們想獲得更多這些紙

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT true about a free good? Nobody wants to have more of it. Its price is zero. It is unlimited in supply. It has use value.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於免費物品的描述，並非正確？ 沒有人想獲得更多免費物品。 它的價格是零。 它的供應無限。 它有使用價值。

questions.en: Read the following advertisement: HOTEL ABC FREE BUFFET DINNER Buy two buffet dinners and get one free! (From Monday to Thursday) $200 for one person $400 for two persons plus a friend The free buffet dinner is a free good because the quantity supplied is greater than the quantity demanded. a free good because it is free of charge. an economic good because more of the food is preferred to less of it. an economic good because non-price competition is involved.
questions.zh: 參閱下列廣告： A B C 酒店 免費自助晚餐 凡惠顧兩客自助晚餐，送一客免費自助晚餐！ (星期一至星期四) 每位$200 每兩位$400，加送一位免費 那份免費的自助晚餐是 免費物品，因為供應量大過需求量。 免費物品，因為它是免費的。 經濟物品，因為人們喜愛獲得更多這些食物，而不是更少。 經濟物品，因為有非價格競爭。

questions.en: If a good is scarce, only a small quantity is available. its price will increase. its quantity supplied is smaller than its quantity demanded at all prices. more of it is preferred.
questions.zh: 若一物品是「稀少」的， 該物品的數量只有很少。 它的價格會上升。 在任何價格下供應量都少於需求量。 我們想獲得更多該物品。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about goods are correct? Free goods are free of charge. Natural resources are free goods. Inputs are economic goods. Outputs are economic goods. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪幾項關於物品的描述是正確的？ 「免費物品」是毋須繳費的。 天然資源是「免費物品」。 投入是經濟物品。 產出是經濟物品。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Jenny won a cooking competition and was awarded a famous brand microwave oven. This microwave oven is a free good because Jenny does not need to pay for it. a consumer good because it is a prize in the competition. an economic good because other competitors want to have it. a capital good because it has a market value.
questions.zh: 珍妮是某項烹飪比賽的冠軍，獎品是名牌微波焗爐一部。該焗爐是 「免費物品」，因為珍妮不用付費以獲取它。 消費品，因為它是比賽中的獎品。 經濟物品，因為其他參賽者都想獲得它。 資本物品，因為它有市場價值。

questions.en: For a resource to be a good, The resource must be limited in quantity. having some of the resource must be preferable to having none of it. there must be competition for the resource. All of the above.
questions.zh: 若要一項資源成為物品， 該資源在數量上必須是有限的。 擁有部分該資源必須比完全不擁有好。 必須對該資源存在競爭。 以上皆是。

questions.en: Good X is a ‘free good’ when there is no opportunity cost involved in using it. its quantity supplied is greater than what consumers are willing to purchase in the market. nobody wants more of it. its supply is so abundant that consumers place no value on it.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況中，物品 X 屬於「免費物品」？ 使用它沒有任何機會成本。 它的供應量超過消費者願意在市場上購買的數量。 沒有人想獲得更多數量的 X。 它的供應十分充裕，因此消費者認爲它沒有價值。

questions.en: A free good is a good that yields zero marginal benefit. average benefit. total benefit. consumer surplus.
questions.zh: 免費物品是指其 ＿＿＿＿ 為零的物品。 邊際利益 平均利益 總利益 消費者盈餘

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT classified as 'economic good'? a company's stock whose price has been falling for two months the votes for the candidates in a Legislative Council election stray and homeless dogs in the streets used paper collected for recycling
questions.zh: 下列哪一項並非歸類為「經濟物品」？ 一間公司的股票。這股票的價格在過去兩個月不斷下跌。 在一次立法會選舉中支持各候選人的選票。 在街上的流浪狗。 被收集作循環再造的已用過的紙張。

questions.en: A free good is less preferable than an economic good. has zero marginal benefit. is a good that has no demand. is a good provided by a generous person free of charge.
questions.zh: 免費物品 較經濟物品不受偏好。 邊際利益為零。 是沒有需求的物品。 是由慷慨的人免費提供的物品。

questions.en: In which of the following situations would ice in the North Pole be regarded as a free good? The ice is a gift of nature. More of the ice is not preferred. The price of the ice is zero. The quantity demanded of ice is smaller than the quantity supplied at a price greater than zero.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，北極裏的冰會被視爲「免費物品」？ 這些冰是大自然送給人類的禮物。 人類並不想得到更多這樣的冰。 這些冰的價格是零。 在價格大於零時，這些冰的需求量少於它的供應量。

questions.en: Nowadays, many people download their favourite songs and pictures through the Internet without paying any fee. To society, these songs and pictures are free goods because there are plenty of songs and pictures on the Internet. free goods because their original owners have not received any payments. economic goods because the cost involved in using the Internet is negligible. economic goods because there are costs involved in producing these songs and pictures.
questions.zh: 現今很多人在沒有付費的情況下，透過互聯網下載他們心愛的歌曲和圖片。對社會來說，這些歌曲和圖片屬於 免費物品，因爲網上有很多歌曲和圖片。 免費物品，因爲原來擁有它們的人或公司並沒有收到下載者任何付款。 經濟物品，因爲使用互聯網的代價微不足道。 經濟物品，因爲生產這些歌曲和圖片是有代價的。

questions.en: In some poor countries in Africa, people do not have enough food and have to eat rats. They have to dig into the ground in order to find these rats. The rats in the above case are not an economic good because rats are harmful to people. an economic good because more of them is preferred. a free good because there is no cost of producing rats. an economic good because rats can satisfy human wants.
questions.zh: 非洲某些貧窮的國家沒有足夠的糧食，人民要靠食老鼠為生。他們掘地來尋找老鼠。在上述個案中，這些老鼠 並非經濟物品，因為老鼠對人有害。 是經濟物品，因為當地人民喜歡有較多老鼠。 是「免費物品」，因為老鼠沒有生產成本。 是經濟物品，因為老鼠能滿足人類慾望。

questions.en: Good X is an economic good if more than one person needs it. more of it is preferred. it can satisfy human wants. it is limited in supply.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，甲物品是經濟物品？ 多於一個人需要甲物品。 人們希望獲得更多數量的甲物品。 甲物品能滿足人類慾望。 甲物品的供應有限。

questions.en: Competition will NOT arise if all individuals are identical. there is a monopoly in each and every market. there is no market. all goods are free goods.
questions.zh: 在以下哪種情況下，競爭將不會產生？ 所有個人都完全相同。 每個市場都存在壟斷。 沒有市場。 所有物品都是免費物品。

questions.en: Upon successful application for a credit card from a bank, Miss Chan obtains a digital versatile disc (DVD) player as a free gift. These free gifts are free goods, because successful applicants like Miss Chan have no cost to pay. free goods, because the quantity supplied is larger than the quantity demanded. economic goods, because more of these goods are preferred to less. economic goods, because the quantity available is limited.
questions.zh: 陳小姐由於成功申請某銀行的信用卡，獲得一部數碼影碟 (DVD) 機作為免費禮品。這些免費禮品是 「免費物品」，因為成功申請者如陳小姐不用付出代價。 「免費物品」，因為供給量大於需求量。 「經濟物品」，因為人們渴望得到更多此類物品。 「經濟物品」，因為供給的數量有限。

questions.en: Every July of the Lunar calendar, many charity organizations distribute packs of rice to people free of charge. Those who spend a lot of time queuing up for this rice are mostly elderly people. These packs of charity rice are economic goods because the quantity of this rice is limited. rice can satisfy people’s wants. the wants for this rice are unlimited. people want more of this rice.
questions.zh: 每年農曆七月都有不少慈善團體派發免費米予市民。長時間輪候這些免費米的人多數是年長者。這些免費米是經濟物品，因爲 這些米的數量有限。 米能滿足人們的慾望。 人們對這些米的慾望無窮。 人們想獲得更多這些米。

questions.en: A good is a free good if it is not rare or it can be found easily. there is enough of it available free of charge for everyone who wants it. there is enough of it available for everybody who pays the market price for it. no one owns it.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況中，某物品是「免費物品」？ 它並非罕有，或容易找得到。 它有足夠數量讓每個想獲得它的人都可以免費得到。 它有足夠數量讓每個付出市價的人都可得到。 沒有人擁有它。

questions.en: Free goods are unlimited in supply. are goods for which people will not pay a price to get more. can be found only in a planned economy but not in a market economy. exist only in theory but not in the real world.
questions.zh: 「免費物品」 的供應是無限的。 是人們不會為得到更多而付出代價的一種物品。 只能在計劃經濟中找到，不能在市場經濟中找到。 只存在於理論中，在真實世界中並不存在。

questions.en: Café ABC uses the following method to attract more customers. After purchasing a drink at the regular price, customers can get another drink free of charge. To society, the free drink is a/an free good because it is free of charge. free good because its quantity supplied is greater than its quantity demanded at any price. economic good because more of the drink is preferred. capital good because the café uses it to attract more customers.
questions.zh: ABC 咖啡店用以下方法吸引更多顧客。顧客以正價購買一杯飲品後，可以免費獲贈一杯相同飲品。從社會的角度看，該杯免費飲品是 「免費物品」，因爲它是免費的。 「免費物品」，因爲在任何價格下它的供應量都大於它的需求量。 經濟物品，因爲人們喜歡獲得更多該飲品。 資本物品，因爲該咖啡店用它來吸引更多顧客。

questions.en: An economic good is a good with its demand greater than its supply. brings us more satisfaction than a free good. is a good whose quantity available cannot satisfy human wants at zero price. cannot be found free of charge in any economy.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關經濟物品的陳述是正確的？ 經濟物品的需求比供應大。 與免費物品相比，經濟物品帶給我們較大的滿足感。 當價格是零，現有經濟物品的數量未能滿足人類的需要。 在任何經濟中找不到免費的經濟物品。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about economic goods is correct? Economic goods may not be scarce. People compete for economic goods. People prefer economic goods to free goods. People compete for both economic goods and free goods.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關經濟物品的陳述是正確的？ 經濟物品可能不是稀少的。 人們會對經濟物品進行競爭。 人們對經濟物品的偏好大於免費物品。 人們對經濟物品和免費物品均會進行競爭。

questions.en: Tommy was asked to choose one birthday present from the following three thins: a model spaceship, a walkman and a jacket. He liked the model spaceship the most and the walkman second. What would be his opportunity cost if he chose the model spaceship? a walkman a walkman and a jacket the price of a model spaceship no opportunity cost since it was a present
questions.zh: 湯美被要求從以下三件物品中選擇一份生日禮物：一個太空船模型、一部隨身聽和一件外套。他最喜歡太空船模型，其次是隨身聽。若他選擇了太空船模型，他的機會成本會是什麼？ 一部隨身聽 一部隨身聽和一件外套 太空船模型的價格 沒有機會成本，因為這是一份禮物

questions.en: Susan is choosing between two jobs: being a teacher and being a singer. If she chooses to be a singer, her opportunity cost will include the income from being a teacher. the income from being a singer. the tuition fee she paid for her training as a teacher. the tuition fee she paid for her training as a singer.
questions.zh: 蘇珊想在教書工作和歌唱事業兩者選擇其一。如果她選擇歌唱事業，她的機會成本會包括 作為教員的收入。 作為歌手的收入。 她已經支付的受訓做教員的學費。 她已經支付的受訓做歌手的學費。

questions.en: Which of the following are opportunity costs of attending school? school fees income forgone poor examination results expenditure on dinners (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 以下哪些項是上學讀書的機會成本？ 學費 所放棄的收入 差劣的考試成績 晚餐的開支 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Mr Wong could spend two hours at a concert or tutoring a student at $60 per hour. He could use the time on painting instead and earn a total of $150. If the price of the concert ticket is $300, what is the opportunity cost of his choice of going to the concert? $150 $300 $420 $450
questions.zh: 黃先生可以花兩小時出席一音樂會；或替學生補習，收費每小時$60。他又可用這段時間來繪畫，賺取$150。若音樂會的票價為$300，他選擇出席該音樂會的機會成本是多少？ $150 $300 $420 $450

questions.en: Mr. Lee owns a photographic studio. Previously he received $30000 per month by letting it out. He now does not let the studio, but, instead he uses the premises for his own business. He also employs a model at $10000 per month. What is Mr. Lee’s opportunity cost of using the studio by himself? $10000 per month $20000 per month $30000 per month $40000 per month
questions.zh: 李先生擁有一間攝影室。以往他出租攝影室時，每月可收到三萬元租金。現在，他不將攝影室出租，而用它來經營自己的生意，並且以月薪一萬元聘用一位模特兒。 李先生自己使用這攝影室的機會成本是甚麼？ 每月一萬元 每月二萬元 每月三萬元 每月四萬元

questions.en: Fanny can choose among three different jobs. Her choice of preference is as follows: First priority: being a teacher in School X Second priority: being a secretary in Company Y Third priority: being a sales representative in Firm Z Assuming her choice of preference remains unchanged, which of the following will increase Fanny’s opportunity cost of being a teacher in School X? The students in School X are becoming more naughty. Company Y requires its secretaries to work longer hours. Company Y decides to increase the salaries of its secretaries. Firm Z decides to increase the bonuses for its sales representatives.
questions.zh: 芬妮可在三份工作中選擇其一。她的選擇偏好如下： 首選： 在 X 學校當教師 次選： 在 Y 公司當秘書 第三選擇： 在 Z 廠商當營業代表 假設芬妮的選擇偏好次序不變，下列哪一種情況會增加她在 X 學校當教師的機會成本？ X 學校的學生變得更頑劣。 Y 公司要求它的秘書增加工作時間。 Y 公司決定增加它的秘書的薪金。 Z 廠商決定增加它的營業代表的年終獎金。

questions.en: John lives in this own apartment which is worth is worth $1 million. He can sell the apartment and put the money in a bank at an interest rate of 5% per year. He can also rent out the apartment at $5000 a month. What is the opportunity cost to John if he decides to live in the apartment? $1 million $50000 a year $5000 a month There is no opportunity cost because he lives in his own apartment.
questions.zh: 大強居住於自己擁有的住宅單位，該單位價值一百萬元。他可以出售該單位，將所獲金錢存於銀行，以年息率 5%來收息。他亦可以將該單位出租，每月收取租金 $5,000。對大強來說，他決定在該單位自住的機會成本是什麼？ 一百萬元。 每年 $50,000。 每月 $5,000。 沒有機會成本，因為他用來自住。

questions.en: Max Department Store has launched a promotion campaign. For every purchase of $1 000, customers are given a coupon to exchange for the following gifts: Number of Coupons Gifts 10 1 camera 20 1 TV set 30 1 air ticket John has accumulated 30 coupons. What is the opportunity cost to John if he uses them to exchange for one air ticket? a TV set $30 000 a camera and a TV set a camera, a TV set and $30 000
questions.zh: 麥氏百貨公司展開推廣活動：凡顧客每購物滿$1,000，便可獲得一張換物券，換取下列禮物： 換物券（張數） 禮物 10 1 部攝影機 20 1 部電視機 30 1 張機票 大雄累積了 30 張換物券，若他拿來換取一張機票，他的機會成本是什麼？ 一部電視機 $30,000 一部攝影機和一部電視機 一部攝影機、一部電視機和$30,000

questions.en: Later, John finds that he has to queue up to exchange his coupons for gifts. The queue shows that these gifts are truly free of charge. there is a shortage of gifts for all the customers. the promotion campaign is successful and there is an increase in the demand for the company’s products. customers has an extra cost to obtain the gifts.
questions.zh: 後來，大雄發現用換物券來換取禮物必須排隊輪候。排隊輪候這件事顯示 這些禮物是真正免費的。 禮物數量短缺，不足以分派給全部顧客。 該推廣活動是成功的，同時該公司的產品需求亦有所增加。 顧客要獲得禮物須付出額外的代價。

questions.en: Before the sale of a big residential estate, many elderly people queued up outside the site office for potential buyers. This implies that the value of the flats to these elderly people was higher than to young people. the price of the flats was above the equilibrium level because there was a shortage. the opportunity cost of the queuing time of these elderly people was lower than that of the potential buyers. the opportunity cost of the queuing time of these elderly people was zero because they did not have a job.
questions.zh: 在某大型屋邨出售前，地盤辦事處門外有很多老人替準買家排隊輪候。這意味： 以這些老人和年輕人相比，該批樓宇對前者來說價值較高。 由於有短缺出現，該批樓宇的價格高於均衡水平。 這些老人排隊所用時間的機會成本，較準買家的為低。 這些老人排隊所用時間的機會成本為零，因為他們沒有工作。

questions.en: Chan and Wong take a journey to City X separately. They can go there either by plane or by train. The plane takes 2 hours while the train takes 10 hours. The air ticket costs $1 000 while the train fare is $200. During the journey to City X, the foregone earning of Chan is $200 per hour and that of Wong is $80 per hour. For the journey to City X, Chan would take the __________ and Wong would take the __________. train ... train train ... plane plane ... train plane ... plane
questions.zh: 陳先生和黃先生分別前往 X 城，他們可以乘飛機或火車前往。飛機需時 2 小時而火車需時 10 小時。飛機票價 $1 000 而火車票價 $200。在前往 X 城的旅程中，陳先生放棄的收入是每小時 $200 而黃先生放棄的收入是每小時 $80。 若要前往 X 城，陳先生會乘搭 ______ 而黃先生會乘搭 ______。 火車 ... 火車 火車 ... 飛機 飛機 ... 火車 飛機 ... 飛機

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT an opportunity cost of constructing Disneyland in Hong Kong? the alternative use of the site the amount of capital invested the pollution created by the construction work the entrance fee of Disneyland
questions.zh: 下列哪一項並非在香港興建迪士尼樂園的機會成本？ 園址的其他用途。 投資的金額。 建築工程造成的污染。 迪士尼樂園的入場費。

questions.en: When convicted for the same crime, a wealthy person is often punished less severely than a poor person by the court because the wealthy person can hire better and more lawyers. However, the total cost of the crime to a wealthy person is higher because his earning is higher. his social status is worth more. he will have a larger decline in future income. All of the above.
questions.zh: 當因同一罪行而被定罪時，富人往往被法庭判處較輕的刑罰，因為富人能聘請更好且更多的律師。然而，犯罪對富人而言的總成本較高，因為 他的收入較高。 他的社會地位更有價值。 他未來的收入將有較大幅度的減少。 以上皆是。

questions.en: Which of the following will change the cost to an individual of attending a concert? He is an hour late for the concert due to traffic congestion. His view is blocked by the audience in front of him. The singer performs badly. The concert overruns by an hour.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會改變某甲入場觀看演唱會的機會成本？ 因爲交通擠塞，他遲了一小時才入場觀看演唱會。 他的視線被前面的觀眾遮擋著。 歌手的表演差勁。 這場演唱會超時一小時。

questions.en: Mr Lee lives in his own house. He bears an opportunity cost from living in that house because he could earn rental income from letting the house to others. he has to pay property tax to the government. he has paid a sum of money to buy the house. (1) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 李先生在自置物業裏居住。他在該居所內居住是有機會成本的，因爲 他可將該居所出租，以賺取租金收入。 他要繳付物業稅給政府。 他支付了一筆金錢，以購買該居所。 只有 (1) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following would affect the cost of constructing the West Rail? an increase in the damage to the natural environment along the railway caused by the construction an increase in the wages of the maintenance staff for the operation of the train service a decrease in the profit from providing the train service a decrease in the revenue of the bus company operating a bus service along the railway
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會影響建造西鐵的代價？ 建築工程對沿鐵路線自然環境造成的損害增加。 該鐵路維修員工的工資增加。 該項火車服務的利潤減少。 提供鐵路沿線巴士服務的巴士公司收益減少。

questions.en: Peter is an F.5 graduate who could not get a study place in F.6. Which of the following may lower the cost of repeating F.5 for Peter? The tuition fee for study in F.5 increases. The tuition fee for study in F.6 decreases. The wage rate for F.5 graduates decreases. Peter’s new F.5 English teacher teaches badly.
questions.zh: 喜福是中五畢業生，但找不到中六學位就讀。下列哪一項可能減低他重讀中五的代價？ 入讀中五學費增加。 入讀中六學費下降。 中五畢業生的工資率下降。 喜福的新的中五英文科老師教得差勁。

questions.en: Medical doctors seldom change their occupation. Which of the following can explain this phenomenon? They have spent much time and effort in getting their professional licence. They have incurred high costs in accumulating the skills and knowledge required for the profession. For medical doctors, changing occupation has a high cost. Being medical doctors has a high cost.
questions.zh: 醫生少有轉業。下列哪一項可解釋此現象？ 他們已花費大量時間及努力以獲取執業牌照。 他們已付出高昂代價以累積專業知識和技能。 他們轉業須付出高昂代價。 他們當醫生須付出高昂代價。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the concept of opportunity cost is correct? Opportunity cost still exists even when there are no choices. Opportunity cost does not exist in a planned economy. When the value of an option decreases, the opportunity cost of choosing that option does not change. When the value of the highest-valued option increases, the opportunity cost of choosing that option will decrease.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於機會成本概念的陳述是正確的？ 即使沒有選擇，還是有機會成本。 在計劃經濟中並沒有機會成本。 當某選擇的價值下降時，揀選該選擇的機會成本不會改變。 當「價值最高的選擇」的價值增加時，揀選該項選擇的機會成本會下降。

questions.en: David is choosing between two ways of spending his summer vacation: to take a summer job or to join an exchange programme to the United Kingdom. Which of the following will increase his opportunity cost of taking the summer job? The fee for the exchange programme increases. The summer job pays a higher salary. A valuable course is added to the exchange programme. Less training for the summer job is provided.
questions.zh: 大衛可選擇以下兩種方式之一度過他的暑假：做暑期工或參加一項前往英國的交流計劃。下列哪一項會增加他做暑期工的機會成本？ 該交流計劃的費用增加了。 該暑期工的工資提高了。 該交流計劃多提供一項有價值的課程。 從該暑期工中獲得的培訓減少了。

questions.en: A resident of Mainland China is choosing between a tour to Hong Kong and a tour to Macau organized by a travel agent. His opportunity cost of choosing to visit Hong Kong will increase if the food provided during his trip in Hong Kong is poorer than expected. he is abandoned on the streets in Hong Kong by the tour guide. newly developed tourist attractions in Macau make it more enjoyable to visit Macau. the rental of hotel accommodation in Macau increases.
questions.zh: 一位中國內地居民考慮在下列二者選擇其一：參加某旅行社主辦的旅行團往香港旅行或往澳門旅行。在下列哪一種情況下，他選擇往訪香港的機會成本會增加？ 在香港的旅程中，食物的質素較預期為差。 給導遊遺棄在香港的街頭。 澳門新發展的景點使澳門的旅客更享受其旅程。 澳門的酒店房租上升。

questions.en: Which of the following could raise the cost of drug abuse? The price of drugs increases. The government imposes heavier punishments on drug abuse. Drug abuse causes greater damage to one’s health. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會增加濫用藥物的代價？ 藥物價格上升。 政府加重對濫用藥物的懲罰。 濫用藥物對人的健康產生更大的傷害。 以上全部正確。

questions.en: Which of the following situations will increase the opportunity cost to Form 7 graduates of receiving a university education? The university undergraduate programme increases from 3 years to 4 years. The wage rate of Form 7 graduates increases. The academic performance of university graduates generally declines. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪種情況會增加中七畢業生接受大學教育的機會成本？ 大學學士課程由三年制轉為四年制。 中七畢業生的工資率上升。 一般大學畢業生的學術水平下降。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Julie is choosing between Hong Kong and the US to complete her university education. Her opportunity cost of studying in the US will increase when the number of scholarships offered by the universities in the US increases. the tuition fee of the universities in Hong Kong increases. the university graduates of Hong Kong become less competitive in the job market than those of the US. the standard of professional training programs offered by the universities in Hong Kong improves.
questions.zh: 朱莉選擇在香港或美國完成她的大學教育。在下列哪種情況下，她在美國求學的機會成本會上升？ 美國的大學增加獎學金的名額。 香港的大學增加學費。 與美國的大學畢業生相比，香港的大學畢業生在就業市場的競爭力下降。 香港的大學提供的專業訓練課程的水平有所提高。

questions.en: A piece of land can be used for the construction of a high speed railway, a highway, a tunnel or a cultural hub. Suppose the money value of the expected return generated by each project is $800 000, $750 000, $650 000 and $550 000 respectively. The opportunity cost of using this piece of land for the construction of a highway is ________ and the opportunity cost of using this piece of land for the construction of a tunnel is ________. $650 000 … $550 000 $750 000 … $650 000 $800 000 … $750 000 $800 000 … $800 000
questions.zh: 一塊土地可用來建造高速鐵路、高速公路、隧道或文化區綜合發展項目。假設以上各項可帶來的預期回報的金錢價值分別為 $800 000、$750 000、$650 000 及 $550 000。 使用該塊土地來建造高速公路的機會成本是 ________；而使用該塊土地來建造隧道的機會成本是 ________。 $650 000 ... $550 000 $750 000 ... $650 000 $800 000 ... $750 000 $800 000 ... $800 000

questions.en: Mary is choosing between two ways of spending her Christmas vacation: to work for her uncle and earn $3 000 or to join a cultural tour to Beijing. Which of the following will lower Mary’s opportunity cost of working for her uncle? Mary’s uncle reduces her wage to $2 000. The fee for the cultural tour decreases. An attractive section of the cultural tour is canceled. Mary’s uncle agrees to employ her best friend to work with her.
questions.zh: 瑪莉正從下列兩種方式中選擇一個來度過她的聖誕假期：替叔叔工作以賺取三千元；參加一個前往北京的文化之旅。 下列哪項會減低瑪莉替叔叔工作的機會成本？ 瑪莉的叔叔將她的人工減至兩千元。 參加文化之旅的費用下降。 文化之旅其中一個精彩項目被取消。 瑪莉的叔叔同意聘請她最要好的朋友與她一起工作。

questions.en: Mr. Chan spent $5 000 on buying a new mobile phone which can be sold for $7 000 in the second-hand market. Mr. Chan’s cost of keeping the mobile phone is __________. $0 $2 000 $5 000 $7 000
questions.zh: 陳先生花了 $5000 購買一部新手提電話，該電話可在二手市場以 $7000 售出。陳先生保留該手提電話的成本是 ________。 $0 $2000 $5000 $7000

questions.en: Mr Kwok plans to purchase a new racing car from a German automobile manufacturer and drive the car in Hong Kong. In which of the following situations will the cost of purchasing the racing car increase? The first registration fee increases. The price of gasoline increases. The Euro depreciates against the Hong Kong dollar. The racing car performs poorly.
questions.zh: 郭先生計劃從德國的汽車製造商購買一部新跑車，並在香港駕駛。下列哪種情況會令購買該部跑車的成本上升？ 首次登記費上升。 汽油價格上升。 歐元兌港元貶值。 該跑車性能欠佳。

questions.en: Jeremy is going to watch a tennis match in which Li Na (李娜), a Grand Slam (大滿貫) winner, will play. Which of the following will increase the cost to Jeremy of watching the tennis match? He is 30 minutes late for the match due to traffic congestion. His view is blocked by the spectators in front of him. Due to a rainstorm, the match is extended by an hour. Li Na is injured and does not show up for the match.
questions.zh: 書豪將觀看大滿貫得主李娜參與的一場網球比賽。下列哪項會令書豪觀看該場網球比賽的成本上升？ 由於交通擠塞，他遲到了 30 分鐘。 他的視線被前面的觀眾阻擋。 由於暴雨關係，比賽時間延長了一小時。 李娜受傷，沒有出場比賽。

questions.en: A famous football team, Manchester United, visited Hong Kong for a friendly match. The day before the match, the team found the pitch in the Hong Kong Stadium had been damaged by prolonged rain and it considered cancelling the match. The opportunity cost for Manchester United to continue playing in such a poor pitch would __________ because __________. increase ... there was a higher chance for the players to get injured increase ... the team was likely to have poor performance remain unchanged ... the expense on the visit to Hong Kong had already been paid remain unchanged ... the players spent the same amount of time in Hong Kong
questions.zh: 著名足球隊曼聯到訪香港進行一場友誼賽。比賽的前一天，該隊發現香港大球場的草地被連場大雨破壞，該隊考慮取消比賽。曼聯繼續在該惡劣草地進行比賽的機會成本會 ________，因爲 ________。 上升 …… 球員受傷的機會增加了 上升 …… 球隊很有可能表現差劣 維持不變 …… 球隊已經支付了到訪香港的開支 維持不變 …… 球員在香港所花的時間是相同的

questions.en: David can choose to take the MTR or a bus to Yuen Long. Suppose the required travel time and the fares of both options are the same in a normal situation. Which of the following will result in an increase in the opportunity cost of travelling to Yuen Long by MTR? The air-conditioner on the bus is out of order. The traffic jam makes the bus trip 15 minutes longer. A signalling problem causes the travel time of the MTR to increase by 15 minutes. David feels annoyed about the news broadcast in the MTR train.
questions.zh: 大衛可選擇乘搭港鐵列車或巴士往元朗。假設上述兩種選擇所需的交通時間和車費在正常情況下均相同。下列哪項會引致乘搭港鐵列車往元朗的機會成本上升？ 巴士的空調設備發生故障。 交通阻塞令巴士車程延長了 15 分鐘。 訊號問題令港鐵列車車程增加了 15 分鐘。 大衛對港鐵列車車廂內的新聞廣播感到煩擾。

questions.en: Mr Ng, a Hong Kong citizen, is going to travel to Tokyo for leisure. Which of the following will decrease his cost of having the trip? A typhoon is approaching Tokyo right before his trip. His boss is going to treat all the staff to a free buffet during his leave. The scenery in Tokyo is better than he expected. Japanese Yen depreciates against other currencies.
questions.zh: 一名香港市民吳先生準備前往東京旅遊。下列哪項會令他去這次旅遊的成本下降？ 在他出發前，有一颱風剛剛移近東京。 在他放假期間，他的老闆將會請全體同事享用自助餐。 東京的風景比他想像中更優美。 日圓兌其他貨幣貶值。

questions.en: Which of the following would be the loss(es) of delaying the completion of a new railway to an economy? the travel time of passengers that would have been saved by the new railway during the period of delay the damage to the corporate image of the railway constructor for the delay the nuisance to the shops and residents nearby during the period of delay (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 對某經濟而言，下列哪 (幾) 項屬延遲建成一條新鐵路的損失？ 該新鐵路原本在延遲期間能為乘客節省的交通時間 因新鐵路工程延遲對承建商公司形象所造成的損害 對新鐵路附近的商店及居民在延遲期間所造成的滋擾 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: John, a Secondary 6 graduate, is considering studying a programme either in Hong Kong or the Mainland. Which of the following situations would lower his opportunity cost of studying the programme in Hong Kong? His tuition fee of the first year will be waived if he studies the programme in Hong Kong. The graduates of the Mainland programme have better job prospects. The qualification of the Mainland programme may not be recognised in Hong Kong. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 約翰是一名中六畢業生，他正考慮留港或到內地修讀一個課程。下列哪些情況會降低他留港修讀該課程的機會成本？ 若他留港修讀該課程，他首年的學費會獲豁免。 該內地課程的畢業生就業前景較佳。 該內地課程所頒授的學術資格在港可能不獲承認。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Mr Lo spent $60000 on buying a second hand car three years ago. Suppose he can resell the car at $2000. Alternatively, he needs to spend $5000 on repairing the car before he can continue to use it. What is his cost of continuing to use the car? $2000 $5000 $7000 $60000
questions.zh: 盧先生三年前用 $60000 買入一輛二手車。假設他能以 $2000 將該車轉售。或者，他需要花 $5000 維修該車，才可以繼續使用它。他繼續使用該車的成本是多少？ $2000 $5000 $7000 $60000

questions.en: After graduating from secondary school, Paul considers whether to become a full-time Key Opinion Leader (KOL) in social media channels or to become an e-sports player. Which of the following will lower Paul’s cost of being a full-time KOL after his graduation? Paul receives sponsored video equipment for KOL. The e-sports team offers a lower basic salary to Paul. The risk of social media channels being attacked by hackers increases. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 中學畢業後，保羅考慮成為全職的社交媒體頻道關鍵意見領袖 KOL（俗稱網紅）或成為電競選手。 下列哪些會減低保羅畢業後成為全職 KOL 的成本？ 保羅獲得錄製 KOL影片器材的贊助。 電競隊給予保羅較低的基本薪金。 社交媒體頻道被駭客攻擊的風險增加。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Because of COVID-19, normal schooling was disrupted. Most schools used video communication software, such as Zoom and Google Meet, to conduct online lessons. Suppose the school campus was re-opened and face-to-face lessons were allowed. Which of the following would be the LEAST important factor for teachers to choose between online lessons and face-to-face lessons? The risk of contracting COVID-19 for teachers is lower when they conduct online lessons. Teachers have no idea what their students are doing during online lessons because students may turn off their cameras. Teachers have already spent a lot of time learning how to use the video communication software to conduct online lessons. The eyesight of teachers may be worsened by the intensive use of the video communication software in conducting online lessons.
questions.zh: 由於新冠肺炎，學校的日常教學受到干擾，大部分學校使用視訊軟件（例如 Zoom 和 Google Meet）進行網上授課。假設校園重新開放，並准許面對面授課。 下列哪項是教師選擇網上授課還是面對面授課時最不重要的因素？ 網上授課會減低教師感染新冠肺炎的風險。 教師不知道網上授課時學生正在做什麼，因為學生可能關掉鏡頭。 教師已經花費很多時間學習使用視訊軟件進行網上授課。 頻密使用視訊軟件進行網上授課可導致教師的視力受損。

questions.en: Tommy is planning for his future after his S.6 graduation. He has several options and his order of preference is as follows. First option: Being a barista in a café Second option: Being a trainee in digital marketing Third option: Being a junior fireman Which of the following factors would LEAST likely affect the cost-benefit analysis for Tommy’s career choice? Coffee culture becomes more popular. More companies expand their digital marketing departments. The remuneration of junior firemen worsens. Safety measures of fire-fighting are improved drastically.
questions.zh: 湯美中六畢業，正計劃將來。他有數個選項，其優先次序如下： 第一選項： 在咖啡店當一名咖啡師 第二選項： 當一名數碼市場推廣業的實習生 第三選項： 當一名初級消防員 在湯美的就業選擇中，下列哪項因素最不可能影響他的成本效益分析？ 咖啡文化愈趨普及。 更多公司擴張其數碼市場推廣部。 初級消防員的薪金下降。 救火的安全措施大幅改善。

questions.en: Mr Cheung bought restaurant premises 2 years ago for $5 000 000 and sells ‘two-dish-rice’ meal boxes at the premises. Recently, his monthly profit has decreased from $30000 to $10000 due to the opening of new restaurants nearby. A businessman offers to rent Mr Cheung’s restaurant premises for a monthly rental of $15000. Which of the following would be included in Mr Cheung’s opportunity cost of continuing to operate his ‘two-dish-rice’ business at the premises? the $5 000 000 purchase price of the restaurant premises the $10000 monthly profit the $15000 monthly rental the $20000 drop in monthly profit
questions.zh: 張先生兩年前以 $5000000 購入一個餐廳鋪位，並於該鋪位出售「兩餸飯」。由於他的店鋪附近最近開了一些新餐廳，導致他每月的利潤由 $30000 下降至 $10000。一名商人提出以每月 $15000 租金租用張先生的鋪位。 下列哪項屬張先生繼續於該鋪位經營「兩餸飯」生意的機會成本？ 該鋪位的購入價 $5000000 每月 $10000 的利潤 每月 $15000 的租金 每月減少了的 $20000 利潤

questions.en: Jacky, a Secondary 6 student in Hong Kong, is going to travel to Korea for his graduation trip. Which of the following will decrease his cost of having the graduation trip to Korea? Hong Kong dollar appreciates against South Korean Won. The return flight from Korea to Hong Kong is delayed. The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in Korea has increased drastically. The services of the hotel in Korea are better than his expectation.
questions.zh: 志傑是一名香港中六學生，他打算到韓國畢業旅行。以下哪項會令他到韓國畢業旅行的成本下降？ 港元兌韓圜升值。 由韓國飛往香港的回程航班延誤。 韓國的新冠肺炎確診宗數大幅上升。 韓國的酒店服務比他預期的好。

questions.en: Mr Chan lives in his own apartment which is worth $8 000 000. He can sell the apartment and deposit the $8 000 000 in a bank at an interest rate of 5% per year. He can also rent out the apartment at $25 000 a month. Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct? When the market value of his apartment increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment will not be affected. When the deposit interest rate increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment will increase. When the rental value of his apartment increases, the opportunity cost for Mr Chan to live in his own apartment may increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 陳先生居住在自己擁有的住宅單位，該單位價值 $8 000 000。他可以出售該單位，並將所得的 $8 000 000 存入銀行，以年利率 5% 來收取利息。他亦可以將該單位出租，每月收取租金 $25 000。 根據上述資料，下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 當陳先生的住宅單位的市值上升時，他居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本不會受影響。 當存款利率上升時，陳先生居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本會上升。 當陳先生的住宅單位的租值上升時，他居住在自己擁有的住宅單位的機會成本可能上升。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Susan planned to watch a concert and bought a ticket of the concert for $1500. Soon after Susan bought the ticket, a company offered to pay her $3000 for a part-time job. However, the work hours of the part-time job clashed with the time of the concert. At the same time, as all tickets were sold out, her friend offered to buy her concert ticket for $1800. Based on the above information, at the time when Susan was deciding whether to sell the concert ticket to her friend, her opportunity cost of choosing to watch the concert would be _____. $3300 $4500 $4800 $6300
questions.zh: 蘇珊計劃觀看一場演唱會，並以 $1500 購買了一張該場演唱會的門票。蘇珊剛購買門票後，一間公司給予她一份薪酬 $3000 的兼職工作。然而，該兼職的工作時間與該場演唱會的時間相撞。與此同時，由於所有門票經已售罄，她的朋友提出以 $1800 購買她那張演唱會門票。 根據以上資料，在蘇珊決定是否將演唱會門票出售予她的朋友時，她選擇觀看該場演唱會的機會成本是 _____。 $3300 $4500 $4800 $6300

questions.en: Private dentists in Shenzhen generally charge lower fees than those in Hong Kong. Despite the longer travel time to Shenzhen, many Hong Kong residents still choose to visit private dentists in Shenzhen. Which of the following statements about the above phenomenon are correct? The cost of Hong Kong residents to visit private dentists in Shenzhen would increase if more time is required to cross the border. The service quality of private dentists in both places would not affect the cost of Hong Kong residents to visit private dentists in Shenzhen. Those Hong Kong residents with higher time costs tend to visit local private dentists in Hong Kong instead of private dentists in Shenzhen. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 深圳的私家牙醫收費一般較香港的私家牙醫低。儘管前往深圳需時較長，許多香港居民仍選擇前往深圳私家牙醫求診。 下列哪些有關上述現象的陳述是正確的？ 當過境所需時間增加，香港居民前往深圳私家牙醫求診的成本會上升。 兩地私家牙醫的服務質素不會影響香港居民前往深圳私家牙醫求診的成本。 那些時間成本較高的香港居民傾向在本地私家牙醫求診，而非前往深圳私家牙醫求診。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Interest exists in the absence of money. risks. a banking system. All of the above.
questions.zh: 在沒有以下哪項的情況下，利息依然存在？ 貨幣 風險 銀行體系 以上皆是

questions.en: Which of the following statements about interest are correct? Interest is a premium received for postponing current consumption. An interest rate does not exist in a barter economy. A fall in the interest rate increases present consumption. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些有關利息的陳述是正確的？ 利息是就延遲當時消費所收取的一個溢價。 在以物易物經濟中，利率並不存在。 利率下降會增加現時的消費。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about interest is correct? People will reduce current consumption when the interest rate drops. The interest rate will be zero if there is no inflation. Interest does not exist in a planned economy. Interest still exists without money.
questions.zh: 下列哪項關於利息的陳述是正確的？ 當利率下跌時，人們便會減少現時的消費。 若沒有通脹，利率便會是零。 在計劃經濟中，利息不存在。 沒有貨幣，利息仍然存在。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about interest are correct? Interest is the compensation for deferring consumption. Interest exists because people are impatient to wait. Interest exists in a barter economy. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些有關利息的陳述是正確的？ 利息是延後消費的補償。 因為人們沒有耐性等待，所以利息存在。 利息在以物易物的經濟中存在。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about interest is correct? Without money, interest does not exist. Without inflation, interest does not exist. Without scarcity, interest does not exist. Interest is the compensation paid to the borrower for delayed consumption.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關利息的陳述是正確的？ 沒有貨幣，利息不會存在。 沒有通脹，利息不會存在。 沒有稀少性，利息不會存在。 利息是對借款人延遲消費的補償。

questions.en: For some types of dry-cured ham (風乾火腿), their flavour improves as they are air-dried for a longer time, and therefore can be sold at higher prices. In this case, interest is ______ because ______. involved ... consumers are willing to pay higher prices for deferring consumption involved ... dry-cured ham producers receive compensation for obtaining income later not involved ... extending the curing time of ham does not affect their production costs not involved ... no borrowing or lending activities are involved
questions.zh: 某些類型的風乾火腿隨着風乾時間的增加，其風味會提升，並因此能以更高的價格出售。 這個案 ______ 利息，因為 ______。 涉及 …… 消費者願意為延後消費支付更高的價格 涉及 …… 風乾火腿的生產者因較遲得到收入而獲得補償 不涉及 …… 延長火腿的風乾時間並不影響其生產成本 不涉及 …… 沒有涉及任何借貸活動

questions.en: The Housing Authority is considering whether it should raise the income limits of families for the application of public housing. What basic economic problem(s) is/are involved in this consideration? What to produce? How to produce? For whom to produce? What and for whom to produce?
questions.zh: 房屋委員會正考慮是否將公共房屋申請人的家庭入息限額提高。這考慮牽涉到什麼基本經濟問題？ 生產什麼？ 如何生產？ 為誰生產？ 生產什麼及為誰生產？

questions.en: Since the opening of Hong Kong Disneyland, some people have suggested a reduction of the ticket price. This suggestion is related to the __________ question(s) in Economics. ‘what to produce’ ‘how to produce’ ‘for whom to produce’ ‘what, how and for whom to produce’
questions.zh: 香港迪士尼樂園開幕後，有人建議減低票價。該建議與經濟學上的 ________ 問題有關。 生產什麼 怎樣生產 爲誰生產 生產什麼、怎樣生產和爲誰生產

questions.en: A large number of pregnant mainland women give birth to babies in Hong Kong's public hospitals. Some people have suggested imposing an additional surcharge on these women so as to reduce the number of them in Hong Kong's public hospitals. The above suggestion concerning the service of the public hospitals in Hong Kong is the ______ question in Economics. 'how to produce' 'for whom to produce' 'what to produce' 'how and for whom to produce'
questions.zh: 大量內地孕婦在香港的公立醫院分娩。有人建議向這些孕婦徵收附加費，以減少在香港公立醫院分娩的內地孕婦的數量。 上述有關香港公立醫院服務的建議是經濟學上 ________ 的問題。 「怎樣生產」 「爲誰生產」 「生產什麼」 「怎樣及爲誰生產」

questions.en: Which of the following illustrates the ‘For whom to produce’ question in Economics? Local manufacturers set up factories in Guangdong to lower production costs. The local government is developing cruise tourism in Hong Kong and the Asia Pacific region. The Hong Kong Science Museum offers free admission to full-time students and senior citizens. More Hong Kong licensed banks are engaged in the issuance of Renminbi bonds.
questions.zh: 下列哪項可以說明經濟學上的「爲誰生產」問題？ 本港製造商在廣東省設立工廠以減低生產成本。 本港政府正發展香港及亞太地區的郵輪旅遊。 香港科學館提供免費入場予全日制學生和長者。 香港有更多持牌銀行加入發行人民幣債券的行列。

questions.en: Suppose the government provides more subsidized housing to the middle-income group. This policy relates to the ________ question in economics. ‘what to produce’ ‘how to produce’ ‘for whom to produce’ ‘what and for whom to produce’
questions.zh: 假設政府提供更多資助房屋予中等收入人士。上述政策與經濟學上的 ________ 問題有關。 「生產什麼」 「怎樣生產」 「爲誰生產」 「生產什麼及爲誰生產」

questions.en: The Hong Kong government proposes to build new towns with residential flats and shopping malls in the North District. However, there are concerns about the ratio of public housing to private housing. Some people are also worried about the size of shopping malls, which may mainly serve mainland tourists. The above case is related to the __________ question(s) in Economics. “for whom to produce” “what to produce” and “how to produce” “what to produce” and “for whom to produce” “how to produce” and “for whom to produce”
questions.zh: 香港政府建議在北區興建有住宅樓宇和商場的新市鎮。其中公共房屋與私人房屋的比例引起不少人關注。另外，亦有人憂慮商場的規模，指這些商場可能主要為內地遊客服務。 上述個案和經濟學中的 ______ 問題有關。 「爲誰生產」 「生產什麼」及「怎樣生產」 「生產什麼」及「為誰生產」 「怎樣生產」及「為誰生產」

questions.en: Mei Ho House (美荷樓), a public housing block built in the 1950s, was recently graded as a historic building in Hong Kong. The building was then turned into a hostel which provides double rooms, family rooms and disabled rooms. The above case is related to the __________ question(s) in Economics. “how to produce” “for whom to produce” “what to produce” and “how to produce” “what to produce” and “for whom to produce”
questions.zh: 美荷樓是一幢在五十年代興建的公共樓宇。近日該樓宇被評爲香港歷史建築後，它被改建為旅舍，提供雙人房、家庭房及傷健人士房間。上述個案和經濟學中的 ________ 問題有關。 「怎樣生產」 「爲誰生產」 「生產什麼」及「怎樣生產」 「生產什麼」及「爲誰生產」

questions.en: The operator of a canteen in the government headquarters decides to sell sushi and not burgers anymore because the former can earn a higher profit. This is an example of using ________ to solve the problem of ________. government command ... 'what to produce' government command ... 'for whom to produce' market mechanism ... 'what to produce' market mechanism ... 'for whom to produce'
questions.zh: 政府總部某間食堂的營運商決定售賣壽司而不再售賣漢堡包，因為前者能賺獲更高利潤。這是以 ________ 去解決 ________ 的問題的一個例子。 政府指令……「生產什麼」 政府指令……「為誰生產」 市場機制……「生產什麼」 市場機制……「為誰生產」

questions.en: The Chief Executive proposed to raise the recurrent education spending by $5 billion. One of her proposals was to provide a $30000 subsidy to eligible secondary school graduates studying self-financing programmes. The above proposal is related to the _________ question(s) in Economics. ‘how to produce’ ‘for whom to produce’ ‘what to produce’ and ‘how to produce’ ‘what to produce’ and ‘for whom to produce’
questions.zh: 行政長官提議增加五十億元教育經常開支。其中一項提案是向修讀自資課程的合資格中學畢業生提供 30000 元補貼。以上提案與經濟學中的 ______ 問題有關。 「如何生產」 「為誰生產」 「生產什麼」和「如何生產」 「生產什麼」和「為誰生產」

questions.en: Which of the following statements are related to the problem of ‘for whom to produce’? Only the elderly and eligible persons with disabilities can enjoy a concessionary fare of $2 per trip under the Public Transport Fare Concession Scheme. Public rental housing (PRH) households whose family income exceeds 5 times the PRH income limits should vacate their PRH flats. The e-Sports & Music Festival moved from Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre to Hong Kong Coliseum to house more fans from all over the world. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些陳述與「為誰生產」的問題有關？ 只有長者和合資格的傷殘人士才可以享有「公共交通票價優惠計劃」的每程 $2 票價優惠。 若公共租住房屋（公屋）的住戶其家庭入息超過公屋入息限額五倍，便須遷出其公屋單位。 電競音樂節由香港會議展覽中心轉移到香港體育館舉行，以容納更多來自世界各地的電競迷。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: In response to the shortage in face mask market, the Government distributes free reusable CuMask to all Hong Kong citizens. This is an example of using _________________ to solve the problem of __________________. government command ... ‘how to produce’ government command ... ‘for whom to produce’ market mechanism ... ‘how to produce’ market mechanism ... ‘for whom to produce’
questions.zh: 為應對口罩市場的短缺，政府向全港市民免費派發可重用的銅芯口罩。 這是以 ______________________ 去解決 ______________________ 問題的一個例子。 政府指令 ... 「如何生產」 政府指令 ... 「為誰生產」 市場機制 ... 「如何生產」 市場機制 ... 「為誰生產」

questions.en: Refer to the following information of the COVID-19 vaccination programme. All residents are eligible for joining the programme free-of-charge. The government has set up vaccination centres in some government buildings and deployed civil servants to work in these centres. The above information is related to the _______________ question(s) in Economics. ‘what to produce’ ‘how to produce’ ‘for whom to produce’ (3) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 參考以下有關新冠肺炎疫苗接種計劃的資料。 所有居民可以免費參加該計劃。 政府在一些政府大樓設立了疫苗接種中心，並調派公務員往中心工作。 以上資料和經濟學中的 ________________ 問題有關。 「生產什麼」 「如何生產」 「為誰生產」 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: In response to a rise in the demand for electric vehicles, a manufacturer decided to produce more electric vehicles and sell them at a higher price. The above decision of the manufacturer is related to the _____ question(s) in Economics because it is related to _____. ‘what to produce’ ... the choice on the quantity of outputs ‘how to produce’ ... the choice on factor inputs ‘for whom to produce’ ... the distribution of outputs (1) only (2) only (3) only (1) and (3) only
questions.zh: 面對電動車需求上升，一間製造商決定生產更多電動車，並提高電動車的售價。 上述製造商的決定與經濟學中的 _____ 問題相關，因為該決定與 _____ 相關。 「生產什麼」…… 產量的選擇 「怎樣生產」…… 要素投入的選擇 「為誰生產」…… 產出的分配 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(3)

questions.en: A government official said, 'The government has decided to reduce the toll of a tunnel and we expect to attract more private vehicles to use the tunnel and relieve the congestion on a nearby highway.' The above decision of the government is related to the ______ question in Economics and the above statement by the government official is a ______ statement. 'how to produce' ... normative 'for whom to produce' ... normative 'how to produce' ... positive 'for whom to produce' ... positive
questions.zh: 一位政府官員表示：「政府已決定降低某隧道的收費，我們預期會吸引更多私家車使用該隧道，從而紓緩鄰近高速公路的擠塞情況。」 上述政府的決定與經濟學中的 ______ 問題相關，而上述政府官員的陳述屬 ______ 陳述。 「怎樣生產」 …… 規範性 「為誰生產」 …… 規範性 「怎樣生產」 …… 實證性 「為誰生產」 …… 實證性

questions.en: Which of the following statements about private property rights is correct? Private property rights may still exist without a court of law. Private property rights may be protected by local customs. Private property rights are an essential prelude for market transactions. All of the above
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於私有產權的陳述是正確的？ 即使沒有法庭，私有產權可能仍然存在。 私有產權可受地方習俗保護。 私有產權是市場交易的必要前奏。 以上皆是

questions.en: Marlene had bought a cookery book from a bookstore. Her friend, Kitman, said to her, “You have private property rights to this cookery book.” Which of the following rights would Marlene have after the purchase of the book? To follow the recipes in the book in preparing a dinner for Kitman To scan and upload the whole book to her blog To leave the book on the bookshelf without reading it To lend the book to Kitman and ask for a dinner in return (1), (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 瑪蓮從書店購買了一本烹飪書。她的朋友潔文告訴她：「你擁有這烹飪書的私有產權。」瑪蓮在購入該書後會擁有哪些權利？ 按書中的食譜，為潔文準備晚餐。 把整本書掃描並上載到她的網誌。 把書放在書架，不去閱讀它。 把書借給潔文，並要求一頓晚餐作回報。 只有 (1)、(2)、(3) 只有 (1)、(2)、(4) 只有 (1)、(3)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: Refer to the following suggestion for tackling the housing problem. The government should build a new type of housing, called Easy Living, for which the owners can lease their flats at a controlled rent. If the owners want to sell their flats, they can only sell them back to the government. Compared with owning a private housing unit, __________ will be weakened for those owning an Easy Living housing unit. the right to use the right to receive income the right to transfer (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參考以下解決房屋問題的建議： 政府應該興建一種新類型的房屋「居住易」，其業主能以一受管制的租金出租其單位。若業主想出售其物業，他們只能將單位售回政府。 與擁有一個私人樓宇單位相比，擁有一個「居住易」單位的業主的 ______ 會被削弱了。 使用權 賺取收入權 轉讓權 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A band in Hong Kong adopted a real-name registration system for the sale of its concert tickets. These tickets were not transferrable so that the chance of ticket scalping (炒賣) was reduced. Which of the following statements about the above real-name registration system is/are correct? It is a mechanism to tackle the problem of ‘what to produce’. The private property rights over the tickets would be weakened under the system. Non-price competition would not be involved in the allocation of the tickets under the system. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 一支香港樂隊採用了實名登記制發售其演唱會門票。這些門票不可轉讓，所以炒賣的機會減少。 以下哪項／哪些有關上述實名登記制的陳述是正確的？ 這是解決「生產什麼」的問題的一個機制。 在該機制下，門票的私有產權會被削弱。 在該機制下，門票的分配並不涉及非價格競爭。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: When private property rights are weakened, ___________. resources are less likely to be allocated to their highest-valued use income derived from assets is likely to decrease non-price competition is more likely to arise (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 當私有產權被削弱時，________。 資源被分配到其最高價值的用途的可能性較低 從資產所衍生的收入很可能減少 非價格競爭較有可能出現 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Mr. Wong, who is a fireman, also works as a part-time taxi-driver. Which stage(s) of production is he engaged in? secondary production only tertiary production only primary and tertiary production only secondary and tertiary production only
questions.zh: 黃先生是一位消防員，同時兼職做的士司機。他的工作屬於哪類生產級別？ 只是第二級生產 只是第三級生產 只是第一級和第三級生產 只有第二級和第三級生產

questions.en: The above diagram shows the interdependence among the three stages of production. The flows of 'X' and 'Y' should be labeled respectively as natural resources and consumer goods. natural resources and capital goods. services and consumer goods. services and capital goods.
questions.zh: 上圖顯示三個生產級別互相依賴的情況。流量 X 及 Y 應分別標記為 天然資源及消費物品。 天然資源及資本物品。 服務及消費物品。 服務及資本物品。

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as consumption? A student saves up unused Christmas cards until next Christmas. A student helps to clean his classroom. Mrs. Hong teaches a TV audience how to cook. A student watches a music TV programme.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項被歸類為「消費」？ 一位學生將未用過的聖誕咭留待來年聖誕節用。 一位學生協助清潔他的課室。 康太教導電視觀眾如何烹飪。 一位學生觀看音樂電視節目。

questions.en: Which of the following are examples of tertiary producers? a pop singer a baker a bank teller a truck driver a film-developing operator (1), (2) and (5) only (1), (3) and (4) only (1), (3) and (5) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪幾項是三級生產者的例子？ 一流行曲歌星 一麵包師傅 一銀行櫃檯員 一貨車司機 一菲林顯影操作員 只有(1)、(2)、(5) 只有(1)、(3)、(4) 只有(1)、(3)、(5) 只有(2)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: Employment in primary, secondary and tertiary industries in 1981 and 1991 Based on the above information, the primary sector employed the same number of workers in 1981 and 1991. the total value of secondary products was lower in 1991. tertiary production is becoming more important in terms of its contribution to employment. real income earned in the tertiary sector was higher in 1991.
questions.zh: 1981 年及 1991 年初級工業、二級工業和三級工業的就業情況 根據上表資料， 1981 年和 1991 年初級工業行業僱用相同數目的工人。 1991 年二級工業產品的總值下降。 三級工業對就業的貢獻愈來愈顯得重要。 1991 年三級工業賺取的實質收入上升。

questions.en: Which of the following activities is NOT classified as production? a mother teaching her child to read a son helping his mother to serve dinner at home a father repairing a TV set at home a daughter playing with her cat at home
questions.zh: 下列哪一種活動 並非 歸類為生產？ 一位母親教導她的孩子閱讀。 一位兒子幫他的母親在家裡預備晚餐。 一位父親在家裡修理電視機。 一位女兒在家裡與她的小貓玩耍。

questions.en: Mary is a sewing worker in a garment factory in the daytime. In the evening, she works as a waitress in a restaurant. Mary is a ______ producer. secondary tertiary primary and secondary secondary and tertiary
questions.zh: 瑪麗在日間是某製衣廠的車衣女工。晚上，她是某餐館的女侍應。瑪麗是 ________ 生產者。 二級 三級 初級及二級 二級及三級

questions.en: % share in total employment 1982 1992 Manufacturing sector 45% 19% Services sector 50% 78% Others 5% 3% Total 100% 100% From the above table, we can conclude that the manufacturing sector had a big fall in employment in 1992 as compared to 1982. the services sector had a great increase in employment in 1992 as compared to 1982. the services sector employed the largest number of working people in 1992. the services sector accounted for a greater proportion of gross domestic product (GDP) than the manufacturing sector in 1992.
questions.zh: 佔總就業人數的百分率 1982 年 1992 年 製造業 45% 19% 服務業 50% 78% 其他 5% 3% 總計 100% 100% 從上表，可得以下結論： 與 1982 年比較，製造業就業人數在 1992 年大幅下降。 與 1982 年比較，服務業就業人數在 1992 年大幅攀升。 在 1992 年，服務業在各行業中聘用最多勞動人口。 在 1992 年，服務業比製造業佔本地生產總值較大的比例。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about production is correct? Developed countries have no primary production. Students selling flags for charity organizations are engaging in production. An Indian restaurant engages in tertiary production only. The car repair work belongs to secondary production.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於生產的描述是正確的？ 已發展國家沒有第一級生產。 學生爲慈善機構賣旗籌款是一種生產活動。 一家印度餐廳的生產只涉及第三級生產。 維修車輛屬於第二級生產。

questions.en: Which of the following activities are classified as production in economics? a man delivering newspapers a girl sewing her own dress a boy selling pirated compact discs (CD) (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項活動被歸類為經濟學上的生產？ 一位男士派送報紙。 一位女孩縫製她的裙子。 一位男孩售賣翻版光碟。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: % share of total employment Country A Country B Primary production 3 1 Secondary production 46 25 Tertiary production 51 74 From the above table, we can conclude that most people in country B enjoy a higher living standard than most people in country A. most people in each of the countries engage in tertiary production. more people engage in tertiary production in country B than in country A. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 佔總就業人口的百分率 甲國 乙國 第一級生產 3 1 第二級生產 46 25 第三級生產 51 74 從上表，我們可得結論如下： 乙國多數人的生活水準較甲國多數人高。 無論甲國或乙國，多數人都參與第三級生產。 乙國較甲國有更多人參與第三級生產。 以上各項皆正確。

questions.en: The following graph shows the relationship of the three stages of production. What does P and Q stand for respectively? services; consumer goods producer goods; consumer goods raw materials; services natural resources; producer goods
questions.zh: 下圖顯示各級生產的關係。P 及 Q 分別代表甚麼？ 服務；消費品 生產者物品；消費品 原料；服務 天然資源；生產者物品

questions.en: The following table shows the employment distribution of Hong Kong. Sector 1985 1997 2005 Primary 2.2 % 0.5 % 0.4 % Secondary 43.5 % 20.4 % 13.7 % Tertiary 54.3 % 79.1 % 86.0 % (Total) 100 % 100 % 100 % From the above table, we can conclude that from 1985 to 2005, the number of people engaged in the primary and secondary sectors decreased while that in the tertiary sector increased. the overall unemployment rate remained constant. the contribution to gross domestic product (GDP) of the tertiary sector increased. the relative importance of the secondary sector in terms of employment decreased.
questions.zh: 下表顯示香港就業分布的情況。 年份 部門 1985 1997 2005 第一級生產 2.2% 0.5% 0.4% 第二級生產 43.5% 20.4% 13.7% 第三級生產 54.3% 79.1% 86.0% (總計) 100% 100% 100% 由上表，我們可推論從1985年至2005年， 第一級及第二級生產的就業人數減少了，第三級生產的就業人數則增加了。 整體失業率維持不變。 第三級生產對本地生產總值的貢獻增加了。 第二級生產在就業上的重要性相對地減少了。

questions.en: Hong Kong's gross domestic product (GDP) at factor cost was higher in 2005 than in 2001. The charts below show the contribution to GDP at factor cost by sectors in 2001 and 2005, respectively. Based on the above information, we can conclude that in the year 2005 workers in the tertiary sector on average earned more than those in the secondary sector. the labour productivity of the secondary sector decreased. the output value of the primary sector increased. the number of workers in the tertiary sector increased.
questions.zh: 以要素成本計算的香港本地生產總值在 2005 年較 2001 年為高。下列圖表分別顯示在 2001 年及 2005 年各生產級別對以要素成本計算的本地生產總值的貢獻。 根據以上資料，我們可得出如下結論：在 2005 年， 從事第三級生產的工人平均較從事第二級生產的工人賺得更多錢。 第二級生產的工人生產力下降。 第一級生產的產出值增加了。 從事第三級生產的工人數目增加了。

questions.en: Some resort hotels in Japan provide natural hot springs for their customers. These resort hotels are engaged in _______ and these hot springs are classified as ________. primary production ... producer goods tertiary production ... producer goods secondary production ... consumer goods tertiary production ... consumer goods
questions.zh: 在日本，一些度假酒店爲顧客提供天然溫泉。這些度假酒店參與 ________，而這些溫泉被歸類為 ________。 初級生產 ... 生產者物品 三級生產 ... 生產者物品 二級生產 ... 消費者物品 三級生產 ... 消費者物品

questions.en: Study the following information about an economy : % of total employment In 1999 In 2009 Primary production 39 5 Secondary production 21 30 Tertiary production 40 65 (Total) 100 100 From the above table, we can conclude that the primary sector’s relative importance in total employment has decreased in 2009 because its average labour productivity has increased. most people have a higher living standard in 2009 than in 1999. the number of workers engaged in the secondary sector in 2009 may be larger or smaller than that in 1999. the tertiary sector contributes the largest share to the gross domestic product (GDP) for 2009.
questions.zh: 細閱下列某經濟的資料。 佔總就業人口百分比(%) 1999年 2009年 初級生產 39 5 第二級生產 21 30 第三級生產 40 65 (總計) 100 100 由上表，我們可得以下哪項結論？ 在2009年，初級生產在總就業人口中的相對重要性下降了，因爲它的勞工平均生產力增加了。 多数人在2009年的生活水準較在1999年爲佳。 2009年的第二級生產工人數目可能大於或小於1999年的數目。 在2009年、第三級生產佔本地生產總值的百分比最大。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the interrelationship of the three stages of production. What do X and Y stand for respectively? producer goods; services producer goods; consumer goods raw materials; services natural resources; producer goods
questions.zh: 下圖顯示三個生產級別的相互關係。X 和 Y 分別代表什麼？ 生產者物品；服務 生產者物品；消費品 原料；服務 天然資源；生產者物品

questions.en: Which of the following descriptions about the relationship between the three types of production is correct? Primary production provides raw materials for the other types of production. Secondary production does not rely on tertiary production to produce finished goods. Tertiary production relies only on primary production. The three types of production are independent, and tertiary production is the most important.
questions.zh: 下列哪項對三類生產之間的關係的描述是正確的？ 第一級生產為其他類型的生產提供原材料。 第二級生產毋須依賴第三級生產去製造完成品。 第三級生產只依賴第一級生產。 三類生產是獨立的，其中第三級生產為最重要。

questions.en: The following graph shows the relationship of the three stages of production. What do E and F stand for respectively? consumer goods; raw materials producer goods; services raw materials; services producer goods; raw materials
questions.zh: 下圖顯示三個生產級別的關係。E 和 F 分別代表什麼？ 消費者物品；原料 生產者物品；服務 原料；服務 生產者物品；原料

questions.en: The following table shows the employment distribution in an economy. Sector 2010 2014 Primary 0.4% 0.4% Secondary 23.6% 18.5% Tertiary 76.0% 81.1% Total 100% 100% From the above table, we can conclude that from 2010 to 2014, the number of workers engaged in the primary sector remained constant. the overall employment rate was the same. the contribution of the tertiary sector to gross domestic product (GDP) increased. the relative importance of the secondary sector in terms of employment decreased.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某經濟的就業分佈。 年 產業 2010 2014 初級 0.4% 0.4% 二級 23.6% 18.5% 三級 76.0% 81.1% 整體 100% 100% 從上表我們可得出以下結論：由 2010 年至 2014 年， 從事初級產業的工人數量維持不變。 整體就業率是相同的。 三級產業對本地生產總值的貢獻增加了。 以就業而言二級產業的相對重要性減低了。

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. What do P and Q stand for respectively? consumer goods; services consumer goods; raw materials producer goods; services producer goods; raw materials
questions.zh: 參考下圖。 P和Q分別代表什麼？ 消費者物品；服務 消費者物品；原料 生產者物品；服務 生產者物品；原料

questions.en: The table below shows the distribution of total production value in an economy. The total production value in this economy was higher in 2024 than that in 2014. Year 2014 Year 2024 Primary production 15.3% 5.1% Secondary production 22.2% 22.2% Tertiary production 62.5% 72.7% Total 100% 100% Based on the above information, we can conclude that from 2014 to 2024, the _____. proportion of workers engaged in primary production decreased labour productivity of primary production decreased total production value of secondary production remained unchanged total production value of tertiary production must have increased
questions.zh: 下表顯示某經濟生產總值的分佈。該經濟 2024 年的生產總值高於 2014 年。 2014 年 2024 年 初級生產 15.3% 5.1% 次級生產 22.2% 22.2% 三級生產 62.5% 72.7% 總計 100% 100% 根據以上資料，可得出的結論是：由 2014 年至 2024 年，____。 從事初級生產的工人的比例下跌了 初級生產的勞工生產力下跌了 次級生產的生產總值維持不變 三級生產的生產總值必然上升了

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of 'land' in economics? reservoirs factories rubber plantations mineral deposits (礦藏)
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是經濟學中「土地」的例子？ 水塘 工廠 橡膠種植園 礦藏

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of land in economics? reclaimed land crude oil underground gasoline stored underground Victoria Harbour following improvements
questions.zh: 以下哪一項是經濟學上「土地」的一個例子？ 填海所得的土地 地下的原油 貯藏於地下的汽油 經改良的維多利亞海港

questions.en: The war in the Middle East has led to fires in the oil wells in Kuwait. Teams of firemen were there risking their lives to put out the fires. Economists classify crude oil as ________, oil pumps as ________, firemen as ________ and the owners of the oil wells as ________. capital; capital; entrepreneurs; entrepreneurs capital; land; labour; labour land; land; capital; entrepreneurs land; capital; labour; entrepreneurs
