questions.zh: 中東戰爭導致科威特油井大火。救火隊員冒生命危險去撲滅火災。經濟學者將原油歸類為____、抽油機為____、救火隊員為____、油井擁有者為____。 資本；資本；企業家；企業家 資本；土地；勞力；勞力 土地；土地；資本；企業家 土地；資本；勞力；企業家

questions.en: The main function of entrepreneurship is to design new products. to bear risks. to provide technical expertise. to make routine business decisions.
questions.zh: 「企業家職能」的主要功能是 設計新產品。 承擔風險。 提供技術專才。 對日常經營事務作出決定。

questions.en: Which of the following belongs to the factor of production 'land'? the reclaimed land in West Kowloon the fishing grounds in the South China Sea the MacLehose Trail the killer whale in the Ocean Park
questions.zh: 下列哪一項屬於「土地」這一生產因素？ 西九龍填海區 南中國海漁場 麥理浩徑 海洋公園裏的殺人鯨

questions.en: In economics, the covered playground of a government school is classified as ________ while the principal of the school is classified as a(n) ________. capital, entrepreneur capital, laborer land, entrepreneur land, laborer
questions.zh: 在經濟學裏，政府中學的雨天操場被歸類為______，而校長則被歸類為________。 資本；企業家 資本；勞工 土地；企業家 土地；勞工

questions.en: Capital differs from land in that, for example, capital is produced from scarce resources but land is not. Capital has a smaller supply elasticity. The demand for capital is a derived demand but that of land is not. Capital generates a higher return to its owners.
questions.zh: 資本不同於土地，例如： 資本是由稀少的資源製造的，而土地則非。 資本的供應彈性較低。 資本的需求屬引申需求，而土地的則非。 資本為它的擁有者提供較高的回報。

questions.en: Which one of the following is an example of land? solar energy collected from sunlight by a power plant rainwater collected in reservoirs land reclaimed from the sea dew on farmland in the morning
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是土地的一個例子？ 某能源廠從陽光收集到的太陽能 在水塘收集到的雨水 填海得來的土地 早上農地上的露水

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as land in economics? live fishes sold in a seafood restaurant silver ore in a mine the newly reclaimed land in Western Kowloon a piece of cultivated land
questions.zh: 下列哪一項在經濟學上被歸類為土地？ 海鮮酒家出售的活魚 礦藏裏的銀礦 西九龍新填海區的土地 一塊開墾了的土地

questions.en: Mrs. Lee is a hawker. She sells fresh flowers in Mong Kok. Which of the following is INCORRECT? She is a secondary producer. She is a tertiary producer. She provides entrepreneurial skills. She provides labour service.
questions.zh: 李太是一名小販，在旺角售賣鮮花。下列哪一項並不正確？ 她是第二級生產者。 她是第三級生產者。 她提供企業家技能。 她提供勞力服務。

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as land in economics? land reclaimed along the Victoria Habour fish caught in the high seas (公海) plants grown in the country parks crude oil newly discovered underground
questions.zh: 在經濟學上，下列哪一項歸類為土地？ 沿維多利亞港填海獲得的土地。 在公海裏捕獲的魚。 郊野公園裏種植的植物。 新發現的地下原油。

questions.en: Land is different from capital in that land cannot be increased but capital can. land is more demand inelastic than capital. the use of land does not cost anything but the use of capital does. land is less occupationally mobile than capital.
questions.zh: 土地有異於資本，由於 土地不能增加，而資本是可以增加的。 土地的需求彈性較資本為低。 使用土地沒有成本，而運用資本卻是有成本的。 土地的職業流動性較資本為低。

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as capital? the singing skill of a superstar the sunlight people enjoy on the beach a strong current in the ocean an oasis in the desert
questions.zh: 下列哪一項被歸類為資本？ 超級巨星的歌唱技巧。 人們在沙灘上享受的陽光。 海洋裏強烈的洋流。 沙漠裏的綠洲。

questions.en: 'Wild birds in the forests are classified as land in economics.' This statement is true, because they are free goods. true, because they are natural resources. false, because they can move while land is geographically immobile. false, because their supply is not fixed.
questions.zh: 「森林裏的野鳥在經濟學上被歸類為土地。」這句子是 正確的，因爲牠們是「免費物品」。 正確的，因爲牠們是天然資源。 不正確的，因爲牠們可以移動而土地沒有地域流動性。 不正確的，因爲牠們的供應並非固定。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about land and capital is correct? Land has no occupational mobility but capital does. There is no cost of producing land but there is cost of producing capital. Land is a free good but capital is an economic good. Over time, the quantity of land is fixed but that of capital is not.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於土地和資本的描述是正確的？ 土地沒有職業流動性，但資本是有的。 製造土地沒有成本，但製造資本卻有成本。 土地是免費物品，但資本卻是經濟物品。 長遠而言，土地的數量是固定的，但資本的數量卻是可變的。

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as 'capital'? sunshine in California oil wells in Kuwait sand in the Sahara Desert fresh air in the Alps
questions.zh: 下列哪一項被歸類為「資本」？ 加州的陽光 科威特的油井 撒哈拉沙漠的沙 阿爾卑斯山上的新鮮空氣

questions.en: Dennis opened a convenience store and he has employed his friend, John, as a storekeeper. Dennis' work is classified as ______ and John's work is classified as ______. secondary production ... labour tertiary production ... entrepreneurship labour ... secondary production entrepreneurship ... tertiary production
questions.zh: 丹尼開設一家便利店，並聘用他的朋友國強打理店務。丹尼的工作被歸類為 ______ 而國強的工作被歸類為 ______。 二級生產 ... 勞力 三級生產 ... 企業家職能 勞力 ... 二級生產 企業家職能 ... 三級生產

questions.en: In economics, which of the following statements about capital is correct? The quantity of fixed capital cannot be changed in the short run. Capital earns the highest rate of return among all factors of production. Capital is produced to satisfy consumers' wants directly. The geographical mobility of capital is greater than that of land.
questions.zh: 在經濟學上，下列哪一項關於資本的描述是正確的？ 在短期而言，固定資本的數量是不能改變的。 在所有生產因素當中，資本的回報率最高。 資本是製造出來以直接滿足消費者的欲望。 資本的地域流動性較土地的為高。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about ‘land’ is correct? The supply of land may be increased through human effort. The supply of land may change over time. Land is a free good because it is part of nature. Land is a scarce good because it cannot be produced.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於「土地」的描述是正確的？ 人力可增加土地供應。 土地供應可能隨時間而改變。 土地是「免費物品」，因為它是大自然的一部分。 土地是「缺乏的物品(又稱稀少性物品)」，因為它是不能製造出來的。

questions.en: Michael Owen is a famous football player for Liverpool Football Club. In economics, he provides the service of ______ and he engages in ______ production. entrepreneurship ... secondary entrepreneurship ... tertiary labour ... secondary labour ... tertiary
questions.zh: 米高奧雲是利物浦足球會一位著名足球員。在經濟學上，他提供 _______ 服務，他的工作屬於 _______ 生產。 企業家職能 ... 第二級 企業家職能... 第三級 勞力 ... 第二級 勞力... 第三級

questions.en: Which of the following is classified as land in economics? soil with chemical fertilizers added to it trees in a plantation area underground coal reserves a piece of cultivated land
questions.zh: 下列哪一項在經濟學上被歸類爲土地？ 加了化學肥料的泥土 植林區裏的樹木 蘊藏於地下的煤礦 經開墾的土地

questions.en: Mr Chan is the owner of a printing factory and he employs Mary as an accountant. The factory engages in ______ production and Mary provides the service of the factor ________. secondary ... labour secondary ... entrepreneurship tertiary ... labour tertiary ... entrepreneurship
questions.zh: 陳先生擁有一家印刷廠，聘用瑪莉做會計。該工廠屬 _______ 生產而瑪利提供 _______ 這種生產要素的服務。 第二級 …… 勞力 第二級 …… 企業家職能 第三級 …… 勞力 第三級 …… 企業家職能

questions.en: Which of the following statements about land is correct? Crude oil unextracted is land because it is fixed in supply. Ocean is land because it is geographically immobile. Rainfall on a piece of farmland is land because it is a gift of nature for production. Wood being cut in the tropical forest is land because it is used for production.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項對土地的描述是正確的？ 未開採的原油是土地，因爲它的供應是固定的。 海洋是土地，因爲它沒有地域流動性。 降在一片農地上的雨水是土地，因爲它是用作生產的天賜之物。 在熱帶森林裏砍下來的木頭是土地，因爲它有生產用途。

questions.en: Land is different from capital in that the supply of land cannot be controlled, whereas that of capital can be. land is a free good but capital is an economic good. land has a lower occupational mobility than capital. land has a greater supply elasticity than capital.
questions.zh: 土地有別於資本是因爲 土地的供應不能控制，而資本是可以的。 土地是「免費物品」，但資本是經濟物品。 土地的職業流動性較資本的爲低。 土地的供應彈性較資本的爲高。

questions.en: In Economics, a taxi is classified as _______ and the income of the taxi owner from renting the taxi to a driver is classified as _______. land ... rent capital ... interest land ... interest capital ... profit
questions.zh: 在經濟學上，計程車被歸類為 ________；而計程車車主將車子出租予司機的收入被歸類為 ________。 土地 ... 租值 資本 ... 利息 土地 ... 利息 資本 ... 利潤

questions.en: Which of the following are land in economics? the Chinese white dolphins living in the waters around Lantau Island the giant pandas living in Ocean Park Hong Kong migratory birds found in the Deep Bay (后海灣) (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項是經濟學上的土地？ 在大嶼山一帶水域生活的中華白海豚 在香港海洋公園裏生活的大熊貓 在后海灣裏出現的候鳥 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following belongs to the factor of production 'land'? endangered species of Tibetan antelope (藏羚羊) found on the Tibetan Plateau (青藏高原) flowers planted in Hong Kong Disneyland crocodiles living in Hong Kong Wetland Park oxygen provided in the trains running across the Tibetan Plateau
questions.zh: 下列哪項屬於生產要素「土地」？ 在青藏高原上發現的瀕危動物藏羚羊。 在香港迪士尼樂園內種植的花朵。 在香港濕地公園內生活的鱷魚。 在青藏高原行駛的火車上供應的氧氣。

questions.en: Which of the following about ‘land’ and ‘capital’ is correct? Both land and capital can be increased by human effort. Both land and capital are fixed factors of production. Land is more elastic in supply than capital. Land is less geographically mobile than capital.
questions.zh: 下列哪項關於「土地」和「資本」的說法是正確的？ 兩者的數量皆可人爲地增加。 兩者皆爲固定生產要素。 土地的供應較資本更具彈性。 土地較資本更缺乏地域流動性。

questions.en: In economics, a medical doctor in the public hospital provides the service of ________ and he engages in ________ production. entrepreneurship ... secondary entrepreneurship... tertiary labour ... secondary labour ... tertiary
questions.zh: 在經濟學上，公立醫院裏的醫生提供 ________ 的服務，而他涉及 ________ 生產。 企業家職能 ... 第二級 企業家職能 ... 第三級 勞力 ... 第二級 勞力 ... 第三級

questions.en: Miss Chan rents a studio to record songs. In economics, the studio is classified as ________ and the rental income of the studio owner is classified as ________. land ... rent land ... profit capital ... profit capital ... interest
questions.zh: 陳小姐租用一間錄音室來錄製歌曲。在經濟學上，該錄音室被歸類為 ________，而錄音室擁有人的租金收入被歸類為 ________。 土地 ... 租金 土地 ... 利潤 資本 ... 利潤 資本 ... 利息

questions.en: A school is a production unit which provides educational services. The following are people and objects that are usually found at a school: Which of the above items are capital of the school? the school building teachers students private cars owned by teachers sanitisers（洗手液）in the toilets (1) and (4) only (1) and (5) only (2) and (3) only (1), (4) and (5) only
questions.zh: 學校是提供教育服務的生產單位。以下是一些在學校常見的人物和物件： 上述哪些是學校的資本？ 校舍 教師 學生 教師擁有的私家車 洗手間的洗手液 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (1)、(5) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4)、(5)

questions.en: Which of the following are capital of a cafe? coffee machines coffee beans video game consoles brought by its customers for party comic books which can be borrowed by its customers free of charge (1) and (2) only (1), (2) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些是一家咖啡店的資本？ 咖啡機 咖啡豆 顧客帶來開派對用的遊戲機 可供顧客免費借閱的漫畫書 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(2)、(4) 只有 (1)、(3)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: Refer to the following dialogue. Given the return of land is rent, the return of labour is wage, the return of capital is interest while the return of entrepreneur is profit. The income earned by Captain Cook consists of ______ while the remaining income earned by Landlord Li consists of ______. wage...profit interest ...rent and profit wage and interest...rent wage and interest ...rent and profit
questions.zh: 參閱以下對話。 已知土地的回報是租金，勞工的回報是工資，資本的回報是利息，企業家的回報是利潤。曲船長的收入包含了____，而李地主所賺取的餘下收入包含了____。 工資 ... 利潤 利息 ... 租金及利潤 工資及利息 ... 租金 工資及利息 ... 租金及利潤

questions.en: Specialization is beneficial to an economy because more resources are used in producing capital goods. the threat of protectionism can be avoided. the risk of unemployment is lowered. the productivity of the factors of production is raised.
questions.zh: 專業化對經濟有好處是因為 可有更多資源使用在生產資本物品上。 可免受保護主義的威脅。 失業的可能性較低。 生產因素的生產力獲得提高。

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of division of labour? higher work incentive higher labor productivity a smaller amount of tools required the right person doing the right job
questions.zh: 下列哪一項不是分工的好處？ 有更大工作熱誠 勞動生產力更高 需要較少量的工具 合適的人員做合適的工作

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of division of labour? greater economies of scale economy in the use of capital higher labour productivity improved skill through more practice
questions.zh: 下列哪一項並非分工的好處？ 可享有更多規模經濟 經濟地使用工具 提高勞工生產力 透過更多練習使技巧得以改進

questions.en: When division of labour is practised, workers have greater job satisfaction. machines are used more intensively. producers produce a greater variety of goods to suit different consumer tastes. the occupational mobility of workers increases.
questions.zh: 若實施分工， 工人會有更大的工作滿足感。 機器的使用率會更高。 生產商會生產更多種類的貨品以適合顧客的不同口味。 工人的職業流動性會增加。

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of division of labour? A wider choice of goods and services can be provided. Workers have a greater incentive to work. Workers have higher occupational mobility. Less time is required to train workers.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是分工的好處？ 有更多種類的物品和服務以供選擇。 工人更有工作熱誠。 工人的職業流動性較高。 訓練工人需時較少。

questions.en: In a secondary school, different teachers are responsible for teaching different subjects. Which of the following are reasons for the above arrangement? It can reduce the cost of training. Practice makes perfect. Different teachers are good at teaching different subjects. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在一所中學裏，不同的教員負責任教不同的科目。下列哪項是上述安排的原因？ 減低訓練成本。 熟能生巧。 不同教員擅長任教不同的科目。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: When division of labour is practised, firms will enjoy greater economies of scale. workers will have a higher occupational mobility. workers will have a higher income. output per man-hour will increase.
questions.zh: 若實施分工， 廠商會享有更多規模經濟。 工人的職業流動性會更高。 工人會有更多收入。 每工時產出會上升。

questions.en: Division of labour can raise labour productivity. One reason is that fewer tools are needed. geographical mobility is increased. time is saved from not moving from task to task. there would be a higher degree of interdependence among different production stages.
questions.zh: 分工可提高勞工生產力，其中一個原因是 使用較少工具。 增加地域流動性。 節省時間，因爲工人毋須轉換工序。 不同工序之間的依賴性較高。

questions.en: Which of the following is a possible reason for the increase in average labour productivity resulting from practising division of labour? Fewer capital goods are required. The occupational mobility of workers is higher. The total wage income of workers is higher. Time is saved from moving workers between different tasks.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是因實施分工而導致平均勞工生產力上升的一個可能的原因？ 所需資本物品較少。 工人的職業流動性較高。 工人的總工資收入較高。 節省了工人在不同工序之間轉換工作所需的時間。

questions.en: A large supermarket chain store is composed of different sections: marketing, sales, delivery, accounts and management. An advantage of the above arrangement is: The staff will have a higher working incentive. A greater variety of services can be provided to customers. The supermarket chain store can enjoy economies of scale. The supermarket chain store can save on the cost of training its staff.
questions.zh: 一家大型超市連鎖店設有下列部門：市場推廣、銷售、送貨、會計及管理。上述安排有以下的優點： 員工會有更大的工作誘因。 可以向顧客提供更多種類的服務。 該超市連鎖店可享有規模經濟。 該超市連鎖店可節省訓練員工的成本。

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of division of labour? Capital goods can be more fully utilized. The risk of unemployment is lowered. Different stages of production become more independent. A wider choice of goods and services can be provided.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是分工的好處？ 資本物品可以更物盡其用。 失業的風險下降。 不同的生產階段變得更獨立。 可以提供更多物品和服務的選擇。

questions.en: A professor has decided to change the way of marking the exam papers of his subject. Instead of asking his teaching assistants to mark the whole paper for their own classes, he assigns each teaching assistant to mark one question of the paper for the entire candidature. Which of the following situations would likely occur? The marking will be more accurate since practice makes perfect. Training time will be reduced as each assistant only needs to know part of the marking schemes. The tools required for marking will be reduced such as fewer red pens are needed. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 一位教授決定改變所任教科目的試卷評改方法：他不再要求其助教們批改他們所屬班別的整份試卷，而是指派每位助教批改全體考生整份試卷的其中一題。下列哪些情況可能會出現？ 評改會更準確，因為熟能生巧。 訓練的時間會減少，因為每位助教只需要了解評卷參考的一部分。 評改所需的工具會減少，例如需用較少的紅色原子筆。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: In the Outline Development Plan for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Hong Kong is an international financial and transportation centre; Macao is a leisure and tourism centre; Guangzhou is an international commercial centre. This is an example of __________ division of labour because _______________. simple ... each city has its own comparative advantage simple ... each city engages in different production stages regional ... multiple cities cooperate to build the Greater Bay Area regional ... each city has its own specialty of production
questions.zh: 在粵港澳大灣區發展規劃綱要中，香港是國際金融和運輸中心，澳門是旅遊休閒中心，廣州是國際商貿中心。 這是 __________ 分工的一個例子，因為 __________ 。 簡單 ... 每個城市各有自己的比較優勢 簡單 ... 每個城市都涉及不同生產階段 區域 ... 多個城市攜手合作共建大灣區 區域 ... 每個城市各有自己專長的生產

questions.en: Which of the following statements about division of labour are correct? When a barter economy starts using money to facilitate exchange, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent. When a closed economy opens up to free trade, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent. When a small clinic expands into a large hospital, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些關於分工的陳述是正確的？ 當一個以物易物經濟開始使用貨幣促進交易時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。 當一個封閉經濟開放自由貿易時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。 當一間小型診所擴張成一間大型醫院時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a public good is correct? A public toilet (water closet) is an example of a public good. When the marginal cost of serving a good to an extra consumer is zero, that good is a public good. A public good is characterized by the fact that one person's use of the good does not reduce the amount available for himself in the future. None of the above.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於共用品的陳述是正確的？ 公廁是共用品的一個例子。 當向額外一名消費者提供某物品的邊際成本為零時，該物品便是共用品。 共用品的特徵是，某人使用該物品並不會減少自己將來可獲得的數量。 以上皆不是。

questions.en: A public good is a good provided by the government but a price is charged. a good that must be produced by the government because it is too costly for a private producer to sell and collect payments. a good that can be consumed by many individuals at the same time. a good that may be used by the public free of charge.
questions.zh: 共用品是指 由政府提供但收取價格的物品。 必須由政府生產的物品，因為私人產銷及收費的成本過高。 可供許多人同時消費的物品。 可供公眾免費使用的物品。

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of public good? books in a public library a public beach the music of Mozart a piece of abandoned land
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是共用品的例子？ 公共圖書館的書籍 公眾泳灘 莫札特的音樂 一塊被荒廢的土地

questions.en: Which of the following comes closest to a public good? a public telephone in a booth in Central the singing of Teresa Tang (鄧麗君) the City Hall Library the public beach at the Repulse Bay
questions.zh: 下列哪一項最接近共用品？ 中環電話亭內的公眾電話 鄧麗君的歌聲 大會堂圖書館 淺水灣的公眾泳灘

questions.en: Which of the following is a public good? the music of Mozart a public toilet a box of candies shared by many people a lighthouse serving only one boat
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是共用品？ 莫札特的音樂 公廁 由多人共享的一盒糖果 只為一艘船隻服務的燈塔

questions.en: Which of the following comes closest to the nature of a public good? the music of Mozart a piano performance of Mozart’s music a compact disc of Mozart’s music a performance of Mozart’s operas
questions.zh: 下列哪一項最接近共用品的性質？ 莫札特的音樂 莫札特音樂的鋼琴演奏 莫札特音樂的激光唱片 莫札特歌劇的演出

questions.en: Which of the following statements about public goods is correct? A public good is a good provided free-of-charge by the government. A public good is a good that can be consumed concurrently by a large number of users. There is no competition in the production of public goods. A public good is a good that is not scarce.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於共用品的陳述是正確的？ 共用品是由政府免費提供的物品。 共用品是可供大量使用者同時消費的物品。 共用品的生產沒有競爭。 共用品並非稀少性物品。

questions.en: Which of the following is a public good produced privately? national defence the poems of Su Dongpo（蘇東坡） the service of a court judge the books of Milton Friedman
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是由私營部門生產的共用品？ 國防 蘇東坡的詩詞 法官的服務 佛利民的著作

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of public good? a study room provided by a charity organization a public football court a poem by Li Bai (李白) an abandoned factory building
questions.zh: 下列哪項是共用品的例子？ 某慈善機構提供的一個自修室 一個公眾足球場 一首李白的詩 一幢被棄置的工廠大廈

questions.en: A parking lot in the government headquarters is reserved for government officials. The parking lot is ______ because ______. a private good ... it is for private use only a private good ... concurrent consumption is not possible a public good ... the government owns it a public good ... no one has an exclusive right to use
questions.zh: 政府總部的某車位是預留給各政府官員使用的。這個車位屬 ________，因爲 ________。 私用品 ... 它只作私人用途 私用品 ... 它不可能被同時共享 共用品 ... 政府擁有它 共用品 ... 沒有人享有其獨有使用權

questions.en: A public good is a good with zero marginal cost of production. can only be provided by the government. cannot be protected by private property rights. allows concurrent consumption by many individuals.
questions.zh: 共用品 是一種邊際生產成本為零的物品。 只可以由政府提供。 不能以私有產權保護。 容許多人同時使用。

questions.en: In Lunar New Year, tourists reserve tables in waterfront restaurants to enjoy firework display. The firework display is a ________ because ________. public good ... the government pays for the firework display public good ... one individual’s consumption will not reduce its availability to others private good ... private firms have to use resources to produce the firework display private good ... the seats in waterfront restaurants are excludable in consumption
questions.zh: 農曆新年時，旅客在海濱餐廳訂座，觀賞煙花匯演。該煙花匯演是 ________，因為 ________。 共用品……政府支付該煙花匯演的費用 共用品……某人享用該物品不會減少其他人可享用的數量 私用品……私人廠商須使用資源來生產該煙花匯演 私用品……海濱餐廳座位的使用具排他性

questions.en: Air-conditioners used in restaurants can be classified as capital goods. consumer goods. scarce goods. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1),(2) and (3)
questions.zh: 酒樓、餐廳所用的冷氣機可被歸類為 資本財貨 消費品 「稀少性」物品 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Electric fans installed in classrooms are classified as consumer goods. capital goods. economic goods. (1) only (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 課室內裝置的電風扇屬於 消費品。 資本物品。 經濟物品。 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(1)及(3) 只有(2)及(3)

questions.en: Which of the following are capital goods of a school? teacher’s knowledge of economics notes taken by the students watch-dogs (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些是學校的資本物品？ 教師的經濟學知識 學生抄錄的筆記 看門狗 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Flour is a ________ when ________. capital good ... it is used by Mrs Chan to make a cake for her daughter's birthday consumer good ... it is for sale in the market capital good ... it is used in a cooking program shown on the television consumer good ... it is packed for delivery to customers
questions.zh: 在 ________ 時，這些麵粉是 ________。 陳太使用麵粉為女兒的生日造蛋糕……資本物品 麵粉於市場上出售……消費品 電視的烹飪節目中使用麵粉……資本物品 將麵粉包裝以付運予客戶……消費品

questions.en: Every morning copies of free newspapers are distributed to citizens in Hong Kong. In economics, these free newspapers are ________ because ________. free goods … people do not have to pay for them economic goods … some people prefer to have more copies of free newspapers consumer goods … these newspapers can entertain the public capital goods … resources are used in producing these newspapers (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 每天早上有免費的報紙派發給香港市民。在經濟學上，這些免費的報紙是 ________，因爲 ________。 免費物品 ... 市民不用付費也可以獲得這些報紙 經濟物品 ... 有些市民喜歡獲得更多免費的報紙 消費物品 ... 這些報紙可以娛樂大眾 資本物品 ... 要運用資源來印製這些報紙 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: During the Hong Kong Computers and Communications Festival, the organisers distribute USB flash drives to the participants as gifts. To the organisers, these USB flash drives are __________. economic goods producer goods consumer goods (2) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only
questions.zh: 在香港電腦通訊展期間，主辦單位派發 USB 快閃隨身碟給參加者作為禮物。對主辦單位來說，這些 USB 快閃隨身碟是 _______。 經濟物品 生產者物品 消費者物品 只有 (2) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3)

questions.en: A department store reduced the price of its television sets but there was still unsold stock. These television sets are Free goods because the quantity supplied is greater than the quantity demanded. Consumer goods because they are sold at a department store. Capital goods because they are man-made. Economic goods because people have to pay a price for them.
questions.zh: 某百貨公司將店內的電視機減價，但仍未能沽清存貨。這些電視機是 免費物品，因為供應量大於需求量。 消費品，因為在百貨公司內出售。 資本物品，因為是人造的。 經濟物品，因為人們須付出代價以獲取。

questions.en: The television broadcast of European football matches is a public good if citizens can enjoy the broadcast of matches in public areas like restaurants and Karaoke lounges. a private good if a local television broadcasting company has purchased the exclusive right to broadcast in Hong Kong. a free good because there is no cost in serving an additional viewer. a producer good if the broadcast is used to teach the children in a football training school.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關歐洲足球賽事的電視廣播的陳述是正確的？ 若市民可在公眾場所如餐廳和卡拉 OK 欣賞賽事廣播，這些賽事的電視廣播便是共用品。 若某本地電視台購買了在本港的獨家播映權，這些賽事的電視廣播便是私用品。 這些賽事的電視廣播是免費物品，因爲服務額外一位觀眾是沒有成本的。 若足球訓練學校播放這些比賽作教導兒童之用，這些賽事的電視廣播便是生產者物品。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the exhibits in the Louvre Museum is correct? They are public goods because the Louvre Museum is open to the public. They are capital because they are man-made resources used in production. They are consumer goods because more of them are preferred. They are economic goods because they satisfy human wants.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關羅浮宮博物館展品的陳述是正確的？ 它們是共用品，因為羅浮宮博物館向公眾開放。 它們是資本，因為它們是用於生產的人造資源。 它們是消費物品，因為人們渴望更多的展品。 它們是經濟物品，因為它們滿足人類的需要。

questions.en: The Government purchased the broadcasting rights of the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. This enabled all Hong Kong people to watch the events for free. The Olympic Games broadcast is a ______________ because ______________. public good ... the Government paid for the broadcasting rights private good ... one individual’s consumption reduces its amount available to others free good ... more is not preferred consumer good ... it can directly satisfy human wants
questions.zh: 政府購入了 2020 東京奧運的轉播權，令全港市民能免費觀賞各項賽事。該奧運廣播屬 _____________，因為 _____________。 共用品 …… 政府支付了轉播權費用 私用品 …… 某一個人的消費會令其他人可享用的數量減少 免費物品 …… 人們並不偏好更多該物品 消費者物品 …… 它能直接滿足人們的欲望

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the classification of goods is correct? Musical instruments used by street performers are public goods because the music performed with these instruments can be enjoyed concurrently by many people. Textbooks are private goods because the marginal cost of producing an additional unit of textbooks is positive. Artworks exhibited in the Hong Kong Palace Museum (香港故宫文化博物馆) are consumer goods because costs are involved in their production. Popular free online videos for learning English are economic goods because their quantities are not enough to satisfy human wants.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關物品分類的陳述是正確的？ 街頭藝人所用的樂器是共用品，因為用這些樂器演奏的音樂可被多人同時享用。 課本是私用品，因為生產多一個單位的課本的邊際成本是正數。 香港故宮文化博物館展出的藝術品是消費者物品，因為它們的生產涉及成本。 受歡迎的免費網上英語學習影片是經濟物品，因為它們的數量不足夠滿足人們的慾望。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about seawater is correct? Seawater is a capital good when fishermen use it to keep their catches alive. Seawater is a public good as the government provides it to the public for flushing the toilets. Seawater is a free good as people can obtain seawater free of charge. Seawater is an inferior good as no one drinks seawater.
questions.zh: 下列哪項關於海水的陳述是正確的？ 當漁民用海水保持漁獲鮮活時，海水是資本物品。 因為政府提供海水予公眾作沖刷之用，所以海水是共用品。 因為人們可以免費獲得海水，所以海水是免費物品。 因為沒有人飲用海水，所以海水是劣等物品。

questions.en: Trees in a natural rainforest are _____. economic goods if people are willing to spend money to preserve the trees free goods because they are natural resources which involve no production costs land in Economics because they are geographically immobile public goods if the rainforest is managed by the government
questions.zh: 天然雨林裏的樹木是 _____。 經濟物品，假如人們願意花費金錢保育該些樹木 免費物品，因為它們是不涉及生產成本的天然資源 經濟學中的土地，因為它們沒有地域流動性 共用品，假如該雨林是由政府管理

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the supply of labour? The legal minimum working age is raised. The government introduces an unemployment benefit scheme. Workers are willing to work for longer hours at the same wage rate. The retirement age is raised. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪項會增加勞力供應？ 法定最低工作年齡提高。 政府引入失業救濟金計劃。 工人在同一工資率下願意工作更長時間。 退休年齡提高。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (3)、(4)

questions.en: The supply of labour does NOT depend on the size of the population. the composition of the population. the legal minimum working age. the productivity of workers.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項不會影響勞工的供應？ 人口數目 人口組成 法定最低工作年齡 勞工生產力

questions.en: Which of the following factors would tend to increase the labor supply in Hong Kong? the government re-employs some retired civil servants. There are more public holidays each year. There is a greater proportion of males in the population. The educational level of workers becomes higher. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 以下哪種因素有可能使本港的勞力供應增加？ 政府再聘用一些已退休的公務員 每年有更多公眾假期 男性佔較高的人口比例 工人的教育水平提高 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following will decrease the labor supply of a country? fewer job vacancies more universities places for students an increase in the retirement age of workers an increase in the number of immigrants
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會使一國的勞工供應減少？ 職位空缺減少。 大學提供更多學位以供學生就讀。 勞工的退休年齡提高了。 入口移民數目增加。

questions.en: Which of the following would increase the labour supply of Hong Kong? The demand for imported workers increases. All women are not allowed to work overtime. More employers provided child care services to their employees. More job vacancies are available.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會導致香港的勞力供應增加？ 輸入勞工的需求增加。 全部婦女不准超時工作。 更多僱主提供幼兒托管服務予其僱員。 有更多職位空缺。

questions.en: Which of the following would increase the labour supply of Hong Kong? the provision of more day-time child-care services a change in the payment system from piece rate to time rate an increase in the number of public holidays in a year a decrease in the number of people migrating to other countries
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會增加香港的勞工供應？ 提供更多日間託管兒服務。 付酬方式由「件計」改為「時計」。 增加每年公眾假期的日數。 移民往外國的人數下降。

questions.en: Under which of the following situations would the labour supply in Hong Kong decrease? All universities in Hong Kong admit fewer full time students. More Hong Kong companies provide training courses to their staff during office hours. Fewer Hong Kong people are allowed to emigrate to the US. The Hong Kong government provides subsidies to private firms for installing high-tech equipment.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況中，香港的勞力供應會減少？ 所有香港的大學都減少招收全日制學生。 香港有更多公司在上班時間提供培訓課程予他們的員工。 更少香港居民獲批准移民到美國。 香港政府提供津貼予私人機構安裝高科技儀器。

questions.en: The labour supply will increase if more job vacancies are available. more universities offer 4-year degree courses instead of 3-year degree courses. the number of public holidays in a calendar year is reduced. the retirement age is reduced.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，勞力供應會增加？ 有更多職位空缺。 有更多大學提供四年大學學位課程，以代替三年大學學位課程。 一年裏的公眾假期減少。 退休年齡下降。

questions.en: Study the following table: Economy A B C D Number of workers 20 5 30 15 Weekly working hours per worker 5 25 5 20 Total output 11 000 12 000 9 000 10 000 Which economy has the largest labour supply? A B C D
questions.zh: 參閱下表。 經濟體系 甲 乙 丙 丁 工人數目 20 5 30 15 每工人每星期的工作時數 5 25 5 20 總產出 11 000 12 000 9 000 10 000 哪一經濟體系的勞力供應最高？ 甲 乙 丙 丁

questions.en: If the government raises the legal retirement age, the occupational mobility of workers will increase. the average labour productivity will increase. the supply of labour will increase. more division of labour will be practised.
questions.zh: 若政府提高法定退休年齡， 工人的職業流動性會增加。 平均勞工生產力會增加。 勞力供應會增加。 廠商會實施更多分工。

questions.en: Which of the following would decrease the labour supply of Hong Kong? better and more job opportunities in mainland China the imposition of a minimum wage law for low-skilled workers in Hong Kong a lower average salaries tax rate in Hong Kong an increase in the retirement age in Hong Kong
questions.zh: 下列哪項會減少香港的勞力供應？ 中國內地有更佳及更多就業機會。 香港實施低技術工人的最低工資法。 香港薪俸稅的平均稅率下降。 提高香港人的退休年齡。

questions.en: Which of the following policies will result in an increase in the labour force of Hong Kong? extension of free education from 9 years to 12 years an increase in the minimum capital requirement of the Capital Investment Entrant Scheme (資本投資者入境計劃) an increase in the immigration scheme quota for talented persons from the mainland introduction of maximum working hours
questions.zh: 下列哪項政策會令香港的勞動人口增加？ 免費教育由九年延長至十二年 提高資本投資者入境計劃的最低資本要求 增加內地優才入境計劃的限額 訂立最高工時

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the labour supply of an economy? More firms allow male employees to take paternity leave. More companies offer free transport to employees working overtime. Universities provide more full-time associate degree programmes for secondary school graduates. The government adopts maximum working hours for the civil servants.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會增加某經濟的勞力供應？ 更多廠商允許男性僱員請侍產假。 更多公司為加班的僱員提供免費交通。 大學為中學畢業生開辦更多全日制副學士學位課程。 政府對公務員實施最高工時。

questions.en: The labour supply of a country will increase if more training is provided for the existing labour force. the legal minimum working age is lowered from 16 to 15. foreign direct investment increases. the government increases the salaries tax rate.
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，某國的勞力供應會增加？ 向現有的勞動人口提供更多訓練。 法定最低的工作年齡由 16 歲降低至 15 歲。 外國直接投資增加。 政府提高薪俸稅率。

questions.en: The labour supply in Hong Kong would increase if more Hong Kong people migrated to foreign countries. more Hong Kong students studied in tertiary institutions. the Government lowered the qualification requirements for the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme. all working fathers were allowed to take two extra days of paternity leave.
questions.zh: 若 ________，香港的勞力供應會增加。 更多香港人移民外國 更多香港學生入讀大專院校 政府降低「優才入境計劃」的資歷要求 所有在職父親可多得兩天的侍產假

questions.en: Which of the following will improve the average productivity of labour? a larger population longer working-hours more opportunities for tertiary education the emigration of skilled workers
questions.zh: 以下哪一項會提高勞工平均生產力？ 人口增加 延長工作時間 有更多機會可接受專上教育 熟練工人移民到外國去

questions.en: Which of the following can increase the productivity of factory workers? abandoning the piece-rate system installing more machinery importing labour from Mainland China providing a better working environment (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 以下哪項可提高工廠工人的生產力？ 放棄「件計」工資制度 裝設更多機器 從中國大陸輸入勞工 提供較佳的工作環境 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following will improve the average productivity of labour in an economy? extending compulsory education to a higher level raising the retirement age increasing the quantity of capital goods raising unemployment benefits (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪一項能提高一經濟中工人的平均生產力？ 擴充強迫教育至較高程度 提高退休年齡 增加資本物品的數量 增加失業救濟金 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: The following table shows the output of dresses from a factory in 1991 and 1992. Year 1991 1992 Number of workers employed 20 25 Units of dresses produced 90 000 80 000 Number of working hours per worker 3 000 2 000 The factory employed a ______ quantity of labour in 1992 and the average labour productivity was ______ in that year. larger; higher larger; lower smaller; higher smaller; lower
questions.zh: 下表顯示一工廠在 1991 年和 1992 年生產衫裙的情況。 年份 1991 1992 僱用工人數目 20 25 生產衫裙數目 90 000 80 000 每名工人的工時 3 000 2 000 在 1992 年，這工廠僱用較______勞動力。該年的勞工平均生產力較______。 多；高 多；低 少；高 少；低

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the average productivity of labour? a larger labour force better education and training of workers better organization of production fewer public holidays (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些情況會增加勞工的平均生產力？ 較大的勞動人口 工人的教育水平及訓練較佳 生產的組織較佳 較少公眾假期 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.en: Firm A Firm B Number of workers employed 200 120 Number of working hours per worker 1000 1900 Units of output produced 100 000 110 000 Which of the following comparisons is correct? Workers in Firm B have a higher productivity. Firm B employs more labor services. Firm B enjoys a greater economics of scale. Production in Firm B is more capital-intensive.
questions.zh: 甲廠商 乙廠商 聘用的工人數目 200 120 每個工人的工作時數 1000 1900 產量（單位） 100 000 110 000 在下列各項比較中，哪一項是正確的？ 乙廠商工人的生產力較高。 乙廠商聘用較多勞力。 乙廠商享有較大規模經濟。 乙廠商的生產較為資本密集。

questions.en: Firm A Firm B Number of workers employed 200 120 Number of working hours per worker 1000 1900 Units of output produced 100 000 110 000 Which of the following is a possible reason for the difference in labor productivity of Firm A and Firm B? Better training of workers in Firm A Better working environment in Firm B A larger labor force in Firm A A higher wage rate in Firm B
questions.zh: 甲廠商 乙廠商 聘用的工人數目 200 120 每個工人的工作時數 1000 1900 產量（單位） 100 000 110 000 下列哪一項是甲、乙廠商有不同的勞工生產力的可能原因？ 甲廠商工人有較佳訓練。 乙廠商有較佳的工作環境。 甲廠商有較多勞工。 乙廠商的工資率較高。

questions.en: An increase in the number of Form 7 graduates studying in the universities will result in a decrease in the present labour supply. a decrease in the present unemployment rate. an increase in future average labour productivity. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 中七畢業生升讀大學的人數增加會導致 現時勞力供應下降。 現時失業率下降。 將來的平均勞動生產力上升。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: The average productivity of labour will increase if there is an increase in the number of machines. there is an increase in the size of the labour force. there is an improvement in the health conditions of workers workers work more hours per day. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 在下列哪些情況下，勞工平均生產力會上升？ 機器數目有所增加。 勞動人口數目有所增加。 勞工的健康狀況有所改善。 勞工每天工作時數有所增加。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Refer to the following table: Firm A Firm B Number of workers employed 100 60 Number of working hours per worker 350 650 Output (Units) 140 000 156 000 Which of the following concerning Firm A and Firm B is correct? Firm B has a higher average labour productivity than Firm A. Firm A has a higher average labour productivity than Firm B. Firm A has a larger labour supply than Firm B. Firm B has a larger labour supply than Firm A.
questions.zh: 參閱下表： 甲廠商 乙廠商 聘用的工人數目 100 60 每個工人的工作時數 350 650 產量 (單位) 140 000 156 000 下列哪一項對於甲廠商和乙廠商的描述是正確的？ 乙廠商的平均勞動生產力較甲廠商高。 甲廠商的平均勞動生產力較乙廠商高。 甲廠商的勞力供應較乙廠商多。 乙廠商的勞力供應較甲廠商多。

questions.en: Suppose the government uses a great amount of its fiscal reserve to develop information technology in education. Which of the following is correct? Government expenditure in other sectors will decrease. The government will have a budget deficit. The average labour productivity will be higher. The banking system will be less able to create deposits.
questions.zh: 假設政府動用大筆財政盈餘發展資訊科技教育。下列哪一項是正確的？ 其他政府部門的支出會減少。 政府會有財政赤字。 平均勞工生產力會更高。 銀行系統創造存款的能力會下降。

questions.en: Refer to the following table : Firm A Firm B Number of workers employed 60 40 Total number of working hours 1 200 1 000 Total output (Units) 10 800 9 500 Which of the following is a possible reason for the difference in the labour productivity of Firm A and Firm B? Firm B has a better working environment. Firm A has a higher degree of division of labour. Firm A enjoys greater economies of scale. Firm B uses a more labour intensive method of production.
questions.zh: 參閱下表： 甲廠商 乙廠商 聘用工人數目 60 40 總工作時數 1 200 1 000 總產量（單位） 10 800 9 500 以下哪一項是甲、乙廠商有不同勞工生產力的一個可能原因？ 乙廠商的工作環境較佳。 甲廠商的分工程度較高。 甲廠商享有較大的規模經濟。 乙廠商使用較為勞力密集的生產方法。

questions.en: A higher average labour productivity means a higher average output per worker. marginal product per man. total output per worker. total product per unit of labour.
questions.zh: 勞工的平均生產力較高，意指 每工人的平均產出較高。 每人的邊際產量較高。 每工人的總產出較高。 每單位勞力的總產量較高。

questions.en: Which of the following situations will increase the average labour productivity? employing more workers extending the working hours changing from time rates to piece rates reducing the degree of division of labour
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會增加勞工平均生產力？ 僱用更多工人 延長工作時數 由時計工資轉為件計工資 減低分工的程度

questions.en: Which of the following would raise the average labour productivity? a larger working population fewer public holidays a larger quantity of advanced equipment a lower degree of occupational mobility of labour
questions.zh: 下列哪項會提高勞工的平均生產力？ 勞動人口增加。 公眾假期減少。 先進機械儀器的數量增加。 勞工的職業流動性減低。

questions.en: Country A Country B Number of workers 100 X Average working hours of workers per day 8 Y Total output (unit) 7200 7200 In the above table, if the labour productivity in Country B is higher, the possible value of X and Y would be ________ and ________ respectively. 140 ... 6 150 ... 5 200 ... 4 300 ... 3
questions.zh: 甲國 乙國 工人數量 100 X 工人平均每天工作時數 8 Y 總產量 (單位) 7200 7200 上表中，若乙國的勞工生產力較高，X 和 Y 的值可能分別是 ________ 和 ________。 140 ... 6 150 ... 5 200 ... 4 300 ... 3

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the average labour productivity? The number of promotion posts increases. The number of retired workers increases. Production becomes more capital-intensive. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項會提升勞工的平均生產力？ 晉升職位的數目增加。 退休工人的數目增加。 生產方式變得更爲資本密集。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following will raise the average productivity of labour? extending free education to the tertiary level raising the retirement age expanding vocational training for workers (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項會提高勞工的平均生產力？ 擴展免費教育至大專程度 提高退休年齡 提供更多職業訓練予勞工 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following would raise the average labour productivity? an increase in the number of imported foreign specialists an increase in the average working hours a ban on the use of environmentally harmful machines a cut in government subsidies for continuing education
questions.zh: 下列哪項會提高勞工的平均生產力？ 輸入外地專才的數目增加 平均工時增加 禁止使用對環境有害的機械 削減政府對持續進修的補貼

questions.en: Refer to the table below: Factory A Factory B Number of workers employed 60 10 Total number of working hours 2 000 5 000 Total output (units) 12 000 20 000 Which of the following is a possible reason for the difference between the labour productivity of Factory A and Factory B? Factory B provides more training for its workers. More machines are used in Factory B. The working environment in Factory A is poorer. Factory A pays its workers at piece rate while Factory B pays at time rate.
questions.zh: 參考下表。 甲工廠 乙工廠 聘用勞工的人數 60 10 總工作時數 2 000 5 000 總產量（單位） 12 000 20 000 下列哪項是甲工廠和乙工廠勞工生產力有差別的可能原因？ 乙工廠提供較多員工訓練。 乙工廠使用較多機器。 甲工廠的工作環境較差。 甲工廠採用計件工資而乙工廠採用計時工資。

questions.en: Refer to the following table: Factory A Factory B Number of full-time workers 25 0 Number of part-time workers 0 50 Average working hours of full-time workers 8 0 Average working hours of part-time workers 0 6 Total output (units) 12 000 15 000 Which of the following is a possible reason for the difference between the labour productivity of Factory A and Factory B? Factory A uses time rate while Factory B uses piece rate to pay its workers. Factory A provides more training for its workers. The part-time workers employed by Factory B are more skilled. Factory B uses more capital goods.
questions.zh: 細閱下表。 工廠甲 工廠乙 全職工人的人數 25 0 兼職工人的人數 0 50 全職工人的平均工作時數 8 0 兼職工人的平均工作時數 0 6 總產出(單位) 12 000 15 000 下列哪項是工廠甲和工廠乙在勞工生產力上有差異的一個可能原因？ 工廠甲以時薪支付工資，工廠乙則以件工計算。 工廠甲向工人提供較多的訓練。 工廠乙聘請的兼職工人有較高技術。 工廠乙運用較多資本物品。

questions.en: Certain restaurants in China found that they can introduce robots to replace some workers in serving customers without reducing their output. This will increase the quantity supplied of restaurant workers. increase the labour productivity of those restaurants. decrease the geographical mobility of restaurant workers. decrease the occupational mobility of restaurant workers.
questions.zh: 某些中國的餐廳發現能運用機械人代替部分工人接待顧客而不會令產出下降。這會 增加餐廳工人的供應量。 增加這些餐廳的勞工生產力。 減低餐廳工人的地域流動性。 減低餐廳工人的職業流動性。

questions.en: The input-output relationship of a firm is as follows: Year 1 Year 2 Number of workers 30 35 Number of working hours per worker per day 10 8 Quantity of output (units) 3 000 2 900 Based on the above information, labour supply ______ and average labour productivity ______. rises ... rises rises ... falls falls ... rises falls ... falls
questions.zh: 某廠商的投入與產出的關係如下： 第一年 第二年 工人數量 30 35 每日每名工人的工作時數 10 8 產出數量 (單位) 3 000 2 900 根據上述資料，勞力供應會 ________ 而平均勞工生產力會 ________。 增加……增加 增加……減少 減少……增加 減少……減少

questions.en: Which of the following would raise both the labour supply and average labour productivity of an economy? The government raises the amount of unemployment benefits. Free education is extended to university programmes. More firms install advanced production equipment. The quota of an immigration scheme of highly skilled individuals is increased.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會同時提高某經濟的勞力供應和平均勞工生產力？ 政府提高失業救濟金額。 免費教育延伸至大學課程。 更多廠商安裝先進的生產設備。 一項為高技術人才而設的入境計劃的配額增加。

questions.en: The Hong Kong Government has implemented the ‘Top Talent Pass Scheme’ (「高端人才通行證計劃」) to attract foreign talents to work in Hong Kong. Successful applicants will be issued a two-year pass for exploring job opportunities in Hong Kong. As a result of the implementation of the above scheme, ___________. Hong Kong’s labour supply will increase geographical mobility of foreign talents will increase average labour productivity of workers in Hong Kong will increase (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 香港政府推出「高端人才通行證計劃」，以吸引境外人才來港工作。成功申請者會獲發為期兩年的許可證，讓他們在香港探索工作機遇。 推出上述計劃的結果是 ___________。 香港的勞力供應會上升 境外人才的地域流動性會上升 在香港的工人的平均勞工生產力會上升 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

The wage payment method of the firm is changed from time rate to piece rate. The firm does not provide adequate training for new workers in Year 2. The working environment of the firm is improved in Year 2. The management of the firm becomes poorer in Year 2. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 參考下列有關一間玩具生產商的資料。 第一年 第二年 工人數量（人） 250 300 每名工人每日的工作時數（小時） 8 9 每日總產出（單位） 9000 10800 下列哪些是該玩具生產商出現上述平均勞工生產力改變的可能原因？ 該廠商的付酬方式由以時計薪改為以件計薪。 該廠商在第二年沒有為新工人提供足夠的培訓。 該廠商的工作環境在第二年有改善。 該廠商的管理在第二年變差了。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

Factory A Factory B Output per worker (units) 7 200 6 000 Number of workers employed 10 50 Average number of working hours per worker 120 60 Which of the following is/are possible reason(s) for the difference between the average labour productivity of Factory A and Factory B? Factory A provides a better working environment than Factory B. Factory A pays its workers at time rate while Factory B pays at piece rate. Compared to Factory B, Factory A practises a higher degree of division of labour. Factory B provides more training for its workers than Factory A. (4) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (1), (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 參考下列有關工廠甲和工廠乙的資料。 工廠甲 工廠乙 每名工人的產出（單位） 7 200 6 000 聘用的工人數目 10 50 每名工人的平均工作時數 120 60 下列哪項／些是工廠甲和工廠乙平均勞工生產力的差別的可能原因？ 工廠甲的工作環境較工廠乙的好。 工廠甲以時薪支付工資，工廠乙則以件工計算。 與工廠乙相比，工廠甲進行較高度的分工。 工廠乙向工人提供的訓練較工廠甲多。 只有 (4) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4) 只有 (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following will raise the occupational mobility of labour? a higher degree of specialization of skills more information about job vacancies greater power of labour unions provision of retraining programmes (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些情況會提高勞工的職業流動性？ 技術更專門化 有更多關於職位空缺的訊息 工會權力更大 提供再培訓計劃 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(3) 只有(2)及(4) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.zh: 下列哪一項的職業流動性最低？ 貨車司機 售貨員 演員 牙科醫生

questions.en: Which of the following types of people is more occupationally mobile? professors in economics in a university accountants salesmen company secretaries
questions.zh: 下列哪一類人的職業流動性較高？ 大學裏的經濟學教授 會計師 售貨員 公司秘書

questions.en: Suppose the government starts to recruit experienced Putunghua teachers from Mainland China. This would ______ the ______ mobility of experienced Putunghua teachers in Mainland China. reduce ... occupational reduce ... geographical increase ... occupational increase ... geographical
questions.zh: 假設政府開始從中國內地招聘有經驗的普通話教師來港任教。這會 ________ 中國內地有經驗普通話教師的 ________ 流動性。 減少 ... 職業 減少 ... 地域 增加 ... 職業 增加 ... 地域

This would ______ the ______ of these Mainland professionals. reduce ... occupational mobility increase ... occupational mobility reduce ... geographical mobility increase ... geographical mobility
questions.zh: 為了吸引更多內地專才來港工作，有些公司計劃向他們提供房屋津貼。此舉會 _______ 這些內地專才的 _______。 減少 ... 職業流動性 增加 ... 職業流動性 減少 ... 地域流動性 增加 ... 地域流動性

questions.zh: 若實施分工，工人的職業流動性會 _______，因爲 _______。 提高 …… 勞工生產力獲得提升 提高 …… 資本工具更能物盡其用 降低 …… 工作變得沉悶單調 降低 …… 工人只獲得某一特定技能的培訓

questions.en: In which of the following situations will the occupational mobility of labour increase? improvement in the transportation network tightened restrictions on obtaining a professional licence provision of more retraining programmes raising the legal retirement age
questions.zh: 下列哪種情況會提高勞工的職業流動性？ 改善運輸網絡 收緊獲取執業牌照的規限 提供更多再培訓計劃 提高法定退休年齡

questions.en: The occupational mobility of labour in an economy will increase when the cross-border railway network is improved. licences are required for more types of job in the labour market. tax allowances are provided for continuing education. there is a greater degree of specialisation in production.
questions.zh: 當 ________, 該經濟中勞工的職業流動性會上升。 跨境鐵路網有所改善 勞力市場中有更多類型的工作需要牌照 持續進修能獲免稅額 生產更高度專門化

questions.en: Which of the following would most likely increase the occupational mobility of labour in an economy? The labour unions have stronger bargaining power for the welfare of their members. The labour department provides tuition fee rebates for participants of retraining programmes. The transport network is improved by the extension of highways. The government stops granting funding for an online data system about job vacancies.
questions.zh: 下列哪項最有可能增加某經濟中勞工的職業流動性？ 工會有更大的討價還價能力為其會員爭取福利。 勞工處為再培訓計劃的參加者提供學費回贈。 高速公路的擴展改善了交通網絡。 政府停止為職位空缺網上資料系統提供資金。

questions.en: The __________ mobility of labour will decrease if __________. geographical ... the government introduces “city-bike rental scheme” in all train stations geographical ... several big companies set up child care centres in their offices occupational ... the travelling subsidy provided by the government is reduced due to a budget deficit occupational ... licences are required by the government for more professions
questions.zh: 若 __________，勞工的 __________ 流動性會下降。 政府在所有火車站推行「城市單車租賃計劃」……地域 數家大公司在其辦公室設立幼兒託管中心……地域 政府所提供的交通津貼因財政赤字而減少……職業 政府在更多的行業規定從業員須具備執業牌照……職業

This policy will lead to a rise in ______ and ______ in the future. labour supply ... geographical mobility labour supply ... occupational mobility labour productivity ... geographical mobility labour productivity ... occupational mobility

Tuen Ma Line connecting Tuen Mun and Ma On Shan is open geographical mobility ... the Government reduces the travel subsidy to the low-income group

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the geographical mobility of labour in a country? The government increases the amount of travelling subsidies to workers. The government increases the subsidies on retraining programmes. Foreign workers are required to apply for an additional visa to work in that country. (1) only (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only

questions.en: Private tuition is usually paid for by time rates because the incentive to work is stronger. better examination results are guaranteed. the tuition fee is less. The output is difficult to measure.

questions.en: Instead of receiving only a fixed monthly salary, hotel waiters in Hong Kong generally earn a low basic monthly salary and receive tips from customers. To the hotel owners, which of the following in an advantage of the latter method of payment compared to the former method? It is easier to calculate the output of the waiters. Fewer waiters are needed. There is a better relationship among the waiters. The waiters provide better service.

questions.zh: 香港的中學教師一般都是以「時計方式」計酬的，因為 教師擔當多種不同性質的工作。 教師的產出不易量度。 這可以提高工作的積極性。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

This change will NOT result in an increase in their income. an improvement in the quality of their work. an increase in the monitoring and supervision cost of their work. an increase in the quantity of work completed by them.

The working incentive of mail assistants is higher in the XYZ Company. The income of a mail assistant is higher in the ABC Company. The cost of supervision is lower in the ABC Company.

(1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
