questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的生產計劃。該廠商只採用兩種要素，即勞力和機器。 機器 (單位) 勞力 (單位) 勞力的平均產量 (單位) 4 1 20 4 2 21 4 3 22 4 4 X 若上述資料說明邊際回報遞減定律，X的值______。 可以是 23 可以小於 22 必然大於 22 必然小於 22

questions.en: The following table shows the production plan of a firm which employs two factors only, namely labour and machinery. Labour (units) Machinery (units) Total output (units) 1 2 10 2 2 25 3 2 45 4 2 Q1 5 2 Q2 Suppose the above data illustrates the law of diminishing marginal returns. Which of the following figures are consistent with the law? Q1 = 60; Q2 = 70 Q1 = 40; Q2 = 30 Q1 = 65; Q2 = 85 (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的生產計劃，它只聘用勞工及機器這兩種要素。 勞工（單位） 機器（單位） 總產出（單位） 1 2 10 2 2 25 3 2 45 4 2 Q₁ 5 2 Q₂ 假設以上數據說明邊際回報遞減定律。下列哪些數值和該定律相符？ Q1 = 60; Q2 = 70 Q1 = 40; Q2 = 30 Q1 = 65; Q2 = 85 只有 (1) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: The following table shows the production plan of a firm which employs two factors only, namely labour and machinery. Labour (units) Machinery (units) Total product (units) 10 2 90 10 3 Q1 10 4 120 10 5 Q2 10 6 130 The law of diminishing marginal returns is illustrated by the above data and the marginal product starts to diminish when the quantity of machinery increases from 4 units to 5 units. The possible values of Q1 and Q2 are ______ and ______ respectively. 95 ... 120 100 ... 127 107 ... 126 115 ... 126
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的生產計劃，它只使用勞力及機器這兩種要素。 勞力（單位） 機器（單位） 總產出（單位） 10 2 90 10 3 Q1 10 4 120 10 5 Q2 10 6 130 上述資料說明了邊際回報遞減定律，而當機器的數量由 4 單位增加至 5 單位時，邊際產出開始遞減。Q1 和 Q2 的可能數值分別是 ______ 和 ______。 95 …… 120 100 …… 127 107 …… 126 115 …… 126

questions.en: The Urban Council and Regional Council are responsible for growing young trees for planting around Hong Kong. Each nursery is usually large in size. Furthermore, a large number of the same kind of young trees are planted in the same area of the nursery. This type of nursery has the following advantages: economy of scale on irrigation facilities economy of scale by caring for plants of the same kind economy of scale in purchasing fertilizers (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1),(2) and (3)
questions.zh: 市政局及區域市政局負責為香港周圍種植的花草樹木培植幼苗。幼苗園通常佔地廣闊，而且在同一地點上大量種植同類型的幼苗。這種幼苗園有什麼好處？ 灌溉系統方面享有規模經濟 護理同類幼苗方面享有規模經濟 購買肥料方面享有規模經濟 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: A producer increase all his input to double the output. He finds that the total production cost increase by 80%. This can be explained by the law of supply. The law of diminishing returns. Economies of scale. Diseconomies of scale.
questions.zh: 一生產者增加所有投入量使產出作雙倍增加。總生產成本則增加 80%。這可用______來解釋。 供應定律 報酬遞減定律 規模經濟 規模不經濟

questions.en: Which of the following about economies of scale is true? It applies to short-run as well as long-run production. It will lead to a decrease in the average cost of production when the output increases. It occurs only when the scale of production is sufficiently large. It will lead to a decrease in the total cost of production when the output increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於規模經濟的描述是正確的？ 它適用於短期及長期生產。 當產出增加時，它使平均成本下降。 只有當生產規模夠大時，它才出現。 當產出增加時，它使總成本下降。

questions.en: No. of machines No. of workers Total output 5 7 100 5 8 120 5 9 150 5 10 200 Refer to the above table. Which of the following is possible reason for the increase in total output? division of labor the law of diminishing returns the law of comparative advantage economies of scale
questions.zh: 機器數目 工人數目 總產出 5 7 100 5 8 120 5 9 150 5 10 200 參閱上表資料，下列哪一項是總產出增加的可能原因？ 分工 報酬遞減定律 比較優勢定律 規模經濟

questions.en: In general, which of the following are the advantages of a small firm over a large firm in the same industry? There is a better relationship between the employees and the employer. It is more adaptable to changing market situations. Specialization can be carried out more extensively. More funds can be raised at a lower cost. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 一般來說，下列哪幾項是同一行業內小型廠商較大型廠商優勝之處？ 勞資關係更佳。 更能適應市場的變化。 分工更精細。 能以較低成本籌集更多資金。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Number of machines Number of workers Total output (units) 3 3 90 3 4 160 3 5 250 3 6 360 The above data refer to a ______ situation in which _______. short run ... the law of diminishing returns applies short run ... the law of diminishing returns does not apply long run ... economies of scale exist long run ... diseconomies of scale exist
questions.zh: 機器數目 工人數目 總產出（單位） 3 3 90 3 4 160 3 5 250 3 6 360 上述資料顯示一種 ________ 情況，當中 ________。 短期 ... 回報遞減定律是適用的 短期 ... 回報遞減定律是不適用的 長期 ... 存在規模經濟 長期 ... 存在規模不經濟

questions.en: Which of the following implies the existence of economies of scale? The total cost of production decreases when output increases. The average cost of production decreases when the production scale increases. Profit increases when output increases. The amount of output increases by a smaller proportion than that of inputs.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項意味規模經濟的存在？ 產出增加時，總生產成本下降。 生產規模增加時，平均生產成本下降。 產出增加時，利潤上升。 產出增加的比例小於投入增加的比例。

questions.en: The table below shows the production of Good X in a firm. Only two inputs are required in the production process. Capital (Units) Labour (Units) Total Output (Units) Total Cost ($) 1 1 20 100 2 2 35 200 3 3 45 300 4 4 50 400 From the above data, the law of diminishing marginal returns applies to the firm. the firm enjoys economies of scale. diseconomies of scale exist for the firm. the firm produces at its optimal scale of production.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商生產貨品 X 的情況。生產該貨品只需要兩種投入。 資本(單位) 勞力(單位) 總產量(單位) 總成本($) 1 1 20 100 2 2 35 200 3 3 45 300 4 4 50 400 由以上資料可見， 邊際報酬遞減定律適用於該廠商。 該廠商享有規模經濟。 該廠商的生產出現規模不經濟。 該廠商正處於最佳生產規模。

questions.en: When a firm enjoys economies of scale, it is in the ______ and its ______ is decreasing. short run ... average cost long run ... average cost short run ... total cost long run ... total cost
questions.zh: 當某廠商享有規模經濟時，它處於________，而它的________正在下降。 短期...平均成本 長期...平均成本 短期...總成本 長期...總成本

questions.en: A producer increases all his inputs to double the output. The following table shows the change in average cost after a change in output. Total Output (Units) Average Cost ($) 10 000 6 20 000 7 Based on the above information, we can conclude that the firm enjoys economies of scale. the firm suffers from diseconomies of scale. the law of diminishing marginal returns applies to the firm. the firm produces at the optimal scale of production.
questions.zh: 某生產者增加全部投入的數量以使產出量倍增。下表顯示產出改變後的平均成本變化。 總產出 (單位) 平均成本 ($) 10 000 6 20 000 7 根據以上資料，我們可得以下結論： 該廠商享有規模經濟。 該廠商受損於規模不經濟。 邊際回報遞減定律適用於該廠商。 該廠商的生產正處於最適規模。

questions.en: The input-output relationship of Firm A is as follows: Capital (units) Labour (units) Marginal output (units) 1 10 10 1 11 9 1 12 8 1 13 7 From the above table, we can conclude that, as the labour input increases total output is increasing. average output is increasing. firm A is experiencing diseconomies of scale. the average cost of production is decreasing.
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲廠商的投入-產出關係。 資本(單位) 勞力 (單位) 邊際產出 (單位) 1 10 10 1 11 9 1 12 8 1 13 7 我們可從上表得到以下哪一項結論？ 當勞力投入增加時， 總產出正在增加。 平均產出正在增加。 甲廠商正面對規模不經濟。 平均生產成本正在減少。

questions.en: Refer to the following information about the inputs, outputs and average cost of a firm. The only inputs required for production are capital and labour. Capital (units) Labour (units) Total output (units) Average cost ($) 500 5 3000 3 1000 10 4500 4 1500 15 5500 5 Within the above range of output, we can conclude that the firm is producing at the optimal scale of production. the law of diminishing marginal returns applies to the firm. the firm does not have a comparative advantage in the production of this good. the firm suffers from diseconomies of scale.
questions.zh: 以下是某廠商的投入、產出及平均成本的資料。投入只包括資本及勞力兩者。 資本 (單位) 勞力 (單位) 總產出 (單位) 平均成本 ($) 500 5 3000 3 1000 10 4500 4 1500 15 5500 5 在上述產出範圍內，我們可得以下哪個結論？ 該廠商的生產處於最適度生產規模。 邊際回報遞減定律適用於該廠商。 該廠商生產該貨品沒有比較優勢。 該廠商的生產因規模不經濟而受損。

questions.en: During the busy season before Christmas, a factory increases the number of workers to increase output. This can be shown in the following table: No. of workers Average output (units) 5 100 6 105 7 108 8 109 The change in output can be explained by ______. the law of diminishing marginal returns diseconomies of scale economies of scale the principle of comparative advantage
questions.zh: 在聖誕節前的繁忙季度，某工廠增加工人數目以增加其產量，這可以從下表顯示出來： 工人數目 平均產出(單位) 5 100 6 105 7 108 8 109 下列哪項可以解釋上述產量的變化？ 邊際回報遞減定律 規模不經濟 規模經濟 比較優勢原理

questions.en: A firm increases all its inputs to double its output. The following table shows the change in total cost after a change in output. Total Output (Units) Total Cost ($) 10 000 60 000 20 000 140 000 Based on the above information, we can conclude that the firm enjoys economies of scale. the firm suffers from diseconomies of scale. the firm cannot cover its cost after doubling the output. the optimal scale of production is 10 000 units of output.
questions.zh: 某廠商增加全部投入的數量以令產出量增加一倍。下表顯示產出改變後總成本的變化。 總產出（單位） 總成本（$） 10 000 60 000 20 000 140 000 根據以上資料，我們可得結論如下： 該廠商享有規模經濟。 該廠商受損於規模不經濟。 在產出量增加一倍後，該廠商無法歸本。 最適規模的產出是10 000單位。

questions.en: Machines (units) Labour (units) Average Product (units) 2 3 30 2 4 40 2 5 50 2 6 55 The above table shows a __________ situation in which __________. short run ... the law of diminishing returns does not apply short run ... the law of diminishing returns applies long run ... economies of scale exists long run ... diseconomies of scale exists
questions.zh: 機器（單位） 勞力（單位） 平均產出（單位） 2 3 30 2 4 40 2 5 50 2 6 55 上表顯示一 ________ 的情況，其中 ________。 短期 ... 邊際回報遞減定律並不適用 短期 ... 邊際回報遞減定律適用 長期 ... 出現規模經濟 長期 ... 出現規模負經濟

questions.en: In order to increase the number of nurses for expanding medical services, the government has allocated more resources to expand the nursing programme in universities. In this case, private hospitals will enjoy internal economies of scale. suffer internal diseconomies of scale. enjoy external economies of scale. suffer external diseconomies of scale.
questions.zh: 爲求增加護士的數目以擴展醫療服務，政府投放了更多資源予大學開辦更多護士課程。在這情況下，私家醫院會 享有內部規模經濟。 承受內部規模負經濟。 享有外部規模經濟。 承受外部規模負經濟。

questions.en: The following table shows the production data of a firm. The only inputs required are capital and labour: Capital (units) Labour (units) Total product (units) Total cost of production ($) 2 2 10 100 3 3 30 270 4 4 45 360 5 5 55 385 Based on the above table, we can conclude that the law of diminishing returns applies to the firm. the total fixed cost is $100. the optimal scale is 45 units. the firm enjoys economies of scale.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的生產資訊。它所需的投入只有資本和勞力。 資本（單位） 勞力（單位） 總產量（單位） 總生產成本（$） 2 2 10 100 3 3 30 270 4 4 45 360 5 5 55 385 根據上表，我們可以得出結論如下： 邊際回報遞減定律適用於該廠商。 總固定成本是 $100。 最優規模是 45 單位。 該廠商享有規模經濟。

questions.en: Tai On Building (太安樓) in eastern Hong Kong Island is well-known as a ‘foodie paradise’. A variety of street snacks such as cart noodles, egg waffles, dumplings and mango mochi are sold by numerous small vendors. Customers from different districts fill their stomachs at Tai On Building. Based on the above information, street snack vendors at Tai On Building can _________. enjoy internal economies of scale enjoy external economies of scale suffer internal diseconomies of scale suffer external diseconomies of scale
questions.zh: 港島東的太安樓是著名的「為食天堂」。那裏很多小店售賣各式街頭小吃，如車仔麵、雞蛋仔、餃子和芒果糯米糍。來自不同地區的顧客均在太安樓大飽口福。 根據以上資料，太安樓的街頭小吃店能________。 享有內部規模經濟 享有外部規模經濟 承受內部規模負經濟 承受外部規模負經濟

questions.en: The following table shows the input, output and cost relationships of a firm. The only inputs required for production are labour and capital. Labour (units) Capital (units) Total product (units) Total cost of production 1 1 20 $150 2 1 50 $200 3 1 70 $250 4 1 80 $300 Based on the above table, we can conclude that the firm enjoys economies of scale. the optimal scale of production is 70 units. the average product of labour is at the highest when the quantity of labour is 2 units. the law of diminishing marginal returns does not apply to the firm.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的投入、產出與成本的關係。生產所需的投入只有勞工和資本。 勞工（單位） 資本（單位） 總產出（單位） 總生產成本 1 1 20 $150 2 1 50 $200 3 1 70 $250 4 1 80 $300 根據上表，我們可以得出結論： 該廠商享有規模經濟。 生產的最優規模是 70 單位。 當勞工的數量是 2 單位時，勞工的平均產出是最高的。 邊際回報遞減定律並不適用於該廠商。

questions.en: The table below shows the input-output relationship of a firm. The only input required for the firm's production is labour. The wage rate per unit of labour is $50. Labour (units) Total output (units) 1 20 2 50 3 90 4 100 5 105 Based on the above information, we can conclude that _____. the law of diminishing marginal returns applies to the firm because when the 4th unit of labour is employed, marginal product starts to diminish when output increases from 90 units to 100 units, the firm suffers from diseconomies of scale when output increases from 100 units to 105 units, the firm suffers a loss the profit-maximising output is 90 units
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的投入與產出的關係。該廠商生產所需的投入只有勞力。每單位勞力的工資率是 $50。 勞力（單位） 總產出（單位） 1 20 2 50 3 90 4 100 5 105 根據以上資料，可得出的結論是：____。 邊際回報遞減定律適用於該廠商，因為當僱用第 4 個勞力單位時，邊際產量開始遞減 當產量由 90 單位增加至 100 單位時，該廠商會承受規模不經濟 當產量由 100 單位增加至 105 單位時，該廠商會承受虧損 利潤極大化的產量是 90 單位

questions.en: Miss Chan plans to open a flower shop. She is considering whether to open a flower shop at Flower Market Road, a district famous for having lots of flower shops, or to open at another location with no flower shops nearby. Based on the above information, an advantage for Miss Chan to open a flower shop at Flower Market Road is that she may be able to _____. enjoy internal economies of scale in terms of lower transportation costs enjoy external economies of scale in terms of lower marketing costs sell flowers at a higher price due to keener competition among sellers (1) only (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 陳小姐計劃開設一間花店。她正考慮將花店開設在花墟道（一個以花店眾多而聞名的地區）還是開設在一個附近沒有花店的地點。 根據上述資料，陳小姐將花店開設在花墟道的一個優點是，她可能可以 _____。 在降低運輸成本方面享有內部規模經濟 在降低營銷成本方面享有外部規模經濟 以更高價格出售花卉，因為賣家之間的競爭更激烈 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3)

questions.en: A firm increases all its inputs to raise its output by 50%. As a result, the total cost of production rises by 20%. Which of the following best explains the above situation? The firm benefits from lower cost of borrowing due to the availability of more collateral. After exhausting all cheap sources of raw materials, the firm needs to purchase raw materials from more expensive sources. The firm incurs higher marketing and promotion costs due to excessive expansion of the entire industry. The law of diminishing marginal returns applies to the firm’s production.
questions.zh: 某廠商增加所有投入以將產出提高 50%。結果，總生產成本上升 20%。以下哪一項最能解釋上述情況？ 該廠商因可提供更多抵押品而享有較低的借貸成本。 在用盡原料的所有廉價來源後，該廠商需要從更昂貴的來源購買原料。 由於整個行業過度擴張，該廠商承擔了更高的市場推廣成本。 邊際回報遞減定律適用於該廠商的生產。

questions.en: The following table shows the total cost schedule of a price-taking firm which has a fixed cost equal to $20. Quantity (units) Total cost ($) 1 40 2 65 3 95 4 130 5 170 Suppose the market price is $35. At the profit-maximizing output level, the firm's profit and total producer surplus are ______ and ______ respectively. $10 ... $10 $10 ... $30 $30 ... $10 $30 ... $30
questions.zh: 以下是一間受價公司的總成本表。該公司的固定成本等於$20。 數量(單位) 總成本($) 1 40 2 65 3 95 4 130 5 170 假設市價是$35。在利潤極大化產出水平，該公司的利潤和總生產者盈餘分別是 ________ 和 ________。 $10 ... $10 $10 ... $30 $30 ... $10 $30 ... $30

questions.en: Refer to the following table showing the production costs of a price-taking firm. Total output (units) 2 3 4 5 6 Marginal cost ($) 4 6 8 10 12 Average variable cost ($) 3 4 5 6 7 Fixed cost ($) 1 1 1 1 1 If the product price is $6, the firm will produce 5 units of output to maximize its profit. the maximum profit the firm can make is $5. the average variable cost is $5 when the firm maximizes its profit. the minimum total cost of the firm is $13.
questions.zh: 細閱下表有關某受價廠商的生產成本。 產出（單位） 2 3 4 5 6 邊際成本($) 4 6 8 10 12 平均可變成本($) 3 4 5 6 7 固定成本($) 1 1 1 1 1 若產品價格為$6， 該廠商會生產 5 單位的產出以爭取最高利潤。 該廠商可賺取的最高利潤是$5。 當該廠商的利潤為最高時，其平均可變成本是$5。 該廠商的最低總成本是$13。

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a firm. Outputs (units) 0 1 2 3 4 5 Total cost ($) 10 28 42 52 60 72 Based on the above table, we can conclude that the firm enjoys the benefits of economies of scale. the firm’s optimal scale of production is 5 units of outputs. the average variable cost is increasing. the total fixed cost is $10.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某廠商的成本與產出的關係。 產出（單位） 0 1 2 3 4 5 總成本（$） 10 28 42 52 60 72 根據上表，我們可得出結論如下： 該廠商享有規模經濟的好處。 該廠商的最佳生產規模是 5 單位的產出。 平均可變成本正上升。 總固定成本是 $10。

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a price taker. Output (unit) Total cost ($) 1 20 2 45 3 75 4 110 5 150 Given that the profit maximizing output of the firm is 3 units. If the fixed cost increases by $5, the price of the good and the output will be ________ and ________ respectively. $25 ... 2 units $30 ... 2 units $30 ... 3 units $75 ... 3 units
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價者的成本和產量的關係。 產量 (單位) 總成本 ($) 1 20 2 45 3 75 4 110 5 150 已知該廠商的利潤極大化產量是 3 單位。若固定成本增加 $5，該物品的價格和產量分別是 ________ 和 ________。 $25 ... 2 單位 $30 ... 2 單位 $30 ... 3 單位 $75 ... 3 單位

questions.en: The schedule below shows the marginal cost of a firm in a perfectly competitive market. Output (units) 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 Marginal cost ($) 5 5.5 6 6.5 7 8 9.5 Suppose the rental of the machine hired, a fixed cost, increases by $2 while the marginal cost for each unit of the output is reduced by $0.5. As a result, the profit-maximising output of the firm ____________ while the profit of the firm ____________. increases ... decreases increases ... may increase or decrease decreases ... decreases decreases ... may increase or decrease
questions.zh: 下表顯示在完全競爭市場內某廠商的邊際成本。 產量(單位) 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 邊際成本($) 5 5.5 6 6.5 7 8 9.5 假設租用機器的租金(屬固定成本)上升了$2，而每單位產出的邊際成本減少了$0.5。該廠商利潤極大化的產量因此 __________，而利潤 __________。 上升 … 下跌 上升 … 可能上升或下跌 下跌 … 下跌 下跌 … 可能上升或下跌

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a price-taker. Output (units) Average cost ($) 2 20 3 21 4 22 5 23 6 24 7 25 Suppose the market price is $25. What are the profit-maximising output and profit respectively? 4 units and $0 4 units and $12 7 units and $0 7 units and $12
questions.zh: 下表顯示一受價者的成本與產出的關係。 產出（單位） 平均成本($) 2 20 3 21 4 22 5 23 6 24 7 25 假設市場價格是 $25，爭取最高利潤的產出和利潤分別是多少？ 4單位及 $0 4單位及 $12 7單位及 $0 7單位及 $12

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a price-taker. Output (units) Average cost ($) 5 10 6 11 7 12 8 13 9 14 The market price is $20. Suppose the average cost has increased by $2 for every unit of output. The profit of the firm will ________. increase by $16 increase by $14 decrease by $16 decrease by $14
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價者的成本與產出的關係。 產出 (單位) 平均成本 ($) 5 10 6 11 7 12 8 13 9 14 市場價格是$20。假設每單位產出的平均成本上升$2。該廠商的利潤會 ________。 增加 $16 增加 $14 減少 $16 減少 $14

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a profit-maximising firm. The firm has a fixed cost of $5. Output (units) 1 2 3 4 5 6 Average cost ($) 7 6 7 8 9.6 12 Which of the following statements is correct? The optimal scale of production is 2 units. There exist diseconomies of scale after the third unit of output is produced. If the market price is $8, the output is 4 units. If the market price is $9, the profit is $6.
questions.zh: 下表顯示一家利潤極大化廠商其成本與產出的關係。該廠商的固定成本是$5。 產出(單位) 1 2 3 4 5 6 平均成本($) 7 6 7 8 9.6 12 下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 最優的生產規模是 2 單位。 在生產第三個單位的產出後，該廠商出現規模負經濟。 若市價是 $8，產出是 4 單位。 若市價是 $9，利潤是 $6。

questions.en: If the fixed cost of a price-taking firm decreases by $200 and the marginal cost of each unit of output increases by $10, the profit-maximising output will ______ and the profit ______. increase ... will decrease increase ... may increase or decrease decrease ... will increase decrease ... may increase or decrease
questions.zh: 如果某廠商的固定成本下跌 $200 而每單位邊際成本上升 $10，利潤極大化的產量會 _______，而利潤 _______。 上升……會下降 上升……可能上升或下降 下降……會上升 下降……可能上升或下降

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a price-taking firm. Total output (units) Average cost ($) 3 10 4 15 5 20 6 25 7 30 If the profit-maximising output is 6 units, the market price will be __________. $5 $25 $30 $50
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價者廠商成本與產出的關係。 總產出（單位） 平均成本（$） 3 10 4 15 5 20 6 25 7 30 若利潤極大化的產量是6單位，市場價格會是 ________。 $5 $25 $30 $50

questions.en: Refer to the following table about the cost-output relationship of a profit-maximising firm. Quantity (units) 1 2 3 4 5 Average cost ($) 5 6 7 8 9 If the average cost of every unit of output decreases by $1 and the market price is $8, the minimum cost of production is $18. the profit maximising output is 3 units. the maximum profit is $10. the marginal cost of every unit of output will remain unchanged.
questions.zh: 參考以下某利潤極大化廠商的成本與產出關係表。 數量（單位） 1 2 3 4 5 平均成本($) 5 6 7 8 9 若每單位產量的平均成本降低 $1，而市場價格是 $8， 最低生產成本為 $18。 利潤極大化產量是 3 單位。 最大利潤是 $10。 每單位產出的邊際成本會維持不變。

questions.en: The following table shows the cost-output relationship of a price-taking firm. Quantity (units) Average cost ($) 1 5 2 4 3 4 4 4.5 5 6 Based on the above table, when the market price falls from $6 to $4, we can conclude that the firm starts to enjoy economies of scale. the total cost of the firm will decrease from $30 to $12. the profit of the firm will decrease by $6. the quantity supplied will decrease from 5 units to 3 units.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價廠商的成本與產出的關係。 產出（單位） 平均成本 ($) 1 5 2 4 3 4 4 4.5 5 6 根據上表，我們可以得出結論：當市場價格由 $6 下降至 $4， 該廠商開始享有規模經濟。 該廠商的總成本會由 $30 下降至 $12。 該廠商的利潤會減少 $6。 供應量會由 5 單位下降至 3 單位。

questions.en: Winnie operates a café in Sham Shui Po. To maximise her profit, Winnie will produce more output if water charges for commercial use fall. business registration fee falls. the monthly rental payment of the café rises. the wage rate of part-time waiters increases.
questions.zh: 雲妮在深水埗經營一家咖啡店。若 _____________，雲妮會增加生產使其利潤最大化。 商業用戶水費下降 商業登記費下降 該咖啡店的按月租金上升 兼職侍應的工資率上升

questions.en: The following table shows the data of a price-taking garment factory. The fixed cost of the factory is $10. Output (units) Total cost ($) 6 48 7 63 8 80 9 99 10 120 11 143 Suppose the market price of garments rises from $17 to $19, and the fixed cost of the factory rises by $2. As a result, the profit maximising output of the factory would ______ while its profit would ______. remain unchanged ... increase to $56 remain unchanged ... increase to $70 increase by 1 unit ... increase to $70 increase by 1 unit ... increase to $82
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價成衣工廠的資料。該工廠的固定成本為 $10。 產出(單位) 總成本($) 6 48 7 63 8 80 9 99 10 120 11 143 假設成衣的市場價格由 $17 上升至 $19，而該工廠的固定成本則上升了 $2。結果，該工廠利潤極大化的產量會 ______，而利潤會 ______。 維持不變 …… 上升至 $56 維持不變 …… 上升至 $70 上升 1 單位 …… 上升至 $70 上升 1 單位 …… 上升至 $82

questions.en: The table below shows the cost-output relationship of a firm in a perfectly competitive market. The fixed cost of the firm is $6 and the market price is $20. Output (units) 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 Total variable cost ($) 4 12 24 40 60 84 112 Suppose the fixed cost decreases by $4 and the marginal cost for each unit of output increases by $4. As a result, the firm's profits will ____. remain unchanged decrease by $6 decrease by $12 decrease by $16
questions.zh: 下表顯示某完全競爭市場中一間廠商的成本與產出的關係。該廠商的固定成本是 $6，而市場價格是 $20。 產出（單位） 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 總可變成本（$） 4 12 24 40 60 84 112 假設固定成本下降 $4，而每單位產出的邊際成本上升 $4。結果，該廠商的利潤會 維持不變 下降 $6 下降 $12 下降 $16

questions.en: Firm X is a price-taking firm. Suppose both the market price and the marginal cost of each unit of output rise by $2 while the fixed cost decreases by $1, the profit-maximising output of Firm X _____ and its profit will _____. will remain unchanged ... increase will remain unchanged ... remain unchanged may increase or decrease ... increase may increase or decrease ... remain unchanged
questions.zh: 廠商 X 是一間受價廠商。假設市場價格和每單位產出的邊際成本皆上升了 ，而固定成本則下降了 ，廠商 X 利潤極大化的產量 ______，而其利潤會 ______。 會維持不變 …… 上升 會維持不變 …… 維持不變 可能上升或下降 …… 上升 可能上升或下降 …… 維持不變

questions.en: Which of the following is regarded as a fixed cost of a restaurant? the water charges the wages of the part-time workers the expenditure on meat and vegetables the rent of the restaurant
questions.zh: 下列哪一項被視為一間餐館的固定成本？ 水費 兼職工人的工資 購買肉類和蔬菜的開支 餐館的租金

questions.en: Short run is a period in which there are fixed factors of production there are variable factors of production. The technology of production is fixed. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1),(2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在短期生產時期內， 有固定生產因素。 有可變生產因素。 生產技術是固定的。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Suppose the MTR extends its service hours on New Year’s Eve. Which of the following are the MTR’s variable costs of extending the service hours? electricity expense overtime payment to the drivers interest payment for loans from banks (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假如地鐵在新年前夕延長時間，下列哪些是地鐵延長服務時間的可變成本？ 電費支出 司機的超時工作津貼 向銀行借錢因而要支付的利息 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following statements concerning the relationship between average cost and marginal cost is correct? When marginal cost reaches its minimum, marginal cost equals average cost. When marginal cost is rising, the average cost must be rising. When average cost is falling, it must be higher than marginal cost. A firm's average cost cannot always equal its marginal cost.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於平均成本與邊際成本之間關係的陳述是正確的？ 當邊際成本達到其最低點時，邊際成本等於平均成本。 當邊際成本上升時，平均成本必定上升。 當平均成本下降時，它必定高於邊際成本。 一間廠商的平均成本不可能經常等於其邊際成本。

questions.en: When average product is rising, marginal product may be rising or falling. may be lower than the average product. must be rising at a decreasing rate. must be rising at an increasing rate.
questions.zh: 當平均產量上升時，邊際產量 可能上升或下降。 可能低於平均產量。 必定以遞減率上升。 必定以遞增率上升。

questions.en: A school is a production unit which provides educational services. The following are people and objects that are usually found at a school: In the long run, which of the above items are variable factors of production of the school? the school building teachers students private cars owned by teachers sanitisers（洗手液） in the toilets (1) and (5) only (1), (2) and (5) only (2), (3) and (4) only (1), (2), (3), (4) and (5)
questions.zh: 學校是提供教育服務的生產單位。以下是一些在學校常見的人物和物件： 長期而言，上述哪些是學校的可變生產要素？ 校舍 教師 學生 教師擁有的私家車 洗手間的洗手液 只有 (1)、(5) 只有 (1)、(2)、(5) 只有 (2)、(3)、(4) (1)、(2)、(3)、(4) 及 (5)

questions.en: An art centre extends its business hours for one hour in order to offer more painting classes. Which of the following are variable costs involved in the extra hour of operation? salary of the accountant electricity fee expense on paints rental payment (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (4) only (1), (2), (3) and (4)
questions.zh: 一間藝術中心延長其營業時間一小時以開辦更多油畫班。下列各項中，哪些屬額外營運一小時所涉及的可變成本？ 會計員的薪金 電費 顏料費用 租金支出 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (4) (1)、(2)、(3) 及 (4)

questions.en: The advantages of sole-proprietorship include limited liability. Flexibility in decision making. A high degree of division of labour. More personal contact with customers. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 獨資經營的優點包括 有限債務責任。 決策具彈性。 高度分工。 與顧客有更多個人接觸。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (4) 只有 (3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Mr Chan was one of the owners of a trading firm which recently went bankrupt. The court then took over his personal property. To what kind of business ownership did this trading firm belong? sole-proprietorship partnership private limited company public limited company
questions.zh: 陳先生是最近破產的一家貿易公司的擁有人之一。法院其後接管了他的個人財產。這家貿易公司屬於哪一種商業擁有權？ 獨資 合夥 私人有限公司 公眾有限公司

questions.en: Which of the following is a common feature of all firms? They aim at profit-making. They have entrepreneurs to organize factors of production. They are legal entities. They are owned by private individuals.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項是全部廠商的共有特徵？ 它們以牟利為目的。 它們有企業家負責組織生產因素。 它們是法團。 它們由私人擁有。

questions.en: Which of the following is a possible consequence when government-run car parks become privately run? In these car parks, there will be greater efficiency in management. more car theft. less frequent changes in parking fees. shorter business hours.
questions.zh: 當政府經營的停車場轉為私營後，這些停車場可能出現什麼後果？ 管理更有效率 更多汽車失竊事件 停放車輛費用變動的次數減少 開放時間縮短

questions.en: Which of the following is regarded as an advantage for a private limited company to go public? Shareholders enjoy limited liability. There is separation of ownership and management. There is a wider scope for raising capital. Shares become transferable.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項被視為私人有限公司「上市」的一項好處？ 股東享有有限債務責任。 擁有權和管理權分開。 籌措資金的來源更為廣泛。 股票可以轉讓。

questions.en: Which of the following are the characteristics of a public corporation in Hong Kong? It is owned by the government. It has limited liability. Its employees are civil servants. Its stocks are quoted on the Stock Exchange. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 以下哪一項是香港公營公司的特性？ 由政府擁有 享有有限償債責任 僱員是公務員 它的股票在證券交易所上市 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of Tate's Cairn Tunnel (大老山隧道) being run by the private sector rather than by the government? The private firm has more freedom in staff management. Management by the private firm helps to ease traffic congestion. The private firm charges users a lower price than the government would charge. The private firm pays a lower interest rate on its loans than the government would have to pay.
questions.zh: 大老山隧道私營較公營有何好處？ 員工管理的自由度較高 有助改善交通擠塞 收費較政府低廉 向外借貸繳付利息較政府為少

questions.en: Peter and Joan form a partnership. Which of the following is true? One of them enjoys limited liability. Peter and Joan share the profits, if any, equally. If Peter borrows money in the name of the partnership, Joan is also liable for this debt. Peter can transfer his ownership in the partnership without Joan's agreement.
questions.zh: 小明和小玲以合夥的形式開設一商號。下列哪一項是對的？ 其中一人可享受有限債償責任。 小明和小玲平分所賺得的利潤。 如果小明以該合夥的名義舉債，小玲亦須承擔該筆債款。 小明可以不經小玲同意而將自己的合夥擁有權轉讓。

questions.en: One of the advantages of a private limited company 'going public' is : limited liability more access to funds being subject to a lower profits tax rate being less likely to be taken over by another company
questions.zh: 私人有限公司轉為公眾有限公司的好處之一是： 有限債償責任 有更多途徑獲得資金 以較低利得稅率繳稅 被收購的機會較低

questions.en: In Hong Kong, a public radio broadcasting company enjoys the following advantage over a private radio broadcasting company: lower production costs priority in obtaining world news a more extensive division of labour the ability to deal more easily with financial difficulties
questions.zh: 香港的公營電台較私營電台優勝處包括： 生產成本較低 有優先權獲得世界新聞 分工更為廣泛 較易應付財政困難

questions.en: A limited company is a legal entity. This implies that the company must obey the law. The company may sue other persons in its own name. Management and ownership of the company are separated. Its shares can be quoted on the stock exchange.
questions.zh: 有限公司是一法人。這表示 它必須遵守法律。 它可以公司名義起訴他人。 它的管理權與擁有權是分開的。 它的股票可以在股票交易所上市買賣。

questions.en: A public limited company differs from a private limited company in that, for example, there is no legal maximum limit on the number of shareholders. Its shareholders enjoy limited liability. It need not submit the memorandum of Associations to the Registrar of Companies. It is subject to a higher profits tax rate.
questions.zh: 公眾有限公司有別於私人有限公司，例如： 前者沒有股東最高人數的法定限制。 前者股東享有有限債償責任。 前者不必向公司註冊處呈交公司組織大綱。 前者利得稅率較高。

questions.en: Fanny and Estella are the only owners of a firm. They must obtain the other’s consent before they can transfer their ownership to other people. Besides, their liability to the firm is confined to their individual investment in the firm. Based on this information, the firm is a sole proprietorship. partnership. private limited company. public limited company.
questions.zh: 某廠商只有兩位東主：芬妮和愛斯。她們在轉讓擁有權予別人前必須另一人同意；並且，她們對該廠商的償債責任只限於各自在該廠商的投資額。根據上述資料，該廠商是 獨資經營。 合夥。 私人有限公司。 公眾有限公司。

questions.en: It is possible for a shareholder to sue his company because a company enjoys limited liability. a company is a legal entity. a company is managed by a board of directors. of the separation of management and ownership.
questions.zh: 股東可以控告他的公司，因為 公司享有有限償債責任。 公司是一法人。 公司由董事會管理。 公司內管理權與擁有權是分開的。

questions.en: A public limited company has more advantages in raising capital over a private limited company because the former is owned by the government but the latter is not. has more directors. can issue shares to the general public but the latter can't. has a larger scale of production.
questions.zh: 公眾有限公司在籌集資金時較私人有限公司優勝，因為前者 由政府擁有，而後者則不是。 有較多董事。 可向公眾發行股票，而後者則不能。 生產規模較大。

questions.en: Which of the following are the advantages of turning a sole-proprietorship into a private limited company? greater flexibly in decision-marking wider sources of capital higher incentive to work limited liability (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪兩項是從獨資經營轉為私人有限公司的好處？ 決策更為靈活 資金來源更廣 更有工作熱誠 有限償債責任 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (4) 只有 (3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Which of the following is a feature of a partnership? Only the sleeping partners enjoy limited liability. The business will be dissolved on the death of any one partner. All partners enjoy an equal share of the firm’s profit. The consent of the majority of partners is needed for the transfer of shares.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是合夥經營的特徵？ 只有不活躍合夥人可享有有限償債責任。 任何一位合夥人逝世，該廠商便要解散。 全部合夥人都平均分享該廠商的利潤。 合夥人轉讓股權，必須獲得多數合夥人的同意。

questions.en: If a listed company is converted into a private limited company, it can avoid being controlled by the government. its firm size will be reduced. it can reduce the risk of being taken over. it loses the status of legal entity.
questions.zh: 若一家上市公司轉為一家私人有限公司，它 可以避免受到政府控制。 縮小生產規模。 可以減少被收購的危險。 喪失法人的地位。

questions.en: Refer to the following information concerning Firm A and Firm B: Firm A Firm B Number of owners 6 7 Transfer of ownership need the consent of other owners need the consent of other owners Legal status of the firm legal entity not a legal entity The type of ownership of Firm A and Firm B is ______ and ______ respectively. public limited company ... private limited company private limited company ... partnership partnership ... private limited company public limited company ... partnership
questions.zh: 細閱以下有關甲、乙廠商的資料： 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 6 7 擁有權的轉讓 須獲得其他東主同意 須獲得其他東主同意 廠商的法律地位 法人 並非法人 甲廠商和乙廠商的擁有權形式分別屬於________和________。 公眾有限公司 … 私人有限公司 私人有限公司 … 合夥 合夥 … 私人有限公司 公眾有限公司 … 合夥

questions.en: Mr. Wai solely owns a restaurant in Tai Po and his wife runs the business for him. As compared to a public limited company, the type of ownership of the restaurant has the following advantages EXCEPT making prompt decision on management paying profits tax at a lower tax rate separation of ownership and management not having to disclose the financial status to the public
questions.zh: 衛先生在大埔獨自擁有一家飯店，他的妻子替他打理該飯店的業務。與公眾有限公司比較，下列哪一項並非該飯店的擁有權形式所具備的優點？ 可即時作管理上的決定 利得稅的稅率較低 擁有權和管理權分開 不須公開其財政狀況

questions.en: Being a small investor, Peter prefers to be a shareholder of a public limited company rather than that of a private limited company. This is because he can enjoy limited liability. the transfer of ownership is easier. shareholders have the right to sue the company. there is no legal maximum limit on the number of shareholders of a public limited company.
questions.zh: 小光作為小額投資者，會選擇做公眾有限公司的股東多於選擇做私人有限公司的股東。這是因為： 他可享有有限償債責任。 轉讓股權較為容易。 股東有權控告該公司。 公眾有限公司股東的數目沒有法定最高數目。

questions.en: John, Andy and Sammi form a partnership. Which of the following is true? They share profit equally. They can transfer their ownership freely without the consent of other partners. They have to bear unlimited liability. They have to disclose the financial conditions of the partnership.
questions.zh: 永康、志安和秀文以合夥形式經營生意。下列哪一項是正確的？ 他們均分利潤。 各人不需其他合夥人同意，也可將其擁有權自由轉讓予他人。 他們要承擔無限債償責任。 他們要公開該合夥的財政狀況。

questions.en: Partnership ___________ than sole proprietorship. has more capital is a less risky type of ownership enjoys more economies of scale has less flexibility in decision making
questions.zh: 合夥經營與獨資經營比較，前者 有更多資本。 風險較低。 享有更多規模經濟。 在決策上靈活性較低。

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of a public limited company over a private limited company? a wider source of capital larger economies of scale a better specialization in management a larger number of shareholders
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是公眾有限公司較私人有限公司優勝之處？ 資金來源更廣。 享有更大的規模經濟。 有更佳的專業化管理。 股東人數更多。

questions.en: Mr Wong and Mr Chan have formed a partnership. Which of the following statements is correct? They enjoy limited liability. The transfer of ownership does not need the other partner's consent. Each of them is responsible for the business decisions of the other. The accounts of the partnership have to be disclosed to the public.
questions.zh: 王先生與陳先生以合夥形式經營生意。下列哪一項是正確的？ 他們享有有限債務責任。 轉讓擁有權時無須另一合夥人同意。 他們每人都要為另一人在生意上的決定負上責任。 該合夥的帳目須公開予公眾人士。

questions.en: Which of the following are advantages of turning a private limited company into a listed company in the stock market? The company gains the status of a legal entity. The company enjoys economies of scale. The company enjoys a wider source of capital. Ownership of the company can be transferred freely in the market. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪項是將私人有限公司轉為股票市場上市公司的優點？ 公司獲得法人地位。 公司享有規模經濟。 公司享有更廣泛的資金來源。 公司的所有權可在市場上自由轉移。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (4) 只有 (2) 及 (3) 只有 (3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Firm A Firm B Legal Status Legal Entity Legal Entity Liability Limited Limited Transfer of ownership Does not need the consent of other owner(s) Needs the consent of other owner(s) Refer to the above table. Which of the following is correct? Firm A has more capital than Firm B. Firm A has a greater risk of being taken over by another firm than Firm B. Firm A is a listed company but Firm B is not. Both firms have to disclose their financial statements to the public.
questions.zh: 甲廠商 乙廠商 法律地位 獨立法人 獨立法人 債務責任 有限 有限 擁有權的轉讓 無需其他東主同意 需要其他東主同意 參閱上表。下列哪一項是正確的？ 甲廠商比乙廠商有較多資金。 與乙廠商相比，甲廠商被其他廠商收購的風險較高。 甲廠商是上市公司而乙廠商不是。 兩廠商都需要向公眾公開其帳目。

questions.en: Mr Lee is a private medical doctor. He wants to expand his business. He can raise funds by borrowing from banks. inviting partners to form a partnership. forming a private limited company and issuing shares to the public. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 李先生是一位私人執業醫生。他可以用下列哪些集資方法以擴充業務？ 向銀行借貸。 邀請別人做合夥人，成立一家合夥。 成立一家私人有限公司及向公眾發行股票。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Amy is an owner of a firm. Her liability to the firm is confined to her investment in the firm and she can transfer her ownership to anyone else without the consent of other owners. Based on the above information, the firm is a partnership. sole proprietorship. private limited company. public limited company.
questions.zh: 愛美是某廠商的一位東主。她對該廠商所負擔的債償責任限於她在該廠商的投資額，而她毋須獲得其他東主的同意也可以將她的擁有權轉讓給任何人。 根據上述資料，該廠商是一家 合夥。 獨資經營。 私人有限公司。 公眾有限公司。

questions.en: If a private limited company in Hong Kong is turned into a public limited company, the company will pay the profits tax at a higher rate. the company will gain the status of a legal entity. the company will have a wider source of capital. the original owners must increase their investments in the company.
questions.zh: 若香港的一家私人有限公司轉變成爲一家公眾有限公司， 該公司繳付的利得稅稅率會較高。 該公司會獲得法人地位。 該公司的資金來源會更廣。 原來的東主必須增加他們在該公司的投資額。

questions.en: Mr Chan is one of the owners of a firm which is a legal entity. Moreover, the transfer of Mr Chan’s ownership in the firm needs the consent of other owners. The firm is a partnership. sole proprietorship. private limited company. public limited company.
questions.zh: 陳先生是某廠商其中一位東主，而該廠商享有法人地位。陳先生若轉讓該廠商的擁有權，必須先獲得其他東主的同意。該廠商屬於 合夥。 獨資經營。 私人有限公司。 公眾有限公司。

questions.en: Compared with a limited company, a partnership has a lasting continuity. has to pay at a higher profits tax rate. has a wider source of capital. has a simpler legal set-up procedure.
questions.zh: 與有限公司相比，合夥 有永久延續性。 利得稅稅率較高。 資金來源更廣。 成立的法律程序較為簡單。

questions.en: If a listed public limited company is turned into a private limited company in Hong Kong, the company will be at a lower risk of being taken over. the company will pay the profits tax at a lower rate. the company will lose its legal entity. the shareholders will bear unlimited liability.
questions.zh: 若香港一家上市的公眾有限公司轉變成爲一家私人有限公司，則該公司 可以減少被收購的風險。 繳付的利得稅稅率會較低。 會失去法人地位。 的股東須承擔無限債務責任。

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of partnership over sole proprietorship? The owners enjoy limited liability. It has a wider source of capital. The risk of running the business is lower. There is no need to disclose its financial accounts to the public.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是合夥較獨資經營優勝的地方？ 東主享有有限債務責任。 資金來源較廣。 經營風險較低。 無需向公眾公開帳目。

questions.en: Study the following information about firm A and firm B. Firm A Firm B Number of owners 2 12 Transfer of ownership freely transferrable needs the consent of other owners Liability limited unlimited According to the above information, Firm A is a _______ and Firm B is a _______. public limited company ... private limited company private limited company ... partnership partnership ... private limited company public limited company ... partnership
questions.zh: 細閱以下有關甲、乙廠商的資料： 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 2 12 擁有權的轉讓 自由轉讓 須獲得其他東主同意 債務責任 有限 無限 根據上述資料，甲廠商是________，乙廠商是________。 公眾有限公司 ... 私人有限公司 私人有限公司 ... 合夥 合夥 ... 私人有限公司 公眾有限公司 ... 合夥

questions.en: Angel, Bonnie and Catherine jointly own a firm. The firm is a legal entity. Which of the following statements about the firm must be correct? The firm can issue shares to raise capital. At least one of the owners has to bear unlimited liability. The firm will be dissolved on the death of any one owner. The accounts of the firm have to be disclosed to the public.
questions.zh: 安琪、邦妮和嘉嘉共同擁有一家廠商。該廠商是一個法人。下列哪項關於該廠商的陳述必然正確？ 該廠商可發行股票籌集資金。 最少有一名東主須負上無限債務責任。 任何一名東主死亡，該廠商都要解散。 該廠商須向公眾披露其帳目。

questions.en: If the owners of a firm have the right to sue their firm but they cannot transfer their ownership freely without the consent of other owners, the firm is a partnership. sole proprietorship. private limited company. public limited company.
questions.zh: 某廠商的東主有權控告該廠商，但在未獲得其他東主同意之前不能自由轉讓其擁有權予他人。該廠商是一家 合夥。 獨資經營。 私人有限公司。 公眾有限公司。

questions.en: Which of the following is a possible reason for turning a partnership into a private limited company? The owners will make more profit. The owners will enjoy limited liability. It will ensure the financial privacy of the firm. Ownership of the firm can be transferred without the consent of other owners.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是由合夥轉為私人有限公司的可能原因？ 東主可獲更高利潤。 東主可享有限債務責任。 該廠商的財務狀況可保持機密。 廠商擁有權的轉讓毋須得到其他東主同意。

questions.en: Which of the following about a public limited company is correct? The company can be a shareholder of a listed company. The shares issued by the company are traded on a stock exchange. The maximum number of shareholders is 50. It earns greater returns than a private limited company.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項對公眾有限公司的描述是正確的？ 該公司可以是一家上市公司的股東。 該公司發行的股票是在股票市場上交易的。 股東的數目不超過 50 人。 它的回報較私人有限公司為高。

questions.en: Firm A Firm B Number of owners 3 12 Transfer of ownership Needs the consent of other owners Needs the consent of other owners Legal status Legal entity Not a legal entity According to the above information, which of the following descriptions of Firm A and Firm B in Hong Kong is correct? All owners of Firm A are legally bound by other owners' business decisions while those of Firm B are not. Firm A has to disclose its financial statement to the public while Firm B need not. Firm A is subject to a higher profits tax rate than Firm B. Firm A has a higher risk of being taken over by other firms than Firm B.
questions.zh: 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 3 12 擁有權的轉讓 須獲得其他東主的同意 須獲得其他東主的同意 法律地位 法人 不是法人 根據上表資料，下列哪項關於本港甲、乙廠商的描述是正確的？ 甲廠商所有東主對其他東主在生意上的決定都須負上法律責任，乙廠商的東主則無須負責。 甲廠商須公開其財政狀況，但乙廠商則無須如此做。 甲廠商的利得稅率較乙廠商高。 甲廠商被其他廠商收購的風險較乙廠商高。

questions.en: Mr. Lee, a sole proprietor, expands his business by forming a partnership with Mr. Chan. As a result, their liability to the firm is confined to their investment in the firm. they have to share profits equally. each of them has to be responsible for the business decisions of his partner. they can issue shares to raise capital.
questions.zh: 李先生原是一位獨資經營者。他爲了擴充生意，與陳先生合組了一家普通合夥。結果， 他們的償債責任限於他們在該廠商的投資額。 他們須均分利潤。 他們每人都要爲另一合夥人的商業決策負責。 他們可發行股票以籌集資金。

questions.en: After the 2008 stock market crash, some listed companies in Hong Kong proposed privatizing their companies. If a listed company is privatized and turns into a private limited company, the company is not a legal entity any more. the firm's size will be reduced. the company can enjoy a lower profits tax rate. the risks of being taken over will be reduced.
questions.zh: 2008年股市大跌之後，香港部分上市公司建議將公司私有化。若一家上市公司私有化，並轉為一家私人有限公司，則 該公司不再是法人。 該公司的規模會縮小。 該公司可享有較低的利得稅稅率。 該公司被收購的風險會減少。

questions.en: Which one of the following statements about a private limited company is correct? The shares issued by the company are traded on the stock market. The transfer of ownership needs the consent of other shareholders. It has to disclose its financial information to the public. It is subject to a lower profits tax rate than a public limited company.
questions.zh: 下列哪項對私人有限公司的描述是正確的？ 該公司發行的股票在股票市場中買賣。 擁有權的轉讓須得到其他股東的同意。 該公司須公開它的財政資料。 該公司繳交利得稅的稅率較公眾有限公司低。

questions.en: If a listed company is converted into a private limited company, it can avoid being controlled by the government. its scale of production will be reduced. it can reduce the risk of being taken over. it will lose the status of legal entity.
questions.zh: 若一家上市公司轉為一家私人有限公司， 它可免被政府控制。 它的生產規模會減少。 它可減低被收購的風險。 它會失去法人的地位。

questions.en: Which of the following is a feature of a partnership? Some partners can enjoy limited liability. The business will be dissolved on the death of any one partner. All partners share the profit of the firm equally. Shares can be transferred with the consent of the majority of partners.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是普通合夥的一個特徵？ 部分合夥人可享有有限債務責任。 任何一個合夥人去世，該合夥便要解散。 全部合夥人均分該廠商的利潤。 在獲得多數合夥人同意下，股份便可轉讓。

questions.en: Study the following information about Firm X and Firm Y. Firm X Firm Y Number of owners 2 50 Raising capital in the stock market possible not possible Liability limited limited According to the above information, Firm X is a _______ and Firm Y is a _______. public limited company … private limited company private limited company … partnership private limited company … public limited company public limited company … partnership
questions.zh: 細閱以下有關甲、乙廠商的資料： 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 2 50 在股票市場籌集資金 可能 不可能 債務責任 有限 有限 根據上述資料，甲廠商是 ________，乙廠商是 ________。 公眾有限公司 ... 私人有限公司 私人有限公司 ... 合夥 私人有限公司 ... 公眾有限公司 公眾有限公司 ... 合夥

questions.en: Tommy and David have turned their firm from a partnership into a private limited company. Which of the following statements is correct? They have a higher incentive to work as the profits tax rate is lower. The firm can still exist even if one of the owners goes bankrupt. The size of the firm will increase. The financial conditions of the firm have to be disclosed to the public.
questions.zh: 湯美和大衛將他們的公司由合夥轉成私人有限公司。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 他們工作意慾較高，因爲利得稅稅率減低了。 即使其中一個東主破產，公司仍可繼續存在。 公司的規模會增加。 公司的財政狀況須透露予公眾。

questions.en: Firm A Firm B Number of owners 2 10 Transfer of ownership Needs the consent of other owners Needs the consent of other owners Continuity Continues to exist when one of the owners goes bankrupt Will be dissolved when one of the owners goes bankrupt According to the above table, which of the following descriptions of Firm A and Firm B is correct? Firm A is at a greater risk of being taken over by another firm than Firm B. Firm A is a legal entity while Firm B is not. Both firms are subject to the same profits tax rate. Firm A is required to disclose its financial status to the public while Firm B is not.
questions.zh: 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 2 10 擁有權的轉讓 須獲得其他東主的同意 須獲得其他東主的同意 延續性 當一名東主破產，該廠商仍然繼續存在 當一名東主破產，該廠商會解散 根據上表資料，下列哪句關於甲、乙廠商的描述是正確的？ 甲廠商被其他廠商收購的風險較乙廠商高。 甲廠商是獨立法人，而乙廠商則不是。 兩間廠商要繳付相同的利得稅稅率。 甲廠商須公開其財政狀況，但乙廠商則不須。

questions.en: If a partnership is turned into a private limited company, the company will become an independent legal entity. the company will be at a higher risk of being taken over. the company will pay a higher profits tax rate. the number of owners will increase. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 若一家合夥變成了一家私人有限公司， 該公司會成爲一獨立法人。 該公司被收購的風險會較高。 該公司須付較高的利得稅率。 東主的數目會上升。 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about partnership and sole proprietorship is correct? Partnership has better continuity than sole proprietorship. Partnership has less flexibility in decision making than sole proprietorship. Partnership has more capital than sole proprietorship. Partnership enjoys more economies of scale than sole proprietorship.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關合夥經營與獨資經營的陳述是正確的？ 與獨資經營相比，合夥經營的持續性較佳。 與獨資經營相比，合夥經營在決策上靈活性較低。 與獨資經營相比，合夥經營有更多資本。 與獨資經營相比，合夥經營享有更多規模經濟。

questions.en: A firm has an independent legal entity but the owners cannot transfer their ownership without the consent of the other owners. When the owners want to expand the firm’s business, they can ____________. use the retained profit of the firm issue shares to the public to raise capital borrow from friends to raise capital (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 某廠商有獨立的法人地位，但擁有人不得未經其他擁有人同意而轉讓其擁有權。當擁有人想擴展廠商的業務，他們可以 __________。 運用廠商的保留利潤 向公衆發行股票以籌集資金 向朋友借貸以籌集資金 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Alan and his partners turned their partnership into a private limited company. After the change, the firm will have more capital for development. have a lower average production cost. enjoy a lower profits tax rate. have a separate legal entity.
questions.zh: 亞倫和他的合夥人將他們的合夥轉成私人有限公司。在轉變後， 該廠商會有更多資本作發展之用。 該廠商的平均生產成本會較低。 該廠商會享有較低的利得稅率。 該廠商會擁有獨立法人地位。

questions.en: Firm X Firm Y Number of owners 2 10 Transfer of ownership the consent of other owners required the consent of other owners NOT required Disclosure of financial account to public NOT required required According to the above table, which of the following descriptions of Firm X and Firm Y is correct? Firm Y earns a higher profit than Firm X. Firm Y raises more capital than Firm X. Owners of both firms enjoy limited liability. Firm Y is a legal entity while Firm X may not be.
questions.zh: 廠商 X 廠商 Y 擁有者數目 2 10 擁有權的轉讓 需要其他擁有者的同意 毋須其他擁有者的同意 向公眾披露財務資料 不需要 需要 根據上表，下列哪項有關廠商 X 和廠商 Y 的描述是正確的？ 廠商 Y 比廠商 X 賺取更高利潤。 廠商 Y 所籌集的資本比廠商 X 多。 兩家廠商的擁有者均享有有限債務責任。 廠商 Y 是獨立法人而廠商 X 可能不是。

questions.en: New World China Land Limited (Stock Code: 0917) announced privatisation of the company and cancelled its listing status at the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Which of the following are the possible advantages of the above change? The company can choose not to disclose its financial accounts to the public. The company can reduce the risk of being taken over. The company can enjoy a lower profits tax rate. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 新世界中國地產有限公司（股票編號：0917）宣布把公司私有化，並取消其在香港交易所的上市地位。 下列哪些是上述改變的可能好處？ 該公司可以選擇不向公眾披露其財務帳目。 該公司可以減低被收購的風險。 該公司可享有較低的利得稅率。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: If a public limited company in Hong Kong gets listed on the stock exchange, it will face a higher profits tax rate. it can no longer keep its accounting information confidential. its shareholders will enjoy higher liquidity of their assets. it will enjoy economies of scale.
questions.zh: 若一間香港的公眾有限公司在證券交易所上市， 它會面對較高的利得稅稅率。 它不能再將其會計資料保密。 其股東將享有更高的資產變現能力。 它會享有規模經濟。

questions.en: Li & Fung (Stock Code: 00494) announced a privatisation of its company, cancelling its listing status at the stock exchange in Hong Kong. Which of the following statements about Li & Fung is correct after the change? The firm can enjoy a lower profits tax rate. The firm can still issue shares to raise capital. The owners will become personally liable for legal charges against the firm. The firm will no longer exist when one of the owners goes bankrupt.
questions.zh: 利豐（股票編號：00494）公布將公司私有化，取消在本港股票交易所的上市地位。在該轉變後，下列哪項有關利豐的陳述是正確的？ 該公司能享有較低利得稅稅率。 該公司仍然能發行股票籌集資金。 東主須在該公司面臨法律訴訟時負上個人責任。 當其中一名東主破產，該公司不會繼續存在。

questions.en: Which of the following is a possible reason for turning a firm from a sole proprietorship to a partnership? The firm can get more profit. The firm can enjoy a wider scope of specialisation. The firm will become an independent legal entity. Business risk will be reduced as all partners have unlimited liability.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是將一家廠商由獨資經營轉成合夥的可能原因？ 該廠商能賺取更多利潤。 該廠商能享有範疇更廣的專門化。 該廠商會成為獨立法人。 由於所有合夥人均承擔無限債務責任，業務風險會減低。

questions.en: Refer to the following information about Firm A and Firm B in Hong Kong. Firm A Firm B Number of owners 3 50 Issuing shares to the public Impossible Possible Disclosure of financial information to the public Not necessary Necessary Based on the above information, we can conclude that Firm B raises more capital than Firm A. owners of both firms are required to obtain consent from other owners when transferring their ownership. Firm A may enjoy a lower profits tax rate than Firm B. Firm B is an independent legal entity while Firm A is not.
questions.zh: 參閱以下有關在香港的甲廠商及乙廠商的資料。 甲廠商 乙廠商 東主數目 3 50 向公眾發行股票 不可能 可能 向公眾披露財務資料 不需要 需要 根據上述資料，我們可得出結論如下： 乙廠商籌集到的資金比甲廠商多。 兩家廠商的東主在轉讓其擁有權時，均需獲得其他東主同意。 甲廠商可能比乙廠商享有較低的利得稅稅率。 乙廠商是獨立法人而甲廠商不是。

questions.en: ABC Studio Limited is a video production company in Hong Kong. Its financial status is not required to be disclosed to the general public by law. Which of the following statements about the company is correct? The admission of new shareholders does not require a consent from existing shareholders. The company can own assets under its name. The company may raise capital by issuing bonds to the general public. There is no upper limit on the number of shareholders.
questions.zh: ABC工作室有限公司是一間香港的影片製作公司。法例上，它毋須向公眾披露其財務狀況。 下列哪項關於該公司的陳述是正確的？ 新股東的加入毋須得到現有股東同意。 該公司可以其名義擁有資產。 該公司可透過向公眾發行債券集資。 股東人數沒有上限。

questions.en: In Hong Kong, if a sole proprietorship is turned into a private limited company, _____. there will be more owners in the firm the firm will face a higher profits tax rate for the same amount of profit earned the firm will enjoy lasting continuity (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在香港，若一家獨資經營變成了一家私人有限公司，______。 該廠商會有更多東主 在賺取相同利潤下，該廠商會面對較高的利得稅稅率 該廠商會享有延續性 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Who will receive the repayment first when a company liquidates? shareholders out of syllabus directors debenture-holders
questions.zh: 當一間公司清盤時，誰會先獲得還款？ 股東 超出課程範圍 董事 債券持有人

questions.en: On the liquidation of a public limited company, which of the following parties will get their money back before the others? the shareholders the debenture-holders the government the employees of the company
questions.zh: 一間公眾有限公司清盤時，以下哪一個團體可較其他人優先收回屬於它的金錢？ 股票持有人/股東 債券持有人 政府 僱員

questions.en: Mr Chan has purchased some shares in a public limited company. Which of the following statements is correct? He cannot participate in the management of the firm. He will automatically receive a dividend from the company every year. His personal accounts have to be disclosed to the public. His ownership in the company is freely transferable.
questions.zh: 陳先生購買了一公眾有限公司的股票，下列哪一項是對的？ 他不能參與該公司的管理。 他每年都收取該公司的股息。 他須向公眾交代他的個人帳目。 他可自由轉讓他對該公司的擁有權。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of a public limited company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing debentures over issuing shares to raise capital? The company can raise more capital. The existing shareholders have a better control of ownership of the company. The company can pay less to debenture holders than to shareholders when its profit is small. It is easier to obtain more bank loans if the company issues more debentures rather than more shares.
questions.zh: 從公眾有限公司的角度看，籌集資金時，發行債券較發行股票為佳的一項原因是： 該公司可籌得較多資金。 現時的股東對該公司有較大的控制權。 當利潤微薄時，該公司付予債券持有人的金錢可較付予股東的為少。 發行更多債券較發行更多股票可使該公司較易獲得銀行貸款。

questions.en: What is the economic role of shareholders in a public limited company? preparing the company’s accounts making production decisions bearing risk sharing profits
questions.zh: 公眾有限公司的股東扮演什麼經濟角色？ 編寫公司帳目 作出生產的決定 承擔風險 分享利潤

questions.en: Which of the following statements about limited companies in Hong Kong is correct? Shareholders and debenture holders have to bear unlimited liability. Issuing more debentures will increase the risk of being taken over. Shares and debentures of public limited companies are traded on the stock exchange. Debenture holders can claim the company's assets prior to shareholders when the company goes bankrupt.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於香港的有限公司的描述是正確的？ 股東和債券持有人都要承擔無限債償責任。 發行更多債券會增加公司被收購的風險。 公眾有限公司的股票和債券是在股票市場上買賣的。 當公司破產時，債券持有人有權先於股東取得公司的資產。

questions.en: As a small investor, Calvin prefers to purchase the shares of a listed company rather than those of a private limited company in Hong Kong because the accounts of a listed company have to be audited by certified accountants. there is a separation between ownership and management in a listed company. the shares of a listed company are freely transferable on the stock market. the liability of the shareholders of a listed company is limited to their investment in the company.
questions.zh: 嘉芬是一位小額投資者，在香港的上市公司與私人有限公司之中，他會選擇購買前者的股票，因爲上市公司的 帳目須由註冊會計師核算。 擁有權與管理權是分離的。 股票在股票市場上可自由轉讓。 股東的債償責任限於他們在該公司的投資額。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of investors, which of the following is an advantage of buying debentures over the purchase of shares? The return of debentures is higher. Debentures can be sold on the stock exchange while shares cannot. The market price of debentures is fixed. Debenture holders have a prior right to get their money back from the company if it liquidates.
questions.zh: 從投資者的角度來看，下列哪一項是購買債券較購買普通股為優勝的地方？ 債券的回報較高。 債券可以在證券交易所出售，而股票則不可以。 債券的市價是固定的。 若公司清盤，債券持有者享有優先權從公司取回他們的金錢。

questions.en: Which of the following descriptions about the shareholders and bondholders of a company is correct? Shareholders have a higher return than the bondholders. Bondholders have voting rights in the annual general meeting Shareholders are the creditors of the company. When the company winds up, the bondholders have a right to get the money back from the company in advance of its shareholders.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於公司股東和公司債券持有人的描述是正確的？ 股東所得的回報較債券持有人的爲高。 債券持有人在股東週年大會上有投票權。 股東是公司的債權人。 公司結束時，債券持有人較公司股東有先取回金錢的權利。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of the company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing shares over bonds to raise capital? The company can raise more capital. The company has the obligation to redeem the bonds but not the shares. The shares can be freely transferable on the stock market. The liability of the shareholders is confined to the amount they have invested in the company.
questions.zh: 從公司的角度出發，下列哪一項是發行股票較發行債券以籌集資金更爲優勝之處？ 該公司可籌得更多資金。 該公司有責任贖回債券，但不用贖回普通股股票。 股票可在股市中自由轉讓。 股東的債務責任只限於他們在該公司已投資的金額。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of the existing shareholders of a listed company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing bonds over shares to raise funds for future development? Their power of control over the company will not be diluted. The interest paid to the debenture holders is lower than the dividend. The company need not pay interest to the debenture holders when it incurs a loss. The debenture holders have no right to sue the company, whereas the shareholders do have the right.
questions.zh: 從上市公司的現有股東的觀點出發，為了籌集資金作發展用途，下列哪一項可顯示發行債券較發行普通股股票為佳？ 他們對該公司的控制權不會被攤薄。 支付予債券持有人的利息較股息低。 該公司有虧損時，毋須支付利息予債券持有人。 債券持有人無權控告該公司，但股東則有此權利。

questions.en: From the viewpoint of investors, which of the following is an advantage of buying shares over debentures? The return of shares is higher than that of debentures. The market price of ordinary shares may increase while that of debentures is fixed. Shareholders invest in the company at a lower risk than debenture holders. Shareholders have voting rights in annual general meetings while debenture holders do not.
questions.zh: 從投資者角度看，下列哪項是購買普通股股票勝於購買債券之處？ 普通股回報是高於債券回報的。 普通股市價可上升，但債券市價是固定的。 普通股股東在該公司投資的風險低於債券持有人。 普通股股東於周年大會上有投票權，而債券持有人則沒有。

questions.en: Which one of the following statements about the shareholders of a limited company is correct? They are the creditors of the company. They have voting rights in the Board of Directors' meetings. They receive dividends at a rate that is not fixed. They receive dividends at a higher rate than the interest of bondholders.
questions.zh: 下列哪項對一家有限公司股東的描述是正確的？ 他們是公司的債權人。 他們在董事局會議中有投票權。 他們收取股息，其股息率是不固定的。 他們收取的股息率較債券持有人所得的利息率高。

questions.en: A public limited company plans to issue new bonds for expansion. For the existing shareholders, which of the following is an advantage of issuing bonds instead of shares? The accounts of the company need not be disclosed to the public. They have priority in getting back their capital if the company liquidates. The interest paid to the bondholders is lower than the dividend paid to the shareholders. Their power of control over the company will not be diluted.
questions.zh: 某公眾有限公司計劃發行新的債券，以擴展業務。對現有的股東來說，下列哪項是發行債券而非股票的優點？ 毋須向公眾人士披露公司的帳目。 若公司清盤，他們會優先取回他們的資本。 付予債券持有人的利息比付予股東的股息低。 他們對公司的控制權不會被削弱。

questions.en: The government launched the Silver Bond for Hong Kong residents aged 65 or above. Bondholders will be paid interest at a rate linked to inflation in Hong Kong, subject to a minimum rate of 2% per year. Bondholders may sell their bonds at original price to the government before maturity. Which of the following statements about the Silver Bond is/are correct? The risk of holding the Silver Bond is lower than that of the shares of a listed company. The return of the Silver Bond would increase during inflation while the return of the shares of a listed company would not. The interest received by Silver Bond holders is higher than the dividend received by the shareholders of a listed company. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 政府為 65 歲或以上的香港居民推出銀色債券。債券持有人會獲發利息，利率和本港通脹掛鉤，但年利率不會少於 2%。債券持有人可在到期前將其債券以原價賣給政府。 下列哪 (幾) 項有關銀色債券的陳述是正確的？ 持有銀色債券的風險較持有上市公司股票的風險低。 在通脹時銀色債券的回報會上升，而上市公司股票的回報則不會。 銀色債券持有人收取的利息較上市公司股東收取的股息為高。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Some small investors prefer debentures to shares. Which of the following is a possible reason for that? The return of debentures is generally higher than that of shares. The price of shares may rise while that of debentures is fixed. Shareholders need to spend time managing the company but debenture holders do not. Companies have obligation to redeem debentures but they have no such obligation for shares.
questions.zh: 一些小投資者偏好購買債券多於股票。下列哪項是可能的原因？ 債券的回報一般高於股票的回報。 股票價格可能上升，而債券價格是固定的。 股東需要花時間管理公司，而債券持有人則不需要。 公司有贖回債券的義務，卻沒有贖回股票的義務。

questions.en: Mr Wong decides to invest in the bonds of a listed company instead of the shares of that company. Which of the following is the LEAST likely reason behind Mr Wong’s investment decision above? Mr Wong is optimistic about the business prospects of the company. Mr Wong prefers a more stable return from investment. Mr Wong wants to have a lower risk of suffering from a loss. Mr Wong wants to have a higher priority in getting back his investment in case the company liquidates.
questions.zh: 王先生決定投資某上市公司的債券，而非投資該公司的股票。下列哪項最不可能是王先生作上述投資決定背後的原因？ 王先生對該公司的經營前景感到樂觀。 王先生偏好較穩定的投資回報。 王先生想有較低的蒙受損失的風險。 王先生想在該公司一旦清盤時，可較優先取回他的投資。

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of lateral integration? a flour mill combines with a bakery a jeans factory combines with a swimwear factory a jewelry manufacturer combines with a noodle factory a furniture factory combines with a lumbering plant
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是側向合併的例子？ 一間麵粉廠與一間麵包店合併 一間牛仔褲廠與一間泳衣廠合併 一間珠寶製造商與一間麵廠合併 一間傢俬廠與一間伐木場合併

questions.en: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd. Took over Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd.(港龍航空公司). This is an example of horizontal integration. lateral integration. forward vertical integration. backward vertical integration.
questions.zh: 國泰航空有限公司收購了港龍航空公司。這是一個________的例子。 橫向合併 側面合併 向前縱合併 向後縱合併

questions.en: A movie-producing firm acquired a number of theatres to present its own films and films produced by other firms. What are the advantages of this type of integration to the firm? The firm can enjoy economies of scale. The firm can reduce its risks by diversifying its investment. It is easier for the firm to obtain contracts with movie stars. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 某電影製片公司收購了若干戲院來放映它本身及其他公司製作的電影。這種合併對該公司有何好處？ 可享有規模經濟 分散投資可降低風險 與電影明星傾談合約時更易成功 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of lateral expansion of a firm? A telephone company combines with a telegram(電報) company. A restaurant combines with a supermarket. A hospital sets up a school to train student nurses. A furniture company combines with another furniture company.
questions.zh: 以下哪一項是「側面擴張」的一個例子？ 一電話公司與一電報公司合併 一酒店與一超級市場合併 一醫院設立一學校以訓練護士學生 一傢俬公司與另一傢俬公司合併

questions.en: A travel agent takes over a real estate firm. What kind of integration is this? conglomerate integration lateral integration vertical integration horizontal integration.
questions.zh: 一旅行社收購一地產公司。這屬於何種合併？ 集團結合 側面合併 縱面合併 橫面合併

questions.en: In Hong Kong, when a commercial bank takes over another commercial bank, it has greater influence on deposit rates. It is able to diversify risk in its business. Its market share is enlarged. It will suffer from diseconomies of scale.
questions.zh: 在香港，當一商業銀行收購另一商業銀行， 它對存款利率有更大的影響。 它可以分散生意上的風險。 它的市場佔有更高。 它會出現規模不經濟的問題。

questions.en: A publisher takes over a bookstore. To the publisher, this is a ______ integration. conglomerate forward backward lateral
questions.zh: 一出版商收購一間書店。對該出版商而言，這是一種 集團結合。 前向合併。 後向合併。 側向合併。

questions.en: Which of the following is the greatest benefit from conglomerate integration? diversification of product economies of scale ensuring the markets for its output larger market share
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是集團結合的最大好處？ 產品多元化。 規模經濟。 保障產品的銷路。 更高的市場佔有率。

questions.en: When a cake shop takes over a coffee shop, which of the following are correct? This can provide an outlet for its products. The resources can be better utilized. The risk of the business is reduced through diversification. The profit will increase. (1), (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 若一家餅店收購一家咖啡店，下列哪幾項是正確的？ 可以為其產品提供一條出路。 資源可以運用得更好。 生意風險可以透過分散投資而減少。 利潤會增加。 只有(1)、(2)、(3) 只有(1)、(2)、(4) 只有(1)、(3)、(4) 只有(2)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: A famous singer expands his show business by producing stationery with his picture on it. This type of expansion is horizontal. forward. backward. conglomerate.
questions.zh: 某著名歌星擴充他的表演事業至生產印有他照片的文具。這屬於哪一類擴張？ 橫向 前向 後向 集團式

questions.en: When a shampoo manufacturer introduces a new product – shampoo for children, it aims at diversifying its market. gaining the economies of scale. ensuring a market outlet for its products. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 一位洗髮水製造商推出它的新產品--兒童洗髮水時，它的目標是 分散市場。 獲取市場規模經濟。 保證產品有銷路。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: A mobile phone company joins hands with a commercial bank. A customer of the bank can handle matters concerning his accounts by using the mobile phones produced by the mobile phone company. Which of the following is least likely a motive of the mobile phone company in this joint venture? to ensure a steady supply of raw materials to benefit from more efficient use of resources to benefit from economies of scale to promote goodwill
questions.zh: 一家流動電話公司與一家商業銀行聯營一種生意。銀行的客戶可以利用該流動電話公司生產的流動電話來處理銀行戶口事宜。以下哪一項是該流動電話公司各種參與該項聯營生意的動機中可能性最低的？ 保證原料有穩定的供應 從更有效地運用資源中得益 可從規模經濟中得益 推廣商譽

questions.en: A bus company expands its business and starts to provide ferry services to the outlying islands. This enables the bus company to diversify the risk of its business. diversify markets for its product. enjoy a larger market share. enjoy technical economies of scale.
questions.zh: 一家巴士公司擴充業務，開始提供來往離島的渡輪服務。此舉可使該巴士公司 分散風險。 的產品市場多元化。 享有更高的市場佔有率。 享有技術規模經濟。

questions.en: Mrs Chan, a large supplier of frozen beef, opens a chain of beef steak houses. To this supplier, the expansion is a vertical forward expansion. the risk of running a loss for her whole business will be lower. this can ensure a steady market outlet for her frozen beef. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)

questions.en: The expansion enables the catering company to spread the business risk by diversifying the product. have a greater influence on the market price. raise the productivity of its workers. have a more steady supply of raw materials.

questions.en: Suppose a Chinese computer manufacturer takes over a US computer manufacturer. Which of the following is NOT an advantage to the Chinese computer manufacturer in the above takeover? turning a competitor into a partner diversifying risk of demand fluctuation building up the goodwill of the company lowering the average cost of production

questions.en: ‘A rise in the price of a good will cause a decrease in demand for it and an increase in its supply.’ The above statement is correct because a change in price will change both demand and supply. incorrect because a rise in price will only increase the supply. incorrect because a rise in price will only decrease the demand. incorrect because both demand and supply will not change as a result of a change in

questions.en: Nowadays, more schools in Hong Kong have implemented reading programs to develop students' reading habits. This would lead to an increase in both the demand for and the supply of books. both the demand for and the quantity supplied of books. both the supply and the quantity demanded of books. both the supply and the quantity supplied of books.
questions.zh: 現今香港有更多學校實施閱讀計劃以培養學生的閱讀習慣。這會導致書本的 _______ 皆增加。 需求和供應 需求和供應量 供應和需求量 供應和供應量

questions.en: Which of the following would lead to a fall in price and an increase in quantity sold of imported Japanese television sets in Hong Kong? The transportation cost of goods from Japan to Hong Kong increases. An increasing number of lower-priced similar models of television sets are imported from Korea. The Japanese technology in producing television sets improves. The salaries tax rate in Hong Kong decreases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會導致進口香港的日本電視機價格下降及銷售量上升？ 香港從日本進口貨物的運輸費用增加。 香港從韓國進口更多類似型號而又較為廉宜的電視機。 日本生產電視機的技術有所進步。 香港的薪俸稅稅率下降。

questions.en: Suppose the technology required to produce LCD TV sets (液晶體電視機) advances. The price of LCD TV sets will _________ and the price of traditional CRT TV sets (傳統顯像管電視機) will _________. rise ... rise rise ... fall fall ... rise fall ... fall
questions.zh: 假設生產液晶體電視機的技術進步了，液晶體電視機的價格會 ________ 而傳統顯像管電視機的價格會 _______。 上升 ... 上升 上升 ... 下降 下降 ... 上升 下降 ... 下降

questions.en: A possible cause of an increase in both the world market price and the quantity transacted of gasoline could be a warmer than usual weather during winter around the world. a rapid industrial development of newly developing countries. oil production cuts by the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). a decrease in the price of crude oil which is used to produce gasoline.
questions.zh: 導致汽油的全球市價及交易量都上升的一個可能原因是： 全球冬季的氣候較平常溫暖。 新興發展國家的工業高速發展。 石油輸出國組織將石油減產。 用以製造汽油的原油價格下降。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the market of exhibition spaces in Hong Kong. An increase in the ______ would lead to a shift of the demand curve from D1 to D2 in the diagram. rental of exhibition spaces in Hong Kong rental of exhibition spaces in Macau number of trade fairs held in Hong Kong exhibition spaces in Macau
questions.zh: 下圖顯示香港展覽場地的市場。 下列哪項會導致圖中需求線從 D1 移至 D2? 香港展覽場地的租金上升。 澳門展覽場地的租金上升。 香港舉辦貿易展覽會的數目增加。 澳門展覽場地的數量增加。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of residential property in Hong Kong. The original equilibrium point is at E. If the population of Hong Kong increases and the wage rate of local construction workers rises, the new equilibrium point will be at _________. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示香港住宅樓宇的供需線。E 是原來的均衡點。 若本港人口增加，本地建築工人的工資率亦上升，那麼新的均衡點會在 ________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: The demand for ________ can be regarded as a derived demand of ________. beef ... leather printing paper ... magazines pop songs ... MP3 players high definition digital receivers (高清電視機器頂盒) ... TV sets
questions.zh: 對 ________ 的需求可視爲 ________ 的衍生需求。 牛肉 ... 皮革 印刷用紙張 ... 雜誌 流行歌曲 ... MP3 播放機 高清電視機機頂盒 ... 電視機

questions.en: An increase in the price of flour will lead to a decrease in the demand for flour. the supply of flour. the demand for bread. the supply of bread.
questions.zh: 麵粉加價會導致__________的__________減少。 麵粉……需求 麵粉……供應 麵包……需求 麵包……供應

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of mainland China's milk powder products in Hong Kong. The original equilibrium point is at E. Some of these milk powder products were found to contain the harmful substance, melamine (三聚氨胺) and some mainland milk powder producers left the industry. One possible new equilibrium point of the above diagram is at _______. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示中國內地奶粉產品在香港市場的供需線。E是原始均衡點。 在這些奶粉產品之中，部分被發現含有有害物質三聚氰胺。另外，內地奶粉生產商中有一部分退出這個行業。上圖一個可能的新均衡點是__________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: Suppose both the price and quantity transacted of imported rice decrease. This is likely to be caused by an increase in the transportation cost resulting from a higher fuel price. a change in taste from consuming rice to consuming noodles. a bad harvest of rice. an increase in the income of households given that rice is a normal good.
questions.zh: 假設進口稻米的價格及交易量皆下降。這可能是由下列哪項引致的？ 燃料價格上升帶來運費的增加。 口味轉變，由食用稻米變為食用麵類。 稻米失收。 家庭收入增加，而稻米是正常物品。

questions.en: Most Hong Kong people use either town gas or electricity for cooking. Suppose there is a drastic increase in electricity charges. Consumers' expenditure on electricity consumption _______ but their expenditure on town gas consumption _______. will decrease ... will increase will increase ... may increase or decrease may remain unchanged ... will decrease may increase or decrease ... will increase
questions.zh: 多數香港人用煤氣或電力煮食。假設電費大幅增加，消費者的電費總支出 ________ 而煤氣費總支出則 ________。 會減少 ... 會增加 會增加 ... 可能增加，亦可能減少 可能維持不變 ... 會減少 可能增加，亦可能減少 ... 會增加

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of swine flu vaccine in Hong Kong. The original equilibrium point is at E. If the number of the swine flu vaccine manufacturers increases and the risk of being infected by swine flu increases, one possible new equilibrium point of the above diagram is at _______. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示人類豬型流感疫苗在香港的供需線。E 是原始均衡點。 假設人類豬型流感疫苗製造商的數目增加了，同時感染該疫症的風險也上升了，上圖一個可能的新均衡點是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of competitive supply? compact discs and compact disc players residential buildings and commercial buildings textbooks and printing paper bread and butter
questions.zh: 下列哪項是競爭性供應的例子？ 光碟和光碟播放機 住宅樓宇和商業樓宇 教科書和印刷用紙張 麵包和牛油

questions.en: The government has imposed an environmental levy on plastic shopping bags but not on non-woven reusable bags (不織布袋). Suppose there was also an increase in the number of producers of non-woven reusable bags. As a result, the total sales revenue of non-woven reusable bags ________. would increase would decrease would remain unchanged might increase, remain unchanged or decrease
questions.zh: 政府針對塑膠購物袋實施環保徵費，而不織布袋則不用徵費。假設不織布袋的生產商數目亦增加了。 結果，不織布袋的總銷售收益________。 會增加 會減少 會維持不變 可能增加，可能維持不變，亦可能減少

questions.en: The following diagram shows the hotel accommodation market in London. Point E is the original equilibrium point. Suppose there is a bomb attack in a tube (subway) station and there is a rise in the operating cost of hotels in London. The new equilibrium point in the diagram would be __________. W X Y Z
questions.zh: 下圖顯示倫敦的酒店住宿市場，E點是原本的均衡點。 假設在倫敦的地鐵站發生炸彈襲擊事件及酒店營運成本上升。在圖中新的均衡點將會是 __________。 W X Y Z

questions.en: In the following diagram, E0 is the initial equilibrium of the market for printed books in Hong Kong. Suppose there is a trend to read electronic books and there is a rise in the price of printing paper. The new equilibrium point in the diagram will be ________. Ea Eb Ec Ed
questions.zh: 在下圖中，E0 是本港印刷書籍市場的起初均衡點。 假設閱讀電子書籍成爲趨勢，而印刷用紙的價格上升。圖中新的均衡點會是 ________。 Ea Eb Ec Ed

questions.en: A train accident seriously affects the confidence of travellers using a high-speed electric train service. At the same time, the airlines are facing the problem of rising fuel prices. Which of the following diagrams could represent a result of the above events?
questions.zh: 一宗鐵路意外嚴重影響了乘客使用高速電動列車服務的信心。同時，航空公司正面對燃油價格上升的問題。下列哪幅圖可代表上述事件的結果？ 航空運輸服務 航空運輸服務 高速電動列車服務 高速電動列車服務

questions.en: The following is the demand-supply diagram of a property market. E0 is the original equilibrium point. If the government increases the stamp duties levied on property buyers and tightens the controls on dumping of construction waste, the new equilibrium point in the property market will be _________. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 以下是某物業市場的供需圖，E0是起初的均衡點。 若政府向樓宇買家徵收較高的印花稅並收緊對棄置建築廢料的限制，該物業市場新的均衡點會是 ________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: Which of the following is assumed to be constant when the market demand curve of a good is derived? the income of the consumers the price of the good prices of related goods preference of the consumers (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 當導出某物品的市場需求曲線時，下列哪項是假設不變的？ 消費者的收入 該物品的價格 相關物品的價格 消費者的偏好 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(1)、(2)、(4) 只有(1)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: Refer to the following demand-supply diagram showing the market of luxury watches in Hong Kong. The initial equilibrium point is E0. Suppose the rental of shopping premises in Hong Kong rises sharply and the economy in the mainland experiences a recession. The new equilibrium point will be _______. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 參閱以下有關本港名貴手錶市場的供需圖。原初的均衡點是 E0。 假設本港商鋪的租金大幅上升，而內地的經濟出現衰退。新的均衡點會是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: A drop in the price for good X will lead to a drop in the price of good Y if good X and good Y are substitutes. good X and good Y are complements. good X and good Y are in competitive supply. good X and good Y are in joint supply. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，物品X的價格下跌會令物品Y的價格下跌？ 物品 X 及物品 Y 是替代品。 物品 X 及物品 Y 是輔助品。 物品 X 及物品 Y 屬競爭性供應。 物品 X 及物品 Y 屬聯合供應。 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: In which of the following pairs does the demand for the first good create a derived demand for the second one? Aviation service and pilots West Rail Line train service and Light Rail train service Blu-ray discs and Blu-ray disc players Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park Hong Kong
questions.zh: 下列哪一對物品中，對首項物品的需求會導致對次項物品的引申需求？ 航空服務及飛機師 西鐵線列車服務及輕鐵列車服務 藍光 (Blu-ray) 光碟及藍光光碟影碟機 香港迪士尼樂園和香港海洋公園

questions.en: Suppose the equilibrium point of the cosmetic surgery market in Hong Kong is originally at E0. If people become open-minded to cosmetic surgery while more regulations are imposed on the cosmetic surgery industry, the new equilibrium point will be at _________. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 假設香港整容手術市場的原初均衡點是 E0。若人們對整容手術日漸接受，而政府對整容手術行業實施更多規管，新的均衡點會是 ________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: Which of the following will result in a rise in the total revenue of chicken farms? The price of chicken feed falls. The government reduces the profits tax rate on chicken farms. The effective quota on the sale of chickens is increased. The government reduces the subsidy for the producers of pork.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會引致活雞農場的總收入上升？ 活雞飼料的價格下降。 政府調低對活雞農場的利得稅率。 出售活雞的有效配額有所提高。 政府減少對豬肉生產商的補貼。

questions.en: Holding other factors constant, a rise in the price of Good X will lead to a fall in the total revenue of Good Y if Good X and Good Y are complements. Good X and Good Y are substitutes. Good X and Good Y are in joint supply. Good X and Good Y are in competitive supply.
questions.zh: 其他因素維持不變，________________________，物品 X 的價格上升會令物品 Y 的總收入下跌。 若物品 X 及物品 Y 是輔助品 若物品 X 及物品 Y 是替代品 若物品 X 及物品 Y 屬聯合供應 若物品 X 及物品 Y 屬競爭性供應

questions.en: SS is the supply curve for smartphones. Which of the following reasons can best explain the change of the equilibrium position in the smartphone market from A to B?
