The retailers offer more free gifts for buying smartphones. The size of a tablet computer with a phone function is reduced. There are more smartphone producers in the market. The major network service providers increase the service charge at the same time.
questions.zh: 智能電話的供應曲線是 SS。下列哪項原因最能解釋智能電話市場的均衡位置由 A 改變至 B？ 零售商向購買智能電話的顧客提供更多贈品。 具備電話功能的平板電腦的體積縮小了。 市場上有更多智能電話生產商。 主要的流動網絡服務供應商同時提高他們的服務收費。

questions.en: Which of the following situations would lead to an increase in the demand for private housing? The price of private housing decreases. The supply of public housing increases. People expect the interest rate for mortgage loans to increase later. People expect the price of private housing to increase later.
questions.zh: 下列哪種情況會令私人房屋的需求增加？ 私人房屋的價格下降。 公共房屋的供應上升。 人們預期按揭貸款的利率稍後會上升。 人們預期私人房屋的價格稍後會上升。

questions.en: The demand for ______ can be regarded as a derived demand for ______. coffee beans ... coffee selfie sticks（自拍桿）... digital cameras chicken wings ... chicken legs newspapers ... printing paper
questions.zh: ________ 的需求可被視為 ________ 的引申需求。 咖啡豆……咖啡 自拍桿……數碼相機 雞翼……雞腿 報紙……印刷用紙

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of taxi services in Hong Kong. The original equilibrium is at E. New apps for smartphone such as "Uber" have been developed that enable some private car owners to provide the general public with personalised point-to-point transport service. At the same time, the fuel price has decreased significantly. The new equilibrium point will be at ________. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示香港的士服務的供應和需求曲線。原初的均衡在 E 點。 新開發的智能手機應用程式如優步 (Uber)，令一些私家車車主能對公眾提供直達目的地的個人化運輸服務。同時，燃料價格大幅下降。新的均衡點會在 ________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: The demand for construction workers in Hong Kong will increase if the legal procedures for urban re-development are simplified. wage rates of construction workers decrease. the government provides more allowances for training programmes for the construction industry. there are fewer job opportunities in the construction industry in Macau.
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，香港建築工人的需求會上升 市區重建的法律程序簡化了。 建築工人的工資率下降。 政府向建築業的培訓計劃提供更多津貼 澳門建築業的工作機會減少。

questions.en: Which of the following situations would most likely lead to an increase in the demand for iPhone produced by Apple Inc.? A technological breakthrough in the battery industry reduces its production cost. People expect the next model of iPhone will have more innovative features. A model of Samsung smartphone is banned by many airlines. Apple Inc. reduces the selling price of iPhone.
questions.zh: 下列哪種情況最有可能導致蘋果公司生產的 iPhone 的需求上升？ 電池業技術突破令其生產成本下降。 人們預期下一款的 iPhone 會有更多創新的特點。 三星公司的一款智能手機被很多航空公司禁止攜帶登機。 蘋果公司下調 iPhone 的售價。

questions.en: Suppose Good Y is an inferior good. When people's income rises and the production cost of Good Y increases, the equilibrium price of Good Y will increase will decrease will remain unchanged may increase or decrease
questions.zh: 假設物品 Y 是劣等物品。當人們的收入增加而物品 Y 的生產成本上升，物品 Y 的均衡價格 ________。 會上升 會下降 會維持不變 可能上升或下降

questions.en: Refer to the above diagram. The price of farming tools will rise because farm products and farming tools are in joint demand. fall because farm products and farming tools are in joint demand. rise because demand for farm products creates a derived demand for farming tools. fall because demand for farm products creates a derived demand for farming tools.
questions.zh: 參考上圖，農具的價格會 上升，因為農作物和農具屬聯合需求。 下降，因為農作物和農具屬聯合需求。 上升，因為農作物的需求衍生出對農具的引申需求。 下降，因為農作物的需求衍生出對農具的引申需求。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of air-purifiers. The original equilibrium point is E. Suppose there is a technological advance in producing air-purifiers. At the same time, the average air pollution index has been increasing over the last decade. The new equilibrium point will be at ___________. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示空氣清新機的供需曲線。原初的均衡點是 E。 假設空氣清新機的生產技術有所提升。同時，平均空氣污染指數近十年不斷上升。新的均衡點是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: The following table shows the number of new Tesla electric vehicle registered in Hong Kong. Month Number of new Tesla electric vehicle registered in Hong Kong December 2016 168 January 2017 168 February 2017 590 March 2017 2939 The Government announced in mid-February 2017 that the full exemption from first registration tax on electric vehicles would end on March 31, 2017. Which of the following best explains the above data? The supply of electric vehicles increased because new technology reduced the production cost of battery used in electric vehicles. The supply of electric vehicles increased because of the exemption of first registration tax by the Government. The demand for electric vehicles increased because the Government built more charging stations in the city. The demand for electric vehicles increased because the buyers expected the cost of buying electric vehicles to go up in the future.
questions.zh: 下表顯示本港新註冊 Tesla 電動車的數量。 月份 本港新註冊 Tesla 電動車的數量 2016 年 12 月 168 2017 年 1 月 168 2017 年 2 月 590 2017 年 3 月 2939 政府在 2017 年二月中公布電動車首次登記稅的全額減免會在 2017 年 3 月 31 日完結。 下列哪項最能解釋上述資料？ 電動車的供應增加了，因為新技術減低電動車用電池的生產成本。 電動車的供應增加了，因為政府豁免首次登記稅。 電動車的需求增加了，因為政府在本港興建更多充電站。 電動車的需求增加了，因為買家預期購買電動車的成本未來會上升。

questions.en: The following is the supply-demand diagram of e-sports equipment. The initial equilibrium point is E0. Suppose the government promotes e-sports by subsidising e-sports equipment manufacturers as well as the e-sports training programmes. The new equilibrium point will be ___. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 以下是電競設備的供需圖。原初的均衡點是 E0。 假設政府透過補貼電競設備製造商及電競訓練項目以推廣電競。 新的均衡點是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: SS is the supply curve of electric vehicles. Which of the following reasons can best explain the change of the equilibrium position in the electric vehicle market from A to B? All electric vehicle dealers provided a longer warranty period. The government removed the subsidies on buying electric vehicles. The gasoline suppliers greatly raised the price of gasoline. The cost of building charging stations drastically decreased.
questions.zh: 電動車的供應曲線是 SS。下列哪項原因最能解釋電動車市場均衡點由 A 改變到 B？ 所有電動車代理商提供更長的保養期。 政府取消購買電動車的補貼。 汽油供應商大幅增加汽油價格。 充電站的興建成本大幅下降。

questions.en: When the market supply curve of a good is derived, which of the following is/are assumed to be constant? the market price of the good the prices of factors of production of the good the expected future price of the good (1) only (2) only (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 當導出某物品的市場供應曲線時，下列哪項／些會假設為不變？ 該物品的市場價格 該物品的生產要素價格 預期該物品在將來的價格 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(3) 只有(2)、(3)

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram for Good Y. Suppose Good Y is an inferior good and the initial market equilibrium point is E. If there is a fall in the average income level of consumers, the new market equilibrium point will be __________. A B C D
questions.zh: 參閱以下物品 Y 的供需圖。 假設物品Y是劣等物品，而原初市場均衡點是E。若消費者的平均收入水平下降，新的市場均衡點會是 __________。 A B C D

questions.en: The demand for ________ can be regarded as a derived demand for ________. mobile phones ... earphones laptops ... batteries music videos ... singers game programmers ... online games
questions.zh: 對 ________ 的需求可視為對 ________ 的衍生需求。 手提電話 ... 耳機 手提電腦 ... 電池 音樂短片 ... 歌手 遊戲程式員 ... 網上遊戲

questions.en: When Good X and Good Y are __________, a decrease in the supply of Good X will result in an increase in the __________ Good Y. substitutes ... supply of substitutes ... quantity supplied of complements ... demand for complements ... quantity supplied of
questions.zh: 當物品 X 和物品 Y 是 ______，物品 X 的供應下降會令物品 Y 的 ______ 上升。 替代品 ... 供應 替代品 ... 供應量 輔助品 ... 需求 輔助品 ... 供應量

questions.en: The diagram below shows the demand and supply curves of webcams. The initial equilibrium point is E0. Suppose more firms replace face-to-face meetings with online meetings using video-conferencing software such as Zoom. At the same time, the price of lens used to produce webcams increases. As a result, the new equilibrium point will be E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示視像鏡頭的需求和供應曲線。原初的均衡點是 E0。 假設更多廠商以視像會議軟件如 Zoom 進行網上會議，取代面對面會議。同時，用於生產視像鏡頭的鏡片價格上升。結果，新的均衡點會是 __________。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: The following diagram shows the demand curve of private housing. Which of the following can best explain the change in equilibrium position from X to Y? The household income decreases. People expect a price drop in private housing. The wage rates of construction workers increase. The demand for commercial buildings decreases.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示私人房屋的需求曲線。 下列哪項最能解釋均衡點由 X 移至 Y？ 住戶收入下降。 人們預期私人房屋價格下降。 建築工人的工資率上升。 商業樓宇的需求下降。

questions.en: If the price of __________ increases, the supply of __________ will decrease. flour ... bread beef ... leather cars ... gasoline commercial buildings ... industrial buildings (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only

The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of electric vehicles. The original equilibrium point is E0. Suppose there is an increase in the cost of producing electric vehicles. At the same time, the decreasing number of car accidents involving electric vehicles increases consumers' confidence in electric vehicles. As a result, the new equilibrium point will be at ______. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示電動車的供需曲線。原初的均衡點是 E0。 假設電動車的生產成本上升。同時，涉及電動車的交通意外數字持續減少，令消費者對電動車的信心提高。結果，新的均衡點會是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: Suppose a campaign successfully attracted many pilots in Mainland cities to work in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, more and more Hong Kong people travel abroad for leisure. Which of the following diagrams best illustrates the effects of the above events?
questions.zh: 假設一項活動成功吸引很多來自內地城市的機師來香港工作。與此同時，越來越多香港人外遊消遣。 下列哪一幅圖最能說明上述事件的影響？

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply curve of taxi services. Which of the following best explains the change in the equilibrium position from point X to point Y? The government lowers the taxi fares. The government provides subsidies for citizens to use railway services. The government reduces the quota on taxi licences. The government amends the law to punish providers of ride-sharing services such as Uber drivers.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示的士服務的供應曲線。 下列哪項是均衡點由 X 點改變至 Y 點的最佳解釋？ 政府降低的士收費。 政府補貼市民使用鐵路服務。 政府減少的士牌照的配額。 政府修訂法例，懲罰乘車共享服務的提供者，例如優步(Uber)司機。

questions.en: The supply curve of Good X is vertical and its demand curve is downward-sloping. Suppose the supply of Good X decreases while the demand for Good X increases. As a result, the equilibrium price of Good X ______ and its equilibrium quantity ______. will increase ... will decrease will increase ... may increase, decrease or remain unchanged will decrease ... will decrease will decrease ... may increase, decrease or remain unchanged
questions.zh: 物品 X 的供應曲線是垂直的，而其需求曲線是向下傾斜的。 假設物品 X 的供應下降，同時物品 X 的需求上升。結果，物品 X 的均衡價格 ______，而其均衡數量 ______。 會上升 …… 會下降 會上升 …… 可能上升、下降或維持不變 會下降 …… 會下降 會下降 …… 可能上升、下降或維持不變

questions.en: Good X and Good Y are substitutes. If the cost of production of Good X increases, ______. the quantity demanded for Good Y decreases the quantity supplied of Good Y increases the supply of Good Y increases the total revenue of Good Y increases (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 物品 X 和物品 Y 是代替品。假如物品 X 的生產成本上升，____。 物品 Y 的需求量下降 物品 Y 的供應量上升 物品 Y 的供應上升 物品 Y 的總收入上升 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. Which of the following best explains why the supply curve shifts from S1 to S2? Cost of production of wine in China decreases. The income of Australian residents increases. The Chinese Government abolishes the import tariffs on Australian wine. Australian dollar appreciates against Renminbi.
questions.zh: 參考下圖。 下列哪項最能解釋為什麼供應曲線從 S1 移至 S2 ? 中國生產葡萄酒的成本下降。 澳洲居民的收入上升。 中國政府取消澳洲葡萄酒的進口關稅。 澳元兌人民幣升值。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the supply and demand curves of student accommodation in Country A. The original equilibrium point is E0. Suppose there is a significant increase in the number of overseas university students studying in Country A. At the same time, more commercial buildings have been converted into student accommodation. As a result, the new equilibrium point will be at _____. E1 E2 E3 E4
questions.zh: 下圖顯示甲國學生宿舍的供需曲線。原初的均衡點是 E0。 假設在甲國就讀的海外大學生人數顯著上升。同時，更多商業大廈被改建為學生宿舍。結果，新的均衡點會是 ______。 E1 E2 E3 E4

questions.en: If a uniform per-unit tax on wine is removed, then the price of high-quality wine will decrease. the price of low-quality wine will decrease. the relative price of high-quality wine will increase. All of the above.
questions.zh: 若取消對葡萄酒徵收的劃一從量稅，則 高質素葡萄酒的價格將會下降。 低質素葡萄酒的價格將會下降。 高質素葡萄酒的相對價格將會上升。 以上皆是。

questions.en: If the government charges the same lump-sum sales tax to each and every customer going to eat in restaurants, the price of food in restaurants will be reduced. a customer will eat less each time he goes to a restaurant and he will go less often. a customer will go to restaurants less often, but he will go to the higher-class restaurants. None of the above.
questions.zh: 如果政府向每一位到餐廳進餐的顧客徵收相同的定額銷售稅， 餐廳食物的價格將會降低。 顧客每次到餐廳進餐時會吃得較少，而且光顧的次數會減少。 顧客光顧餐廳的次數會減少，但他會光顧較高級的餐廳。 以上皆非。

questions.en: A unit sales tax imposed on cigarettes implies that the cigarettes produced will be longer. more smokers will buy cigarettes by the carton (條裝). the quantity of tobacco consumed will not be affected. the age distribution of smokers will not be affected.
questions.zh: 對香煙徵收從量銷售稅意味著 生產的香煙會較長。 更多吸煙者會購買條裝香煙。 煙草的消耗量將不受影響。 吸煙者的年齡分佈將不受影響。

questions.en: There are two types of cars: luxury cars and ordinary cars. If a uniform lump-sum tax is imposed on the purchase of a new car, the proportion of luxury cars will increase. the proportion of ordinary cars will increase. the number of luxury cars will increase. the number of ordinary cars will increase.
questions.zh: 汽車有兩種類型：豪華汽車和普通汽車。若對購買新車徵收劃一的定額稅， 豪華汽車的比例將會增加。 普通汽車的比例將會增加。 豪華汽車的數量將會增加。 普通汽車的數量將會增加。

questions.en: Which of the following pairs of incidents is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? terrorist attacks in a country and a fall in the number of visitors to that country heavier penalties for speeding and a reduced number of casualties in car accidents an imposition of quotas on garment exports and a fall in the quality of garments exported an invention of a new software program which tracks the illegal downloading of movies and an increase in the sales revenue of movie companies
questions.zh: 以下哪一組事件與需求定律不相符？ 某國發生恐怖襲擊，與到訪該國的旅客人數下跌 加重超速駕駛的刑罰，與交通意外傷亡人數減少 對成衣出口實施配額，與出口成衣的質素下降 發明追蹤非法下載電影的新軟件，與電影公司的銷售收益增加

questions.en: Which of the following pairs of observations is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? an increase in unemployment benefits and an increase in the number of unemployed people a sharp rise in the prices of dinners during Christmas Eve and a decrease in the number of people eating at home an increase in the rental of parking spaces and a decrease in the average quality of vehicles None of the above
questions.zh: 以下哪一對觀察與需求定律不相符？ 失業救濟增加與失業人數增加 平安夜晚餐價格急劇上升與留在家中進餐的人數減少 車位租金增加與車輛的平均質素下降 以上皆非

questions.en: Which of the following statements is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? A restaurant charges one dollar for one cooked chicken. A publisher sells some books well below the original cost of production. A hotel charges lower room rates for travel agents. Foreign tourists tend to stay in cheaper hotels than local tourists.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項陳述與需求定律不相符？ 餐廳的一隻熟雞收費一元。 出版社以遠低於原本生產成本的價格出售某些書籍。 酒店向旅行社收取較低的房租。 外地旅客比本地旅客較傾向入住較便宜的酒店。

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? An imposition of an import quota on garments will lead to an improvement in the average quality of imported garments. People who live in remote areas tend to buy better seats at concerts held in the town centre. An increase in unemployment allowance raises the unemployment rate. If an additional lump-sum charge is imposed per taxi trip, the number of short-distance trips will fall by a smaller percentage than the number of long-distance trips.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 對成衣實施進口配額會令進口成衣的平均質素改善。 居住在偏遠地區的人士購買於市中心舉行的音樂會門票時，會傾向選擇較佳的座位。 增加失業援助金會推高失業率。 若每程的士徵收一定額的額外費用，短程乘搭次數下跌的百分率會小於長程乘搭次數下跌的百分率。

questions.en: On 10th July 2011, the urban taxi fare for the first 2km was raised from $18 to $20. Which of the following statements about the urban taxi service are correct? The demand for taxi service dropped. The price of long-distance taxi trips relative to short-distance taxi trips dropped. The consumer surplus for the taxi service dropped. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 由2011年7月10日開始，市區的士服務首兩公里的車費由18元增加至20元。下列哪些有關市區的士服務的陳述是正確的？ 的士服務的需求下降。 相對短程的士服務，長程的士服務的價格下降。 的士服務的消費者盈餘下降。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? When a higher per-unit import tariff is imposed, the quality of garment imports worsens. When a government reduces the unemployment benefit, the number of unemployed people drops. When political unrest in a country causes riots in its major cities, the number of tourists visiting the country drops. When people expect the price of the shares of a listed company to rise, the price of those shares rises.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 當實施更高的從量進口關稅，進口成衣的質素下降。 當政府削減失業救濟金，失業人數下跌。 當某國政局不穩引致它的主要城市發生暴亂，到該國遊覽的旅客人數下跌。 當人們預期某上市公司股票的價格上升，該股票的價格上升。

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? More high-quality Japanese grapes are imported to Hong Kong during Mid-Autumn Festival. An increase of the per unit tax on beer results in a fall in the quantity of small-bottle beer sold in the market. After the introduction of the airport departure tax which is a fixed amount for any traveller, the average length of airplane journeys decreases. The birth rate increases when the income tax allowance for children increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 中秋節期間，香港進口較多日本的優質葡萄。 提高啤酒的從量稅引致小瓶啤酒在市場上的銷售數量下降。 對所有旅客徵收固定金額的機場離境稅後，旅客平均飛行旅程縮短了。 當提高入息稅中的子女免稅額，出生率便上升。

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? When the government imposes an ad valorem tax (i.e. the tax is a certain percent of the price) on red wine, the ratio of high-quality red wine sold to low-quality red wine sold remains unchanged. A larger quantity of expensive fruits is sold in a faraway market than a market near the farm. Price of residential flat and quantity transacted are positively related during an economic boom. An increase in the monthly rental of parking spaces will lead to a decrease in the average quality of vehicles that use the parking spaces.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 當政府對紅酒徵收從價稅 (即該稅項是價格的某一百分比)，售出的高質紅酒和劣質紅酒的比率維持不變。 與農場附近的市場比較，距離農場較遠的市場售出較大量的貴價水果。 在經濟繁榮時，住宅樓宇的價格和交易量是正向關係。 泊車位的月租租金上升會令停泊於這些泊車位的車輛的平均質素下降。

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? The abolishment of per unit import tariff on garment results in a rise in the quality of imported garments. Live fishes sold in a market near the fish farm have a higher price than frozen fishes sold in a faraway market. The ratio of high-quality white wine sold to total white wine sold remains unchanged when the government imposes an ad valorem tax on the white wine. Developers tend to build higher-quality housing units on a piece of land with a good view.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 取消對成衣的從量進口關稅令進口成衣的質素上升。 與距離養魚場較遠的市場售出的冰鮮魚比較，在養魚場附近市場售出的活魚價格較高。 當政府對白酒開徵從價稅，高檔白酒售出量相對於白酒總售出量的比率維持不變。 發展商傾向在一幅擁有良好景觀的地皮上興建較優質的住宅。

questions.en: Which of the following statements is correct after the adjustment of taxi fare shown below? Existing taxi fare Adjusted taxi fare First 2 kilometres: $20 First 2 kilometres: $25 Every subsequent 200 metres $1.5 Every subsequent 200 metres $1.5 Passengers will take more long-distance taxi trips. The ratio of short-distance taxi trips taken to long-distance taxi trips taken will decrease. The total revenue received by taxi drivers will increase. The fixed cost of operating taxi service will increase.
questions.zh: 在的士收費作出以下調整後，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 現時的士收費 調整後的士收費 首 2 公里： $20 首 2 公里： $25 其後每 200 米： $1.5 其後每 200 米： $1.5 乘客會乘搭更多長途的士行程。 乘搭短途的士行程與乘搭長途的士行程的比率會下降。 的士司機所得的總收益會增加。 經營的士服務的固定成本會上升。

questions.en: The table below shows the quantities of high-quality and average-quality Japanese fruits sold in Japan and Hong Kong. Assume the consumers' preferences on Japanese fruits are similar in both economies. Quantity of high-quality Japanese fruits sold (units) Quantity of average-quality Japanese fruits sold (units) Japan 50 200 Hong Kong Q1 Q2 Suppose the cost of transporting both types of fruits from Japan to Hong Kong are the same. Which of the following figures is/are consistent with the law of demand? Q1 = 30; Q2 = 140 Q1 = 40; Q2 = 150 Q1 = 45; Q2 = 180 (1) only (2) only (3) only (1) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下表顯示日本產優質水果和普通水果在日本和香港兩地的銷量。假設兩地消費者對日本產水果的偏好相近。 日本產優質水果銷量（單位） 日本產普通水果銷量（單位） 日本 50 200 香港 Q1 Q2 假設這兩種水果由日本運至香港的費用相同。下列哪項／些數據與需求定律相符？ Q1 = 30; Q2 = 140 Q1 = 40; Q2 = 150 Q1 = 45; Q2 = 180 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(3)

questions.en: Country A imports a huge amount of red wine every year via shipping. Suppose the shipping cost of each container rises from $250 to $1000. What will be the effect of the increase in shipping cost on the red wine sold in Country A? More red wine will be imported. The total expenditure on high-quality red wine will drop by the same percentage as that on low-quality red wine. The proportion of low-quality red wine sold in the market will decrease. The average quality of red wine sold in the market will decrease.
questions.zh: 甲國每年以海運進口大量紅酒。 假設每個貨櫃的海運成本由$250上升至$1000。海運成本上升對甲國售出的紅酒會有什麼影響？ 紅酒的進口量會增加。 用於高檔紅酒的總支出和用於低檔紅酒的總支出會以相同百分比下降。 市場上售出的低檔紅酒所佔的比例會下降。 市場上售出的紅酒的平均質素會下降。

questions.en: Which of the following is INCONSISTENT with the law of demand? When a theme park reduces its ticket price, visitors stay in the theme park for longer hours on average. Both the price and quantity transacted of private housing units decrease when people expect an increase in mortgage interest rates. Compared with customers living close to supermarkets, customers living far away from supermarkets tend to buy more items in each visit to supermarkets. If the Hong Kong Government shortens the quarantine period for incoming arrivals, the number of tourists visiting Hong Kong would increase.
questions.zh: 下列哪項與需求定律並不相符？ 當某主題公園減低入場費時，遊客在主題公園逗留的平均時間會較長。 當人們預期按揭利率上升時，私人住宅單位的價格和成交量均下降。 與居住在超級市場附近的顧客相比，居住在遠離超級市場的顧客每次到超級市場往往購買更多貨品。 若香港政府縮短入境旅客的檢疫期，訪港旅客人數會增加。

questions.en: ABC Company is a food delivery service provider. It offers the following two payment options to customers. Option 1: to pay a delivery fee of $30 per order Option 2: to pay a lump-sum membership fee of $200 per month and do not need to pay any delivery fee per order Based on the above information, after a customer paying the lump-sum membership fee, _____. he/she tends to use the food delivery services of ABC Company more frequently he/she tends to order higher-priced food when using the food delivery services of ABC Company the marginal benefit of the last unit of food delivery services of ABC Company consumed by him/her tends to become lower (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: ABC公司是一間提供送餐服務的公司。它予顧客以下兩種付費選項。 選項1：每次點餐支付$30送餐費用 選項2：每月支付$200定額會員費，每次點餐無須支付任何送餐費用 根據上述資料，當一名顧客支付定額會員費後，______。 他／她傾向更頻密地使用ABC公司的送餐服務 他／她使用ABC公司的送餐服務時傾向點選較高價的食品 他／她消費的最後一單位的ABC公司送餐服務的邊際利益傾向變得較低 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Suppose the Hong Kong Government adjusts the arrangement of ‘Public Transport Fare Concession Scheme for the Elderly and Eligible Persons with Disabilities’ as below: Fare under the original scheme Fare under the adjusted scheme Short-distance trip (Fare equal to or below $10) $2 $2 Long-distance trip (Fare above $10) $2 80% discount of the original fare As a result of the above policy adjustment, the ______ for the elderly and eligible persons with disabilities will decrease. quantity demanded for long-distance trips ratio of short-distance trips taken to long-distance trips taken average travel distance (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設香港政府調整「長者及合資格殘疾人士公共交通票價優惠計劃」的安排如下： 原計劃的車資 計劃調整後的車資 短途車程（車資等於或低於） 長途車程（車資高於） 原車資的兩折 由於上述政策調整，長者及合資格殘疾人士的 ______ 會下降。 長途車程的需求量 短途車程乘搭次數相對長途車程乘搭次數的比例 平均乘車距離 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A large stock of corn is piling up because of a good harvest. Which of the following diagrams can explain this phenomenon?
questions.zh: 由於豐收，粟米大量囤積。以下哪一圖可解釋此現象？

questions.en: It was reported that many people queued for two days in order to get the monthly parking ticket for a certain car park. This phenomenon implies scarcity in parking spaces. the existence of competition. shortage of parking spaces. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 有報道指不少人排隊兩天以購買某停車場的泊車月票。這現象意味著 泊車位屬「稀少性」。 競爭的存在。 泊車位短缺。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The Mass Transit Railway Corporation (MTRC) encourages the adoption of a flexi-time office-hours scheme (彈性上班時間) to reduce the overcrowding of passengers during the rush hours. Hence, passengers using the Nathan Road Route before 8:00 a.m. and between 9:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. will have a discount on their MTR fares. Which of the following diagrams could be a result of such a measure of the MTRC?
questions.zh: 香港地下鐵路公司鼓勵實施彈性上班時間計劃，以減低繁忙時間乘客的過份擁擠。因此，彌敦道幹線的乘客在上午 8 時前及在上午 9 時至 9 時 30 分之間乘搭地鐵可獲減價優待。 下列哪一幅圖可能是地下鐵路上述措施的一個結果？

questions.en: When the Real Madrid football team visited Hong Kong, many people queued up for days for the tickets to watch the game. Some people complained that they were unable to buy a ticket even they were willing to pay the official ticket price. This implies that there was only price competition for the ticket. the official ticket price was set below the market clearing level. the opportunity cost of obtaining a ticket was higher than its official selling price. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 皇家馬德里足球隊訪港時，很多人為購買球賽門券排隊多天。部分人投訴說即使他們願意付出主辦單位訂定的票價，還是買不到門券。這意味着 購買門券只有價格競爭。 主辦單位訂定的票價低於市場清銷價格。 獲得一張門券的機會成本高於主辦單位訂定的售價。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: It was reported that in late 2004, there were millions of unemployed people in the countryside of the Chinese mainland. On the other hand, the firms in the Pearl River delta faced a labour shortage problem. Which of the following would reduce unemployment in the countryside? The social welfare benefit of workers in the Pearl River delta improves. Labour wages in the Pearl River delta fall. Firms in the Pearl River delta move to the countryside. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2), (3)
questions.zh: 根據新聞報道，於2004年終，中國內地的農村有數以百萬計的人失業。另一方面，珠江三角洲的廠商則有勞工短缺問題。 下列哪項會減少農村的失業人口？ 在珠江三角洲，工人的社會福利保障有所改善。 珠江三角洲的工資下降。 珠江三角洲的廠商搬往農村生產。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: While many construction workers are unemployed in Hong Kong, there is a shortage of construction workers in Macau. Suppose a law is passed in Macau which allows the importation of construction workers from Hong Kong to Macau. Which of the following diagrams would best describe the effects of such a law on the labour market of construction workers in Macau?
questions.zh: 當香港有很多建築工人失業，澳門的建築業卻有工人短缺問題。假設澳門通過一條法例容許澳門從香港輸入建築工人，則關於該法例對澳門建築業的勞工市場的影響，下列哪一幅圖會是最佳的描述？

questions.en: Many people queued up for days for the tickets to watch the show of Tsz-Wah, a famous artist performing stand-up comedy. Some people complained that they were unable to buy tickets even though they were willing to pay the ticket price set by the organiser. The above situation implies that price was the only criterion for allocating the tickets. the producer was not maximising its profit. a black market for the tickets might emerge. there was an effective price ceiling in the ticket market.
questions.zh: 很多人連日排隊買票觀看著名藝人子華的棟篤笑表演。有些人投訴即使他們願意支付主辦機構所訂的門票價格，他們仍買不到門票。上述情況意味著 價格是分配門票的唯一準則。 生產商沒有爭取最高利潤。 有可能出現黑市門票。 門票市場存在有效的價格上限。

questions.en: The average waiting time for public housing is 4.7 years according to the data from the Housing Authority. Which of the following would lead to an increase in the waiting time for public housing in the long term? a financial aid offered to low-income families renting private residential flats a rise in the income limit of applying for public housing a relaxation of rules regulating the change of land use a provision of shared-housing units by a billionaire for the applicants of Comprehensive Social Security Assistance Scheme
questions.zh: 根據房委會的資料，公屋平均輪候時間為 4.7 年。下列哪項長遠來說會令公屋輪候時間增加？ 向租住私人住宅的低收入家庭提供金錢補助 提高申請公屋的人息限額 放寬規管改變土地用途的規例 某億萬富翁為綜合社會保障援助計劃的申請者提供共享房屋

questions.en: As part of the 'Happy Hong Kong' campaign, the 'Hong Kong Cinema Day' was held in April 2023, with tickets priced at HK$30 across all participating cinemas. It was reported that many people failed to buy any discounted film ticket even after queuing up for hours. From the information above, we can infer that the quantity transacted of the discounted film tickets is equal to the quantity supplied and smaller than the quantity demanded equal to the quantity supplied and larger than the quantity demanded equal to the quantity demanded and smaller than the quantity supplied equal to the quantity demanded and larger than the quantity supplied
questions.zh: 作為「開心香港」活動的一部分，「全港戲院日」在 2023 年 4 月舉行，參與活動的戲院的電影票價一律為 $30。有報道指，很多人即使排隊輪候數小時，仍未能購得優惠戲票。 從以上資料可以推斷，該些優惠戲票的交易量______。 等於其供應量而小於其需求量 等於其供應量而大於其需求量 等於其需求量而小於其供應量 等於其需求量而大於其供應量

questions.en: Peter Pang is an indigenous male resident in the New Territories. Which of the following are guided by price signals? He buys a concessionary house (丁屋) from his cousin. He is given a red packet by the Indigenous Inhabitant Representative (原居民代表) during the Lunar New Year. He rents one of his concessionary houses to a tenant who is not an indigenous resident. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 彭樹德是一位男性新界原居民。下列哪些是由價格訊息指導的？ 他向堂兄購買一幢「丁屋」。 在農曆新年時，他獲「原居民代表」分派紅封包。 他將名下的其中一幢「丁屋」出租給一位非原居民。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: A famous artist, Tsz-Wah, held a show. Many people complained that they could not buy a ticket. Ticket touts resold the tickets on the Internet and some buyers paid a price higher than HK$10 000 for a ticket. The above case illustrates the ______ function of price because ______. rationing ... the tickets are rationed to the highest-valued buyers rationing ... demand will be reduced by a higher price allocative ... more profits can be earned with a higher price allocative ... more resources should be allocated to the producer to raise the supply
questions.zh: 著名藝人子華舉辦了一場表演，很多人抱怨未能購得門票。門票黃牛黨在互聯網上轉售這些門票，有買家付出高於港幣 $10 000 購入一張門票。 上述個案說明了價格的 ________ 功能，因為 ________。 配給……這些門票配給予最高價值的買家 配給……價格愈高，需求便會下降 分配……價格愈高，利潤便會增加 分配……更多的資源應該分配予生產商以增加供應

questions.en: In recent years, the rise in demand for private cars in China has attracted Volkswagen, a German car manufacturer, to set up car manufacturing factories in China. The above case illustrates the __________ function of price because __________. rationing ... private cars are sold to the highest-valued users in China rationing ... fewer buyers are willing to buy private cars in Germany allocative ... the supply of private cars falls in Germany allocative ... more resources are allocated to the production of private cars in China
questions.zh: 近年，中國對私家車的需求上升，這吸引了福士汽車（一家德國汽車製造商）在中國開設汽車製造工廠。 上述個案說明了價格的 __________ 功能，因為 __________。 配給……在中國，私家車賣給最高價值的用家 配給……在德國，較少買家願意購買私家車 分配……在德國，私家車的供應下降 分配……在中國，更多的資源投放在私家車的生產上

questions.en: Suppose there is a good harvest of apples this year. Under which of the following conditions will apple growers earn more income? They sell more apples. The demand for apples is elastic. The supply of apples is inelastic. The government fixes a minimum price on apples.
questions.zh: 假設今年蘋果豐收。在下列哪種情況下，種植蘋果的農民會賺取更多收入？ 他們售出更多蘋果。 對蘋果的需求是有彈性的。 蘋果的供應是缺乏彈性的。 政府為蘋果訂立最低價格。

questions.en: After the launching of an advertising campaign, both the price and the quantity sold of a product increase. Which of the following statements can explain this? The demand for the product is inelastic. The supply of the product is elastic. The demand for the product increases. The supply of the product decreases.
questions.zh: 在推出廣告宣傳活動後，某產品的價格和銷量均告上升。下列哪項陳述能解釋這現象？ 該產品的需求是低彈性的。 該產品的供應是高彈性的。 對該產品的需求增加。 該產品的供應減少。

questions.en: Price Quantity demanded Total revenue $2 10 $20 $4 6 $24 $6 4 $24 $8 3 $24 $10 1 $10 The elasticity of demand is unitary over the price range from $2 to $6. $2 to $8. $4 to $8. $4 to $10.

When demand increases, which of the following would cause a greater rise in price? There is a large unsold stock of the good. It is easy to enter the industry. The factors of production have a low mobility. There is excess capacity in production.
questions.zh: 當需求增加時，以下哪一項會使價格有較大的增幅？ 這物品有大量未售出的存貨。 加入這行業是容易的事。 生產因素流動性低。 這行業有過剩生產能力。

questions.en: A tax on using the Cross-Harbour Tunnel will have the least effect on solving the Tunnel's congestion problem if the demand for the Tunnel service is elastic. the demand for the Tunnel service is inelastic. the supply of the Tunnel service is elastic. the demand for other transportation means of crossing the harbour is inelastic.
questions.zh: 在以下哪一種情況下，向海底隧道用家徵稅對解決該隧道擠塞問題效果最小 該隧道的需求彈性高 該隧道的需求彈性低 該隧道的供應彈性高 其他過海交通工具的需求彈性低

questions.en: Suppose the demand for wheat is elastic. Which of the following will decrease if there is a poor harvest of wheat? the price of wheat the total expenditure on wheat the demand for wheat the quantity of wheat transacted (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 設小麥的需求彈性高。若小麥失收，以下哪項會下跌或減少？ 小麥價格 購買小麥總支出 對小麥的需求 小麥交易量 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: If the demand is unitarily elastic along the above curve DD, then area 1 ______ area 2. is equal to is greater than is smaller than may be greater or smaller than
questions.zh: 如沿上圖曲線 DD 的各點需求彈性都是單位彈性時，面積 1____面積 2。 相等於 大於 小於 可大於亦可小於

questions.en: In a period of rainy weather, the price of umbrellas increased by 10% while the quantity transacted increased by 15%. What is the price elasticity of demand/supply of umbrellas in the above situation? The demand is elastic. The demand is inelastic. The supply is elastic. The supply is inelastic.
questions.zh: 天雨期間，雨傘的價格上升 10%，銷售量增加 15%。在這種情況下，雨傘的價格需求彈性或價格供應彈性是怎樣的？ 需求有彈性 需求缺乏彈性 供應有彈性 供應缺乏彈性

questions.en: The demand for good X is elastic. unitary elastic. perfectly elastic. inelastic.
questions.zh: X 貨品的需求屬 有彈性 單一彈性 完全彈性 缺乏彈性

questions.en: If there is a poor harvest of rice in Thailand, the total expenditure on Thai rice in Hong Kong would increase because of a price rise. would decrease because of the availability of substitutes. would be more or less the same because of the availability of substitutes. may increase or decrease, depending on the price elasticity of demand of Thai rice.
questions.zh: 若泰國食米嚴重失收，香港花費在泰國食米的總支出會 因而上升，因為價格上升。 因而下降，因為有替代品。 大致與前一樣，因為有替代品。 可能上升或下降，這取決於泰國食米的需求價格彈性。

questions.en: The price elasticity of demand for the Hung Hom Cross-Harbour Tunnel service would decrease if: the tunnel fee is raised from $10 to $30. the Western Harbour Crossing is open. the Eastern Harbour Crossing is closed for maintenance work. a new hydrofoil service is provided between Tsuen Wan and Wan Chai.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，經紅磡的海底隧道服務的需求價格彈性會降低？ 隧道收費由$10 提高至$30。 西區海底隧道通車。 東區海底隧道關閉做維修工作。 在荃灣和灣仔之間有渡海水翼船投入服務。

questions.en: Suppose the MTR fares on short-distance journeys (X) and cross-harbour journeys (Y) are raised by 6.9% and 13.6% respectively. If the quantity demanded for X and Y falls by 8% and 3.5% respectively, which of the following is correct? Both the demand for X and Y are elastic. Both the demand for X and Y are inelastic. The demand for X is less elastic than the demand for Y. The demand for X is more elastic than the demand for Y.
questions.zh: 假設地下鐵路短程（X）和渡海（Y）的收費分別提高 6.9% 和 13.6%。若 X 和 Y 的需求量分別下跌 8% 和 3.5%，下列哪一項是正確的？ X 和 Y 的需求都屬彈性高。 X 和 Y 的需求都屬彈性低。 X 與 Y 相比，前者需求彈性較低。 X 與 Y 相比，前者需求彈性較高。

questions.en: In the above diagram, if the demand is unitary elastic, Q2 will be 60 75 80 100
questions.zh: 上圖中，若需求是單一彈性，Q₂ 便是 60 75 80 100

questions.en: Suppose the unit price of good X increases from $2 to $2.8, and its quantity demanded changes by 20%. Which of the following statements is correct? The increase in price leads to a more than proportionate decrease in the quantity demanded of good X. The increase in price leads to an increase in the total revenue of good X. The elasticity of demand for good X is 0.4. The change in the quantity demanded is less than the change in the price of good X.
questions.zh: 設物品 X 的單位價格從$2 上升至$2.8，而其需求量則改變 20%。下列哪一項是正確？ 物品 X 的價格上升導致其需求量下跌，而該下跌的百分比大於價格上升的百分比。 物品 X 的價格上升導致其銷售收益上升。 物品 X 的需求彈性是 0.4。 物品 X 需求量的改變小於其價格的改變。

questions.en: When the supply of a commodity increases, its price may rise if the demand for it is perfectly elastic. the demand for it is perfectly elastic. the price of its complement decreases. the price of its substitute decreases.
questions.zh: 若某商品的供應有所增加，在下列哪一種情況它的價格可能上升？ 它的需求屬完全無彈性。 它的需求屬完全有彈性。 它的輔用品價格下降。 它的替代品價格下降。

questions.en: In the above diagram, when the price P₁ increases to P₂, the excess demand will disappear. the quantity transacted will decrease. the total revenue will necessarily increase. the total revenue will increase only if the demand is inelastic.
questions.zh: 在上圖中，當價格 P1 上升至 P2 時， 求過於供會消失。 交易量會下降。 總銷售收益必然上升。 只有當需求彈性弱時，總銷售收益才會上升。

questions.en: The demand elasticity of good X is 1.2. After a decrease in supply, the equilibrium quantity drops by 30%. The equilibrium price would ______ by increase ... 25% decrease ... 25% increase ... 36% decrease ... 36%
questions.zh: 物品 X 的需求彈性是 1.2。在供應減少之後，均衡數量下降 30%。均衡價格會 增加 25% 減少 25% 增加 36% 減少 36%

questions.en: 'I love to take photos very much. Even though the price of film has increased by 30%, my spending on it will still be the same.' Mary said. Mary's demand for film is perfectly inelastic. inelastic. elastic. unitarily elastic.
questions.zh: 小欣說：「我很喜歡攝影。即使菲林的價格上升了30%，我在菲林上的開支仍會維持不變。」小欣對菲林的需求屬於 完全無彈性。 低彈性。 高彈性。 單一彈性。

questions.en: After a good harvest, the price of choi-sum has changed by 50% and the quantity transacted has changed by 40%. Which of the following statements is/are correct? The quantity demanded of choi-sum has increased. The demand for choi-sum has increased. The total revenue from selling choi-sum has increased. (1) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在某次豐收後，菜心的價格改變了 50% 而交易量則改變了 40% 。下列哪項描述是正確的？ 菜心的需求量增加了。 菜心的需求增加了。 菜心的總銷售收益增加了。 只有 (1) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose there is a technological advance in the production of a normal good. In which of the following situations may the market price of the good remain unchanged? The income of consumers decreases. The government raises the unit sales tax on the good. The demand for the good is perfectly inelastic. The supply of the good is perfectly inelastic.
questions.zh: 假設某正常物品的生產技術進步了。在下列哪一種情況下，該物品的市價可能維持不變？ 消費者的收入減少。 政府提高該物品的從量銷售稅。 該物品的需求完全無彈性。 該物品的供應完全無彈性。

questions.en: Which of the following would increase the elasticity of demand of the transport service of the Mass Transit Railway (MTR)? the cutting of bus lines running routes similar to those of the MTR a decrease in MTR passenger fares the opening of new bus lines running routes similar to those of the MTR a decrease in the operating costs of the MTR
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會增加地下鐵路運輸服務的需求彈性？ 削減與地鐵路線相近的巴士路線。 地鐵票價下降。 開設與地鐵路線相近的新巴士路線。 地鐵的營運成本下降。

questions.en: Refer to the following straight line demand curve DD. Point A is the mid-point of the demand curve DD. If the unit price increases from $8 to P, the total revenue will be greater than $80. will be equal to $80. will be smaller than $80. may be greater or smaller than $80.
questions.zh: 下圖的需求線 DD 是一條直線。 A 點是需求線 DD 的中點。若單位價格由$8 增加至 P，總收益 會大於$80。 會等於$80 會小於$80。 可能大於，亦可能小於$80。

questions.en: A market researcher reports to the manager of a company, "Even if we cut prices to boost sales, the sales revenue will remain unchanged because of the elasticity of demand of our product." According to the market researcher, their product's elasticity of demand is perfectly inelastic. inelastic. elastic. unitarily elastic.
questions.zh: 一名市場研究員向公司的經理提交報告：「即使我們減價以刺激銷量，銷售收益仍會維持不變。這是由我們產品的需求彈性所導致的。」 根據他所言，他們產品的需求屬 完全無彈性 低彈性 高彈性 單一彈性

questions.en: In the above diagram, DD is a demand curve. In the price range P1 to P2, the elasticity of demand is less than 1. is equal to 1. is greater than 1. may be less than or greater than 1, depending on the exact values of P1, P2, Q1 and Q2.
questions.zh: 上圖中 DD 是一條需求曲線。在 P1 至 P2 的價格範圍內，需求彈性 小於 1。 等於 1。 大於 1。 可能小於或大於 1，視乎 P1、P2、Q1 及 Q2 的實際數值而定。

questions.en: The table below shows the relationship between the price of Good X and its total sales revenue. Price ($) 1 2 3 Total sales revenue ($) 100 200 300 Within the above price range, the elasticity of demand of Good X is equal to zero. greater than zero and smaller than one. equal to one. greater than one.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某物品的價格與其總銷售收益之間的關係。 價格 ($) 1 2 3 總銷售收益 ($) 100 200 300 在上述價格範圍內，該物品的需求彈性 等於零。 大於零及小於一。 等於一。 大於一。

questions.en: If the price elasticity of demand is greater than one, it means when demand increases total revenue increases. when demand increases the price goes up. when the price goes down total revenue decreases. when the price goes up total revenue decreases.
questions.zh: 若需求價格彈性大於一，這意味著 當需求增加時，總收入增加。 當需求增加時，價格上升。 當價格下降時，總收入減少。 當價格上升時，總收入減少。

questions.en: Fearing an outbreak of bird flu, people tend to consume less live poultry but more canned food. As a result, the price of the canned food of a particular brand changed by 50% and its quantity transacted rose from 1 000 cans to 1 350 cans per month. We can conclude that within the above price range this canned food had an elastic demand. an inelastic demand. an elastic supply. an inelastic supply.
questions.zh: 因恐懼禽流感爆發，人們傾向減少食用活家禽而增加食用罐頭食品。因此，某牌子罐頭食品的價格改變了 50%，交易量則由每月 1 000 罐增加至每月 1 350 罐。 我們可得結論如下：在上述價格範圍內，該罐頭食品的 需求屬高彈性。 需求屬低彈性。 供應屬高彈性。 供應屬低彈性。

questions.en: The table below shows the relationship between the price of Good X and its sales revenue. Price ($) 10 20 30 Sales revenue ($) 1 000 1 500 2 000 Within the above price range, the elasticity of demand for Good X is equal to zero. greater than zero and smaller than one. equal to one. greater than one.
questions.zh: 下表顯示物品 X 的價格與其銷售收益的關係。 價格 ($) 10 20 30 銷售收益 ($) 1 000 1 500 2 000 在上述價格範圍內，物品 X 的需求彈性 等於零。 大於零及小於 1。 等於 1。 大於 1。

questions.en: The imposition of a per unit sales tax on a good will reduce its equilibrium quantity if the demand is inelastic. the demand is elastic. the demand is unitarily elastic. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，政府向某物品徵收從量銷售稅會減少其均衡量？ 它的需求彈性低。 它的需求彈性高。 它的需求屬單一彈性。 以上皆爲正確答案。

questions.en: Recently the stock market in Shanghai has become overheated. Compared with last year, the selling price of a financial magazine has increased from RMB¥5 to RMB¥8 while its sales volume has increased by 10%. In the above case, the law of demand is violated. the demand curve of the magazine can still be downward sloping. the demand for the magazine is inelastic. the supply of the magazine is elastic.
questions.zh: 近期上海股票市場過熱。與去年比較，某財經雜誌的售價由人民幣 5 元增加至人民幣 8 元，其銷售量則上升了 10%。 在上述個案中， 需求定律被推翻了。 該雜誌的需求曲線仍可以是向右下斜的。 該雜誌的需求屬低彈性。 該雜誌的供應屬高彈性。

questions.en: With the introduction of high-definition television (HD TV) broadcasting in Hong Kong, more people have chosen to buy an HD TV set. Under what condition will the market price of HD TV sets remain unchanged? The income of consumers increases. The government grants a cash subsidy to lower income groups to buy HD TV sets. The demand for HD TV sets is perfectly inelastic. The supply of HD TV sets is perfectly elastic.
questions.zh: 香港出現高清電視廣播後，更多人選擇購買高清電視機。在什麼條件下高清電視機的市價會維持不變？ 消費者的收入上升。 政府給予低收入人士一筆現金資助以購買高清電視機。 高清電視機的需求完全缺乏彈性。 高清電視機的供應屬完全有彈性。

questions.en: Mr Chan travels frequently between Hong Kong and Beijing on business trips. Last year, even though the price of air-tickets increased by 50%, Mr Chan's total expenditure on these air-tickets remained unchanged. If Mr Chan's demand for these air-tickets last year remained the same as the previous year, his demand for these air-tickets last year would have been perfectly inelastic. inelastic. unitarily elastic. elastic.
questions.zh: 陳先生不時因公幹往返香港、北京兩地。在去年，即使飛機票價上升了 50%，陳先生在飛機票上的總支出不變。假設陳先生去年對飛機票的需求和之前一年相同，他去年對飛機票的需求屬於 完全無彈性。 低彈性。 單一彈性。 高彈性。

questions.en: Suppose with the more popular use of iPods (portable media players), the price of the traditional MP3 players has fallen by 40% and the quantity sold has changed by 50%. This would indicate that within that price range, there was an ________ for the traditional MP3 player. elastic demand inelastic demand elastic supply inelastic supply
questions.zh: 假設由於人們更普及地使用 iPod (一種可攜式媒體播放器)，傳統 MP3 播放器的價格下跌了 40%，其銷售量則改變了 50%。 這顯示傳統 MP3 播放器在該價格範圍內的 需求彈性高。 需求彈性低。 供應彈性高。 供應彈性低。

questions.en: The demand elasticity of Good X is equal to one. Which of the following is a correct description of Good X? An increase in its price will not affect the quantity demanded. An increase in the price of its substitute will not affect the quantity demanded. The imposition of a per unit sales tax on it will not affect consumers' expenditure on it. A per unit subsidy offered by the government will not affect the total revenue (including the subsidy) of the sellers.
questions.zh: 物品 X 的需求彈性是 1。下列哪項對物品 X 的描述是正確的？ 它的價格上升不會影響它的需求量。 它的代替品的價格上升不會影響它的需求量。 對它徵收從量銷售稅不會影響消費者在該物品上的支出。 政府給予該物品的從量津貼不會影響賣家包括津貼額在內的總收益。

questions.en: Suppose an increase in the demand for Good Y results in a 10% and 5% change in its price and quantity transacted respectively. Which of the following could explain the extent of the change in the price and the quantity transacted? The good is a habit-forming good. There are no close substitutes for the good. Firms producing the good have excess capacity in production. Firms producing the good have used factor inputs which are more specialized.
questions.zh: 假設物品 Y 的需求增加導致它的價格及交易量分別改變了 10% 及 5%。下列哪項可以解釋它的價格及交易量改變的幅度？ 該物品是慣性使用的物品。 該物品沒有近似的代替品。 生產該物品的廠商有剩餘的產能。 生產該物品的廠商使用了更專門的生產要素。

questions.en: A seller found that when he raised the price of good X from $10 to $12, the daily total sales revenue of good X increased from $1 000 to $1 200. Based on the above information, within the above price range, the elasticity of demand of Good X is ________. zero greater than zero but smaller than one equal to one greater than one
questions.zh: 某賣家發現當他將物品 X 的價格由 $10 提高至 $12，每日總銷售收益由 $1 000 增加至 $1 200。 根據以上資料，在該段價格範圍內，物品 X 的需求彈性是________。 零 大於零但小於壹 等於壹 大於壹

questions.en: During the last Easter holiday, the unstable political situation in Thailand caused the price of air tickets to Thailand to fall by 50% and the quantity sold to change by 70%. This suggests that during that period of time and within that price range, there was an ________ for/of air tickets to Thailand. elastic demand inelastic demand elastic supply inelastic supply
questions.zh: 在去年復活節假期期間，泰國的政局不穩導致飛往當地的機票價格下降了 50%，而其售出數量改變了 70%。 這意味在該時期及上述價格範圍內，飛往泰國的機票的________。 需求屬高彈性 需求屬低彈性 供應屬高彈性 供應屬低彈性

questions.en: During winter, women tend to buy more hydrating facial cream. As a result, the price of bottled hydrating facial cream of a particular brand changed by 20% and its quantity transacted rose from 2 000 bottles to 2 800 bottles per month. We can conclude that within the above price range this bottled hydrating facial cream had an elastic demand. an inelastic demand. an elastic supply. an inelastic supply.
questions.zh: 在冬季，女士們傾向購買更多保濕面霜。結果，某品牌樽裝保濕面霜的價格改變了 20%，而其交易量由每月 2 000 樽上升至 2 800 樽。 我們可以總結出，在上述價格範圍內，該樽裝保濕面霜具有 彈性需求。 低彈性需求。 彈性供應。 低彈性供應。

questions.en: Suppose there is political unrest in the countries exporting crude oil. As a result, there is a 30% increase in the price of gasoline and a 15% change in the quantity transacted of gasoline. We can conclude that the demand for gasoline is elastic. the demand for gasoline is inelastic. the supply of gasoline is elastic. the supply of gasoline is inelastic.
questions.zh: 假設原油出口國政局不穩。結果，汽油的價格增加 30%，而汽油的交易量改變了 15%。我們可以得出結論如下： 汽油的需求屬高彈性。 汽油的需求屬低彈性。 汽油的供應屬高彈性。 汽油的供應屬低彈性。

questions.en: Michelle is a jewelry lover and she says, "I will spend all my monthly salary on jewelry no matter what the price is." From this we can conclude that her demand for jewelry is elastic. inelastic. unitarily elastic. perfectly inelastic.
questions.zh: 米雪是珠寶愛好者。她說：「我會將我全部的月薪花在珠寶上，不論它的價格如何。」由此我們可得出結論：她對珠寶的需求屬 高彈性。 低彈性。 單一彈性。 完全沒有彈性。

questions.en: Owing to continuous bad weather, the quantity transacted of local vegetables falls by 40% while the price rises by 13%. Which of the following statements are correct? The quantity demanded of local vegetables falls. The total expenditure on local vegetables rises. The demand for imported vegetables rises. The total expenditure on imported vegetables may rise or fall depending on the elasticity of demand. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 由於天氣持續惡劣，本地蔬菜的交易量下降了 40%，而價格上升了 13%。下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 本地蔬菜的需求量下降。 本地蔬菜的總支出上升。 進口蔬菜的需求上升。 進口蔬菜的總支出可能上升或下降，按其需求彈性而定。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4) 只有 (3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following would reduce the elasticity of demand for the transport service of the Airport Express? There are more airport bus routes to different districts. Vans are not allowed to pick up passengers at the airport. The fare of the Airport Express is raised. The maintenance cost of the Airport Express trains increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會減低對機場快線列車服務的需求彈性？ 有更多來往不同地區的機場巴士路線。 客貨車不准在機場接載乘客。 機場快線的車費增加。 機場快線列車的維修費用增加。

questions.en: The table below shows the relationship between the price of and the total expenditure on ice-cream. Unit price ($) 5 6 7 8 Total expenditure ($) 25 30 35 40 From the above table, we can conclude that the elasticity of demand for ice-cream is __________ (without regard to its negative sign). between zero and one equal to zero larger than one equal to one
questions.zh: 下表顯示雪糕的價格和顧客對雪糕的總支出的關係。 單位價格($) 5 6 7 8 總支出($) 25 30 35 40 我們可從上表得出結論：雪糕的需求彈性是__________ (不理會其負號)。 在零和一之間 等於零 大於一 等於一

questions.en: A decrease in the cost of producing Good X results in a 5% and 10% change in its price and quantity transacted respectively. Which of the following best explains the above changes? Good X is a durable good. There are no close substitutes for Good X. Firms producing Good X have excess capacity in production. The factors of production for Good X are not easily available.
questions.zh: 物品 X 的生產成本下降，導致其價格和交易量分別改變了 5% 及 10%。下列哪項最能解釋上述的改變？ 物品 X 是一種耐用品。 物品 X 沒有接近的替代品。 生產物品 X 的廠商有剩餘的產能。 物品 X 的生產要素並不容易找到。

questions.en: Refer to the following conversation between Mandy and Shirley. Mandy: I like coffee very much! No matter how its price changes, I always buy the same amount of coffee every week! Shirley: I like coffee very much too! No matter how its price changes, I always spend the same amount of money on coffee every week! Base on their conversation, Mandy's demand for coffee is ______ and Shirley's demand for coffee is ______. perfectly inelastic ... perfectly inelastic perfectly inelastic ... unitarily elastic unitarily elastic ... perfectly inelastic unitarily elastic ... unitarily elastic
questions.zh: 參看文迪和莎莉的對話。 文迪： 我酷愛咖啡！不論其價格如何轉變，每週我總是購買相同數量的咖啡。 莎莉： 我也酷愛咖啡！不論其價格如何轉變，每週我總是花費相同金額購買咖啡。 根據他們的對話，文迪對咖啡的需求屬 ________ 而莎莉對咖啡的需求屬 ________ 完全沒有彈性……完全沒有彈性 完全沒有彈性……單一彈性 單一彈性……完全沒有彈性 單一彈性……單一彈性

questions.en: The original price of Sausage McMuffin with Egg was $11 each. McDonald's introduced the following discount in a limited time. As a result, more people bought Sausage McMuffin with Egg during the promotion period. Which of the following statements about this situation is correct? McDonald's was not maximising profit during the promotion period. The demand for Sausage McMuffin with Egg would be higher during the promotion period. The total expenditure of consumers on Sausage McMuffin with Egg would increase if the demand was elastic. There would be a temporary shortage of the food ingredients for making Sausage McMuffin with Egg.
questions.zh: 豬柳蛋漢堡原價每個$11。麥當勞在限定時間內推出以下優惠。 結果，在優惠期間有更多人購買豬柳蛋漢堡。下列哪項有關這情況的陳述是正確的？ 在優惠期間麥當勞沒有爭取最高利潤。 豬柳蛋漢堡的需求在優惠期間會上升。 若需求屬高彈性，消費者對豬柳蛋漢堡的總支出會上升。 製作豬柳蛋漢堡所需的食材會暫時出現短缺。

questions.en: Study the following news abstract. A Dengue fever (登革熱) scare has hit Hong Kong after 19 people in the past week were confirmed to have contracted the virus locally. Dengue fever is transmitted to humans by Aedes albopictus (白紋伊紋), a type of mosquito commonly found in Hong Kong. Suppose the price and the quantity of mosquito repellents sold in Hong Kong changed by 5% and 120% respectively shortly after the release of the above news. This indicates that during that period and within the price range, there was an __________ the mosquito repellents in Hong Kong. elastic supply of inelastic supply of elastic demand for inelastic demand for
questions.zh: 細閱以下報章摘要： 登革熱恐慌襲港——上星期本港有19人確診在本地感染登革熱病毒。登革熱是由白紋伊蚊傳播給人類，而白紋伊蚊是在本港常見的蚊子。 假設以上新聞發佈後，本港售賣的蚊怕水的價格和數量隨即分別轉變了 5%和 120%。這顯示在該段時間和價格範圍內，本港蚊怕水的 ________。 供應屬高彈性 供應屬低彈性 需求屬高彈性 需求屬低彈性

questions.en: A new private hospital, Gleneagles Hong Kong Hospital (GHK), opened in Wong Chuk Hang in early 2017. GHK offered a 50% salary rise to attract experienced nurses from public hospitals. Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct after the opening of GHK? The wage rates of experienced nurses in public hospitals would increase by more than 50% if the demand for nurses is elastic. The supply of experienced nurses in public hospitals would decrease. The elasticity of demand of public medical services would decrease. The waiting time for public medical services would remain unchanged.
questions.zh: 港怡醫院是一所新的私家醫院，於2017年初在黃竹坑開幕。港怡醫院以加薪 50% 來吸引公立醫院有經驗的護士轉職。 根據以上資料，在港怡醫院開幕後，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 若護士的需求屬高彈性，公立醫院有經驗的護士的工資率會上升超過 50%。 公立醫院有經驗的護士的供應會減少。 公共醫療服務的需求彈性會下降。 公共醫療服務的輪候時間會維持不變。

questions.en: When the price of Australia's red wine decreases from $70 to $50, the quantity demanded increases from 100 units to 122 units. What is the arc elasticity of demand for Australia's red wine within the above price range? 0.59 0.77 1.30 1.68
questions.zh: 當澳洲紅酒的價格由$70下降至$50，其需求量由100單位上升至122單位。在上述的價格範圍內，澳洲紅酒需求的弧彈性是多少？ 0.59 0.77 1.30 1.68

questions.en: Refer to the following news. In order to reduce pollution, the government imposes a production tax on all kinds of motor vehicles (except electric vehicles). As a result, the price of gasoline changes by 22% and its quantity transacted changes by 35%. Which of the following statements is correct? The demand for gasoline is elastic. The demand for gasoline is inelastic. The supply of gasoline is elastic. The supply of gasoline is inelastic.
questions.zh: 參考以下一則新聞。 為了減少污染，政府對所有種類的車輛徵收一項生產稅（電動車除外）。 結果，汽油的價格改變了 22% 及其交易量改變了 35%。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 汽油的需求屬高彈性。 汽油的需求屬低彈性。 汽油的供應屬高彈性。 汽油的供應屬低彈性。

questions.en: The following table shows the total expenditure of Mary and Peter on soft drinks. Unit price ($) Consumer’s total expenditure ($) Mary Peter 1 20 60 2 40 60 3 60 60 4 80 60 Mary’s elasticity of demand for soft drinks is ________ while Peter’s elasticity of demand for soft drinks is ________ (without regard to the negative sign). between zero and one ... equal to zero between zero and one ... equal to one equal to zero ... equal to zero equal to zero ... equal to one
questions.zh: 下表顯示瑪莉和彼德用於汽水的總支出。 單位價格($) 消費者的總支出($) 瑪莉 彼德 1 20 60 2 40 60 3 60 60 4 80 60 瑪莉對汽水的需求彈性是 __________ 而彼德對汽水的需求彈性是 __________（不理會負號）。 在零和一之間 ... 等於零 在零和一之間 ... 等於一 等於零 ... 等於零 等於零 ... 等於一

questions.en: Semiconductor chips are key components for producing smartphones. Due to a global shortage of semiconductor chips, the quantity of smartphones sold has changed by 10% whereas the price of smartphones has increased by 20%. Which of the following best explains the above changes in the price and quantity sold of smartphones? Smartphones have no close substitutes. Smartphone manufacturers have excess capacity in production. Consumers' expenditure on smartphones takes up a large proportion of their total expenditure. The workers for producing smartphones cannot be easily recruited.
questions.zh: 半導體晶片是生產智能電話的關鍵組件。 由於全球半導體晶片短缺，智能電話的銷售量有 10% 的變動，而智能電話的價格則上升了 20%。下列哪項最能解釋上述智能電話價格與銷售量的轉變？ 智能電話沒有接近的替代品。 智能電話生產商有剩餘的產能。 消費者在智能電話的開支佔其總開支的比例高。 生產智能電話的工人不容易招聘。

questions.en: Suppose the demand curve of face masks is a downward-sloping straight-line. When the price of face masks falls from $5 to $4, consumers' total expenditure on face masks remains unchanged. If the price of face masks falls further from $4 to $3, consumers' total expenditure on face masks will increase. will decrease. will remain unchanged. may increase, decrease or remain unchanged.
questions.zh: 假設口罩的需求曲線是一條向下傾斜的直線。當口罩價格由 $5 下降至 $4 時，消費者對口罩的總支出維持不變。若口罩價格再由 $4 下降至 $3，消費者對口罩的總支出 會上升。 會下降。 會維持不變。 可能上升、下降或維持不變。

questions.en: Suppose the government of an economy subsidises the manufacturing of air purifiers. As a result, the price of air purifiers decreases from $1 200 to $1 000 and the quantity transacted increases from 5 000 to 8 000 units. This indicates that within the price range, the price elasticity (in absolute value) of ______ is ______. demand ... greater than 1 demand ... smaller than 1 supply ... greater than 1 supply ... smaller than 1
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的政府補貼空氣淨化機的生產。結果，空氣淨化機的價格由$1200下降至$1000，而交易量則由5000單位上升至8000單位。這顯示了在該價格範圍內，____價格彈性（以絕對值計算）的數值____。 需求 …… 大於 1 需求 …… 小於 1 供應 …… 大於 1 供應 …… 小於 1

questions.en: Which of the following will lower Hong Kong households' price elasticity of demand for foreign domestic helpers? More Hong Kong people are trained to work as part-time domestic helpers. Fewer childcare centres are provided in Hong Kong for parents who both work. The Hong Kong Government reduces the quota of foreign domestic helpers. The wage rate of foreign domestic helpers in Hong Kong increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會令香港家庭對外籍家庭傭工的需求價格彈性下降？ 更多香港人接受培訓成為兼職家庭傭工。 為雙職家長提供的托兒中心減少。 香港政府減少外籍家庭傭工的配額。 在香港的外籍家庭傭工的工資率上升。

questions.en: If good X and good Y are in _____ and the demand for good Y is _____, a decrease in the demand for good X will lead to a decrease in the total revenue of good Y. competitive supply ... elastic competitive supply ... inelastic joint supply ... elastic joint supply ... inelastic (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 若物品 X 和物品 Y 是 ______，而物品 Y 的需求屬 ______，物品 X 的需求下跌會令物品 Y 的總收入下跌。 競爭性供應 …… 高彈性 競爭性供應 …… 低彈性 聯合供應 …… 高彈性 聯合供應 …… 低彈性 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Suppose there is a threat of earthquake in Japan. As a result, there is a 20% decrease in the price of Japan tour packages and a 30% change in its quantity transacted. Which of the following best explains the above changes in the price and quantity transacted of Japan tour packages? There are many close substitutes for Japan tour packages. The workers required in providing Japan tour package services can be easily recruited or dismissed in the labour market. The entry into and exit from the market of Japan tour package services is restricted. Consumers' expenditure on Japan tour packages takes up a small proportion of their total expenditure.
questions.zh: 假設日本受到地震威脅。結果，日本旅遊套票的價格下跌 20%，而其交易量改變了 30%。下列哪項最能解釋日本旅遊套票的價格與交易量有上述的轉變？ 日本旅遊套票有很多接近的替代品。 在勞工市場上能容易招聘或裁減提供日本旅遊套票服務的工人。 進入和離開日本旅遊套票服務的市場受到限制。 消費者在日本旅遊套票的開支佔其總開支的比例低。

questions.en: A telephone company raises the monthly charge from $68.5 to $90. Which of the following is true for a household that continues to use the telephone service of this company? The average time of telephone calls the household makes will increase. The household will make more telephone calls. All of the household's consumer surplus will be fully extracted. The household's total benefit of using the telephone service is at least $90 per month.
questions.zh: 一間電話公司將月費由$68.5調高至$90。對於一個繼續使用該公司電話服務的住戶而言，下列哪項是正確的？ 該住戶撥打電話的平均時間將會增加。 該住戶會撥打更多電話。 該住戶的所有消費者盈餘將被完全榨取。 該住戶使用電話服務的總利益每月最少為$90。

questions.en: Consumer surplus is the difference between exchange value and use value. the extra amount a consumer is willing to pay on an all-or-nothing basis. the extra amount a consumer is willing to pay over and above what he actually pays. All of the above.
questions.zh: 消費者盈餘是 交換價值與使用價值之間的差額。 消費者在「非要即失」基礎上願意額外支付的金額。 消費者願意支付的金額超過他實際支付金額的額外款項。 以上皆是。

questions.en: The marginal benefit of an individual on a good is observable. is asserted to be decreasing. always begins with a positive value. has to be expressed in terms of money.
questions.zh: 個人對某物品的邊際利益 是可觀察的。 被斷定為遞減。 總是始於正數。 必須以貨幣表示。

questions.en: Consumer surplus is what a consumer possesses that is more than he can consume. what a consumer has purchased that is more than he intended. that part of total benefit of a good exceeding the exchange value. that part of income a consumer donated to charity.
questions.zh: 消費者盈餘是指 消費者擁有的多於他能消費的部分。 消費者購買的多於他原先打算購買的部分。 物品的總利益超過其交易價值的部分。 消費者捐贈予慈善機構的那部分收入。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the demand and supply curves of good X in a perfectly competitive market. There is a shift in the demand curve for good X from D₁ to D₂. As a result, firms enjoy more producer surplus. the marginal cost of producing the last unit decreases. the supply of good X increases. consumers enjoy less consumer surplus.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示在一個完全競爭市場內物品 X 的需求和供應曲線。 物品 X 的需求曲線由 D₁ 移至 D₂。結果， 公司享有較多的生產者盈餘。 生產最後一單位的邊際成本會下降。 物品 X 的供應會增加。 消費者享有較少的消費者盈餘。

questions.en: Refer to the following demand-supply diagram of a good with the government setting a quota at Q1. Which of the following will be the result of a reduction in quota on the good? The total expenditure on the good may increase or decrease. The consumer surplus will decrease. The total social surplus may increase or decrease. (1) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參閱以下某物品的供需圖，政府為該物品設立配額 Q1。 下列哪項是減少該物品配額的結果？ 對該物品的總支出可能上升或下降。 消費者盈餘會下降。 總社會盈餘可能上升或下降。 只有(1) 只有(1)、(2) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Which of the following are results of the government lowering an effective price ceiling on a good? a reduction in the producer surplus an increase in excess demand an increase in the total sales revenue if the demand is elastic (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些是政府降低對某物品的有效價格上限的結果？ 生產者盈餘下降。 超額需求上升。 若需求屬高彈性，總銷售收益會上升。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose the supply curves of cars and petrol are upward-sloping. If the government imposes an effective quota on the production of cars, the total social surplus in the car market will increase. the producer surplus in the car market will decrease. the total social surplus in the petrol market will decrease. the consumer surplus in the petrol market will increase.
questions.zh: 假設汽車和汽油的供應曲線是向右上斜的。若政府對汽車的生產實施一有效的配額， 汽車市場的總社會盈餘會上升。 汽車市場的生產者盈餘會下降。 汽油市場的總社會盈餘會下降。 汽油市場的消費者盈餘會上升。

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. The maximum total social surplus is equal to ___________. area Z area (Y+Z) area (W+X+Y) area (X+Y+Z)
questions.zh: 細閱下圖。 最大的總社會盈餘等於__________。 面積 Z 面積 (Y+Z) 面積 (W+X+Y) 面積 (X+Y+Z)

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply and demand curves of Good X. Good X and Good Y are in competitive supply. A rise in the demand for Good Y will lead to ______ in the consumer surplus and ______ in the producer surplus in the market of Good X. (Assume the supply and demand curves of Good X shift in a parallel manner.) an increase ... an increase an increase ... a decrease a decrease ... an increase a decrease ... a decrease
questions.zh: 下圖顯示物品 X 的供應和需求曲線。 物品 X 和物品 Y 屬於競爭性供應。物品 Y 的需求上升會令物品 X 市場的消費者盈餘 _______。而生產者盈餘 _______。 (假設物品 X 的供應和需求曲線平行移動。) 增加……增加 增加……減少 減少……增加 減少……減少

questions.en: If the government raises the effective price floor on Good X and at the same time the price of its substitute increases, the consumer surplus in the market of Good X will increase will decrease will remain unchanged may increase or decrease
questions.zh: 若政府提高對物品 X 的有效價格下限，同時其替代品的價格上升了，在物品 X 市場的消費者盈餘 ______。 會增加 會減少 會維持不變 可能增加或減少

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram of a good with a quota set at Q1 by the government. Which of the following will be the results of a reduction in quota on the good? The total expenditure on the good may increase. The consumer surplus will decrease. The total social surplus may increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參閱以下某物品的供需圖，當中 Q1 為政府設下的配額。 下列哪些會是減少該物品配額的結果？ 對該物品的總支出可能增加。 消費者盈餘會減少。 總社會盈餘可能增加。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram of Good X. If the government sets a quota at Q1, then __________ will decrease. total social surplus total expenditure on Good X consumer surplus producer surplus (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 參閱以下物品 X 的供需圖。 若政府把配額設定為 Q1，________會下降。 總社會盈餘 物品 X 的總支出 消費者盈餘 生產者盈餘 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Suppose there is a bad harvest of flowers due to global warming. The marginal benefit of flowers will __________ and the total exchange value __________. decrease ... will decrease increase ... will increase decrease ... may decrease or increase increase ... may decrease or increase
questions.zh: 假設全球暖化導致鮮花收成欠佳，鮮花的邊際利益會 ________，而總交易價值 ________。 減少 …… 會減少 增加 …… 會增加 減少 …… 可能減少或增加 增加 …… 可能減少或增加

questions.en: Because of the outbreak of COVID-19, the government of a country announced a temporary ban of dine-in services in restaurants. Which of the following statements about restaurants under the temporary ban is correct? If the expected sales revenue generated from takeaway food exceeds the variable cost of running a restaurant, the restaurant will continue to operate. With the extremely high cost of breaking the rental contract, the fixed rental will affect whether the owners continue to operate their restaurant. A decrease in prices of takeaway food will necessarily decrease the sales revenue of the restaurants. Unpopular restaurants will close down before popular ones.
questions.zh: 因為新冠肺炎爆發，某國政府宣布臨時禁制餐廳提供堂食服務。在該臨時禁制下，下列哪項有關餐廳的陳述是正確的？ 若從外賣食品所得的預期銷售收入超過營運餐廳的可變成本，餐廳會繼續經營。 當違反租賃合約的成本極高，固定租金會影響東主是否繼續經營餐廳。 外賣食品的價格下降必然會令餐廳的銷售收入下降。 不受歡迎的餐廳會早於受歡迎的餐廳倒閉。

questions.en: Refer to the following demand-supply diagram of Good Y. If the government lowers the price ceiling of Good Y from P1 to P2, the producer surplus will decrease. the consumer surplus will increase. the total social surplus will remain unchanged. the excess supply of Good Y will be eliminated.
questions.zh: 參考以下物品 Y 的供需圖。 若政府將物品 Y 的價格上限由 P₁ 下調至 P₂， 生產者盈餘會下降。 消費者盈餘會上升。 總社會盈餘會維持不變。 物品 Y 的超額供應會消失。

questions.en: Since most schools deliver their lessons online, more students need to buy tablet computers. The marginal cost of the last unit of tablet computers will ______ and the producer surplus will ______. decrease ... increase decrease ... decrease increase ... increase increase ... decrease
questions.zh: 由於大部分學校進行網上授課，更多學生需要購買平板電腦。最後一單位的平板電腦的邊際成本會 __________，而生產者盈餘會 __________. 下降 ... 上升 下降 ... 下降 上升 ... 上升 上升 ... 下降

questions.en: The following table shows the marginal benefit schedule of a consumer for avocados. Quantity (units) 1 2 3 4 5 6 Marginal benefit ($) 8 7 6 5 4 3 When the price of avocados increases from $5 to $6, the consumer surplus will _______. increase by $1 increase by $3 decrease by $1 decrease by $3
questions.zh: 下表顯示某消費者對牛油果的邊際利益表。 數量（單位） 1 2 3 4 5 6 邊際利益 ($) 8 7 6 5 4 3 當牛油果的價格由$5上升至$6，消費者盈餘會________。 增加$1 增加$3 減少$1 減少$3

questions.en: When Good X and Good Y are in ______, a decrease in the price of Good X will lead to ______. competitive demand ... a decrease in the price of Good Y joint demand ... a decrease in the producer surplus in the market of Good Y competitive supply ... an increase in the consumer surplus in the market of Good Y joint supply ... a decrease in consumers' total expenditure on Good Y (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 當物品 X 和物品 Y 屬 ______，物品 X 的價格下降會導致 ______。 競爭性需求 …… 物品 Y 的價格下降 聯合需求 …… 物品 Y 市場上的生產者盈餘下降 競爭性供應 …… 物品 Y 市場上的消費者盈餘上升 聯合供應 …… 消費者對物品 Y 的總支出下降 只有(1)、(3) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(2)、(4)

questions.en: The provision of a per-unit production subsidy on a good will lead to a fall in the producer surplus of the good a rise in consumers' total expenditure on the good a rise in the total social surplus of the good a rise in the total revenue including the subsidy of the good
questions.zh: 向某物品提供從量生產補貼會導致 ______。 該物品的生產者盈餘下降 消費者對該物品的總支出上升 該物品的總社會盈餘上升 該物品包括補貼在內的總收入上升

questions.en: The table below shows the production costs of a price-taking firm. Total output (units) Average cost ($) 1 20 2 25 3 30 4 35 Suppose the fixed cost of the firm is $5 and the product price is $30. The firm’s maximum producer surplus is ___________. $0 $5 $10 $15
questions.zh: 下表顯示某受價者廠商的生產成本。 總產出（單位） 平均成本 ($) 1 20 2 25 3 30 4 35 假設該廠商的固定成本是$5，而產品價格是$30。該廠商最大的生產者盈餘是 ___________。 $0 $5 $10 $15

questions.en: Suppose the government of an economy imposes an effective catch limit (quota) on Pacific bluefin tuna. If the catch limit is lowered, the marginal benefit of the last unit of Pacific bluefin tuna will _______ and consumers’ total expenditure on Pacific bluefin tuna ________. increase ... will increase decrease ... will decrease increase ... may decrease or increase decrease ... may decrease or increase
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的政府對太平洋藍鰭金槍魚實施一項有效的捕撈限制（配額）。如果降低該捕撈限制，最後一單位的太平洋藍鰭金槍魚的邊際利益會____，而消費者對太平洋藍鰭金槍魚的總支出____。 上升 …… 會上升 下降 …… 會下降 上升 …… 可能下降或上升 下降 …… 可能下降或上升

questions.en: The above diagram shows the price and quantity of Good X. The price increases from Pc to Pe after the price ceiling is cancelled. As a result, the total expenditure on Good X will increase. decrease. remain unchanged. either increase or decrease, depending on its price elasticity of demand.
questions.zh: 上圖顯示物品 X 的價格和數量。在價格上限取消後價格由 Pc 上升至 Pe。物品 X 的消費總值會 因此而增加。 因此而減少。 維持不變。 增加或減少，視乎它的價格需求彈性而定。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply of and the demand for the tickets of a concert. If the tickets are sold at P2 instead of P1, a black market may occur. The sales revenue will be smaller. The quantity transacted will be greater. The sales revenue may increase or decrease, depending on the price elasticity of demand. (1) and (2) only. (2) and (4) only. (2) and (3) only. (3) and (4) only.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某演唱會入場券的供應和需求： 如果入場券以 P₂ 而非 P₁ 的價格出售， 可能出現黑市買賣。 銷售收益會更少。 交易量會更大。 銷售收益可能增加或減少，視乎它的價格需求彈性而定。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: In the above figure, the market price of good X is fixed by the government at P'. If the demand increases from D to D', the excess demand will be greater. the quantity transacted will not change. the sales revenue will increase when the demand is elastic. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 上圖中物品 X 的市價由政府固定在 P'。若需求由 D 增加至 D'， 求過於供的數量會更大。 交易量不會改變。 而需求屬有彈性，則銷售收益會增加。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Shortage occurs when a price floor below the equilibrium price is imposed. An effective price ceiling is imposed. The supply is reduced. The demand increase sharply.
questions.zh: 短缺在下列哪一種情況下出現？ 實施一低於均衡價的價格下限。 實施一有效的價格上限。 供應減少。 需求大幅增加。

questions.en: Suppose initially the price of a certain good is fixed below the market equilibrium. Relaxing the price control will lead to an increase in revenue. A decrease in demand. An increase in revenue only if the demand for this good is inelastic. An increase in the quantity supplied. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 假設初時某物品的價格固定在市場均衡水平之下。放寬該價格管制會導致 銷售收益增加。 需求下降。 銷售收益增加，但必須符合一個條件，就是該物品的需求缺乏彈性。 供應量增加。 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.en: Suppose the government has put an end to all sorts of rent control in Hong Kong. This measure would NOT lead to a wider wealth gap. increase the property tax revenue. lead to a shortage in the property market. increase the quantity supplied of rental accommodation.
questions.zh: 假設香港政府已取消了全部租金管制。這措施不會 導致貧富更為懸殊。 增加物業稅收益。 導致物業市場出現短缺。 增加出租單位的供應量。

questions.en: The following table shows the supply of and demand for Good X. Unit price ($) Quantity demanded (units) Quantity supplied (units) 2 20 4 4 16 8 6 12 12 8 8 16 10 4 20 If the government raises the price ceiling from $4 per unit to $8 per unit, the quantity transacted will increase by 4 units. increase by 8 units. decrease by 8 units. decrease by 4 units.
questions.zh: 下表顯示物品 X 的供需情況。 單位價格 ($) 需求量 (單位) 供應量 (單位) 2 20 4 4 16 8 6 12 12 8 8 16 10 4 20 假設政府將價格上限從每單位 $4 提高至每單位 $8，成交量會 增加 4 個單位。 增加 8 個單位。 減少 8 個單位。 減少 4 個單位。

questions.en: Refer to the above diagram. Which of the following statements is correct? If a price ceiling is set at P1, the quantity transacted is Q3. If a price floor is set at P1, the quantity transacted is Q2. If a price floor is set at P3, the quantity transacted is Q2. If a price ceiling is set at P3, non-price competition will occur.
questions.zh: 參閱上圖。下列哪一項是正確的？ 若價格上限設定在 P₁，交易量是 Q₃。 若價格下限設定在 P₁，交易量是 Q₂。 若價格下限設定在 P₃，交易量是 Q₂。 若價格上限設定在 P₃，非價格競爭會出現。

Suppose the government imposed an effective price ceiling on good X. If the government raises the effective price ceiling, the total consumer expenditure on good X would increase. would decrease. would remain unchanged. may increase, decrease or remain unchanged depending on the elasticity of demand.
questions.zh: 假設政府對物品 X 實施有效的價格上限。若政府將有效的價格上限提高，消費者在物品 X 的總支出 會增加。 會減少。 會維持不變。 可能增加、減少或維持不變，視乎需求彈性而定。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market of Good Z. If the government imposes a maximum price control on Good Z at $Pc per unit, there would be an excess demand for Good Z. an excess supply of Good Z. no change in consumers' total expenditure on Good Z. an increase in consumers' total expenditure on Good Z.
questions.zh: 下面顯示物品Z的市場。 若政府對物品Z實施價格管制，最高價為每單位Pc。 物品Z會出現求過於供現象。 物品Z會出現供過於求現象。 消費者在物品Z的總支出會維持不變。 消費者在物品Z的總支出會增加。

questions.en: Shortage occurs when a ________ is set ________ the equilibrium price. price ceiling ... above price ceiling ... below price floor ... above price floor ... below

questions.en: Suppose the government introduces an effective rent control which sets a maximum rental per square feet the landlords can charge to any tenants. Which of the following statements is correct? There will be a shortage of rental units. The landlords will have less incentive to rent out their flats. The landlords will spend less on maintenance of the rental flats. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設政府實施有效租金管制，即為業主可向租客收取的每平方呎租金設定上限。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 出租單位會有短缺。 業主出租他們單位的意欲會較低。 業主會花費較少的金錢維修出租單位。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. If the government lowers the price ceiling from Pa to Pb, the quantity transacted will increase. the deadweight loss will decrease. the producer surplus will decrease. the consumer surplus will increase.
questions.zh: 細閱下圖。 若政府將價格上限由 Pa 調低至 Pb， 交易量會上升。 效率損失會下降。 生產者盈餘會減少。 消費者盈餘會增加。

questions.en: Suppose the government imposed an effective rent control on living units. Which of the following would LEAST likely occur? There would be a shortage of living units. Black market would emerge. Poor people would be able to rent a living unit more easily. Landlords would have a lower incentive to renovate their living units for rent.
