questions.en: Case I: The market price of Good X decreases by $4 per unit after the provision of a $10 per unit subsidy. Case II: The market price of Good X decreases by $6 per unit after the provision of a $10 per unit subsidy. We can conclude that in comparing the two cases, Good X in Case I has a __________ demand or a __________ supply. less elastic ... less elastic more elastic ... more elastic less elastic ... more elastic more elastic ... less elastic
questions.zh: 個案一： 對物品 X 給予 $10 單位津貼後，它的單位市價下跌 $4。 個案二： 對物品 X 給予 $10 單位津貼後，它的單位市價下跌 $6。 我們可得出結論如下：比較兩個個案，物品 X 在個案一的需求彈性 ______ 或供應彈性 ______。 較低 ... 較低 較高 ... 較高 較低 ... 較高 較高 ... 較低

questions.en: Refer to the following demand and supply schedules of a good. Price per unit $25 $30 $35 $40 $45 Quantity demanded (units) 120 100 80 75 60 Quantity supplied (units) 60 75 80 100 120 According to the above information, we can conclude that the total sales revenue would be $3 000 when the price is $30 per unit. a unit subsidy of $10 on production would cause the equilibrium price to drop by $5. a unit tax would lower the market price to a price smaller than $35. the seller could set the price at $40 to gain the highest profit.
questions.zh: 參閱下列某物品的供需表。 單位價格 $25 $30 $35 $40 $45 需求量(單位) 120 100 80 75 60 供應量(單位) 60 75 80 100 120 根據以上資料，我們可有以下結論： 當價格是每單位 $30 時，總銷售收益是 $3 000。 給予生產該物品單位津貼 $10 會導致其均衡價格下降 $5。 從量稅會使市價下降至低於 $35。 供應商可訂價 $40 一單位以賺取最高的利潤。

questions.en: Suppose the government imposes a unit subsidy on good Y causing a shift of its supply curve from S1 to S2. The amount of subsidy benefit enjoyed by the sellers of good Y is (P2 – P1) x Q1 (P3 – P1) x Q1 (P3 – P2) x Q2 (P4 – P3) x Q2
questions.zh: 假設政府對物品 Y 給予單位津貼，使它的供應曲線從 S1 移至 S2。 物品 Y 的賣家可享有的津貼利益是 (P2 – P1) x Q1 (P3 – P1) x Q1 (P3 – P2) x Q2 (P4 – P3) x Q2

questions.en: The above diagram shows the increase in supply of a good from S1 to S2 as a result of the provision of a per unit subsidy for the good by the government. Suppliers' new total revenue excluding the subsidy ________ their old total revenue before the provision of the subsidy. is smaller than is equal to is larger than may be larger or smaller than
questions.zh: 上圖顯示政府對某物品提供從量津貼的結果：該物品的供應由 S1 增加至 S2。 供應商新的總收益在減去上述津貼後 ______ 之前政府沒有提供津貼時供應商的總收益。 少於 等於 多於 可能多於或少於

questions.en: The following table shows the market demand and supply of a good. Unit Price ($) Market quantity demanded (Units) Market quantity supplied (Units) 10 70 130 9 90 120 8 110 110 7 130 100 6 150 90 5 170 80 If the government provides a per unit subsidy of $3 to the suppliers, the new equilibrium price is $5 per unit. the total amount of subsidy provided is $390. the subsidy benefit enjoyed by the consumers is greater than that of the suppliers. the total expenditure of consumers will decrease.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某物品的市場需求及供應。 單位價格 ($) 市場需求量 (單位) 市場供應量 (單位) 10 70 130 9 90 120 8 110 110 7 130 100 6 150 90 5 170 80 若政府向供應商提供從量津貼 $3， 新均衡價格是每單位 $5。 津貼總額是 $390。 消費者享有的津貼利益大於供應商。 消費者總支出會減少。

questions.en: The graph below shows the market situation of Good X when the government provides a per-unit subsidy of $30 to the producers. Suppose the government abolishes the above per-unit subsidy. The new market price would be $100 $120 $140 $160
questions.zh: 下圖顯示政府向生產商提供每單位 $30 的從量津貼時物品 X 的市場情況。 假設政府取消上述從量津貼。新的市場價格會是 $100 $120 $140 $160

questions.en: The graph below shows the market situation of Good X when the government provides a per-unit subsidy of $30 to the producers. Within the range of the original and new market prices, the elasticity of supply of Good X is smaller than its elasticity of demand. equal to its elasticity of demand. greater than its elasticity of demand. unity.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示政府向生產商提供每單位 $30 的從量津貼時物品 X 的市場情況。 在新、舊巿價範圍內，X 物品的供應彈性 小於其需求彈性。 等於其需求彈性。 大於其需求彈性。 是 1。

questions.en: Refer to the following demand and supply schedules of a good. Price $1 $2 $3 $4 $5 Quantity demanded (unit) 120 100 80 75 60 Quantity supplied (unit) 60 75 80 100 120 According to the above information, we can conclude that the total sales revenue would be $200 when the price is $2. there would be a shortage of 25 units when the government imposes a price floor at $4. when a per unit subsidy of $2 was granted to the seller, the total revenue (including the subsidy) would increase by $160. when a per unit subsidy of $2 was granted to the seller, the equilibrium price would drop to $1.
questions.zh: 參閱以下某物品的供需表。 價格 $1 $2 $3 $4 $5 需求量(單位) 120 100 80 75 60 供應量(單位) 60 75 80 100 120 根據以上資料，我們可得出結論如下： 當價格是$2，總銷售收益會是$200。 當政府把價格下限定為$4，市場會出現 25 單位的短缺。 當政府給予賣家每單位$2的補貼，總收益(包括補貼)會增加 $160。 當政府給予賣家每單位$2的補貼，均衡價格會下降至 $1。

questions.en: The government provides a per-unit subsidy of $10 on producing green products. The market price drops by $6 as a result. Which of the following statements about the green product market is/are correct? The supply of green products is more elastic than their demand. Consumers enjoy more subsidy benefit than producers. The demand for green products increases. (2) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 政府對生產綠色產品提供$10的從量補貼，市場價格因而下降了$6。下列哪項/些有關綠色產品市場的陳述是正確的？ 綠色產品的供應較其需求更具彈性。 消費者所獲得的補貼得益比生產者多。 綠色產品的需求上升。 只有 (2) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Refer to the following demand and supply schedules of a good. Price ($) 40 50 60 70 80 90 Quantity demanded (units) 14 12 10 8 6 4 Quantity supplied (units) 6 8 10 12 14 16 Which of the following statements is correct when the government provides a per unit subsidy of $20 on the good? The total revenue including the subsidy is $840. The total subsidy granted by the government is $200. Within the range of the original and new market prices, the elasticity of demand is smaller than one. The change in total revenue of its complements is uncertain.
questions.zh: 參閱以下某物品的供需表。 價格 ($) 40 50 60 70 80 90 需求量 (單位) 14 12 10 8 6 4 供應量 (單位) 6 8 10 12 14 16 當政府對該物品提供每單位 $20 的補貼，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 包括補貼在內的總收益是 $840。 政府所支付的補貼總額是 $200。 在原初市價和新市價的範圍內，需求彈性小於一。 它的輔助品的總收益轉變是未能確定的。

questions.en: The following table shows the demand and supply schedules of a good. Price ($) Quantity demanded (units) Quantity supplied (units) 20 70 40 22 60 45 24 50 50 26 40 55 28 30 60 If the government provides a $6 per-unit subsidy for the producers of the good, the total subsidy provided by the government will be ______ and the ratio of consumers' share to producers' share of the subsidy will be ______. $300 ... 1:1 $300 ... 1:2 $360 ... 1:1 $360 ... 1:2
questions.zh: 下表顯示某物品的供需表。 價格 ($) 需求量 (單位) 供應量 (單位) 20 70 40 22 60 45 24 50 50 26 40 55 28 30 60 若政府給該物品的生產商每單位$6補貼，政府提供的補貼總額會是____，而消費者補貼份額和生產者補貼份額的比率會是____。 $300 ... 1:1 $300 ... 1:2 $360 ... 1:1 $360 ... 1:2

questions.en: Refer to the following demand-supply schedules of Good X. Price ($) Quantity demanded (units) Quantity supplied (units) 80 100 80 90 100 90 100 100 100 110 100 110 120 100 120 130 100 130 If a $10 per-unit subsidy is provided to the producers of Good X, the total revenue including the subsidy will remain unchanged. the subsidy benefit will be received entirely by the producers. the total expenditure of consumers on Good X will reduce by $1 000. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參閱以下物品 X 的供需表。 價格 ($) 需求量（單位） 供應量（單位） 80 100 80 90 100 90 100 100 100 110 100 110 120 100 120 130 100 130 若對物品 X 的生產商提供 $10 的從量補貼， 總收入（包括補貼）會維持不變。 生產者會獲得全部的補貼得益。 消費者對物品 X 的總支出會減少 $1000。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market of Good X. A per-unit subsidy of $30 is provided to the producers of Good X. Which of the following statements about the market of Good X is correct? The subsidy benefit enjoyed by consumers is $1400. The total revenue inclusive of the subsidy is $11700. Within the range of the original and the new equilibrium prices, the price elasticity of demand is higher than the price elasticity of supply. Within the range of the original and the new equilibrium prices, the price elasticity of demand is smaller than one.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示物品 X 的市場。物品 X 的生產者有 $30 從量補貼。 下列哪項關於物品 X 的市場的陳述是正確的？ 消費者享有的補貼得益是 $1400。 包含補貼在內的總收入是 $11700。 在介乎原初的均衡價格和新的均衡價格之間的範圍內，需求價格彈性高於供應價格彈性。 在介乎原初的均衡價格和新的均衡價格之間的範圍內，需求價格彈性小於一。

questions.en: The reasons for classifying the video-renting industry in Hong Kong as monopolistic competition are: The entry and exit of firms are restricted. The firms engage in non-price competition. The services of the firms are not homogeneous. The firms charge the same price. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 將香港的錄影帶租用行業歸類為壟斷性競爭的理由是： 加入或退出這行業都有限制。 廠商進行非價格競爭。 廠商服務並不同質。 廠商收取相同價錢。 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.en: The market structure of gasoline supply in Hong Kong is best classified as perfect competition. monopolistic competition. oligopoly. monopoly.
questions.zh: 在香港，汽油供應的市場結構最適宜歸類為 完全競爭。 壟斷性競爭。 寡頭競爭。 獨佔。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a monopolist is true? It has a high set-up cost. It sells only one type of product. It is regulated by the government. There are no close substitutes for its product.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項有關壟斷性廠商的描述是對的？ 它的創業成本高。 它只售賣一種產品。 它受政府管制。 它的產品沒有非常相似的替代品。

questions.en: In economics, which of the following statements about 'market' is correct? All buyers and sellers must meet at a physical location for transactions to take place. Under monopolistic competition, the entry of firms is restricted. Firms in an oligopolistic market compete in price only. A perfectly competitive firm cannot influence the market price by itself.
questions.zh: 在經濟學上，下列哪一項有關「市場」的描述是正確的？ 買賣各人必需在同一地點集合以進行買賣。 在壟斷性競爭下，廠商的加入受限制。 寡頭壟斷廠商只在價格方面競爭。 一完全競爭性廠商不能獨自影響市價。

questions.en: Competition in the market will tend to be imperfect when customers favor brand names. There are differentiated products There is free entry into the market. There are numerous sellers. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 在下列哪些情況下，市場競爭趨向不完全？ 顧客對名牌有偏好 有異質產品 可以自由加入市場買賣 有很多賣家 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(4) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following is a general feature of oligopoly? There is perfect information. There is price competition only. There is free entry. There are only a few sellers who can dominate the market.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是寡佔的一般特徵？ 訊息完全。 只存在價格競爭。 可自由進入市場。 只有少數賣家可支配市場。

questions.en: Newspapers in Hong Kong competed among themselves by cutting prices in 1995. This implies that the total revenue of a newspaper will increase if its demand is inelastic. The profit of a newspaper will increase if its demand is elastic. Total revenue in the magazine industry will increase because newspapers and magazines are in competitive demand. The market structure of newspapers is not perfect competition.
questions.zh: 在 1995 年，香港的報社以減價來互相競爭。這意味什麼？ 若某報紙的需求屬低彈性，它的總收益會增加。 若某報紙的需求屬高彈性，它的利潤會增加。 雜誌行業的總收益會增加，因為報紙與雜誌屬競爭性需求。 報紙的市場不屬於完全競爭。

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT a difference between monopoly and perfect competition? Advertisements are found in monopoly but not in perfect competition. Firms are free to enter a perfectly competitive market but not a monopoly. A monopolist can influence the market price while a competitive firm cannot. Monopolists make greater profits than perfectly competitive firms.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項不是獨佔與完全競爭的差異？ 獨佔有賣廣告的活動，而完全競爭廠商則不能。 完全競爭時廠商可自由進入市場，而獨佔時則不能。 獨佔者可影響市價，而完全競爭廠商則不能。 獨佔者的利潤高於完全競爭廠商。

questions.en: With a number of new firms entering the market of mobile phone services, which of the following would LEAST likely occur? The price of mobile phone services would decrease. The market share occupied by existing firms would decrease. Firms would engage more in non-price competition. The market would become a perfectly competitive one.
questions.zh: 當流動電話服務的市場有一些新廠商加入時，下列哪一項最不可能發生？ 流動電話服務的價格會下降。 原有廠商的市場佔有率都會下跌。 廠商之間會有更多非價格競爭。 該市場會變成一個完全競爭市場。

questions.en: The market structure of the newspaper publishers in Hong Kong is perfect competition because a particular newspaper is sold at the same price at different places. monopolistic competition because there are many newspaper stalls. oligopoly because only a few newspapers have leading market shares. monopoly because there is no close substitute when the consumer has formed the habit of reading a particular newspaper.
questions.zh: 香港的報章出版社的市場結構是 完全競爭，因為同一份報章在不同地點的售價相同。 壟斷性競爭，因為有很多報攤售賣報章。 寡頭壟斷，因為只有幾份報章有領導性的市場佔有率。 壟斷，因為顧客在養成閱讀某一份報章的習慣後，便沒有近似的替代品。

questions.en: Which of the following about a monopoly is correct? Its product has no substitutes as it is the only seller of the product of the kind. A monopolist still faces non-price competition. A monopolist can increase the price without losing any customers. Any business granted a franchise by the government is a monopoly.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於獨佔的描述是正確的？ 它的產品沒有替代品。這是由於它是該種產品的唯一售賣者。 獨佔者仍面對非價格競爭。 獨佔者可提高價格而不會失去任何顧客。 任何生意獲得政府的專利經營權都是獨佔。

questions.en: Private doctors in Hong Kong charge different prices for their medical services. This is because people do not have sufficient knowledge of their illnesses. there are many doctors in the market. the private doctors' services are different. there are entry barriers to becoming a doctor.
questions.zh: 香港私家醫生的醫療服務收費各自不同。這是因爲 人們對自己的疾病沒有足夠的認識。 市場中有很多醫生。 私家醫生的服務各有不同。 醫生這種職業有入行的障礙。

questions.en: Many people say that the MTR Corporation Limited is a monopolist. Which of the following about the company is correct? The demand for its product is perfectly inelastic. It still has to face competition. It does not need to advertise its product. It is sure to make profits as it is the only supplier.
questions.zh: 很多人說地鐵有限公司是一壟斷經營者。下列哪一項關於該公司的描述是正確的？ 用家對它的產品的需求屬完全無彈性。 它仍需要面對競爭。 它無需要宣傳自己的產品。 由於它是唯一的供應者，它肯定可以賺取利潤。

questions.en: Which of the following comes closest to a product sold in a price-takers' market? jade gold diamond pearl
questions.zh: 下列哪一項最接近在受價者市場中出售的產品？ 翡翠 黃金 鑽石 珍珠

questions.en: Which of the following is a general feature of a perfectly competitive market? Market information is imperfect. There is non-price competition. There is only one price prevailing in the market. None of the above is a correct answer.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是完全競爭市場的一種特徵？ 市場訊息不完全。 市場上有非價格競爭。 市場上只有一個價。 以上皆非正確答案。

questions.en: In Hong Kong, free television broadcasting is provided by Television Broadcasts Limited (TVB) and Asia Television Limited (ATV). Which of the following is NOT correct? These two companies are oligopolists. operate under franchise. broadcast television programmes which are economic goods. engage in non-price competition only.
questions.zh: 在香港，電視廣播有限公司(TVB)和亞洲電視有限公司(ATV)播放免費的電視節目。以下哪一項並非正確？ 該兩家公司 是寡頭壟斷者。 獲政府發給專營權。 所提供的電視節目是經濟物品。 彼此只有非價格競爭。

questions.en: The market structure of petroleum companies (e.g. Esso, Caltex) in Hong Kong could be regarded as oligopolistic because in making decisions these companies have to consider the reactions of other dominant companies in the industry. the total sales revenue of the market is equally shared by these companies. these companies are selling homogeneous products. the information about their products can be obtained at zero cost.
questions.zh: 在香港，石油公司（例如埃索、加德士）的市場結構可視作寡頭壟斷，因為 這些公司決策時須考慮業內其他有影響力的公司的反應。 市場裏的全部銷售收益被這些公司平分。 這些公司售賣同質產品。 不需要成本便可獲知他們產品的資訊。

questions.en: A firm is said to be a price-taker if it has the same cost curves as other competing firms. it cannot alone decide on its output level. it cannot ask a price higher than the market price and expect to survive. out of syllabus
questions.zh: 一間廠商在下列哪種情況下被稱為受價者？ 它與其他競爭廠商具有相同的成本曲線。 它不能單獨決定其產量水平。 它不能索取高於市場價格的價格並期望能生存。 課程範圍以外

questions.en: Which of the following descriptions about monopoly is correct? A monopolist must possess a franchise to run the business. A monopolist faces no competition. A monopolist may incur losses. A monopolist sells only one product.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於獨佔的描述是正確的？ 獨佔者必須擁有專營權。 獨佔者毋須面對競爭。 獨佔者可能會有所虧損。 獨佔者只售賣一種產品。

questions.en: A market can be regarded as an oligopoly when information in the market is not perfect. a few sellers have a significantly larger market share than the others. the products sold in the market are daily necessities. the government controls the entry of sellers into the market.
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，一個市場可被視爲寡頭壟斷？ 市場訊息不完全。 少數廠商的市場佔有率明顯比其他廠商大很多。 市場上出售的貨品是日常必需品。 賣家能否進入市場是由政府操控的。

questions.en: The Airport Express is the only railway service carrying passengers to the airport in Hong Kong. Which of the following statements about the Airport Express is correct? It would surely make a profit since it is the sole supplier of airport railway services. It does not need to promote its business through advertising. It can increase its prices without losing any customers. It has to face competition in the market from other transport services to the airport.
questions.zh: 機場快線是香港唯一載客往返機場的鐵路服務。下列哪一項對機場快線的描述是正確的？ 它肯定獲得利潤，因爲它是機場鐵路服務的唯一供應者。 它毋須透過賣廣告來推廣業務。 它可以加價而不流失顧客。 它在市場中須面對其他來往機場運輸服務者的競爭。

questions.en: Non-price competition implies surplus. shortage. scarcity. monopoly.
questions.zh: 非價格競爭意味著 過剩。 短缺。 稀少性。 壟斷。

questions.en: Which of the following is a feature/are features of a perfectly competitive market? There is freedom of entry and exit of firms. The market price of the product is stable. Sellers use non-price competitions to attract consumers. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是完全競爭市場的特徵？ 廠商可自由加入或退出該行業。 該市場的物品的市價是穩定的。 賣家以非價格競爭的方法來吸引消費者。 以上全部正確。

questions.en: The market structure of the electricity supply on Hong Kong Island is regarded as a/an monopoly because the government controls the entry of suppliers in the market. oligopoly because there are two electricity companies in Hong Kong. monopoly because there is only one supplier. oligopoly because the supplier is a price searcher.
questions.zh: 港島電力供應的市場結構被視爲 獨佔，因爲政府控制供應商進入市場。 寡頭壟斷，因爲香港有兩家電力公司。 獨佔，因爲只有一個供應商。 寡頭壟斷，因爲供應商是尋價者。

questions.en: The market structure of pay TV services (such as Now TV and Cable TV) in Hong Kong is classified as monopoly. oligopoly. monopolistic competition. perfect competition.
questions.zh: 在香港，收費電視 (例如 Now 寬頻電視和有線電視) 服務的市場結構被歸類為 獨佔。 寡頭壟斷。 壟斷性競爭。 完全競爭。

questions.en: The market structure of Internet service providers (e.g. PCCW and i-Cable) could be regarded as _______ and one feature of this market structure is that _______. monopolistic competition ... there is imperfect information about their services monopolistic competition ... they engage in both price and non-price competition oligopoly ... their services are homogeneous oligopoly ... they will consider the response of other providers when making decisions
questions.zh: 網絡供應商（例如：電訊盈科和有線寬頻）的市場結構可被視為 ________。該種市場結構的一個特色是 ________。 壟斷性競爭……有關它們的服務的資訊是不完全流通的 壟斷性競爭……它們進行價格競爭及非價格競爭 寡頭壟斷……它們的服務是同質的 寡頭壟斷……它們在決策時會考慮同業的反應

questions.en: A market is regarded as monopolistic competition when ___________. there is imperfect information there are many sellers selling differentiated products there are both price and non-price competition there is freedom of entry into the market
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，一個市場被歸類為壟斷性競爭？ 訊息不完全。 有很多售賣異質產品的賣家。 價格及非價格競爭同時存在。 可以自由進入市場。

questions.en: A market can be regarded as an oligopoly when market information is not perfect. the market is dominated by a few sellers. the government restricts the entry of sellers into the market. different sellers sell similar but differentiated products.
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，一個市場可被視為寡頭壟斷？ 市場訊息不完全。 市場被少數賣家支配。 政府限制賣家進入市場。 不同賣家出售相似但可區別的產品。

questions.en: Which of the following are features of a perfectly competitive market? The marginal revenue of each firm equals the market price. The sellers and buyers have perfect market information. The marginal cost schedule of a firm is the same as its supply schedule. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些是完全競爭市場的特徵？ 每間公司的邊際收益等於市價。 賣家和買家掌握完全市場資訊。 一間公司的邊際成本表與它的供應表相同。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: If a firm is a monopolist in a market, its monopoly power may come from the government. its return will be positive. it faces no competition. it bears no risk.
questions.zh: 若一廠商是某市場的壟斷者， 它的壟斷能力可能來自政府。 它的回報會是正數。 它無需面對競爭。 它無需承擔風險。

questions.en: The market structure of the electric power industry in Hong Kong is an oligopoly because there are two dominating companies in the market. an oligopoly because the pricing strategies of the companies are interdependent. a monopoly because the companies can increase the price without losing customers. a monopoly because there is only one electric company providing electricity in any district.
questions.zh: 香港電力行業的市場結構屬 寡頭壟斷，因爲市場上有兩間具支配力的公司。 寡頭壟斷，因爲各公司的訂價策略互相影響。 壟斷，因爲各公司可提高價格而不會流失顧客。 壟斷，因爲在任何地區只有一間電力公司提供電力。

questions.en: The table below shows the distribution of market share of supermarkets in Hong Kong in 2012. Name Market share (%) Wellcome 39.8 Parknshop 33.1 Vanguard 7.8 Others 19.3 Total 100 From the above table, we can conclude that the market of supermarkets in Hong Kong is an example of ______ because ________. oligopoly ... sellers are interdependent in their marketing strategies oligopoly ... a few major sellers are in control of the total sales of the market monopolistic competition ... sellers can affect the market price as their products are heterogeneous from the consumers' viewpoint monopolistic competition ... there are many sellers adopting non-price competition in the market
questions.zh: 下表顯示 2012 年香港超級市場的市場份額的分佈。 名稱 市場份額 (%) 惠康 39.8 百佳 33.1 華潤萬家 7.8 其他 19.3 合共 100 我們可以由上表得出結論如下：香港超級市場是 ________ 市場的一個例子，因爲________。 寡頭壟斷……賣家的營銷策略互相影響 寡頭壟斷……幾位主要賣家操控了市場的總銷售量 壟斷性競爭……賣家能影響市價，從消費者角度看來，它們的貨品是異質的 壟斷性競爭……市場上有許多賣家採用非價格競爭

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the theme park industry in Hong Kong is correct? Hong Kong Disneyland is a monopolist because its average cost of production drops when there are more tourists. Hong Kong Disneyland guarantees a profit because it is protected by the government. Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park Hong Kong have no competition with each other as tourists may go to both theme parks. Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park Hong Kong are interdependent in their marketing strategies.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關香港主題公園行業的陳述是正確的？ 香港迪士尼樂園是一壟斷者，因為當遊客增加，它的平均生產成本下降。 香港迪士尼樂園保證能獲得利潤，因為它受政府保護。 香港迪士尼樂園和香港海洋公園之間沒有競爭，因為遊客可能兩個主題公園皆到訪。 香港迪士尼樂園和香港海洋公園的營銷策略是互相影響的。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about monopoly are correct? A monopolist sets the market price. A natural monopoly arises when no firms are permitted to enter the market. There are substitutes for the products provided by a monopolist. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些有關壟斷的陳述是正確的？ 壟斷者訂立市場價格。 當沒有廠商可獲准進入該市場，便會出現自然壟斷。 壟斷者所提供的產品是有替代品的。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about monopolistic competition are correct? There can be a few or many buyers and sellers in the market. The sellers are price searchers. The goods and services provided by the sellers are homogeneous. There are free entry and exit in the market. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪些有關壟斷性競爭的陳述是正確的？ 市場內可以有小量或大量的買家和賣家。 賣家屬尋價者。 賣家所提供的物品及服務屬同質的。 該市場是自由進入和退出的。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following statements about economies of scale is correct? It could be a source of monopoly power. It exists when the average fixed cost is falling. Only large firms enjoy economies of scale. It is the result of the law of diminishing marginal returns.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關規模經濟的陳述是正確的？ 它可以是壟斷能力的來源。 當平均固定成本下降，規模經濟便會出現。 只有大型廠商才享有規模經濟。 它是邊際回報遞減定律的結果。

questions.en: Sony’s PS4 was responsible for $17.8 billion of sales value, or 51% share of the global console hardware market, compared with Microsoft’s Xbox One at $9.1 billion of sales value or a 26% market share. Nintendo’s 3DS platform (and its variants, such as the 2DS) was a distant third on the list with $2.6 billion of sales value or 8% share of the market. The market structure of the above global console hardware market is oligopoly. This statement is correct because the companies sell heterogeneous goods in the market. correct because there are a few dominating companies in the market. incorrect because the PS4 was only responsible for 51% of the market. incorrect because there are a lot of sellers in the global market.
questions.zh: 索尼的 PS4 的銷售額為 17.8 億元，在環球遊戲機硬件市場的佔有率為 51%。與其相比，微軟的 Xbox One 的銷售額為 9.1 億元，市場佔有率為 26%。任天堂的 3DS 平台 (及其他型號如 2DS) 則是遠遠落後的第三名，銷售額 2.6 億元，市場佔有率為 8%。 上述環球遊戲機硬件市場的市場結構屬寡頭壟斷。這陳述 是正確的，因為各公司在市場售賣異質物品。 是正確的，因為市場有數家具支配力的公司。 是不正確的，因為 PS4 只佔市場的 51%。 是不正確的，因為環球市場有眾多賣家。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about a perfectly competitive market are correct? Firms cannot survive if they ask a price higher than the market price. There is no entry barrier to the market. The profit-maximising condition of the firms is that price equals marginal cost. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些有關完全競爭市場的陳述是正確的？ 若廠商收取的價格高於市場價格，便不能生存。 進入市場並沒有限制。 廠商利潤極大化的條件為價格等於邊際成本。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Alfred booked a room in a resort hotel. Later he found that Betty had booked a room in the same hotel at a lower price. Which of the following are possible reasons for such a price difference? Alfred's booking was non-refundable while Betty's booking was with free cancellation. Alfred booked the room in a weekend while Betty booked the room in a weekday. Alfred booked the room with sea view while Betty booked the room with street view. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 小明在一家渡假酒店預訂了一間房。後來他發現小欣在同一家酒店以較低價格預訂了一間房。下列哪些是這價格差異的可能原因？ 小明的預訂屬不可退款，而小欣的預訂可免費取消。 小明預訂了週末的房間，而小欣預訂了平日的房間。 小明預訂了海景房，而小欣預訂了街景房。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Clothing retail market can be classified as monopolistic competition. Which of the following statements about clothing retail market are correct? The retailers engage in both price and non-price competitions. There are a few dominant sellers in the market. There is imperfect information about the quality of clothing in the market. The entry and exit of retailers are restricted. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 成衣零售市場可以歸類為壟斷性競爭。下列哪些有關成衣零售市場的陳述是正確的？ 零售商進行價格和非價格競爭。 市場上有數個具支配力的賣家。 市場上有關成衣質素的訊息並不完全。 零售商進入和退出該行業都受到限制。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: The table below shows the distribution of market share of Mandatory Provident Fund (強制性公積金) trustees in Hong Kong in 2021. Mandatory Provident Fund trustee Market share Manulife 25.8% HSBC 18.6% Sun Life 10.4% AIA 9.1% Others 36.1% Based on the above information, we can conclude that the above market is an example of ______ because oligopoly... sellers are interdependent in their marketing strategies oligopoly... there are a few dominant sellers in the market monopolistic competition ... there are many sellers in the market monopolistic competition ... services provided by different sellers are heterogeneous
questions.zh: 下表顯示 2021 年香港強制性公積金受託人的市場佔有率分布。 強制性公積金受託人 市場佔有率 宏利 25.8% 匯豐 18.6% 永明 10.4% 友邦 9.1% 其他 36.1% 根據以上資料，可得出結論如下：上述市場是 ______ 市場的一個例子，因為 ______。 寡頭壟斷 …… 賣家的營銷策略互為影響 寡頭壟斷 …… 市場上有數家具支配力的賣家 壟斷性競爭 …… 市場上有大量賣家 壟斷性競爭 …… 不同賣家所提供的服務是異質的

questions.en: Which of the following statements about perfect competition is INCORRECT? The market price tends to be stable as no firm can affect the market price. Price is the only competitive criterion in determining the distribution of goods. The marginal cost of the last unit of all firms is equal when the firms maximise their profits. Firms sell homogeneous products.
questions.zh: 下列哪項關於完全競爭的陳述是不正確的？ 市場價格傾向穩定，因為沒有廠商能夠影響市場價格。 價格是決定物品分配的唯一競爭準則。 當廠商利潤極大化時，所有廠商的最後一單位的邊際成本相等。 廠商出售同質物品。

questions.en: The table below shows the market shares of top four subscription video-on-demand (SVoD) service providers worldwide in March 2024. SVoD service provider Market share (%) Netflix 18.8 Amazon Prime Video 17.7 Disney+ 11.7 Tencent Video 10.6 Based on the above information, we can conclude that the market structure of the worldwide SVoD market in March 2024 could be regarded as ______ because ______. monopolistic competition ... market information was imperfect monopolistic competition ... services provided by different service providers were heterogeneous oligopoly ... there were several dominant service providers in the market oligopoly ... the governments in different countries controlled the entry of service providers into their markets
questions.zh: 下表顯示全球四大訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商於2024年3月的市場佔有率。 訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商 市場佔有率(%) 網飛（Netflix） 18.8 亞馬遜 Prime Video 17.7 迪士尼+（Disney+） 11.7 騰訊視頻 10.6 根據以上資料，可得出的結論是：全球訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商市場於2024年3月的市場結構可被視為____，因為____。 壟斷性競爭……市場資訊是不完全的 壟斷性競爭……不同服務供應商提供的服務是異質的 寡頭壟斷……該市場上有數個具支配力的服務供應商 寡頭壟斷……不同國家的政府對服務供應商進入其市場有管控

questions.en: Firm X is a price-taking firm in a perfectly competitive market. Which of the following statements about Firm X are correct? Firm X engages in both price competition and non-price competition. If Firm X increases its price of goods above the market price, it will lose all of its customers. Customers cannot differentiate the goods sold by Firm X from those sold by other firms in the market. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 廠商 X 是一間完全競爭市場的受價廠商。下列哪些有關廠商 X 的陳述是正確的？ 廠商 X 進行價格競爭和非價格競爭。 若廠商 X 將其物品價格提高至高於市場價格，它將流失所有顧客。 顧客無法將廠商 X 銷售的物品和市場上其他廠商所銷售的物品作出區別。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Market price is a criterion which determines who wins and who loses. is the maximum amount a consumer is willing to pay at the margin. may not be necessary in directing the use of scarce resources. All of the above.
questions.zh: 市場價格 是決定誰勝誰負的準則。 是消費者在邊際上願意支付的最高金額。 在指引稀缺資源的用途上可能並非必要。 以上皆是。

questions.en: The marginal cost schedule of a firm can be interpreted as its supply schedule in the production of a good because marginal cost will increase when the output of the firm increases. we can tell the quantity of the good the firm plans to produce from the marginal cost schedule given the price of the good. the quantity of the good the firm plans to produce depends positively on the marginal cost of producing the good. we can tell the price of the good from the marginal cost schedule given the quantity of the good.
questions.zh: 一家廠商生產一物品時，它的邊際成本表可被理解為它的供應表，這是因為 它的產出增加時，它的邊際成本會增加。 在已知該物品價格情況下，我們可從邊際成本表得知它計劃生產該物品的數量。 它計劃生產該物品的數量受到生產該物品的邊際成本所影響，兩者關係是正向的。 在已知該物品數量的情況下，我們可從邊際成本表得知該物品的價格。

questions.en: Suppose the government provides a per-unit subsidy to the producers of a good. This would lead to an increase in consumer surplus and a fall in producer surplus, so having an ambiguous effect on efficiency. an increase in producer surplus and a fall in consumer surplus, so having an ambiguous effect on efficiency. an improvement in efficiency because both sellers and buyers would benefit from the subsidy. a deadweight loss because the amount of subsidy provided by the government is greater than the sum of the increase in consumer and producer surpluses.
questions.zh: 假設政府向某物品的生產商提供從量補貼，這會導致 消費者盈餘上升及生產者盈餘下降，因此對效率的影響不明確。 生產者盈餘上升及消費者盈餘下降，因此對效率的影響不明確。 效率的改善，因賣家及買家均會從補貼得益。 淨損失，因政府提供的補貼額大於消費者盈餘及生產者盈餘上升的總和。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the demand and supply curves of good X in a perfectly competitive market. Suppose a price floor is set at P1. As a result, the deadweight loss is equal to area BEF. the producer surplus is equal to area P1BC0 the consumer surplus is equal to area AEPe. the total social surplus is equal to area P1BCG
questions.zh: 下圖顯示在一個完全競爭市場內物品 X 的需求和供應曲線。 假設價格下限設在 P1。結果， 效率損失 (deadweight loss) 等於面積 BEF。 生產者盈餘等於面積 P1BC0。 消費者盈餘等於面積 AEPe。 總社會盈餘等於面積 P1BCG。

questions.en: Economic efficiency is attained when total benefits to consumers are maximized. all potential gains are fully captured. marginal social benefits are equal to marginal social costs. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在下列哪些情況下，會達致經濟效率？ 消費者得到最大的總利益。 所有潛在得益可以完全攫取。 邊際社會利益等於邊際社會成本。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: The increase of an effective quota on a good will result in an increase in the quantity transacted of the good. a further improvement in the quality of the good. a smaller deadweight loss. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 增加對某物品的有效配額會導致 該物品的交易量上升。 該物品的質素進一步提升。 效率損失較小。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose the market equilibrium output level is greater than the efficient output level. It implies that total social surplus will increase if output is reduced towards the efficient output level. at the equilibrium output level, marginal benefit is greater than marginal cost. the sum of consumer surplus and producer surplus is maximized as the market output level satisfies the equilibrium condition. government intervention is necessary to reduce output as there is over-production.
questions.zh: 假設市場均衡產出水平高於效率產出水平。這意味着 若減少產出令其更接近效率產出水平，總社會盈餘會上升。 在均衡產出水平，邊際得益大於邊際成本。 消費者盈餘和生產者盈餘之和達到最大，因爲市場產出水平滿足均衡條件。 政府有需要作出干預以令產出下降，因爲出現過度生產。

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram for the Cross-Harbour Tunnel. The government proposed to raise the toll for the Cross-Harbour Tunnel so as to lessen the traffic congestion during rush hours. Suppose the maximum vehicular volume of the tunnel is fixed. Which of the following statements are correct? The demand for the service of the Cross-Harbour Tunnel will decrease. The total revenue of the Cross-Harbour Tunnel will increase. The deadweight loss caused by traffic congestion will decrease. The opportunity cost of the drivers using the tunnel will increase. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 參閱以下有關海底隧道的供需圖。 政府建議提高海底隧道的收費，以減輕繁忙時段的交通擠塞情況。假設隧道最大行車流量是固定的。下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 對海底隧道服務的需求會減少。 海底隧道的總收益會上升。 由交通擠塞引起的效率損失會減少。 司機使用該隧道的機會成本會上升。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: In which of the following situations is efficiency attained? Total social benefit is equal to total social cost. Producer surplus is equal to consumer surplus. The difference between marginal social benefit and marginal social cost is zero. The consumer surplus of all consumers in the market is maximised.
questions.zh: 下列哪種情況會達至有效率？ 總社會得益等於總社會成本。 生產者盈餘等於消費者盈餘。 邊際社會得益和邊際社會成本的差額為零。 市場上全部消費者的消費者盈餘達至最高。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the demand and supply curves of Good X. Suppose the government increases the tax on Good X from t1 to t2. Which of the following statements is correct? The deadweight loss will increase by area bcgh. The deadweight loss will decrease by area abh. The new deadweight loss is area bcf. The new deadweight loss is area aci.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示物品 X 的供需曲線。 假設政府對物品 X 的稅項由 t1 提高至 t2。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 效率損失會增加面積 bcgh。 效率損失會減少面積 abh。 新的效率損失是面積 bcf。 新的效率損失是面積 aci。

questions.en: A non-profit organisation supports the increase in cigarette tax. The organisation reveals that every 10% increase in cigarette prices reduces the total cigarette quantity transacted by 4%. Which of the following statements about cigarette tax is INCORRECT? Law of demand is illustrated in the above case. The total expenditure on cigarette will increase after the increase of the cigarette tax. The increase in cigarette tax may lead to a greater income inequality. The cigarette tax could help reduce the problem of under-production of cigarette.
questions.zh: 某非牟利組織支持增加香煙稅。該組織透露，香煙價格每增加 10%，香煙總成交量則下降 4%。下列哪項關於香煙稅的陳述是不正確的？ 上述個案說明了需求定律。 在增加香煙稅後，對香煙的總支出會增加。 增加香煙稅可能導致收入不均加劇。 香煙稅有助於減輕香煙生產不足的問題。

questions.en: Study the following news extract. In the last decade, the rent of residential units in Berlin was doubled due to continuous increase in demand. To deal with the problem, the Berlin government imposed a ‘Rent Frozen Bill’ under which the rent of residential units was not allowed to increase for at least 5 years. Suppose a similar bill is implemented in Hong Kong. Which of the following statements is correct? The Gini coefficient will increase. The property tax revenue of the government will increase. There will be a deadweight loss if the demand for residential units keeps on increasing. The property owners will have higher incentives to renovate their flats.
questions.zh: 細閱下列的新聞撮要： 近十年來，由於需求持續上升，柏林住宅單位的租金已上升一倍。為了應付該問題，柏林政府實施「租金凍結法」，限制住宅單位的租金最少5年內不能增加。 假設香港推行類似的法例。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 堅尼系數會上升。 政府的物業稅收入會上升。 若住宅單位的需求持續上升，效率損失會出現。 物業擁有人會有較高意欲裝修其單位。

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram for Good X. If the price floor of Good X changes from P₁ to P₂, producer surplus will increase. quantity transacted of Good X will remain at Q₁. deadweight loss will increase. excess demand of Good X will change to excess supply.
questions.zh: 參閱以下物品X的供需圖。 若物品X的價格下限由 P1 轉變至 P2， 生產者盈餘會上升。 物品X的交易量會維持在 Q1。 效率損失會增加。 物品X的超額需求會轉變成超額供應。

questions.en: Initially a country imposes an effective quota on coffee bean production. If now more people like to drink coffee, which of the following statements about coffee bean market are correct? The total expenditure will increase. The deadweight loss will increase. The consumer surplus will increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 原初某國對咖啡豆生產實施有效配額。 若現在更多人愛喝咖啡，下列哪些有關咖啡豆市場的陳述是正確的？ 總支出會上升。 效率損失會上升。 消費者盈餘會上升。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram of Good X. If the government cancels the per-unit subsidy on Good X, it will lead to a decrease in _______. quantity transacted consumer surplus deadweight loss (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參考以下有關物品X的供需圖。 若政府取消對物品X的從量補貼，這會引致________下降。 交易量 消費者盈餘 效率損失 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply and demand curves of a good. Suppose the government changes the price floor from P1 to P2. Which of the following statements is/are correct? The marginal benefit of the last unit of the good will decrease. There will be an increase in the excess demand for the good. Consumers' total expenditure on the good will decrease. The quantity transacted of the good will remain unchanged. (4) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某物品的供需曲線。 假設政府將價格下限由 P1 改為 P2。下列哪項／哪些陳述是正確的？ 該物品的最後一個單位的邊際利益會下降。 該物品的超額需求會上升。 消費者對該物品的總支出會下降。 該物品的交易量會維持不變。 只有(4) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram about the market of local vegetables in an economy. The shift of the demand curve from D0 to D1 can be caused by an increase in the price of local vegetables will raise the marginal cost of the last unit of local vegetables will lead to economic inefficiency can be caused by a decrease in the sales tax on imported vegetables
questions.zh: 參考以下有關某經濟本地蔬菜市場的圖表。 需求曲線由 D₀ 移至 D₁ ______。 可以是由本地蔬菜價格上升所導致 會令本地蔬菜的最後一個單位的邊際成本上升 會引致經濟缺乏效率 可以是由進口蔬菜的銷售稅下降所導致

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply and demand curves of Good Z. Suppose a price ceiling is set at P1. When the demand for Good Z increases from D1 to D2, there is ______ and the deadweight loss is ______. over-production ... area abc over-production ... area acf under-production ... area abc under-production ... area acf
questions.zh: 下圖顯示物品 Z 的供需曲線。 假設價格上限設於 P₁。當物品 Z 的需求從 D₁ 上升至 D₂，會出現 ______，效率損失為 ______。 過度生產 …… 面積 abc 過度生產 …… 面積 acf 生產不足 …… 面積 abc 生產不足 …… 面積 acf

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply and demand curves of a good. Suppose the government increases the per-unit subsidy from $5 to $10. Which of the following statements is correct? The new total social surplus is area aib. The new total social surplus is area acdb. The increase in deadweight loss is area ehif. The increase in deadweight loss is area cid.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某物品的供應曲線及需求曲線。 假設政府將從量補貼由$5增加至$10。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 新的總社會盈餘是面積 aib。 新的總社會盈餘是面積 acdb。 淨損失的增加是面積 ehif。 淨損失的增加是面積 cid。

questions.en: The following is the demand-supply diagram of Good X. Initially the price of Good X is P0. Which of the following situations may reduce the consumer surplus and create a deadweight loss in the market of Good X at the same time? a decrease in the demand for Good X the imposition of an effective price ceiling on Good X the imposition of an effective price floor on Good X (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 以下是物品 X 的供需圖。原初，物品 X 的價格是 P0。 下列哪些情況可能令物品X市場上的消費者盈餘下降，同時造成淨損失？ 物品X的需求下降 對物品X實施一有效的價格上限 對物品X實施一有效的價格下限 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Due to poor harvests of oranges, many juice producers use other fruits such as mandarins as an alternative ingredient to produce juice. Based on the above information, which of the following is correct? There is a deadweight loss in the market of oranges. The total revenue of orange sellers may increase. The total social surplus in the market of mandarins decreases. The total exchange value of mandarins may decrease.
questions.zh: 由於橙的收成欠佳，很多果汁生產商改以柑橘等其他水果作為生產果汁的材料。根據上述資料，下列哪項是正確的？ 橙的市場上出現效率損失。 橙的賣家的總收入可能上升。 柑橘市場上的總社會盈餘下降。 柑橘的總交易價值可能下降。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the supply and demand curves of a good. Suppose the government imposes a per-unit tax on the production of the good. Which of the following statements about the imposition of the per-unit tax are correct? The consumers bear no tax burden. The decrease in total social surplus is area 0abc. There is deadweight loss after the imposition of the tax. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某物品的供需曲線。假設政府對該物品的生產徵收一項從量稅。 下列哪些關於徵收上述從量稅的陳述是正確的？ 消費者沒有任何稅項負擔。 總社會盈餘的下降是面積 0abc。 徵收該稅項後出現效率損失。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market situation of good X after the government had imposed a per-unit tax on good X. Suppose the government abolishes the above per-unit tax and imposes a price floor at PA instead. Which of the following statements are correct? There will be an excess supply of good X. The producer surplus will rise. The deadweight loss will remain unchanged. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下圖顯示政府對物品 X 徵收從量稅後，物品 X 的市場情況。 假設政府取消上述的從量稅，而實施一項價格下限定為 PA。 下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 物品 X 會出現超額供應。 生產者盈餘會上升。 效率損失會維持不變。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following implies a divergence between private and social costs? Male students contribute money towards buying perfumes for female students. A student accidentally pours coffee on a professor’s jacket and says sorry. A husband complains about his wife all the time but refuses to get a divorce. A piano player who never receives any payment for his music from his neighbour always plays the piano up to the point that the marginal value of his piano play to his neighbour is zero.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項意味著私人成本與社會成本之間出現分歧？ 男學生提供貨幣，合資為女學生購買香水。 一名學生不小心把咖啡潑在教授的外套上，並表示抱歉。 一名丈夫經常抱怨他的妻子，但拒絕離婚。 一位鋼琴手從未因其音樂而獲得鄰居的任何付款，但他總是彈奏鋼琴，直至其演奏對鄰居的邊際價值為零為止。

questions.en: In which of the following situations will there be NO divergence between private and social costs / benefits? A chemical factory upstream pollutes a river without considering the damage inflicted upon fish farmers downstream. A diner smokes in a restaurant without considering the effects on people nearby. A farmer raises some sheep which damage the crops of nearby farmland owned by the farmer. A pianist plays the piano at home and receives no payment from his neighbour who enjoys the music.
questions.zh: 在以下哪種情況下，私人與社會成本／利益之間不會出現分離？ 一家位於上游的化學廠污染河流，而沒有考慮對下游養魚戶造成的損害。 一名食客在餐廳內吸煙，而沒有考慮對附近人士造成的影響。 一名農民飼養羊隻，牠們破壞了附近由該農民擁有的土地上的農作物。 一名鋼琴家在家中彈奏鋼琴，而欣賞該音樂的鄰居並沒有向他支付費用。

questions.en: A beekeeper keeps the bees for their honey. The bee-keeping benefits the farmers in the orchard nearby because the bees help pollinate the fruits in the orchard. Which of the following statements about this case is correct? There will be a divergence between private and social benefits and the honey is over-produced. The beekeeper should be subsidized by the government to improve economic efficiency. If the value of honey is higher than the value of fruits, there is no need for the government to intervene to correct the externality. There will be no divergence between private and social benefits if the orchard nearby is owned by the beekeeper.
questions.zh: 養蜂者養蜂是為了獲取蜂蜜。養蜂對附近果園的農民有利，因爲蜜蜂幫助果園的果樹傳播花粉。下列哪項有關上述個案的陳述是正確的？ 私人和社會得益分歧會出現，而蜂蜜會過度生產。 養蜂者應獲政府補貼以改善經濟效率。 若蜂蜜的價值高於水果的價值，政府毋須介入改正界外效應。 若附近果園屬該養蜂者所擁有，私人和社會得益分歧不會出現。

questions.en: Korean pop singers are becoming more popular in Hong Kong. To these singers, which of the following are their private benefits? the rise in royalties from the sales of their albums the rise in sales revenue of Korean-designed fashion the rise in the number of tourists visiting Korea the rise in revenue shared from their concerts held in Hong Kong (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 韓國的流行歌手在香港越來越受歡迎。對這些歌手來說，下列哪些屬於他們的私人得益？ 出售他們的唱片所得的版稅收入增加了。 韓國所設計的服裝其銷售收益增加了。 到訪韓國的遊客人數增加了。 他們在香港舉行演唱會所分成的收益增加了。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following are ways to lessen the problem of divergence between private and social costs in Hong Kong? to collect a sewage charge to collect a university tuition fee to collect a charge on electricity to collect a levy on plastic bags (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 在香港，下列哪些是減輕私人與社會成本分歧這個問題的方法？ 收取排污費 收取大學學費 收取電費 對使用膠袋徵費 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following is an example of the divergence between private and social benefits? A security guard watches live concerts when he is working in a concert hall. A tourist enjoys the music performed by a singer on the street and he does not pay for that. A resident living next to a karaoke lounge cannot fall asleep because of the noise. After the removal of the airport, the market value of the residential flats in that region increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是私人利益和社會利益分歧的一個例子？ 一名保安員在演奏廳當值時觀看到現場音樂會。 一名遊客欣賞街頭歌手的音樂表演而沒有付費。 一名住在卡拉 OK 酒廊隔鄰的居民因噪音不能入睡。 機場遷離後，該地區的住宅樓宇的市場價值上升。

questions.en: Recently, unmanned aircraft systems have become very popular but using those aircrafts in urban areas has caused noise and safety concerns. The Civil Aviation Department is considering regulating the manufacture, import and sale of unmanned aircraft systems. It is an example of divergence between private and social _______ and the _______ solution is being considered to reduce the divergence. costs ... market costs ... government benefits ... market benefits ... government
questions.zh: 近年，無人飛行系統變得十分普及，但在市區使用這些飛行器引起人們對它在噪音和安全方面的關注。民航處正考慮對生產、進口和銷售無人飛行系統作出監管。 這是私人和社會 ______ 分歧的一個例子，而 ______ 的方法正被考慮用作減少該分歧。 成本 …… 市場 成本 …… 政府 利益 …… 市場 利益 …… 政府

questions.en: With reference to the above information, which of the following statements is correct? Children screaming in the café results in negative externality and all cafés should introduce similar policy to restore efficiency. The extra charge on screaming children increases the marginal private cost of the groups with screaming children. The ‘screaming child tax’ is a government solution to the divergence between private and social costs. The ‘screaming child tax’ is a kind of discrimination and should not be imposed.
questions.zh: 參考以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 小孩在咖啡店尖叫引致負面界外影響，而所有咖啡店應該採取相似的政策以回復效率。 對小孩尖叫的額外收費增加有尖叫小孩的人士的邊際私人成本。 「小孩尖叫稅」是政府解決私人成本和社會成本分歧的一種方法。 「小孩尖叫稅」是一種歧視，因此不應實施。

questions.en: Which of the following will most likely be the positive external effect of the opening of the full Tuen Ma Line of MTR? The travel time is shortened for MTR passengers. The business of restaurants near the stations of MTR Tuen Ma Line rises. The problem of noise pollution worsens. The income of minibus drivers drops.
questions.zh: 下列哪項最有可能是港鐵屯馬綫全綫通車引起的正面外部影響？ 港鐵乘客的乘車時間縮短。 港鐵屯馬綫車站附近餐廳的生意上升。 噪音污染問題惡化。 小巴司機的收入下降。

questions.en: Plastic straws are a major source of plastic waste. Most plastic straws would break into smaller particles, releasing chemicals which threaten the environment. Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct? The use of plastic straws results in negative externality, and the quantity of plastic straws used is below the efficient level. To maximise total social surplus, governments around the world should completely ban the use of plastic straws. Charging a lump-sum tax on the businesses that provide plastic straws to customers must restore efficiency in the market of plastic straws. Granting a per-unit subsidy to the producers of environmentally-friendly paper straws tends to reduce the deadweight loss in the market of plastic straws.
questions.zh: 塑膠飲管是塑膠廢料的主要源頭。大部分塑膠飲管會分解成較細小的粒子，釋出危害環境的化學物質。 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 塑膠飲管的使用引致負面界外影響，而塑膠飲管的使用量低於效率水平。 為達至總社會盈餘極大化，各地政府應全面禁止使用塑膠飲管。 對提供塑膠飲管予顧客的業務徵收一項定額稅，必然可以回復塑膠飲管市場的效率。 向環保紙飲管生產者提供從量補貼，傾向降低塑膠飲管市場的效率損失。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about overproduction is/are correct? Overproduction of a good occurs when there is an excess supply of the good. Overproduction does not occur whenever the market is at equilibrium. When overproduction occurs, the marginal social cost is greater than the marginal social benefit at the last unit. (2) only (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項／些關於過度生產的陳述是正確的？ 當某物品有超額供應時，該物品會出現過度生產。 每當市場處於均衡狀態時，便不會出現過度生產。 當過度生產出現時，最後一單位的邊際社會成本大於邊際社會利益。 只有(2) 只有(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: In recent years, more and more people play videos loudly with their smartphones on public transport, disturbing other passengers. Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct? Total social surplus may decrease if playing videos loudly with smartphones on public transport is banned by the government. Economic efficiency may improve if suppliers of public transportation services designate quiet zones in their vehicles where passengers are not allowed to play videos loudly with their smartphones. The divergence between private and social costs may decrease if people playing videos loudly with their smartphones on public transport are fined. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 近年，越來越多人在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片，對其他乘客造成滋擾。 根據上述資料，下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 假如政府禁止在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片，總社會盈餘可能會下降。 假如公共交通服務的供應者在其交通工具上設立靜音區，不准乘客在靜音區內用智能電話大聲地播放影片，經濟效率可能會有所改善。 假如在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片會被罰款，私人成本與社會成本的分歧可能會下降。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A developer plans to construct a tall building. The building will block the sea view enjoyed by some households living in another building. In the above situation, efficiency may be attained if _______. the government restricts the height of the new building the developer pays a compensation to each affected household for blocking the sea view the affected households pay the developer to request it to reduce the height of the new building (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 某發展商計劃興建一座高聳的建築物。該建築物將會擋着另一座建築物部分住戶享有的海景。 在上述情況中，若 ______，則可能達至有效率。 政府限制該座新建築物的高度 該發展商向每一個受影響住戶就阻擋海景支付賠償 受影響住戶向該發展商付費，要求它降低該座新建築物的高度 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: When there is a negative externality, ______ occurs in the market and its efficient output level is ______ its equilibrium output level. overproduction ... above overproduction ... below underproduction ... above underproduction ... below
questions.zh: 當有負面界外影響時，市場會出現 ______，而其有效率的產出水平會 ______ 其均衡產出水平。 過度生產 …… 高於 過度生產 …… 低於 生產不足 …… 高於 生產不足 …… 低於

questions.en: Study the following Lorenz curves of two economies. From the above diagrams, we can conclude that the income distribution of Country A is more even than that of Country B. the income distribution of Country B is more even than that of Country A. the high-income group in Country A earns a higher income than that in Country B. the high-income group in Country B earns a higher income than that in Country A.
questions.zh: 細閱以下兩個經濟體的洛倫茨曲線。 根據以上圖表，可得出以下結論： 國家A的收入分配比國家B更均勻。 國家B的收入分配比國家A更均勻。 國家A的高收入組別賺取的收入比國家B的高。 國家B的高收入組別賺取的收入比國家A的高。

questions.en: The following table shows the Gini coefficient of Economy A from Year 1 to Year 4. Year Gini coefficient 1 0.534 2 0.563 3 0.609 4 0.614 Based on the above information, which of the following statements is/are correct? The income of high-income households increases while the income of low-income households decreases. The income distribution becomes more uneven. The general living standard declines. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲經濟由年份 1 至年份 4 的堅尼系數。 年份 堅尼系數 1 0.534 2 0.563 3 0.609 4 0.614 根據以上資料，下列哪項／些陳述是正確的？ 高收入住戶的收入增加，而低收入住戶的收入則減少。 收入分布愈變不均。 一般生活水準下降。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following are possible causes of income inequality among individuals? difference in race difference in capital ownership difference in health (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些是導致不同人之間收入不均的可能原因？ 種族的差異 資本擁有權的差異 健康的差異 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Li Ka Shing Foundation gave HK$5 000 to each 2017 HKDSE candidate living in those remote districts with lower average household income. Which of the following statement about this unconditional gift is correct? It reduces the income inequality as a larger portion of the receivers of the gift are from lower income group. It increases the income inequality as it is unfair to the candidates living in the non-remote districts. As the money is given to all candidates living in those remote districts, income distribution remains unchanged. It helps equalizing opportunities as those candidates will study harder to improve their exam results.
questions.zh: 李嘉誠基金會向每位居住在那些平均住戶收入較低之偏遠地區的2017年香港中學文憑考試考生派發港幣5 000元。下列哪項有關該無條件饋贈的陳述是正確的？ 這減低了收入不均，因為收到該饋贈的人較大部分來自低收入組別。 這增加了收入不均，因為對居住在非偏遠地區的考生並不公平。 因為該款項是給予那些居住在偏遠地區的所有考生，所以收入分配維持不變。 這有助機會均等化，因為那些考生會更用功讀書以提高其考試成績。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the Gini coefficient of Hong Kong based on original household income. Based on the above diagram, we can conclude that the income level of Hong Kong people increased. income for high income household increased while income for low income household decreased. the welfare policy failed to reduce the income inequality. income gap had been widening.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示香港的堅尼系數 (按原初住戶收入計算): 根據上圖，我們可以得出的結論是： 香港人的收入水平上升。 高收入住戶的收入增加而低收入住戶的收入減少。 福利政策未能減低收入不均。 收入差距日漸擴大。

questions.en: The Work Incentive Transport Subsidy Scheme helps low-income earners reduce their cost of travelling to and from work and encourages them to get a job. Workers meeting certain criteria, such as monthly income and asset limited, are eligible to get the subsidy. Which of the following would likely occur after the implementation of this scheme? Labour supply would increase. Labour productivity would increase. Geographical mobility of labour would increase. Income inequality would decrease. (1) and (2) only (3) and (4) only (1), (3) and (4) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 「鼓勵就業交通津貼計劃」協助低收入在職人士減低往返工作地點的交通費負擔，並鼓勵他們就業。工人只要符合指定條件，例如每月收入限額及資產限額，便有資格獲得津貼。 在上述計劃推行後，下列哪些會可能出現？ 勞力供應會增加。 勞工生產力會增加。 勞工的地域流動性會增加。 收入不均會下降。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(3)、(4) 只有 (1)、 (3) 及 (4) 只有 (2)、 (3) 及 (4)

questions.en: The following table shows the data of average annual income earned by women and men according to their age in 2018. Age Average annual income of women (HK$) Average annual income of men (HK$) 20 - 29 122000 121000 50 - 59 482000 645000 Which of the following may explain the phenomena shown by the above data? Women tend to leave the job market earlier than men for taking care of the family, leading to fewer women to take up senior positions in companies. Sex discrimination in labour market exists in the older generations. Accumulation of human capital contributes to the difference in income between different age groups. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示 2018 年女性與男性按年齡劃分的平均年收入資料。 年齡 女性平均年收入 (港幣 $) 男性平均年收入 (港幣 $) 20 - 29 122000 121000 50 - 59 482000 645000 下列哪些可能解釋以上資料所示的現象？ 女性傾向於比男性更早離開職場以照顧家庭，以致擔任公司高職的女性較少。 勞動市場的性別歧視存在於年長一輩中。 人力資本的積累導致不同年齡組別的收入差異。 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The following table shows the information about two top-tier football leagues. Average annual income of the players Football league Defensive players Attacking players England £2 751 537 £3 839 875 Italy £1 536 945 £2 625 975 Which of the following is/are possible reason(s) for the income differences among players? The television broadcast revenue generated by the top-tier football league in England is higher than that in Italy. The price level in England is higher than that in Italy. The commercial values of attacking players are higher than those of defensive players since attacking players are more popular. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示有關兩個頂級足球聯賽的資料。 球員的每年平均收入 足球聯賽 防守球員 進攻球員 英格蘭 £2 751 537 £3 839 875 意大利 £1 536 945 £2 625 975 下列哪項／些是球員之間收入差異的可能原因？ 英格蘭頂級足球聯賽的電視轉播收入較意大利的為高。 英格蘭的物價水平較意大利的為高。 進攻球員的商業價值較防守球員的為高，因為進攻球員較受歡迎。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Refer to the following Lorenz curves of a country. Based on the above information, which of the following statements about the country is/are correct? The tax system is progressive. Social transfer helps equalise outcome. The income inequality problem becomes more serious after the government’s redistribution of income. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1) and (2) only
questions.zh: 參閱以下某國的洛倫茨曲線。 根據以上資料，下列哪項／些有關該國的陳述是正確的？ 稅制屬累進的。 福利轉移幫助結果均等化。 在政府進行收入再分配後，收入不均的問題變得更嚴重。 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(3) 只有(1)、(2)

questions.en: The table below shows the Gini coefficients by industry of an economy. Gini coefficient Accommodation and food services 0.34 Finance and insurance 0.51 Which of the following are possible explanations for the above difference in the Gini coefficient? The salaries of workers in the accommodation and food services industry are lower than that of professionals in the finance and insurance industry. Compared to professionals in the finance and insurance industry, the levels of human capital tend to be more homogeneous among workers in the accommodation and food services industry. The wage payment method for professionals in the finance and insurance industry is mostly basic salary plus commission while that for workers in the accommodation and food services industry is mostly time rate. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示某經濟中按行業分類的堅尼系數。 堅尼系數 住宿及膳食服務 0.34 金融及保險 0.51 下列哪些是上述堅尼系數差異的可能解釋？ 住宿及膳食服務業工人的薪金較金融及保險業專才的低。 與金融及保險業專才相比，住宿及膳食服務業工人之間的人力資本水平傾向較同質。 金融及保險業專才的薪酬支付方式多為底薪加佣金，而住宿及膳食服務業工人的薪酬支付方式多為以時計薪。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Study the Lorenz curves of Country A and Country B below. Suppose the total incomes in the two countries are equal. Based on the above information, we can conclude that Country A has a lower Gini coefficient than Country B the bottom 20% households in Country A earn a higher total income than the bottom 20% households in Country B the top 20% households in Country A earn a smaller proportion of the country's total income than that in Country B (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 細閱以下甲國和乙國的洛倫茨曲線。 假設兩國的總收入相等，根據上述資料，可得出的結論是：____。 甲國的堅尼系數較乙國的低 甲國最低端 20% 的住戶的總收入高於乙國最低端 20% 的住戶的總收入 甲國最高端 20% 的住戶的收入佔其國家總收入的比例較乙國的小 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Study the following data about the Gini coefficients of an economy based on household income. 2024 2025 Pre-tax pre-social transfer Gini coefficient 0.52 0.52 Post-tax post-social transfer Gini coefficient 0.39 0.45 Which of the following is/are possible reason(s) for the above changes in the Gini coefficients from 2024 to 2025? The government decreases the progressivity of the salaries tax in 2025. Many companies replace their low-skilled workers with artificial intelligence robots in 2025. The government gives out $5 000 cash to each household in 2025. (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 細閱以下有關某經濟按住戶收入計算的堅尼系數資料。 2024 2025 按除稅及福利轉移前計算的堅尼系數 0.52 0.52 按除稅及福利轉移後計算的堅尼系數 0.39 0.45 下列哪項／些是上述堅尼系數在 2024 年至 2025 年間改變的可能原因？ 在 2025 年，政府降低薪俸稅的累進程度。 在 2025 年，許多公司以人工智能機器人取代低技術工人。 在 2025 年，政府向每個住戶派發 5 000 元現金。 只有 (1) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: X and Y in the above circular flow of economic activities should be labeled respectively as sales revenue, factor services. Sales revenue, goods and services. Factor income, goods and services. Factor income, factor services.
questions.zh: 上列經濟活動循環流程中的 X 和 Y 應分別標示為 銷售收益、生產要素服務。 銷售收益、物品及服務。 生產要素收入、物品及服務。 生產要素收入、生產要素服務。

questions.en: The diagram above shows the circular flow of economic activities. The economy's expenditure and income are shown in Flow ______ and Flow ______ respectively. (1); (2) (1); (4) (2); (3) (3); (4)

questions.en: What does the above diagram show? Economic activities take place in an open economy. There is government intervention in the economy. national income equals national expenditure. Households conduct transactions in the goods market only.
questions.zh: 上圖顯示什麼？ 它顯示一開放經濟體系的經濟活動。 這經濟體系有政府的干預。 國民收入與國民支出相等。 家庭只在產品市場交易。

questions.en: Flow A, Flow D: real flows Flow B, Flow C: money flows Refer to the above circular flows. Which of the following statements is correct? Flows A and D are flows of households' expenditure and firms' payment to factor owners respectively. All value-added totals contributed by the firms equal the market value of all final goods and services. The market value of Flow B equals the market value of all final goods and services plus the market value of unsold goods. The flow of final goods and services includes self-provided services.
questions.zh: 流程 A及流程 D：實質流程 流程 B及流程 C：金錢流程 根據以上流程圖作答。下列哪一項描述是正確的？ 流程 A 及 D 分別是家庭支出的流程及廠商支付生產因素擁有者的流程。 所有廠商「增值」的總和與全部最終物品和服務的市值相等。 流程 B 的市值等於全部最終物品和服務的市值與未售出貨物的市值之和。 最終物品和服務的流程包括向自己提供的服務。

questions.en: Refer to the following circular flow of an economy: Which of the following is included in Flow X? household expenditures on final goods and services factor income such as rent and wages value of intermediate goods market value of all final goods and services
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟的流程圖： 下列哪一項包括在X流程內？ 家庭在最終物品及服務方面的支出。 生產要素的收入，例如租金及工資。 中間物品的價值。 全部最終物品及服務的市值。

questions.en: Refer to the following circular flow of Economy A: Flow X represents the total expenditures on all final goods and services. the total income earned by households from their factor services. the total value of factor services provided by households to firms. the total market value of all intermediate and final goods and services.
questions.zh: 參閱下列甲經濟的生產流程圖： X 流程代表 在所有最終貨品和服務上的總支出。 家庭從它們所提供的要素服務中賺獲的總收入。 家庭提供予廠商的要素服務總值。 所有中間及最終貨品和服務的總市值。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the circular flow of an economy. Based on the above information, Flow X represents ______ and Flow Y represents ______. factors of production ... factor income factor cost of production ... intermediate goods sales revenue ... producer goods consumption expenditure ... final goods
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟的循環流程。 根據上述資料，流程 X 代表 ______，流程 Y 代表 ______。 生產要素 …… 要素收入 生產要素成本 …… 中間物品 銷售收益 …… 生產者物品 消費支出 …… 最終物品

questions.en: Which of the following items should be included in Hong Kong’s GDP for the current year? An investor buys shares on the local stock exchange. A British citizen receives a salary for teaching English in a school in Hong Kong. A students sells some used textbooks to his friend. A manufacturer sells last year’s unsold stocks.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項應被包括在香港當年本地生產總值內？ 一投資者在本港股票交易所購買股票。 一英國人在本港一所學校教授英語而收取薪金。 一學生將一些舊教科書出售予他的朋友。 一製造商賣出去年的存貨。

questions.en: Which of the following will NOT be included in Hong Kong's GDP? profits earned by individual investors from buying and selling shares in the Hong Kong stock market bonuses paid by the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited to its staff stamp duty levied on the shares bought and sold in the Hong Kong stock market. commissions paid to the brokers for transactions in the Hong Kong stock market.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項不會計算在香港的本地生產總值內？ 個別投資者在香港股市買賣股票所賺獲的利潤。 香港聯合交易所給予職員的年終獎金。 在香港股市買賣股票所繳付的印花稅。 經紀在香港股市代客進行買賣所賺取的佣金。

questions.en: Which of the following items is included in the calculation of Hong Kong's GDP? The government grant received by a university student. The salary received by a civil servant who is a foreigner working in Hong Kong. Interest to a loan paid by a firm in Hong Kong to a bank in Japan. Loans repayment made by the Hong Kong government to the Hong Kong Bank.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項被計算入香港本地生產總值之內？ 某大學生得到的政府津貼。 某外國人在香港任職公務員得到的薪金。 香港某廠商向日本某銀行借款所付出的利息。 香港政府向匯豐銀行償還的債款。

questions.en: Which of the following items is NOT included in the calculation of GDP? government spending of $300 million on the employee retraining programme unemployment benefits of $20 million paid by the government commission paid by a successful job searcher to an employment agency for job referral services salaries paid to the two extra posts created in the Labour Department to help job searchers
questions.zh: 下列哪一項並不包括入本地生產總值的計算之中？ 政府花費在僱員再培訓計劃的 3 億元 政府支付的 2 千萬元失業救濟金 一名成功求職者對替他介紹工作的職業介紹所支付的佣金 勞工處為幫助求職者增加的兩名新官員的薪金

questions.en: The following transactions were recorded in an economy in a certain year: In the above transactions what was the total contribution of Firm B and Firm C to the gross domestic product (GDP) of this economy? Firm A sold its products to Firm B for $100 and Firm C for $200. Firm B then resold part of the products to households for $200 and the rest to other firms for $300. Firm C then exported the products for $500. $700 $900 $1100 $1300
questions.zh: 下文顯示某經濟體系某年的交易記錄： 在上列交易中，乙廠商和丙廠商對該經濟體系本地生產總值的貢獻合共是多少？ 甲廠商將部分產品以$100 售予乙廠商，其餘以$200 售予丙廠商。 乙廠商將購得的產品以$200 售予家庭，其餘以$300 售予其他廠商。 丙商則將購得的產品出口，獲得$500。 $700 $900 $1,100 $1,300

questions.en: Transfer payments are NOT included in national income because they are included in the gross national income but not the net national income. they are already included in the incomes of households. they are not returns for the production of goods and services. they are not taxed by the government.
questions.zh: 轉移支付不是計算在國民收入之內，因為 它計算在國民收入總值之中，卻不在國民收入淨值之內。 它已計算在家庭收入之內。 它不是生產貨物及勞務的回報。 政府沒有對它徵稅。

questions.en: Which of the following $1 million amounts is included in the calculation of Hong Kong’s GDP? A famous singer holds a charity performance in Hong Kong and donates all the proceeds of $1 million to the floods victims in Mainland China.
