questions.zh: 下列是 X 國的資料： 年份 1992 1997 本地生產總值 5 000 億元 7 000 億元 物價指數(1990 年=100) 120 135 從 1992 年到 1997 年的實質本地生產總值增長率是 24.4% 28.6% 40.0% 57.5%

questions.en: An increase in the GDP deflator from 100 to 110 in a certain year means that every household's cost of living has increased by 10%. the general price level has increased by 10%. the prices of all goods produced in the current year have increased by 10%. people's nominal incomes have increased by 10%.
questions.zh: 某年，本地生產總值平減指數由 100 上升至 110，這意味 每個家庭的生活費用增加了 10%。 一般物價水平上升了 10%。 當年生產的全部貨物的價格都上升了 10%。 市民的名義收入增加了 10%。

questions.en: Suppose a closed economy produces food and clothing only. The outputs of Years 1 and 2 are as follows: Year Quantity of food (unit) Unit price of food ($) Quantity of clothing (unit) Unit price of clothing ($) 1 20 4 40 12 2 15 10 35 30 From Year 1 to Year 2, the real gross national product (real GNP) of this country has worsened because the price level increases. worsened because the output of both goods decreases. improved because the nominal GNP increases. improved because the technology advances.
questions.zh: 設某封閉式經濟體系只生產食物和衣服，第 1、2 年生產量如下： 年份 食物數量 (單位) 食物單位價格 ($) 衣服數量 (單位) 衣服單位價格 ($) 1 20 4 40 12 2 15 10 35 30 從第 1 年到第 2 年，該國的實質國民生產總值 下降，因為物價水平上升。 下降，因為兩種物品的產出下降。 提升，因為名義國民生產總值上升。 提升，因為科技有進步。

questions.en: Suppose a country experiences a 2% increase in the production volume of goods and services as well as a 3% rise in the general price level in a year. We can conclude that the real GNP will increase by 2% the nominal GNP will increase by 2% the nominal GNP will increase by 3% the nominal GNP will increase more than the real GNP by 1% (1) only (2) only (1) and (2) only (1), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 設某國某年貨物及勞務的生產量增加 2%，而一般物價水平則上升 3%。可得結論如下： 該國實質國民生產總值上升 2%。 該國名義國民生產總值上升 2%。 該國名義國民生產總值上升 3%。 該國名義國民生產總值較實質國民生產總值多增加 1%。 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3)、(4)

questions.en: Suppose the nominal GNP and the price level increase by 10% and 5% respectively, but the population decreases by 10%. Then the per capita nominal GNP will ______ and the per capita real GNP will ______. increase ... increase decrease ... decrease increase ... remain unchanged remain unchanged ... increase
questions.zh: 假設名義國民生產總值與物價水平分別上升 10% 和 5%，但人口下降 10%。那麼，人均名義國民生產總值會 ______ 而人均實質國民生產總值會 ______。 增加 ... 增加 下降 ... 下降 增加 ... 維持不變 維持不變 ... 增加

questions.en: Under which of the following circumstances will the per capita real GNP understate the living standard? when the construction industry causes noise pollution when there is an increase in population due to immigration when Mrs Lam does the housework by herself instead of employing a servant when there is inflation
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況中，人均實質國民生產總值所反映出來的生活水準較實際生活水準為低？ 建築業帶來噪音。 入口移民導致人口增加。 林太沒有聘用家庭傭工，她自己做家務。 通貨膨脹的出現。

questions.en: Year GNP at current market prices ($ billion) GNP deflator 1997 2 100 105 1998 2 800 125 Based on the above information, the growth rate of real gross national product (real GNP) between 1997 and 1998 is 12% 16.3% 33.3% There is insufficient information to find the answer.
questions.zh: 年份 以當時市價計算的國民生產總值 (以 10 億元為單位) 國民生產總值平減指數 1997 2 100 105 1998 2 800 125 根據上述資料，從 1997 年到 1998 年間實質國民生產總值的增長率是 12% 16.3% 33.3% 無足夠資料作答。

questions.en: Suppose the GNP at current market prices and the GNP at constant market prices of an economy increase by the same percentage. This means that real output increases but price level remains unchanged. both price level and real output increase by the same percentage. price level rises at a greater percentage than real output. price level rises but real output remains unchanged.
questions.zh: 假設某經濟以當時市價計算的本地居民生產總值與以固定市價計算的本地居民生產總值按相同的百分比增加。這意味著 實質產出增加，但物價水平維持不變。 物價水平和實質產出均按相同的百分比增加。 物價水平上升的百分比大於實質產出。 物價水平上升，但實質產出維持不變。

questions.en: Consider the following information on an economy: Nominal GNP Growth Rate - 3 % Real GNP Growth Rate - 4 % Per Capita Nominal GNP Growth Rate - 5 % The above table shows that there is a ________ in price level and a/an ________ in population. rise ... increase rise ... decrease fall ... increase fall ... decrease
questions.zh: 細閱以下某經濟的資料： 名義本地居民生產總值增長率 - 3 % 實質本地居民生產總值增長率 - 4 % 人均名義本地居民生產總值增長率 - 5 % 上表顯示物價水平 ________，而人口則 ________。 上升 ... 增加 上升 ... 減少 下降 ... 增加 下降 ... 減少

questions.en: Country X has a higher GDP but a lower general living standard than Country Y. Which of the following is a possible reason for this? The net factor income from abroad of Country Y is smaller. The working hours of people in Country Y are longer. Capital goods make up a higher proportion of the output of Country Y. The population size in Country Y is smaller.
questions.zh: X 國的本地生產總值較 Y 國高，但 X 國的一般生活水準則較低。下列哪一項是可能的原因？ Y 國的海外淨收入較低。 Y 國人民的工作時間較長。 資本物品佔 Y 國產出較高比例。 Y 國人口較少。

questions.en: Refer to the chart below. Gross Domestic Product of Hong Kong, 1989 - 1999 Source: The Census and Statistics Department From 1991 to 1998, GDP at current market prices is always greater than GDP at constant (1990) market prices because the inflation rate is increasing in this period. the real output level is rising in this period. the current price level is always higher than the price level of 1990. the inflation rate is higher than the real output growth rate.
questions.zh: 參閱下圖。 從 1991 年至 1998 年，按當時市價計算的本地生產總值都是大於按固定 (1990年) 市價計算的本地生產總值，因爲 在此時期內，通脹率是上升的。 在此時期內，實質產出水平是上升的。 當時物價水平總是高於1990年的物價水平。 通脹率高於實質產出增長率。

questions.en: According to the above graph, the ratio of G to GDP is increasing. decreasing. first increasing and then decreasing. first decreasing and then increasing.
questions.zh: 根據上表，政府支出佔本地生產總值的比例 正在上升。 正在下降。 起初上升，跟着下降。 起初下降，跟着上升。

questions.en: If the growth rate of per-capita real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is greater than that of the real GDP as well as that of the per-capita nominal GDP, we can conclude that both the population and the general price level have fallen. the growth rate of population is higher than that of real output and the standard of living has fallen. the growth rate of population is lower than that of real output and the standard of living has risen. the inflation rate is greater than the growth rate of real output.
questions.zh: 若人均實質本地生產總值（GDP）的增長率高於實質本地生產總值的增長率，亦高於人均名義本地生產總值的增長率，我們可以總結出 人口與一般物價水平皆下跌。 人口增長率高於實質產出的增長率，且生活水平下降。 人口增長率低於實質產出的增長率，且生活水平上升。 通脹率高於實質產出的增長率。

questions.en: Suppose the GDP deflator of an economy decreases from 100 to 90. This implies that its GDP decreases by 10%. the general price level decreases by 10%. people's real income increases by 10%. people's living standard decreases by 10%.
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的本地生產總值平減指數由 100 減至 90。這意味着 它的本地生產總值下降了 10%。 一般物價水平下降了 10%。 人民的實質收入增加了 10%。 人民的生活水準下降了 10%。

questions.en: If both the nominal and real GDP of an economy are rising, the general price level of the economy is rising. is falling. remains unchanged. may be rising, falling or remains unchanged.
questions.zh: 若名義及實質本地生產總值皆上升，則一般物價水平 正在上升 正在下降 維持不變 可能上升、下降或維持不變。

questions.en: Composite Consumer Price Index -3.0% GDP deflator -2.7% Nominal GDP -0.6% According to the above data on an economy, the real GDP has increased. the unemployment rate has increased. the inflation rate has increased. the general living standard has decreased.
questions.zh: 綜合消費物價指數 -3.0% 本地生產總值平減物價指數 -2.7% 名義本地生產總值 -0.6% 根據上列某經濟的資料， 實質本地生產總值增加了。 失業率上升了。 通脹率上升了。 一般生活水準下降了。

questions.en: In an economy the growth rate of nominal GDP is positive and falling while the population growth rate and the inflation rate are both negative. It means that both per capita nominal GDP and real GDP are rising. the growth rate of real GDP must be rising. the per capita real GDP must be falling. the fall in nominal GDP growth rate will lead to a fall in aggregate demand.
questions.zh: 在某經濟中，名義本地生產總值的增長率是正數且正在下降，而人口增長率及通脹率皆為負數。這代表 人均名義本地生產總值與實質本地生產總值皆正在上升。 實質本地生產總值的增長率必然正在上升。 人均實質本地生產總值必然正在下降。 名義本地生產總值增長率的下降會導致總需求下降。

questions.en: Study the following information about a country: Year Nominal GDP (in million dollars) Price index 2003 75 000 90 2004 100 000 100 As compared to 2003, the ______ of this country was higher in 2004. general living standard real GDP consumption expenditure average income
questions.zh: 參閱下列某國的資料： 年份 名義本地生產總值 (以百萬元計) 物價指數 2003 75 000 90 2004 100 000 100 與2003年比較，該國在2004年的_______較高。 一般生活水準 實質本地生產總值 消費支出 平均收入

questions.en: Consider the following information on an economy: (relative to previous year) (%) Year 1 Year 2 Nominal gross domestic product (Nominal GDP) -3 0 General price level -4 -2 Population 2 -1 Which of the following about the economy is FALSE? The nominal GDP in the above two years is the same. The real output increased in year 2. The general price level is decreasing at a decreasing rate. The per capita real GDP decreased in year 2.
questions.zh: 細閱以下某經濟的資料： （相對於上一年）（%） 第 1 年 第 2 年 名義本地生產總值（名義 GDP） -3 0 一般物價水平 -4 -2 人口 2 -1 下列哪項關於該經濟的陳述是不正確的？ 上述兩年的名義本地生產總值相同。 實質產出在第 2 年增加。 一般物價水平正以遞減的幅度下降。 人均實質本地生產總值在第 2 年減少。

questions.en: GDP at constant market prices would NOT be a good indicator to compare the living standard of two countries when the ______ of the two countries is different. population size income distribution inflation rate (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 若兩國的 ______ 並不相同，則以固定市價計算的本地生產總值不會是比較兩國生活水準的良好指標。 人口 收入分配 通脹率 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Year Nominal GDP ($ billion) Population (million) Consumer Price Index 1 3 000 2 100 2 3 500 2.5 110 According to the above information, from Year 1 to Year 2, the economy's real GDP has ______ and the per capita nominal GDP has ______. increased ... decreased increased ... increased decreased ... decreased decreased ... increased
questions.zh: 年份 名義本地生產總值 (以十億元計) 人口(百萬人) 消費物價指數 1 3 000 2 100 2 3 500 2.5 110 根據上表資料，由第1年至第2年，該經濟的實質本地生產總值_________ 而人均名義本地生產總值_________。 增加了 ... 減少了 增加了 ... 增加了 減少了 ... 減少了 減少了 ... 增加了

questions.en: The following table shows the change in GDP from Year 1 to Year 2. Change GDP at current market prices +5.1% GDP at constant market prices +8.1% We can conclude from the above data that the real output _______ and the general price level _______ in that period. increased ... decreased increased ... increased decreased ... increased decreased ... decreased
questions.zh: 本地生產總值從第 1 年至第 2 年有如下變動： 變動 以當時市價計算的本地生產總值 +5.1% 以固定市價計算的本地生產總值 +8.1% 根據以上資料，我們可得結論如下：在該期間的實質產出 _______ 而一般物價水平 _______。 增加了 ... 下降了 增加了 ... 增加了 下降了 ... 增加了 下降了 ... 下降了

questions.en: If a country's real GDP is growing at a faster rate than its nominal GDP, we can conclude that its general living standard rises. its unemployment rate falls. its implicit GDP deflator falls. there is disinflation in the country.
questions.zh: 若某國的實質本地生產總值增長率高於其名義本地生產總值增長率，我們可推斷 其一般生活水平上升。 其失業率下降。 其隱含本地生產總值平減物價指數下降。 該國出現通脹放緩。

questions.en: Refer to the following statistical data (in $million) on an economy. Year GDP at current market prices GDP at constant (2000) market prices 2007 142 900 134 200 2008 144 800 132 300 Compared with 2007, the general price level has _______ and the real output of goods and services has _______ in 2008. increased ... decreased increased ... increased decreased ... decreased decreased ... increased
questions.zh: 參閱下表關於某經濟的統計資料(以百萬元為單位)。 年份 以當年市價計算的本地生產總值 以2000年固定市價計算的本地生產總值 2007 142900 134200 2008 144800 132300 與2007年比較，2008年的一般物價水平 ________ 了，而貨品及服務的實質產出 ________ 了。 增加 ... 減少 增加 ... 增加 減少 ... 減少 減少 ... 增加

questions.en: The per capita real GDP of a country would overstate the living standard of its people because it does not reflect the improvement in the quality of goods and services produced. does not reflect the uneven distribution of income. does not reflect the undesirable effects of production. excludes the calculation of the goods and services not transacted in the market. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 因爲一國的人均實質本地生產總值_______，所以該國的一般生活水準會被高估了。 沒有反映該國所生產物品及勞務在品質方面的改善 沒有反映不平均的收入分配。 沒有反映生產的不良後果 沒有計算不在市場交易的物品及勞務 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (3)、(4)

questions.en: Year Year-on-year percentage change GDP at current market prices GDP at constant (2000) market prices 2007 9.5% 6.4% 2008 3.8% 2.4% Based on the above information, we can conclude that in 2008, the general price level decreased. the real GDP decreased. the GDP deflator increased. the general living standard increased.
questions.zh: 按年變動百分率 以當時市價計算的本地生產總值 以2000年固定市價計算的本地生產總值 2007 9.5% 6.4% 2008 3.8% 2.4% 根據上述資料，我們可得以下結論：在2008年 一般物價水平下降了。 實質本地生產總值下降了。 本地生產總值平減物價指數上升了。 一般生活水準上升了。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about gross domestic product (GDP) is correct? The growth rate of real GDP is smaller than that of nominal GDP during deflation. Real GDP and nominal GDP will increase simultaneously only during inflation. When the growth rate of nominal GDP is smaller than the inflation rate, real GDP decreases. Nominal GDP is equal to real GDP only in the base year.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項對本地生產總值的描述是正確的？ 在通貨緊縮期間，實質本地生產總值的增長率小於名義本地生產總值的增長率。 只有在通貨膨脹期間，實質本地生產總值和名義本地生產總值才會同時增加。 當名義本地生產總值的增長率小於通脹率時，實質本地生產總值便會下降。 只有在基準年，名義本地生產總值才等於實質本地生產總值。

questions.en: Refer to the following statistical data (in $million) on an economy. Year GDP at current market prices GDP at constant (2008) market prices 2009 163 000 150 000 2010 170 000 165 000 Compared with 2009, the general price level has _______ and the real output of goods and services has _______ in 2010. decreased ... increased decreased ... decreased increased ... increased increased ... decreased
questions.zh: 參閱以下關於某經濟的統計數字 (以百萬元為單位)。 年份 以當時市價計算的本地生產總值 以 2008 年固定市價計算的本地生產總值 2009 163 000 150 000 2010 170 000 165 000 與 2009 年相比，2010 年的一般物價水平 ________ 而貨物及勞務的實質產出 ________。 下降了 ... 增加了 下降了 ... 減少了 上升了 ... 增加了 上升了 ... 減少了

questions.en: Study the following information of two economies. Per capita Gross Domestic Product (GDP) Population Gini Coefficient Country A US$10 000 20 million 0.45 Country B US$12 000 10 million 0.3 Based on the above information, we can conclude that the GDP of Country A is higher than that of Country B. the income distribution of Country A is more even than that of Country B. the general living standard of the low-income group in Country A is higher than that in Country B. all of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 細閱以下兩個經濟體的資料。 按人口平均計算的本地生產總值 人口 堅尼系數 甲國 10 000 美元 2 000 萬 0.45 乙國 12 000 美元 1 000 萬 0.3 根據以上資料，我們可以得出結論： 甲國的本地生產總值高於乙國。 甲國的收入分配較乙國平均。 甲國低收入組別的一般生活水平高於乙國。 以上全部皆正確。

questions.en: Consider the following information about an economy: Growth rate (relative to previous year) (%) Year 1 Year 2 Nominal GDP -3 0 Real GDP 2 1 Population 2 -1 Which of the following about the economy is true? The real output decreased in year 2. The per capita nominal GDP decreased in year 2. The nominal GDP in the above two years is the same. The general price level decreased in year 1 but increased in year 2.
questions.zh: 細閱以下某經濟的資料： 增長率（相對於上一年）（%） 第 1 年 第 2 年 名義本地生產總值 -3 0 實質本地生產總值 2 1 人口 2 -1 下列哪項關於該經濟的陳述是正確的？ 實質產出在第 2 年減少。 人均名義本地生產總值在第 2 年減少。 上述兩年的名義本地生產總值相同。 一般物價水平在第 1 年下降，但在第 2 年上升。

questions.en: Over a given period, the GDP at current market prices of an economy increases by 15% and the rate of inflation decreases from 10% to 5%. Based on the above information, the real GDP _______ and the general price level _______. increases ... rises increases ... falls decreases ... rises decreases ... falls
questions.zh: 在一段時間內，某經濟以當時市價計算的本地生產總值增加 15%，而通脹率則由 10% 減至 5%。 根據以上資料，實質本地生產總值 ________，而一般物價水平 ________。 增加 ... 上升 增加 ... 下降 減少 ... 上升 減少 ... 下降

questions.en: Country A's general price level increases by 10% and its aggregate output and population drop by 2% and 10% respectively. As a result, Country A's nominal GDP will _______ and the per-capita real GDP will _______. rise ... rise rise ... fall remain unchanged ... rise remain unchanged ... fall
questions.zh: 甲國的一般物價水平上升了 10%，而總產出和人口則分別下降了 2% 及 10%，由此可知，甲國的名義本地生產總值會 ______，而人均實質本地生產總值會 ______。 上升 ... 上升 上升 ... 下降 維持不變 ... 上升 維持不變 ... 下降

questions.en: Year Year-on-year percentage change in nominal GDP Year-on-year percentage change in nominal government spending 2011 9.0 12.0 2012 5.5 6.0 Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct?
