questions.en: During the period around Lunar new year every year, many people in Hong Kong withdraw cash from their deposit accounts with banks. Thus the amount of cash held by the public increases. Which of the following is a definite consequence of the above situation? The value of the maximum banking multiplier of the banking system of Hong Kong decreases. The maximum possible amount of deposits of the banking system of Hong Kong decreases. The amount of bank loans made to the public decreases. The money supply of Hong Kong decreases.
questions.zh: 每年農曆新年期間，香港有不少人從他們的銀行存款戶口中提取現金。因此，公眾持有的現金增加。 下列哪項是上述情況的必然結果？ 香港銀行系統的銀行乘數最大值下降。 香港銀行系統的最高可能存款額下降。 銀行放貸予公眾的款額下降。 香港的貨幣供應量下降。

questions.en: Which of the following may reduce the size of the actual banking multiplier of a banking system? an increase in the use of cheques by the public an increase in the demand for bank loans an increase in the risk of non-repayment of bank loans a reduction in the required reserve ratio
questions.zh: 下列哪項有可能減低一個銀行系統的實際銀行乘數？ 公眾增加使用支票。 向銀行借款的需求增加。 銀行不獲得還款的風險增加。 法定儲備比率下降。

questions.en: The table below shows the balance sheet of a banking system, which has an excess reserve of $50. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 250 Loans 750 Deposits 1 000 Which of the following is correct? The required reserve ratio is 25%. The actual reserve ratio is 20%. If $100 cash is deposited into the banking system, the total amount of deposits will be $1 500. If $100 is withdrawn from the banking system, the maximum possible total deposits will be $750.
questions.zh: 以下是某銀行系統的資產負債表，它的超額儲備是$50。 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 250 貸款 750 存款 1 000 下列哪一項描述是正確的？ 法定儲備比率是 25%。 實質儲備比率是 20%。 若有 $100 現金存入該銀行系統中，存款總額會是 $1 500。 若有 $100 從該銀行系統中提走，存款的最大可能值會是 $750。

questions.en: Study the following balance sheet of a banking system which never holds excess reserves. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 600 Loans 2 400 Deposits 3 000 Suppose the public in this economy always holds the same amount of cash. If $200 is withdrawn from the bank deposits, the maximum possible amount of loans of the banking system would become $1 200 $1 600 $2 000 $2 200
questions.zh: 某銀行系統永不持有超額儲備，它的資產負債表如下： 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 600 貸款 2 400 存款 3 000 假設該經濟的公眾總是持有相同數量的現金。若銀行存款被提取 $200，則該銀行系統的最高放款額會變成 ________。 $1 200 $1 600 $2 000 $2 200

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the maximum banking multiplier? Octopus cards are widely used. The economy grows fast and investment opportunities flourish. Banks keep more reserves to avoid the risk of bank runs. Commercial banks are allowed to increase the proportion of customers' deposits that can be loaned out.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會增加銀行乘數的最大值？ 八達通卡被廣泛使用。 經濟快速發展，遍地有投資機會。 銀行系統持有更多儲備以避免銀行擠提的風險。 商業銀行獲准提高其顧客存款額的可借出比例。

questions.en: Suppose the actual banking multiplier is smaller than the maximum banking multiplier in a certain banking system. Which of the following would be a possible reason for this? There is insufficient demand for bank loans. The banking system is facing a reserve shortage. The maximum possible amount of total deposits of the banking system will decrease. The actual reserve ratio is smaller than the required reserve ratio.
questions.zh: 假設在某銀行體系內，實際銀行乘數少於最大銀行乘數。下列哪項會是一個可能的原因？ 銀行貸款需求不足。 銀行體系面對儲備不足問題。 銀行體系內最大的可能總存款額會減少。 實際儲備比率少於法定儲備比率。

questions.en: Below is the balance sheet of a banking system which has $50 excess reserves. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 350 Loans 850 Deposits 1 200 Suppose all banks lend out their excess reserves and all loans will be redeposited into the banking system. After the deposit creation process is completed, the amount of reserves held by banks would be ______ and the amount of loans would be ______. $300 ... $1 400 $300 ... $1 100 $350 ... $1 400 $350 ... $1 050
questions.zh: 以下是某銀行體系的資產負債表，該銀行體系有 $50 超額儲備。 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 350 貸款 850 存款 1 200 假設全部銀行將超額儲備借出，而全部貸款都再存入銀行體系內。在存款創造過程完成後，銀行持有的儲備會是 ________，而其貸款額會是 ________。 $300 ... $1 400 $300 ... $1 100 $350 ... $1 400 $350 ... $1 050

questions.en: The maximum banking multiplier of a banking system will decrease when the amount of excess reserves held by banks increases. the required reserve ratio increases. the amount of cash leakage from the banking system increases. the demand for loans decreases.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，銀行體系的最大銀行乘數會減少？ 銀行持有的超額儲備增加了。 法定儲備比率提高了。 銀行體系的現金流失額增加了。 貸款的需求減少了。

questions.en: Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 2 500 Loans 7 500 Deposits 10 000 The above table shows the balance sheet of a banking system which has an excess reserve of $500. Suppose the public withdraw $1 000 cash from the banking system. If the banks do not hold any excess reserves and there is no cash leakage, what will happen eventually after the process of deposit contraction is completed? Bank deposits will fall by $5 000. Bank loans will fall by $2 500. The money supply will fall by $1 500. Both B and C are correct.
questions.zh: 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 2 500 貸款 7 500 存款 10 000 以上顯示某銀行體系的資產負債表。它的超額儲備是 $500。 假設公眾從銀行提走 $1 000 現金。若銀行不持有超額儲備，又沒有現金流失的情況出現，在存款收縮過程全部完成後，最終有什麼結果？ 銀行存款會減少 $5 000。 銀行貸款會減少 $2 500。 貨幣供應量會減少 $1 500。 B 項及 C 項皆正確。

questions.en: Which of the following is an effect of the increasingly popular use of the Octopus card in Hong Kong? The banking multiplier will decrease. The money supply will decrease. The deposit creation ability of the banking system will increase. The function of money as a medium of exchange will be weakened.
questions.zh: 在香港，八達通卡的使用愈趨普及。這會帶來什麼影響？ 銀行乘數會減少。 貨幣供應量會減少。 銀行體系的存款創造能力會增加。 貨幣作爲交易媒介的功能會被削弱。

questions.en: Refer to the following balance sheet of a banking system which has an excess reserve of $100 million. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 500 Loans 1 500 Deposits 2 000 Suppose $200 million worth of deposits is withdrawn from the banking system. The maximum amount of bank deposits will be _________. $500 million $1 000 million $1 500 million $2 000 million
questions.zh: 參閱下列某銀行體系的資產負債表。該銀行體系有 100 百萬元超額儲備。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 500 貸款 1 500 存款 2 000 假設有人從銀行體系中提取 200 百萬元。銀行存款金額最高可達至 __________。 500 百萬元 1 000 百萬元 1 500 百萬元 2 000 百萬元

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the deposit creation ability of the banking system? a decrease in the use of bank cheques by the public a decrease in the restrictions imposed on mortgage loans from banks an increase in the legal reserve requirement for banks an increase in the holding of cash by the public
questions.zh: 下列哪項會增加銀行體系的存款創造能力？ 公眾減少使用銀行支票。 減少對銀行按揭貸款的限制。 提高銀行的法定儲備比率。 公眾增持現金。

questions.en: The table below shows the balance sheet of a banking system. Suppose the public holds $500 cash and the amount of its excess reserves is $600. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 1 000 Loans 1 000 Deposits 2 000 Which of the following statements about the banking system is correct? The required reserve ratio is 40%. The maximum amount of deposits is $4 000. The maximum banking multiplier is 5. The monetary base is $2 500.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某銀行體系的資產負債表。假設公眾持有 $500 現金，而超額儲備為 $600。 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 1 000 貸款 1 000 存款 2 000 下列哪項有關該銀行體系的陳述是正確的？ 法定儲備比率是 40%。 最高存款額是 $4 000。 最高銀行乘數是 5。 貨幣基礎是 $2 500。

questions.en: Suppose the balance sheet of a banking system is as follows. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 150 Loans 350 Deposits 500 The amount of excess reserves in the banking system is $50. Now, a customer withdraws $50 from his bank account. If the banking system is fully loaned up, the maximum amount of loans in the banking system is ___________. $350 $400 $450 $500
questions.zh: 假設某銀行體系的資產負債表如下。 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 150 貸款 350 存款 500 該銀行體系的超額儲備是$50。現在一名客戶從他的銀行戶口提取$50。若該銀行體系將可貸出款項全數借出，該銀行體系的貸款額最大為 ________。 $350 $400 $450 $500

questions.en: The table below shows the balance sheet of a banking system. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 400 Loans 600 Deposits 1 000 Suppose the required reserve ratio for the banking system is 25%. Which of the following statements is correct? The excess reserves of the banking system are $200 million. The actual banking multiplier of the banking system is 4. The banking system can expand its total deposits to $1 600 million. The maximum amount of loans the banking system can make is $1 000 million.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某銀行體系的資產負債表。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 400 貸款 600 存款 1 000 假設該銀行體系的法定儲備比率是 25%。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 該銀行體系的超額儲備是 200 百萬元。 該銀行體系的實際銀行乘數是 4。 該銀行體系可擴大其總存款至 1 600 百萬元。 該銀行體系可製造的最大貸款額為 1 000 百萬元。

questions.en: Initially, a banking system has an excess reserve of $160 million and the public holds $200 million cash. The balance sheet of the banking system is as follows: Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 400 Loans 800 Deposits 1 200 Suppose $100 million is withdrawn from the banking system and held as cash by the public. What will the money supply be if the banks lend out all excess reserves? $1 500 million $1 700 million $1 800 million $2 300 million
questions.zh: 某銀行系統原初的超額儲備是 160 百萬元，而公眾持有 200 百萬元的現金。該銀行系統的資產負債表如下： 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 400 貸款 800 存款 1 200 假設公眾從該銀行系統提取 100 百萬元並以現金方式持有。若銀行借出全部超額儲備，貨幣供應會是多少？ 1 500 百萬元 1 700 百萬元 1 800 百萬元 2 300 百萬元

questions.en: Refer to the following balance sheet of a banking system. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 400 Loans 800 Deposits 1 200 Suppose the required reserve ratio is 25%. If all banks loan out their excess reserves, which of the following statements about the above banking system is correct? The amount of reserves held by the banks will decrease. The maximum banking multiplier will increase. The money supply will remain unchanged. The maximum possible increase in loans will be the same as the maximum possible increase in deposits.
questions.zh: 參閱以下某銀行系統的資產負債表。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 400 貸款 800 存款 1 200 假設法定儲備比率是 25%。若所有銀行借出其超額儲備，下列哪項有關上述銀行系統的陳述是正確的？ 銀行持有的儲備金額會下降。 最大銀行乘數會上升。 貨幣供應會維持不變。 貸款額增加的可能最大值，與存款額增加的可能最大值相同。

questions.en: Study the following information about an economy. Monetary base $500 billion The coins and notes circulated in the public $300 billion Required reserve ratio 20% If all the banks are fully loaned up, the amount of deposits will be _________. $1 000 billion $1 500 billion $2 500 billion $4 000 billion
questions.zh: 細閱下列有關某經濟的資料。 貨幣基礎 500十億元 公眾流通的硬幣和紙幣 300十億元 法定儲備比率 20% 若所有銀行將可貸款項全數借出，存款的金額會是 ________。 1000十億元 1500十億元 2500十億元 4000十億元

questions.en: Study the following balance sheet of a banking system. The required reserve ratio is 20%. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 300 Loans 700 Deposits 1 000 If the central bank issues newly printed banknotes worth $200 million, the cash held by the non-bank public will increase by $100 million and the money supply will increase by $500 million. The total amount of excess reserves in the banking system will then be ___________. $100 million $120 million $280 million $400 million
questions.zh: 參閱以下某銀行系統的資產負債表。法定儲備比率為 20%。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 300 貸款 700 存款 1 000 若中央銀行發行價值 200 百萬元的新印製鈔票，非銀行公衆人士持有的現金會增加 100 百萬元，而貨幣供應會增加 500 百萬元，則該銀行系統超額儲備的總額會是 __________。 100 百萬元 120 百萬元 280 百萬元 400 百萬元

questions.en: Refer to the following balance sheet of a banking system. Its excess reserve is $125 million. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 250 Loans 250 Deposits 500 Which of the following statements is INCORRECT? The required reserve ratio is 25%. The maximum amount of loans is $750 million. The banking system can expand its total deposit to $1 000 million. The actual banking multiplier is 4.
questions.zh: 參閱以下某銀行系統的資產負債表。該系統的超額儲備是125百萬元。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 250 貸款 250 存款 500 下列哪項陳述是不正確的？ 法定儲備比率是 25%。 最高的貸款金額是 750 百萬元。 該銀行系統能把存款總額擴大至 1000 百萬元。 實際銀行乘數是 4。

questions.en: The following table shows the balance sheet of a banking system. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 300 Loans 600 Deposits 900 Suppose the public does not hold cash and the required reserve ratio is reduced to 25%. After deposit creation, the amount of loans in the banking system is $750. Which of the following statements about the banking system is correct? The money supply increases by $300. The actual banking multiplier is 3.5. The deposits increase by $600. Bank reserves are $450.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某銀行系統的資產負債表。 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 300 貸款 600 存款 900 假設公眾並沒有持有現金，而法定儲備比率調低至 25%。在存款創造後，銀行系統的貸款額是 $750。下列哪項有關該銀行系統的陳述是正確的？ 貨幣供應增加 $300。 實際銀行乘數為 3.5。 存款增加 $600。 銀行儲備是 $450。

questions.en: Refer to the following information about an economy. Money supply $35 000 Actual reserve ratio 25% Excess reserves $1 150 Suppose the public always holds $12 000 cash. If all banks loan out their excess reserves and all the loans are re-deposited into the banking system, the maximum possible amount of money supply will be $28 750. the monetary base of the economy will be $16 600. the maximum possible amount of loans will be $23 000. the maximum banking multiplier will be 4.
questions.zh: 參考有關某經濟的以下資料： 貨幣供應 $35000 實際儲備比率 25% 超額儲備 $1150 假設公眾總是持有現金 $12000。若所有銀行借出其超額儲備，而所有貸款均再存入銀行系統，則 貨幣供應的最大可能金額會是 $28750。 該經濟的貨幣基礎會是 $16600。 貸款的最大可能金額會是 $23000。 最大銀行乘數會是 4。

questions.en: The following table shows the balance sheet of Country A's banking system. The money supply in Country A is $2800 and all banks do not hold excess reserves. Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 500 Loans 2 000 Deposits 2 500 Suppose the public deposits $200 cash into the banking system. Which of the following statements about the banking system is correct after the deposit creation process is completed? The deposits would increase by $3500. The money supply would increase by $1000. The monetary base would increase by $200. The loans will increase by $800.
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲國銀行系統的資產負債表。甲國的貨幣供應是 $2800，而所有銀行並不持有超額儲備。 資產（$） 負債（$） 儲備 500 貸款 2 000 存款 2 500 假設公眾將 $200 現金存入該銀行系統。在存款創造的過程完成後，下列哪項有關該銀行系統的陳述是正確的？ 存款會增加 $3500。 貨幣供應會增加 $1000。 貨幣基礎會增加 $200。 貸款會增加 $800。

questions.en: Refer to the following information about an economy. Suppose all banks do not hold any excess reserves. $ million Currency in public circulation 10 Monetary base 30 Money supply 110 If the public deposits all the cash into the banking system, the actual banking multiplier will be 4. the maximum amount of loans will be $120 million. the maximum amount of deposits will be $140 million. the new money supply will be $160 million.
questions.zh: 參考以下有關某經濟的資料。假設所有銀行均沒持有超額儲備。 百萬元 公眾流通的貨幣 10 貨幣基礎 30 貨幣供應 110 若公眾把所有現金存入銀行系統， 實際銀行乘數會是 4。 最大貸款額會是 120 百萬元。 最大存款額會是 140 百萬元。 新的貨幣供應會是 160 百萬元。

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the actual banking multiplier? The public tends to hold more cash. The use of credit card becomes more popular. The central bank increases the required reserve ratio. The interest rate of bank deposit decreases.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會令實際銀行乘數上升？ 公眾傾向持有更多的現金。 信用卡的使用日漸普及。 中央銀行調高法定儲備比率。 銀行存款的利率下降。

questions.en: The table below shows the monetary data of a country. Money supply $250 million Legal tender held by public $50 million Required reserve ratio 20% Excess reserves $10 million Which of the following statements are correct? Monetary base is $100 million. Actual reserves are $40 million. The maximum amount of deposits after credit creation is $250 million. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示某國的貨幣資料。 貨幣供應 250 百萬元 公眾持有的法定貨幣 50 百萬元 法定儲備比率 20% 超額儲備 10 百萬元 下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 貨幣基礎是 100 百萬元。 實際儲備是 40 百萬元。 在信貸創造後，最大存款金額是 250 百萬元。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: The balance sheet of a banking system is as follows. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 500 Loans 1 500 Deposits 2 000 The required reserve ratio is 20% and the public does not hold cash initially. Suppose a customer withdraws $200 million from his bank account and holds it as cash. If all banks do not hold any excess reserves, the amount of money supply is ___________ after the process of credit creation/contraction has been completed. $1200 million $1400 million $1500 million $1700 million
questions.zh: 某銀行系統的資產負債表如下： 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 500 貸款 1 500 存款 2 000 法定儲備比率為 20%，公眾原初並不持有現金。 假設某顧客在其銀行戶口提款200百萬元，並以現金持有該筆款項。若所有銀行均沒持有超額儲備，在信貸創造／收縮的過程完結後，貨幣供應的金額是________。 1200百萬元 1400百萬元 1500百萬元 1700百萬元

questions.en: Suppose the central bank requires the commercial banks to keep all deposits as reserves. Which of the following statements is INCORRECT? The monetary base will be equal to the money supply. The required reserve ratio will be equal to one. The maximum banking multiplier will be equal to zero. The money creation ability of the banking system will be smaller than that of a fractional reserve banking system.
questions.zh: 假設中央銀行要求商業銀行保留全部存款作為儲備。下列哪項陳述是不正確的？ 貨幣基礎會等於貨幣供應。 法定儲備比率會等於一。 最大銀行乘數會等於零。 相對於一個採用部分儲備制度的銀行系統，該銀行系統的貨幣創造能力會較低。

questions.en: Refer to the following balance sheet of a banking system which has excess reserves of $125 million Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($ million) Reserves 500 Loans 1 000 Deposits 1 500 Which of the following statements about the above banking system is correct? The actual banking multiplier is 4. If the banking system loans out all the excess reserves, the amount of reserves will decrease after the deposit creation process is completed. If the banking system loans out all the excess reserves, the maximum possible increase in loans will be $500 million. If the public withdraws $125 million from the banking system and holds it as cash, the amount of excess reserves will decrease to zero immediately.
questions.zh: 參閱以下某銀行系統的資產負債表。該系統的超額儲備是 125 百萬元。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 500 貸款 1 000 存款 1 500 下列哪項有關上述銀行系統的陳述是正確的？ 實際銀行乘數是 4。 若該銀行系統借出所有超額儲備，在存款創造的過程完成後，儲備金額會下降。 若該銀行系統借出所有超額儲備，貸款額增加的可能最大值是 500 百萬元。 若公眾從該銀行系統提取 125 百萬元，並以現金持有該筆款項，超額儲備會即時下降至零。

questions.en: The table below shows the balance sheet of a banking system. Suppose there are excess reserves of $20 million in the banking system and the public always holds a fixed amount of cash. Assets ($ million) Liabilities ($million) Reserves 40 Loans 60 Deposits 100 Suppose some banks lend out their excess reserves. After deposit creation, the loans in the banking system increase by $20 million. Which of the following statements about the banking system is correct? The reserves of the banking system become $20 million. The excess reserves of the banking system become $16 million. The banking system has a reserve shortage of $8 million. The amount of deposits in the banking system becomes $200 million.
questions.zh: 下表顯示某銀行系統的資產負債表。假設該銀行系統有 20 百萬元的超額儲備，而公眾總是持有固定金額的現金。 資產（百萬元） 負債（百萬元） 儲備 40 貸款 60 存款 100 假設一些銀行借出其超額儲備。經過存款創造後，該銀行系統的貸款增加了 20 百萬元。下列哪項關於上述銀行系統的陳述是正確的？ 該銀行系統的儲備變成 20 百萬元。 該銀行系統的超額儲備變成 16 百萬元。 該銀行系統出現 8 百萬元的儲備不足。 該銀行系統的存款金額變成 200 百萬元。

questions.en: The table below shows the monetary data of a country. The public always holds a fixed amount of cash. Money supply $95 million Cash held by public $15 million Actual reserve ratio 25% Excess reserves $4 million Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct? The monetary base is $35 million. The maximum banking multiplier is 5. When all banks are fully loaned up, the maximum amount of money supply is $115 million. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示某國的貨幣資料。公眾總是持有固定金額的現金。 貨幣供應 95百萬元 公眾持有的現金 15百萬元 實際儲備比率 25% 超額儲備 4百萬元 根據上述資料，下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 貨幣基礎是 35 百萬元。 最大銀行乘數是 5。 當所有銀行將可貸款項悉數借出時，最大貨幣供應是 115 百萬元。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

Suppose the public decides to reduce cash holdings by depositing $100 cash into the banking system. When the maximum deposit of the banking system is reached, which of the following will be its new balance sheet? Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 300 Loans 900 Deposits 1 200 Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 350 Loans 1 050 Deposits 1 400 Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 300 Loans 1 200 Deposits 1 500 Assets ($) Liabilities ($) Reserves 350 Loans 1 400 Deposits 1 750
questions.zh: 細閱下列某銀行系統的資產負債表。 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 250 貸款 750 存款 1 000 原初，該銀行系統有 $50 的超額儲備。 假設公眾決定將 $100 現金存入該銀行系統以減持現金。 當該銀行系統達至最大存款時，下列哪項是其新的資產負債表？ 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 300 貸款 900 存款 1 200 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 350 貸款 1 050 存款 1 400 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 300 貸款 1 200 存款 1 500 資產 ($) 負債 ($) 儲備 350 貸款 1 400 存款 1 750

questions.en: Which of the following statements is correct if the required reserve ratio of a banking system is 100%? The central bank cannot affect the money supply of the economy. Banks can still serve as financial intermediaries that channel savings into investment. The money supply will not be equal to the monetary base. The maximum banking multiplier will be equal to one.
questions.zh: 若銀行系統的法定儲備比率為 100%，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 中央銀行不能影響該經濟的貨幣供應。 銀行仍可作為金融中介，將儲蓄引導向投資。 貨幣供應不會等於貨幣基礎。 最大銀行乘數會等於一。

questions.en: The monetary base will increase if the central bank issues more banknotes. the commercial banks hold more reserves. the central bank reduces the required reserve ratio. All of the above
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，貨幣基礎會增加？ 中央銀行發行更多紙幣。 商業銀行持有更多儲備。 中央銀行調低法定儲備比率。 以上皆是

questions.en: The monetary base increases when the commercial banks hold less excess reserves. the commercial banks buy government bonds from the public. the central bank buys government bonds from the public. the central bank increases the discount rate.
questions.zh: 當 __________，貨幣基礎增加。 商業銀行持有較少超額儲備 商業銀行向公衆購買政府債券 中央銀行向公衆購買政府債券 中央銀行調高貼現率

questions.en: Which of the following will lead to a reduction in monetary base? The central bank increases the required reserve ratio. The central bank purchases the government bonds from the public. The central bank raises the discount rate. The commercial banks hold more excess reserves.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會令貨幣基礎下降？ 中央銀行增加法定儲備比率。 中央銀行從公眾購入政府債券。 中央銀行提高貼現率。 商業銀行持有更多超額儲備。

questions.en: Which of the following will lead to an increase in monetary base? The central bank raises the discount rate The central bank reduces the required reserve ratio. The central bank buys government bonds from the public. The central bank replaces some of the paper banknotes in circulation with polymer banknotes.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會令貨幣基礎上升？ 中央銀行調高貼現率。 中央銀行調低法定儲備比率。 中央銀行從公眾購入政府債券。 中央銀行以塑質鈔票取代部分流通的紙質鈔票。

questions.en: Refer to the above diagram. Which of the following can explain the shift of the total demand for money curve from M1 to $M2? a rise in the interest rate more shops accepting the Easy Pay System (EPS) payment method a fall in the national income (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參考上圖。下列哪項能解釋貨幣總需求曲線由 M1 移至 M2？ 利率上升 更多店舖接受「易辦事」付款方式 國民收入下降 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following can explain the shift of the total demand for money curve from Md0 to Md1? expectations of a rise in bond prices a rise in bond prices an increase in inflationary expectations an increase in the real income of households
questions.zh: 下列哪項能解釋貨幣總需求曲線由 Md0 移至 Md1？ 預期債券價格上升 債券價格上升 通脹預期增加 住戶的實質收入增加

questions.en: Suppose individuals can only choose to hold bonds or cash. The cost of holding cash is the real interest rate because the return from holding bonds will not be affected by a change in the price level. the real interest rate because it reflects the rate of return from investment. the nominal interest rate because it is the return from bonds. the nominal interest rate only when inflation rate can be accurately anticipated.
questions.zh: 假設個人只可以選擇持有債券或現金。持有現金的成本是 實質利率，因為持有債券的回報不會受物價水平的變動影響。 實質利率，因為它反映投資的回報率。 名義利率，因為它是來自債券的回報。 只有當通脹率能被準確預期時，才是名義利率。

questions.en: Which of the following can explain the rightward shift of the total demand for money curve? more extensive use of credit cards an increase in the velocity of circulation of money a fall in interest rates higher risk of holding bonds
questions.zh: 下列哪項能解釋貨幣總需求曲線向右移？ 信用卡更廣泛使用 貨幣流通速度上升 利率下降 持有債券的風險較高

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. The asset demand for money will shift from Ma0 to Ma1 when income increases. the interest rate decreases. the general price level increases. the interest rate is expected to increase.
questions.zh: 參閱下圖。 在下列哪種情況下，資產性貨幣需求會由 Ma0 移至 Ma1？ 收入增加。 利率下降。 一般物價水平上升。 預期利率會上升。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about money demand is true? Transaction demand for money tends to be more stable than asset demand for money. The shorter the time interval between wage receipts, the higher the transaction demand for money. The higher the volatility of the financial market, the higher the asset demand for money. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關貨幣需求的陳述是正確的？ 交易性貨幣需求往往較資產性貨幣需求穩定。 領取工資的時間間隔越短，交易性貨幣需求越高。 金融市場的波動性越大，資產性貨幣需求越高。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following can explain a leftward shift of the money demand curve? a rise in the interest rate an increase in income of households a more widespread use of Octopus cards an increase in the required reserve ratio
questions.zh: 下列哪項能解釋貨幣需求曲線向左移？ 利率上升 住戶收入增加 人們更廣泛使用八達通卡 法定儲備比率增加

questions.en: The real value of money decreases when the ___________ is rising. deflation rate general price level money demand nominal interest rate
questions.zh: 當 ________ 正在上升，貨幣的實質價值下降。 通縮率 一般物價水平 貨幣需求 名義利率

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram. The curve of asset demand for money will shift from Ma1 to Ma2 when the risk of investing in the stock market increases. the interest rate decreases. the general price level rises. the government reduces the income tax rate.

The general price level is expected to fall continuously. The central bank raises the discount rate. There is a fall in disposable income of households.
questions.zh: 參閱下圖。 下列哪項會引致資產貨幣需求曲線有以上的改變？ 股票市場變得較少波動。 預期一般物價水平持續下跌。 中央銀行提高貼現率。 住戶的可用收入下跌。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the money demand and money supply curves of an economy. The original equilibrium point is at E. Suppose more and more people in the economy like to make payments for daily expenses using e-wallets. At the same time, the central bank of the economy performs an open market purchase of government bonds. The new equilibrium point in the above diagram will be at point _______. A B C D
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟的貨幣需求曲線和貨幣供應曲線。原初的均衡點是 E。 假設該經濟越來越多人喜歡使用電子錢包支付日常開支。同時，該經濟的中央銀行在公開市場進行一項政府債券購入行動。新的均衡點會在上圖的 ______ 點。 A B C D

questions.en: The national income of a country will tend to increase if the government increases its budget surplus. The government raises the interest rates. The government reduces the profits tax rates. The demand for exports decreases.
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，某國的國民收入會傾向增加？ 政府增加其預算盈餘。 政府調高利率。 政府調低利得稅率。 出口需求減少。

questions.en: Which of the following is a fiscal policy used to reduce inflation? a direct control on the rise in wages of workers an increase in unemployment benefits an increase in the required reserve ratio of banks a decrease in the spending on an environmental protection scheme
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是用以減少通貨膨脹的財政政策？ 直接管制工人工資的上升 增加失業救濟 提高銀行的法定儲備比率 減少環境保護計劃的開支

questions.en: Which of the following government measures would lead to more equal distribution of income within a country? an increase in subsidies on basic foodstuffs an increase in the progressivity of the tax system a decrease in property tax rate (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪項政府措施會使一國之內的收入分配更平均？ 增加基本食品的補貼 提高稅制的累進程度 降低物業稅稅率 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following are tools of fiscal policy in Hong Kong? the linked exchange rate government expenditure on infrastructure the standard tax rate the minimum cash reserve ratio (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only

questions.en: Which of the following is most likely to lead to a fall in the inflation rate? an increase in the money supply an increase in the interest rate an increase in government expenditure an increase in indirect tax
questions.zh: 以下哪一項最有可能導致通脹率下降？ 貨幣供應量增加 利率上升 增加政府支出 提高間接稅

questions.en: Which of the following is an expansionary fiscal policy? the introduction of a new tax the construction of a new airport the cutting of expenditure in some government departments the increased purchase of water from China

questions.en: A surplus budget will lead to a decrease in government expenditure. a fiscal surplus. a balance of payments surplus. a contraction of the economy.
questions.zh: 盈餘預算案會導致 政府支出下降。 政府有財政盈餘。 國際收支盈餘。 經濟收縮。

questions.en: Which of the following will lead to a more uneven income distribution? decreasing the sales tax rate imposing more indirect taxes on luxuries increasing the housing allowance of senior civil servants Increasing the standard tax rate of the salaries tax.

questions.en: An increase in the number of unemployed will lead to a lower ___________. potential GDP of the economy direct tax revenue to the government real output of the economy (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)

(1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
