questions.zh: 假設某經濟中薪俸稅的基本免稅額下降了。下列哪項可以抵銷其對總需求的影響？ 人們的儲蓄意慾增加。 物價水平下降。 中央銀行於公開市場出售政府債券。 銀行體系的法定儲備比率下降。

questions.en: Refer to the AS-AD diagram below. The economy operates at E1 initially. Which of the following can help the economy restore to the long run equilibrium? to reduce the subsidies to small enterprises to increase the required reserve ratio to reduce the discount rate to reduce property tax (1) and (2) only (3) and (4) only (1), (2) and (3) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 參考以下的總供需圖。 原初該經濟在 E1 運作。下列哪些能幫助該經濟回復至長期均衡？ 減少對小型企業的補貼 提高法定儲備比率 減低貼現率 減低物業稅 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (3)、(4) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (3) 只有 (2)、(3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Which of the following policies would result in the above change in the Lorenz curve in Hong Kong? lowering the profits tax rates reducing the salaries tax allowance increasing the progressivity of the salaries tax raising the air passenger departure tax
questions.zh: 下列哪項政策會使香港的洛倫茨曲線有以上的轉變？ 減低利得稅率 減少薪俸稅免稅額 提高薪俸稅的累進程度 增加機場離境稅

questions.en: The government carried out the following two policies: Policy one: Reduce the profits tax rate for corporations with profit less than two million dollars. Policy two: Inject fifty billion dollars to develop innovation and technology. Which of the following AD-AS diagrams could most likely show the effect on aggregate output caused by the above two policies?
questions.zh: 政府實施下列兩項政策： 政策一: 減低盈利低於二百萬元的公司之利得稅率。 政策二: 投入五百億元，發展創新科技。 下列哪幅總供需圖最能顯示上述兩項政策對總產出的影響？

questions.en: Suppose an inflationary (output) gap and a fiscal surplus exist in an economy. Which of the following measures would help narrow the inflationary (output) gap and attain a balanced fiscal condition at the same time? reducing quota for inbound tourists raising income tax rate adopting a universal retirement protection scheme for all elderly aged 65 or above increasing government spending on infrastructure
questions.zh: 假設某經濟出現通脹（產出）差距和財政盈餘。下列哪項措施有助於縮小通脹（產出）差距，同時達至財政收支平衡？ 減少入境旅客的配額 提高入息稅率 為全部 65 歲或以上長者推行全民退休保障計劃 增加基建方面的政府開支

questions.en: Which of the following is a contractionary monetary policy? an increase in the discount rate an increase in the salaries tax rate a decrease in the required reserve ratio a decrease in the quota for migration
questions.zh: 下列哪項屬收縮性貨幣政策？ 增加貼現率 增加薪俸稅率 減低法定儲備比率 減低移民的配額

questions.en: Which of the following policies would offset the effect of an increase in the willingness to invest on the price level? an increase in profits tax rate an increase in transfer payment a decrease in tax allowance (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些政策會抵銷了投資意願上升對價格水平的影響？ 利得稅率上升 轉移支付上升 免稅額下降 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: The diagram below shows the aggregate demand curve, the short run aggregate supply curve and the long run aggregate supply curve of an economy. Suppose the economy initially operates at E0 and the total import value equals to the total export value. If the government decreases the amount of social security assistance for the elderly, in the short run, the deflationary (output) gap will become _______ and there will be a _______. narrower ... trade surplus narrower ... trade deficit wider ... trade surplus wider ... trade deficit
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟的總需求曲線、短期總供應曲線和長期總供應曲線。 假設該經濟原初於 E0 運作，而總進口值與總出口值相等。若政府減少長者社會保障援助金額，在短期內，通縮（產出）差距會 ________，並會出現 ________。 收窄……貿易盈餘 收窄……貿易赤字 擴闊……貿易盈餘 擴闊……貿易赤字

questions.en: An economist said, 'The continuous fall in stock prices in our country has already affected the consumption expenditure as well as the money demand. We should implement a policy to relieve the effects on the output level and the interest rate.' Which of the following policies can stabilise the output level and the interest rate in the country at the same time in the short run? (Assume the interest rate is mainly affected by the asset demand for money in this case.) The government increases cash subsidy to the poor. The government gives tariff exemption to the imports of goods. The central bank instructs the commercial banks to tighten the requirement of personal loans. The central bank buys government bonds from the public.
questions.zh: 一位經濟學家指出：「我國股票價格持續下挫，已經影響消費支出及貨幣需求。我們應該推出政策以紓緩對產出水平和利率的影響。」下列哪項政策能於短期同時穩定該國的產出水平和利率？ （假設在這情況下，利率主要受資產貨幣需求的影響。） 政府增加對貧困人士的現金津貼。 政府提供進口貨品的關稅豁免。 中央銀行指示商業銀行收緊私人貸款條件。 中央銀行從公眾購入政府債券。

questions.en: The outbreak of COVID-19 results in a significant decline in employment level and the volume of exports of a country. Which of the following policies can most likely relieve the above two problems? The central bank reduces the discount rate. The government distributes cash to citizens aged 18 years old or above. The government imposes ‘employment support scheme’ to industries that are adversely affected. The country devalues its currency against the currencies of its major trading partners.
questions.zh: 新冠肺炎爆發令某國的就業水平和出口數量顯著下跌。 下列哪項政策最能舒緩以上兩個問題？ 中央銀行調低貼現率。 政府向 18 歲或以上的市民派發現金。 政府對受負面影響的行業實行「就業支援計劃」。 該國令其貨幣兌主要貿易伙伴的貨幣官方貶值。

questions.en: Which of the following would offset the effect on aggregate output of an expansionary fiscal policy? The public held more cash. The use of electronic wallets became more popular. The interbank rate decreased. The government increased quota on the importation of foreign domestic helpers.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會抵銷擴張性財政政策對總產出的影響？ 公眾持有更多現金。 使用電子錢包日漸普及。 銀行同業拆息下降。 政府增加外籍家傭入境的配額。

questions.en: Which of the following policies may narrow a deflationary (output) gap and reduce the budget deficit at the same time? an open market purchase of government bonds an increase in income tax allowance a reduction in transfer payment an increase in required reserve ratio
questions.zh: 下列哪項政策可以收窄通縮（產出）差距，並同時減少預算赤字？ 在公開市場購入政府債券 提高入息稅的免稅額 減少轉移支付 提高法定儲備比率

questions.en: Suppose a government finances its expenditure by collecting tax from the households and the amount of expenditure equals the amount of tax collected. The effect on aggregate demand will be ________. expansionary contractionary neutral indeterminate
questions.zh: 假設政府向住戶收取稅款為其支出融資，該支出和所收稅款的金額相同。這對總需求的影響屬 ________。 擴張性 收縮性 中性 未能決定

questions.en: The following table shows the monetary base and money supply of a country. Date Monetary base ($ billion) Money supply ($ billion) 1 January 2020 150 500 1 January 2021 150 800 Which of the following could explain the above data? The central bank bought bonds from the public in 2020. The central bank increased the discount rate in 2020. The central bank lowered the required reserve ratio in 2020. (3) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下表顯示某國的貨幣基礎和貨幣供應。 日期 貨幣基礎（十億元） 貨幣供應（十億元） 2020年1月1日 150 500 2021年1月1日 150 800 下列哪項／些可以解釋以上數據？ 中央銀行在 2020 年向公眾購買債券。 中央銀行在 2020 年調高貼現率。 中央銀行在 2020 年調低法定儲備比率。 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following will widen the deflationary (output) gap of a country? Its trading partners experience an economic recovery. Credit cards are more widely used. There is a decrease in transfer payment. The central bank prints more money.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會擴大某國的通縮（產出）差距？ 它的貿易夥伴經歷經濟復甦。 人們更廣泛地使用信用卡。 轉移支付下降。 中央銀行印發更多貨幣。

questions.en: Which of the following may lead to a rise in aggregate output and an improvement in equity in Hong Kong at the same time? a charity fund donating HK$10 billion to set up non-governmental organisations in order to provide services for the underprivileged a cash payout of HK$10 000 to each permanent resident aged 18 or above by the Government a 1% reduction in the standard tax rate of salaries tax (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些可能導致香港的總產出上升而同時改善公平情況？ 某慈善基金捐出一百億港元成立非政府組織以提供服務予低下階層 政府向每位 18 歲或以上的永久居民派發現金 10000 港元 薪俸稅的標準稅率下調 1% 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose there is a fall in the national income of a country's major trading partner. Which of the following would offset its effect on the aggregate output of the country? The government increases the amount of tax rebate on salaries tax. The government imposes stricter quarantine requirements for inbound travellers. Firms become pessimistic about the economic prospect of the country. Landlords raise the rent of their office and retail premises.
questions.zh: 假設某國的主要貿易夥伴的國民收入下降。下列哪項會抵銷其對該國總產出的影響？ 政府提高薪俸稅退稅金額。 政府對入境旅客實施更嚴緊的隔離要求。 廠商對該國的經濟前景變得悲觀。 業主提高寫字樓及零售鋪位的租金。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the aggregate demand (AD) curves, the short run aggregate supply (SRAS) curves and the long run aggregate supply (LRAS) curve of an economy. The economy initially operates at point E. Which of the following will result in a change in the long run equilibrium point from E to F? Households' desire to save increases. Prices of factor inputs decrease. The government offers more retraining programmes to workers. The required reserve ratio decreases.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟的總需求 (AD) 曲線、短期總供應 (SRAS) 曲線及長期總供應 (LRAS) 曲線。該經濟原初在 E 點運作。 下列哪項會導致長期均衡點由 E 改變為 F？ 住戶儲蓄意慾上升。 要素投入的價格下降。 政府為工人提供更多再培訓課程。 法定儲備比率下降。

questions.en: Which of the following are examples of an expansionary fiscal policy? increasing the child allowance of salaries tax launching a consumption voucher scheme lowering required reserve ratio (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪些是擴張性財政政策的例子？ 提高薪俸稅的子女免稅額 推行一項消費券計劃 調低法定儲備比率 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Suppose the central bank of Country A lowers the discount rate. Which of the following situations would weaken the effect of the above policy on the aggregate output of Country A in the short run? The use of digital money becomes more popular in Country A. Some major trading partners of Country A experience an economic recession. The government of Country A relaxes the restrictions on the importation of foreign workers. The government of Country A increases its investment on local infrastructure.
questions.zh: 假設甲國的中央銀行下調貼現率。下列哪項情況會削弱上述政策對甲國在短期的總產出的影響？ 數碼貨幣的使用在甲國漸趨流行。 甲國的一些主要貿易伙伴經歷經濟衰退。 甲國政府放寬輸入外勞的限制。 甲國政府增加對本地基建的投資。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the short run aggregate supply (SRAS) curves of a country. Which of the following is a possible reason for the above shift of the SRAS curve from SRAS0 to SRAS1? The government of the country provides subsidies to the core technology industries. The currency of the country appreciates against that of its trading partners. A large-scale hill fire occurs in the country and leads to massive destruction of production facilities. The central bank of the country raises the money supply.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某國的短期總供應（SRAS）曲線。 下列哪項是短期總供應曲線由 SRAS₀ 移至 SRAS₁ 的可能原因？ 該國政府向核心科技行業提供補貼。 相對其貿易伙伴的貨幣，該國貨幣升值。 該國發生了一場大規模的山火，令生產設施受到重大破壞。 該國的中央銀行增加貨幣供應。

questions.en: A contractionary monetary policy is adopted in China when the People’s Bank of China (中國人民銀行) increases the required reserve ratio of commercial banks. the People’s Bank of China cuts the interest rate on its loans to commercial banks. the Chinese Government raised the tax rates of the individual income tax. (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下列哪項／些情況下，中國正採取緊縮性貨幣政策？ 中國人民銀行提高商業銀行的法定儲備比率。 中國人民銀行調低向商業銀行貸款的利率。 中國政府提高個人所得稅稅率。 只有(1) 只有(3) 只有(1)、(2) 只有(2)、(3)

questions.en: In an open economy, if the government raises the income tax rate, the income tax revenue _______ and the total import value _______. will increase ... may increase or decrease will decrease ... may increase or decrease may increase or decrease ... will increase may increase or decrease ... will decrease
questions.zh: 在一個開放經濟中，假如政府提高入息稅稅率，入息稅收入______，而進口總值______。 會上升 …… 可能上升或下降 會下降 …… 可能上升或下降 可能上升或下降 …… 會上升 可能上升或下降 …… 會下降

questions.en: Which of the following is most likely to cause an increase in the short run aggregate output of an economy? an increase in the rate of savings and an increase in the labour productivity in the economy an increase in the income tax rate in the economy and a faster economic growth in its trading partners a decrease in the discount rate in the economy and a decrease in the world oil price a decrease in the tariff rate imposed on imported consumer goods and an increase in the quota for the immigration of skilled workers in the economy
questions.zh: 下列哪項最可能令某經濟在短期的總產出上升？ 該經濟的儲蓄比率上升以及勞工生產力上升 該經濟的入息稅稅率上升以及其貿易伙伴的經濟增長加快 該經濟的貼現率下降和國際油價下降 該經濟降低對進口消費品徵收的關稅稅率和增加高技術工人入境的配額

questions.en: When the short run aggregate output exceeds the full-employment output level, _____. an increase in the required reserve ratio by the central bank may help bring the aggregate output back to the full-employment output level the aggregate output would fall back to the full-employment output level due to a decrease in aggregate demand through the market adjustment mechanism there would be an excess supply in the factor market the full-employment output level would increase until it is equal to the short run aggregate output
questions.zh: 當短期的總產出超過充分就業產出水平時，____。 中央銀行上調法定儲備比率可能有助總產出回復至充分就業產出水平 透過市場調節機制，總產出會因總需求下跌而降回充分就業產出水平 要素市場會出現超額供應 充分就業產出水平會上升，直至與短期的總產出相等

questions.en: Suppose both a fiscal deficit and a trade deficit exist in an economy. Which of the following may eliminate both the fiscal deficit and the trade deficit at the same time? The government imposes tariffs on a wide range of imported goods. The government raises the rate of the salaries tax. The government devaluates its currency against that of its major trading partners. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設某經濟中出現財政赤字和貿易赤字。下列哪些可能同時消除其財政赤字和貿易赤字？ 政府對廣泛的進口物品徵收關稅。 政府提高薪俸稅稅率。 政府令其貨幣兌主要貿易伙伴的貨幣官方貶值。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose a government reduces its expenditure on medical services to provide a tax rebate on salaries tax, and the amount of the tax rebate equals the amount of reduction in the expenditure. The effect on the aggregate demand will be _____. expansionary contractionary neutral indeterminate
questions.zh: 假設政府透過削減醫療服務支出以支付薪俸稅的退稅，而退稅的金額和削減支出的金額相同。 這對總需求的影響屬 ______。 擴張性 收縮性 中性 未能決定

questions.en: According to the data below, what do we call the phase of the business cycle that the economy was in 1991? Year 1989 1990 1991 1992 1993 Real GDP growth rate (%) 1.5 0.0 2.1 2.8 3.5 recovery peak recession trough
questions.zh: 根據下表數據，某國在 1991 年處於經濟週期中哪個部分？ 年份 1989 1990 1991 1992 1993 本地生產總值實質增長率 (%) 1.5 0.0 2.1 2.8 3.5 復甦期 高峰期 衰退期 低谷期

questions.en: During recession, The growth rate of national income is steady. The general price level begins rise. The unemployment rate increase. The production level declines. (1) and (2) only. (1) and (4) only. (2) and (3) only. (3) and (4) only.
questions.zh: 在經濟衰退期間， 國民收入有穩定的增長率。 一般物價水平開始上升。 失業率增加。 生產水平下降。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following will happen in times of recession? The total demand for goods and services will decrease. The budget deficit will decrease. The unemployment rate will increase. The balance of payments deficit will increase. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 經濟衰退時會出現下列哪些情況？ 物品及勞務總需求下降。 財政赤字減少。 失業率上升。 國際收支赤字擴大。 只有(1)及(3) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(2)及(4)

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of the phases of recession in a business cycle? The consumption expenditure decreases. The investment expenditure decreases. The unemployment rate increases. The government suffers from fiscal deficit as her tax revenue decreases and expenditure increase.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項並非經濟循環中衰退時期的特徵？ 消費開支減少。 投資開支減少。 失業率增加。 政府有財政赤字，因為她的稅收減少而支出增加。

questions.en: An economy is experiencing the following: the unemployment rate is declining, prices have stopped falling and started rising, and investment expenditure is expanding. It is in the ______ phase of a business cycle. recovery peak recession trough
questions.zh: 某經濟體系的失業率下降，物價止跌回升，投資支出擴展。它處於經濟循環中哪一個時期？ 復甦 高峰 衰退 谷底

questions.en: Which of the following indicates that the economy is beginning to recover from depression? decreasing price level increasing government fiscal deficit decreasing balance of payments deficit increasing employment rate
questions.zh: 下列哪一項顯示某經濟體系正開始從蕭條中復甦？ 物價水平正在下跌。 政府財政赤字正在增加中。 對外收支赤字正在減少。 就業比率正在上升。

questions.en: According to the government, Hong Kong experienced a recession in 1998 because for three consecutive quarters, there was an increase in the unemployment rate. a fall in the average wage rate. a fall in the general price level. a negative growth rate of real gross domestic product (GDP).
questions.zh: 根據政府所言，香港在 1998 年經歷經濟衰退，因為連續三個季度的 失業率上升。 平均工資下降。 一般物價水平下降。 實質本地生產總值有負增長。

questions.en: The following phenomena are observed in an economy: Which phase of the business cycle is the economy in? industrial output on an upward trend increasing imports and exports growth of retail receipts forecast of economic growth being revised upwards peak recession trough recovery
questions.zh: 下面的現象是在某經濟裏觀察到的： 該經濟是處於經濟周期中的哪一個時期？ 工業生產量在上升軌裏 進口及出口增加 零售收益出現增長 經濟增長預測向上修訂 頂峰 衰退 谷底 復甦

questions.en: If Hong Kong is in the stage of recovery in the business cycle, government expenditure will increase. the proportion of tax revenue in total government revenue will decrease. government revenue from direct taxes will increase. there will be a budgetary surplus for the government.
questions.zh: 若香港正處於經濟周期中的復甦期， 政府支出會增加。 稅收佔政府總收入的比例會減少。 政府的直接稅稅收會增加。 政府的財政預算會出現盈餘。

questions.en: The information above shows that the economy is in a stage of ______ in Year 3. recession depression recovery prosperity
questions.zh: 上列資料顯示該經濟第3年處於______時期。 衰退 蕭條 復甦 繁榮

questions.en: When an economy is in the recovery stage, retail receipts will increase. the government will have a budget surplus. the unemployment rate will fall. the balance of payments deficit will decrease. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 當一經濟處於復甦時期， 零售收益會增加。 政府會有財政盈餘。 失業率會下跌。 國際收支赤字會減少。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: The following is observed in an economy: the unemployment rate is decreasing, the price level is no longer falling but rising instead, and the investment expenditure is increasing. In which phase of the business cycle is the economy situated? recovery peak recession trough
questions.zh: 某經濟的失業率下降，物價止跌回升，投資支出增加。這經濟正處於經濟周期中哪一個時期？ 復甦 高峰 衰退 谷底

questions.en: According to the above information, the economy is in a stage of ______ in 2004. recovery prosperity recession depression
questions.zh: 根據上圖資料，該經濟在 2004 年是處於 ________ 時期。 復甦 繁榮 衰退 蕭條

questions.en: In the diagram below, X is situated in a certain phase of the business cycle. Which of the following is a characteristic of this phase? The general price level is falling. The consumption expenditure is falling. The balance of payments surplus is increasing. The level of investment is increasing.
questions.zh: 下圖中，X 標示經濟周期中某一個時期。下列哪一項是該時期的特徵？ 一般物價水平正在下降。 消費支出正在下降。 國際收支帳盈餘正在增加。 投資水平正在增加。

questions.en: In the stage of economic __________, the percentage change in real GDP _____ recession ... could be negative recovery ... is equal to the inflation rate prosperity ... will be constant depression ... will be zero
questions.zh: 在經濟 _______ 時期，實質本地生產總值的改變百分比 _______。 衰退 ... 可能是負值 復甦 ... 等於通脹率 繁榮 ... 會是一個常數 蕭條 ... 會是零

questions.en: The following phenomena are observed in an economy: Which phase of the business cycle is the economy in? Total sales value at the retail level is decreasing. Bankruptcy petitions are increasing. The inflation rate is falling. The forecast of economic growth has been revised downward. peak recession trough recovery
questions.zh: 在某經濟中有如下的觀察： 該經濟正處於經濟周期中哪一個時期？ 零售界銷售總值正在下降。 申請破產的個案正在增加。 通貨膨脹率正在下降。 向下修訂對經濟增長的預測。 頂峰 衰退 谷底 復甦

questions.en: The following phenomena are observed in an economy: Which phase of the business cycle is the economy in? Retail receipts are increasing. The employment of the manufacturing sector is increasing. The stock prices are increasing. The forecast of the real GDP growth rate has been revised upward. peak recession trough recovery
questions.zh: 在某經濟裏出現下列現象： 該經濟處於經濟周期中哪一個時期？ 零售業的收入正在增加 製造業的就業人口正在增加 股票價格正在上升 實質本地生產總值增長率的預期被調高 頂峰 衰退 谷底 復甦

questions.en: Which of the following will increase in times of economic recovery? trade surplus budget deficit government expenditure direct tax revenue
questions.zh: 在經濟復甦的時候，下列哪一項會增加？ 貿易盈餘 財政赤字 政府支出 直接稅稅收

questions.en: According to the above information, the economy was in a stage of _______ in 2009. recession depression recovery prosperity
questions.zh: 根據以上資料，該經濟在 2009 年是處於 ________ 期。 衰退 蕭條 復甦 繁榮

questions.en: The following phenomena are observed in an economy: The economy is in the ______ phase of a business cycle. The unemployment rate is increasing. The inflation rate is no longer rising but falling instead. The inventories of producers are accumulating. The forecast of economic growth is revised downward. recession trough recovery peak
questions.zh: 某經濟出現下列現象： 該經濟正處於經濟週期的 ________ 階段。 失業率正上升。 通脹率不再上升而是下降。 生產商的存貨正增加。 經濟增長的預測被調低了。 衰退 低谷 復甦 高峰

questions.en: In the diagram below, A is situated in a certain phase of the business cycle. At Point A, there will be an increase in ________ in the economy. the labour employment level the general price level the sales of firms transfer payments (1) and (2) only (3) and (4) only (1), (2) and (3) only (1), (2), (3) and (4)
questions.zh: 下圖中，A 標示經濟周期中的某一時期。 在 A 點，該經濟的 ______ 會上升。 勞工就業水平 一般物價水平 公司的銷售額 轉移支付 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (3)、(4) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (3) (1)、(2)、(3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Study the following diagram. Which of the following are the features of an economy when it is operating at point A? Labour supply is increasing. Purchasing power of money is decreasing. Government expenditure is increasing. Business confidence of companies is increasing. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 細閱下圖。 當某經濟在 A 點運作，下列哪些是該經濟的特徵？ 勞力供應正在增加。 貨幣的購買力正在減少。 政府支出正在增加。 公司的商業信心正在增加。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Study the following diagram. Which of the following are economic phenomena that likely occur when an economy is operating at point A? The percentage of shop premises that are vacant is increasing. The frequency of non-repayment of bank loans is increasing. The expenditure on imported goods is increasing. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 細閱下圖。 下列哪些是當一個經濟在A點運作時很可能出現的經濟現象？ 商鋪鋪位的空置率正在上升。 未能償還銀行貸款的頻率正在上升。 對進口物品的開支正在上升。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: An economy is experiencing the following situations: The economy is most likely in the _____ phase of a business cycle. The purchasing power of money is decreasing. The inventories of producers are decreasing. The amount of government expenditure on transfer payments is decreasing. The unemployment rate is decreasing. recovery peak recession trough
questions.zh: 某經濟正經歷下列情況： 該經濟最有可能正處於經濟周期的 ______ 階段。 貨幣的購買力正在下跌。 生產者的存貨正在減少。 政府在轉移支付上支出的金額正在減少。 失業率正在下降。 復甦 高峰 衰退 低谷

questions.en: Which of the following people would be classified as ‘unemployed’ in Hong Kong? jack, aged 30, who has retired after winning the mark six peter, aged 14, who cannot find a job after completing form three john, who has quit his job and has gone on a trip to Europe Mary, who lost her job five weeks ago and has been looking for a new job for one month
questions.zh: 在香港，下列何者被歸類為「失業者」？ 積克，30 歲，在贏取六合彩後便退了休。 彼得，14 歲，中三畢業後仍未找到工作。 約翰辭去工作，現正在歐洲旅行。 瑪麗於五周前失去工作，過去一個月內她不斷尋找新的工作。

questions.en: Which of the following are the possible losses to society caused by unemployment? loss of output a higher crime rate a greater expenditure in public assistance a reduction in the government's tax revenue (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列各項中，哪些是因失業而可能導致的社會的損失？ 產出的損失 犯罪率較高 公共援助支出較大 稅收下降 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(3) 只有(2)及(4) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.en: David has quit his job for two months because he has been ill and is restring in bed. According to the Hong Kong government, he is unemployed underemployed. employed. not in the labor force.
questions.zh: 小明辭去他的工作已有兩個月，因為他病了，一直臥床休息。香港政府現時將他視為下列哪一類？ 失業。 就業不足。 就業人口。 不在勞動人口之內。

questions.en: Study the following data about Hong Kong in a certain year: Number of Persons Employed Population 2 931 000 Underemployed Population 33 000 Unemployed Population 69 000 The unemployment rate is 2.27% 2.30% 3.36% 3.40%
questions.zh: 細閱下列某年關於香港的資料： 人數 就業人數 2,931,000 就業不足人數 33,000 失業人數 69,000 失業率是 2.27% 2.30% 3.36% 3.40%

questions.en: Which of the following are included in the calculation of the labour force of Hong Kong? an employee with a foreign nationality working in a law firm in Hong Kong Mr Chan, who is unemployed and searching for a job Mr Wong, who works as a volunteer in a community center after his retirement (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列何者計算在香港的勞動人口中？ 在香港某律師樓工作的外籍僱員 失業的陳先生正在尋找工作 王先生退休後在社區中心當義工 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: If some Hong Kong residents who emigrated return to Hong Kong to fill up some posts which have been vacant for a long time, then Hong Kong’s labour force would ________ and her unemployment rate would ________ . increase ... fall decrease ... fall increase ... rise decrease ... rise
questions.zh: 若部分移民外國的香港市民回流，並將懸空一段長時間而未能聘得人選的職位填補了，則香港的勞動人口會______而失業比率會______。 增加…下跌 減少…下跌 增加…上升 減少…上升

questions.en: Many imported workers who had stayed in Hong Kong several years working on the new airport project, have gone back to their home countries. What will be the effect of their departure on the unemployment rate in Hong Kong? The unemployment rate will increase. The unemployment rate will decrease. The unemployment rate will remain constant. The effect cannot be determined.
questions.zh: 留港數年興建新機場的外來勞工很多已返回他們的家鄉。這批人離開香港會對香港的失業率有什麼影響？ 失業率會上升。 失業率會下降。 失業率會維持不變。 未能確定有什麼影響。

questions.en: Which of the following will increase the rate of unemployment? More teenagers enrol at universities. The unemployment benefit is reduced. The minimum wage is increased by 20%. The real wage falls.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會使失業率上升？ 更多青少年入讀大學。 失業救濟減少。 最低工資增加 20%。 實質工資下降。

questions.en: Which of the following changes would reduce unemployment? The government introduces a minimum wage law. The profits tax rate is raised. Many domestic firms try to use more labour-saving machines. The demand for the country's exports increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項轉變會使一國家的失業人數下降？ 引入最低工資法。 提高利得稅率。 很多本地廠商嘗試使用更多可節省人手的機器。 外國對其出口貨品的需求增加。

questions.en: Number of Persons Population aged 15 or above 10 000 000 Employed population 6 800 000 Unemployed population 1 200 000 Underemployed population 800 000 According to the above table, which of the following statements is/are correct? The labour force amounts to 8 000 000. The underemployment rate is 10%. The unemployment rate is 12%. (3) only (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 人數 15歲或以上人口 10 000 000 就業人口 6 800 000 失業人口 1 200 000 就業不足人口 800 000 根據上表，下列哪項描述是正確的？ 勞動人口總數是 8 000 000。 就業不足率是 10%。 失業率是 12%。 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following are possible losses to a society caused by unemployment? more government spending on public security due to a higher crime rate more unemployment assistance given by the government lower output level lower cost of living (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (1), (2) and (3) only (2), (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪幾項有可能是失業對社會造成的損失？ 由於犯罪率上升，政府為保障公眾安全而增加支出 政府提供更多失業援助 產出水平下降 生活費用下降 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4) 只有 (1)、(2) 及 (3) 只有 (2)、(3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Study the following data about Hong Kong in the period of July 2002 to September 2002. Number of Persons Employed Population 3 243 000 Underemployed Population 101 000 Unemployed Population 267 000 The unemployment rate in the period is 7.4% 7.6% 8.2% 10.2%
questions.zh: 參閱以下香港在 2002 年 7 月至 2002 年 9 月的資料： 人數 就業人口 3 243 000 就業不足人口 101 000 失業人口 267 000 該期間內的失業率是 7.4% 7.6% 8.2% 10.2%

questions.en: Number of Persons Employed population 18 400 Unemployed population 1 600 Now there are 1 000 additional job seekers in the economy. If 90% of them succeed in finding a job, the unemployment rate will increase. will decrease. will remain unchanged. may increase or decrease.
questions.zh: 人數 就業人口 18 400 失業人口 1 600 現有 1 000 名新增加的尋找工作的人。若其中 90% 的人成功尋獲工作，該經濟的失業率 會增加。 會減少。 不會變。 可能增加、亦可能減少。

questions.en: Population Aged 15 or above 10 000 000 employed 6 800 000 unemployed 1 200 000 underemployed 1 600 000 According to the above data, the total labour force is 9 600 000. the underemployment rate is 20%. the unemployment rate is 12.5%. the unemployment rate is 16%.
questions.zh: 人數 15歲或以上人口 10 000 000 就業人口 6 800 000 失業人口 1 200 000 就業不足人口 1 600 000 根據以上資料， 勞動人口總數是 9 600 000。 就業不足率是 20%。 失業率是 12.5%。 失業率是 16%。

questions.en: Suppose the unemployed population of an economy is 500 000 while the unemployment rate is 5%. The employed population is 500 000 1 000 000 9 500 000 10 000 000
Unemployment is costly to society because the employed will pay more tax. the potential GDP will fall. the real output of the economy will fall. unemployment benefit is a burden to society.
questions.zh: 社會要為失業付出代價，因爲 就業人士要繳付更多稅款。 潛在本地生產總值會下降。 經濟的實質產出會下降。 失業救濟金是社會的一種負担。

questions.en: Study the following figures of an economy. Number of People Unemployed 20 000 Under-employed 60 000 Employed 480 000 Persons aged 15 or above 1 000 000 The unemployment rate of the economy is __________. 2.0% 3.7% 4.0% 4.17%
questions.zh: 參閱下列某經濟的數據。 人數 失業人口 20 000 就業不足人口 60 000 就業人口 480 000 15 歲或以上人口 1 000 000 該經濟的失業率是 _______。 2.0% 3.7% 4.0% 4.17%

questions.en: Labour force (persons) 600 000 Unemployment rate 10% Under-employment rate 5% According to the above information on an economy, the population aged 15 or above is 600 000. the employment rate is 85%. the employed population is 540 000. the number of unemployed takes up 10% of the population.
questions.zh: 勞動人口 (人數) 600 000 失業率 10% 就業不足率 5% 根據上表關於某經濟的資料， 年屆 15 歲或以上的人口是 600 000 人。 就業率是 85%。 就業人口是 540 000 人。 失業人口佔總人口的 10%。

questions.en: Below are the employment figures of a country. Number of Persons Employment 18 000 Unemployment 2 000 Suppose there are new job seekers entering into the labour market after graduation but only 85% of them succeed in finding a job. The unemployment rate ________. will increase will decrease will remain unchanged may increase or decrease
questions.zh: 以下顯示某國的就業數據。 人數 就業人口 18 000 失業人口 2 000 假設有學校畢業生投入勞工市場尋找職位，其中只有 85% 成功。這樣，該國的失業率________。 會上升 會下降 會維持不變 可能會上升，亦可能會下降

questions.en: Suppose the unemployed population of an economy is 300 000 while the unemployment rate is 6%. The employed population is ________. 1 800 000 2 100 000 4 700 000 5 000 000

Many Hong Kong construction workers stay in Macau to work for several years. If they are attracted by the job opportunities offered by new infrastructure projects in Hong Kong and return to seek jobs, what will be the effect on the unemployment rate in Hong Kong? The unemployment rate will increase. The unemployment rate will decrease. The unemployment rate will remain unchanged. The effect on the unemployment rate cannot be determined.
questions.zh: 許多香港建築工人留在澳門工作數年。若他們受香港新的基建工程所提供的就業機會所吸引，回港找尋工作，這對香港的失業率會有什麼影響？ 失業率會上升。 失業率會下降。 失業率會維持不變。 對失業率的影響未能確定。

questions.en: Which of the following will reduce the unemployment rate of a country? Some university graduates join the labour force. Some factories move to a neighbouring country with lower labour cost. Some unemployed workers give up seeking jobs. The government increases unemployment benefits.
questions.zh: 下列哪項會減低某國的失業率？ 一些大學畢業生加入勞動人口。 一些工廠搬遷到勞工成本較低的鄰近國家。 一些失業工人放棄了尋找工作。 政府增加失業援助金。

questions.en: The government launches 'Admission Scheme for the Second Generation of Chinese Hong Kong Permanent Residents' in order to meet the challenge of ageing population and declining workforce. If some second-generation of Hong Kong permanent residents returned to Hong Kong to fill up the posts which have been vacant for a long time. Hong Kong's labour force would ______ and the unemployment rate would ______. rise ... remain unchanged rise ... fall fall ... remain unchanged fall ... fall
questions.zh: 政府推出「輸入中國籍香港永久性居民第二代計劃」以應付人口老化及勞動人口下降的挑戰。 若一些香港永久性居民的第二代回流香港填補了一些長期無人問津的職位，香港的勞動人口會 ________ 而失業率會 ________。 上升……維持不變 上升……下跌 下降……維持不變 下降……下跌

questions.en: The following table shows the data of an economy. Population aged 15 or above 6500000 Labour force participation rate* 60% Employed population 3780000 Underemployed population 100000 *Labour force participation rate = proportion of labour force in population aged 15 or above Based on the above data, the unemployment rate of the economy is _______. 1.85% 3.08% 3.38% 5.64%
questions.zh: 下表是某經濟的資料： 15歲或以上的人口 6500000 勞動人口參與率* 60% 就業人口 3780000 就業不足的人口 100000 *勞動人口參與率 = 15歲或以上的人口中勞動人口所佔比例 根據以上資料，該經濟的失業率是 ______。 1.85% 3.08% 3.38% 5.64%

questions.en: The following table shows the employment data of Hong Kong from April to June in 2019. Number of persons ('000) Population 7524 Aged 15 or above 6590 Employed persons 3871 Unemployed persons 114 Underemployed persons 41 According to the above data, the underemployment rate is _______. 0.55% 0.62% 1.03% 1.06%
questions.zh: 下表顯示 2019 年 4 至 6 月本港的就業數據。 人數(‘000) 人口 7524 15歲或以上人士 6590 就業人口 3871 失業人口 114 就業不足人口 41 根據以上數據，就業不足率是 ______。 0.55% 0.62% 1.03% 1.06%

questions.en: Suppose the unemployment rate of an economy is 8%. Which of the following would increase the unemployment rate? 15% of the new graduates could not find jobs successfully. Some employers closed down their local businesses and migrated to other countries. Some of the part-time workers lost their job due to automation of production. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的失業率是 8%。下列哪些會令失業率上升？ 15% 的新畢業生未能成功找到工作。 一些僱主結束其本地業務並移居外國。 一些兼職的工人因為生產自動化而失去工作。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Many workers in Country A emigrated to other countries. All the job vacancies resulting from the emigration were filled by unemployed people. As a result, the unemployment rate of Country A would increase would decrease would remain unchanged cannot be determined
questions.zh: 甲國很多工人移民外國，而所造成的職位空缺全部由失業人士填補。結果，甲國的失業率________。 會上升 會下降 會維持不變 未能判斷

questions.en: Study the following data of a country. Year 2020 2021 Unemployed population (million) 176.9 175.4 Unemployment rate (%) 3.8 4.0 Which of the following best explains the above changes of the country from 2020 to 2021? More people look for jobs. More employed persons emigrate to other countries. The government raises the effective minimum wage rate. The government raises the amount of unemployment benefits.
questions.zh: 細閱下列有關某國的資料。 年份 2020 2021 失業人口（百萬） 176.9 175.4 失業率(%) 3.8 4.0 下列哪項最能解釋上述國家從 2020 年到 2021 年的改變？ 更多人尋找工作。 更多就業人士移民到其他國家。 政府提高有效的最低工資率。 政府提高失業救濟金額。

questions.en: Suppose the unemployment rate of an economy is 5%. Which of the following situations would lead to a decrease in the unemployment rate of the economy? Foreign workers are imported to fill the vacancies in various industries. 96% of the new university graduates who enter the labour market are employed. Some underemployed workers work for more hours. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的失業率是 5%。下列哪些情況會令該經濟的失業率下降？ 輸入外勞以填補不同行業的職位空缺。 加入勞動市場的應屆大學畢業生中，96%成功獲得聘用。 一些就業不足的工人的工時增加。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The following table shows the employment data of an economy. Population aged 15 or above 10 000 000 Labour force participation rate* 80% Unemployed population 500 000 Underemployed population 1 000 000 *Labour force participation rate = proportion of labour force in population aged 15 or above Based on the above data, the employed population of the economy is _____. 6 500 000 7 000 000 7 500 000 8 000 000
questions.zh: 下表是某經濟的就業資料。 15 歲或以上的人口 10 000 000 勞動人口參與率* 80% 失業人口 500 000 就業不足的人口 1 000 000 *勞動人口參與率 = 15 歲或以上的人口中勞動人口所佔比例 根據以上資料，該經濟的就業人口是 ______。 6 500 000 7 000 000 7 500 000 8 000 000

questions.en: What will happen when there is inflation? The cost of living will fall. The budget deficit will decrease. The living standard will improve. The value of money will decrease.
questions.zh: 通脹發生時會出現以下哪一項情況？ 生活費用會減少 財政赤字會減少 生活水準會有所改善 貨幣價值會下跌

questions.en: Year 1990 1991 Consumer price index 100 125 According to the table above, which of the following statements is true? The cost of living was lower in 1990. The standard of living was lower in 1990. The purchasing power of money was higher in 1991. The consumption expenditure was higher in 1991.
questions.zh: 年份 1990 1991 消費物價指數 100 125 根據上表資料，以下哪一項為正確？ 1990 年的生活費用較低。 1990 年的生活水準較低。 1991 年的貨幣購買力較高。 1991 年的消費支出較高。

questions.en: Who will lose during an unanticipated inflation? Mrs. Lee, who has hired a Filipino maid Mr. Chan, who has bought ten coupons which can be exchanged for cakes at a bakery Mr. Fu, who runs a restaurant Mr. Wong, who has put all his money in his time deposit account
questions.zh: 當非預期通貨膨脹出現時，下列何者會有損失？ 李太；她聘用了一位菲傭 陳先生；他購買了十張餅券，可以從麵包店換取糕餅 傅先生；他經營一間酒樓 王先生；他已將全部金錢存入定期存款戶口內

questions.en: Which of the following people will gain in times of unexpected inflation? holders of long-term government bonds holders of certificates of deposits those who have used credit cards to buy goods shareholders of companies which have issued long-term fixed-interest debentures. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 非預期通脹發生時，下列哪些人得益？ 長期政府債券持有者 存款證持有者 用信用咭購買了物品的人 發行了長期定息債券的公司的股東 只有(1)及(2) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(3)及(4)

questions.en: Source: Hong Kong Economic Times The above data reflects that during this period, the consumption power of the people became weaker. the economy was on a downswing. the people consumed less but saved more. the increase in the cost of living had slowed down.
questions.zh: 資料來源：香港經濟日報 上圖資料反映在該段時期內， 市民的消費力減弱。 經濟正走下坡。 市民的消費減少而儲蓄增加。 生活費用的增加減慢。

questions.en: Study the figure below concerning the changes in the Consumer Price Index. Study the figure below concerning the changes in the Consumer Price Index. From the figure, we can conclude that inflation has stopped as prices go down. wages have decreased. the cost of living has been rising at a slower rate. some debts who purchased mortgages on flats recently have suffered a loss.
questions.zh: 參閱下表中消費物價指數的改變。 由上表，我們可得以下結論： 物價持續下跌，通貨膨脹終止。 工資下降。 生活費用以較慢的速度增長。 部分用按揭方法借錢供樓的負債者近期蒙受損失。

questions.en: The inflation rate in an economy was 10% in 1996 and dropped to 5% in 1997. Which of the following must be true about the economy in the above period? There was a fall in the standard of living. There was deflation in the year 1997. There was a rise in the prices of all goods. None of the above.
questions.zh: 某經濟的通脹率在 1996 年為 10%，並在 1997 年下降至 5%。在上述期間，下列哪項有關該經濟的陳述必然是正確的？ 生活水準下降。 1997 年出現通貨緊縮。 全部物品的價格都上升。 以上皆不是。

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT a problem in using the consumer price index as an indicator of the inflation rate? It uses a fixed basket of goods. It assumes the quality of goods remains unchanged. It includes only final goods. It includes imported goods.
questions.zh: 以消費物價指數作為通脹率的指標，下列哪項不是當中的問題？ 它採用固定的物品籃子。 它假設物品的質素維持不變。 它只包括最終物品。 它包括進口物品。

questions.en: Mr A borrows money from a bank for a housing mortgage at a fixed interest rate of 7% p.a. After that the general price level falls continuously. In this event, Mr A loses and the bank gains. This is because the value of the mortgaged house has been falling. Mr A's wage income has been falling. the bank can sell the house if Mr A fails to repay the loan. when the general price level keeps on falling, the purchasing power of a fixed amount of interest will increase.
questions.zh: 甲先生以固定年息 7% 向某銀行借入一筆房屋按揭貸款。之後，一般物價水平一直下降。在這事件中，甲先生有損失而該銀行有得益。這是因爲 所按房屋的價值一直下降。 甲先生的薪酬收入一直下降。 若甲先生未能還款予銀行，銀行可以將該房屋賣掉。 當一般物價水平一直下降，定額利息的購買力會上升。

questions.en: Chart 1 Movements of the Composite Consumer Price Index Based on the data in Chart 1, under what situation would Mr Chan have gained from July 1999 to July 2000? Before that period of time he had already borrowed a sum of money from a bank at a fixed interest rate. His salary remained unchanged during that period of time. He adjusted the rental charge to his tenant in a rental property according to the change in price level. He had a collection of antique vases.
questions.zh: 根據表一的資料，在1999年7月至2000年7月這一段時期內，陳先生會在什麼情況下得益？ 在此段時期前，他已用固定利率由銀行借入一筆款項。 在此段時期內，他的薪金維持不變。 他根據物價水平的變動來調整他收取租客的租金。 他早已收藏了一批古董花瓶。

questions.en: Refer to the following data about an economy. Year 1 Year 2 GDP Deflator 150 180 We can conclude that from Year 1 to Year 2, the purchasing power of money has decreased. the real national income has decreased. the average standard of living has gone down. the income distribution has become more uneven.
questions.zh: 參閱下列某經濟的數據： 年份 第一年 第二年 本地生產總值平減指數 150 180 我們可以得到以下的結論：由第一年到第二年， 貨幣的購買力下降了。 實質國民收入減少了。 平均生活水準下降了。 收入分配變得更不平均。

questions.en: The table below shows the wealth positions of four individuals. Individual Monetary assets ($) Real assets ($) Monetary Liabilities ($) Real Liabilities ($) A 10 000 25 000 0 3 000 B 5 000 50 000 5 000 7 000 C 8 000 30 000 20 000 13 000 D 12 000 12 000 4 500 40 000 Who will gain the most if there is an unanticipated inflation? Individual A Individual B Individual C Individual D
questions.zh: 下表顯示四個人的財富狀況。 個人 貨幣資產 ($) 實質資產 ($) 貨幣負債 ($) 實質負債 ($) A 10 000 25 000 0 3 000 B 5 000 50 000 5 000 7 000 C 8 000 30 000 20 000 13 000 D 12 000 12 000 4 500 40 000 若出現非預期通脹，誰的得益最大？ 個人 A 個人 B 個人 C 個人 D

questions.en: Disinflation means that the inflation rate is at a disequilibrium level. inflation destabilizes the economy. the deflation rate is rising. the price level is increasing at a slower rate.
questions.zh: 反通貨膨脹是指 通脹率處於不均衡水平。 通貨膨脹使經濟不穩定。 通貨緊縮率正在上升。 物價水平以較慢的速率上升。

questions.en: Which of the following would gain when unexpected inflation occurs? holders of fixed deposits with banks employees whose salaries are adjusted according to inflation people who receive a fixed amount of unemployment benefits a government which has issued bonds at fixed interest rates
questions.zh: 下列何者會因非預期通脹出現而得益？ 銀行定期存款的持有人 按通脹調整薪酬的僱員 領取定額失業援助的人 發行了定息債券的政府

questions.en: Refer to the following diagram about the GDP deflator of Hong Kong from January 2000 to September 2004. Based on the above diagram, we can conclude that during this period, the nominal GDP was decreasing. the real GDP was decreasing. the cost of living was increasing. the purchasing power of money was increasing.
questions.zh: 參閱下列關於香港於 2000 年 1 月至 2004 年 9 月期間的本地生產總值平減物價指數的圖。 根據上圖，我們可得出結論如下：在該期間， 名義本地生產總值正在減少。 實質本地生產總值正在減少。 生活費用正在增加。 貨幣購買力正在增加。

questions.en: The above diagram shows that during the period there is disinflation in the economy. the growth rate of money supply is positive. the general price level is falling. the standard of living is falling.
questions.zh: 上圖顯示在該期間內 該經濟出現反通貨膨脹。 貨幣供應的增長率為正數。 一般物價水平正在下降。 生活水準正在下降。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about inflation is correct? A continuous increase in the price of a good is not inflation. During inflation, everyone suffers to the same extent. During inflation, incomes and prices increase at the same rate. Inflation may benefit some people, particularly those people whose incomes are fixed.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項對通貨膨脹的描述是正確的？ 一件物品的價格持續上升並非通脹。 通脹發生時，每個人的損失都相同。 通脹發生時，收入和物價都以相同的百分比增加。 通脹可能使某些人得益，尤其是那些收入是固定的人。

questions.en: Refer to the following information about the composite consumer price index of Hong Kong. Based on the above information, we can conclude that during this period in 2006, the nominal GDP was falling. the nominal GDP was increasing. the purchasing power of money was falling. the purchasing power of money was increasing.
questions.zh: 下表顯示香港綜合消費物價指數的資料。 我們可從上述資料得出如下結論：在2006年該段期間內， 名義本地生產總值正在下降。 名義本地生產總值正在上升。 貨幣的購買力正在下降。 貨幣的購買力正在上升。

questions.en: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) may overstate the actual increase in the cost of living during periods of inflation because consumption pattern may change when the relative prices of goods change. the quality of goods and services may improve over time. the weights assigned to different goods in the calculation of the CPI are fixed. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在通脹期間，消費物價指數（CPI）可能會高估生活費用的實際增幅，因為 當物品的相對價格改變時，消費模式可能會改變。 物品及服務的質素可能會隨時間改善。 在計算 CPI 時分配給不同物品的權數是固定的。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following would lose during an unexpected inflation? a tenant who has signed a fixed rental contract before the unexpected inflation occurs an employer who has fixed the wage payment to his employees before the unexpected inflation occurs a creditor who has loaned out a sum of money at a fixed interest rate before the unexpected inflation occurs an insurer who is paying compensation, the amount of which was fixed before the unexpected inflation occurs
questions.zh: 下列哪些人/機構會於非預期通貨膨脹出現時蒙受損失？ 在非預期通脹出現前已簽了固定租約的住客。 在非預期通脹出現前已將發放予僱員的工資數目固定了的僱主。 在非預期通脹出現前以固定利率借出一筆款項的債主。 提供賠償的保險公司，該賠償額在非預期通脹出現前已固定了。

questions.en: The following table shows the Consumer Price Index (A) of Hong Kong from 2004 to 2006. Year Consumer Price Index (A) 2004 99.3 2005 100.3 2006 102.1 Based on the above table, we can conclude that during this period of time, the per capita nominal GDP has increased. the living standard has worsened. the cost of living has increased. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 下表顯示香港從 2004 年至 2006 年的甲類消費物價指數。 年份 甲類消費物價指數 2004 99.3 2005 100.3 2006 102.1 根據上表，我們可得結論如下：在該時期內， 人均名義本地生產總值上升了。 生活水準變差了。 生活費用增加了。 以上全部正確。

questions.en: When inflation is expected, creditors will charge the debtors a higher nominal interest rate. workers will request for a raise in their nominal wage rates. people will tend to hold more monetary assets instead of real assets. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 人們預期通貨膨脹時， 債主會向借款者收取更高的名義利率。 工人會要求提高他們的名義工資率。 人們會傾向持有更多貨幣性資產來取代實物資產。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: When the consumer price index of an economy increases from 100 to 110, it implies that the prices of all consumer goods involved in the calculation of the index have increased by 10%. the cost of living has increased. the standard of living has increased. people’s nominal income has increased.
questions.zh: 某經濟的消費物價指數由 100 上升至 110，這意味着： 計算該指數中所涉及的全部消費品的價格都上升了 10%。 生活費用增加了。 生活水準提高了。 人們的名義收入增加了。

questions.en: Which of the following people will benefit from unanticipated inflation? a landlord who leases out his land with a fixed rental a businessman who lends out a sum of money at a floating interest rate an investor who holds a lot of government bonds an employer who signs a fixed nominal wage contract with his employees
questions.zh: 下列哪類人士會從非預期通脹中獲益？ 以固定租金出租土地的業主 以浮動利率借出款項的商人 持有大量政府債券的投資者 與僱員簽署固定名義工資合約的僱主

questions.en: Inflation will still have real effects on wealth distribution even if it is fully anticipated. will cause wealth redistribution from retired people to working people. will occur when there is an increase in property prices. will occur when there is a tax rebate to all taxpayers from the government.
questions.zh: 通貨膨脹 即使被完全預期，仍會對財富分配產生實質影響。 會導致財富從退休人士再分配至在職人士。 會在樓價上升時出現。 會在政府向全體納稅人退稅時出現。

questions.en: When inflation is expected, people will tend to hold more real assets instead of monetary assets. employees will ask for an increase in their nominal wage rates to compensate for their loss of purchasing power. creditors will gain and debtors will lose because the purchasing power of repayments will decrease. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 當人們預期有通脹出現， 人們會傾向增持實質資產以代替貨幣資產。 僱員會要求僱主提高他們的名義工資率，以補償他們損失了的購買力。 債主會得益，而欠債人會受損，因爲所還款項的購買力會下降。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following people will lose when unexpected inflation occurs? an individual holding time deposits in a bank a holder of government bonds with interest rates adjusted according to the inflation rate a flat owner repaying a fixed-rate mortgage loan a billionaire keeping all his wealth in the form of gold
questions.zh: 當非預期通脹出現時，下列哪位人士會有損失？ 一位銀行定期存款持有人 一名政府債券持有人，而該債券利率隨通脹率調整 一名正在償還固定息率按揭貸款的樓宇業主 一名以黃金保存全部財富的億萬富翁

questions.en: The US government has accumulated a huge amount of debt, about US$14 trillion in 2011. If there is unexpected inflation in the US, which of the following parties will most likely gain? Hong Kong residents holding cash in Hong Kong dollars under the linked exchange rate system US citizens holding time deposits countries holding a large amount of US government bonds, like China and Japan the US government
questions.zh: 美國政府已累積的債務金額非常龐大，在 2011 年約為 14 萬億美元。若美國出現非預期通脹，下列哪類人士／機構最有可能從中得益？ 在聯繫匯率制度下，持有港元現金的香港居民 持有定期存款的美國國民 持有大量美國國庫債券的國家，如中國及日本 美國政府

questions.en: Which of the following people will benefit from unanticipated inflation? A loan shark who lends out a sum of money at a floating interest rate A manager who receives a fixed salary with the period of a two-year contract A flat-owner who repays a fixed-rate mortgage loan A retired teacher who receives dividends from various listed companies
questions.zh: 下列哪位人士會受惠於非預期通脹？ 一位放高利貸者，以浮動利率借出一筆金錢 一位經理，在兩年合約內收取固定薪金 一位物業業主，償還固定息率按揭貸款 一位退休教師，收取多間上市公司的股息

questions.en: Which of the following statements about inflation is/are correct? Inflation occurs when the government handouts a large sum of cash to every citizen in a certain year. Inflation redistributes wealth from lenders to debtors if it is anticipated. People prefer holding real assets to cash under expected inflation. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下列哪(幾)項有關通脹的陳述是正確的？ 當政府在某一年向每位市民派發一大筆現金，通脹便會出現。 若通脹是預期的，通脹會令財富再分配，由貸款人轉至債務人。 在預期通脹的情況下，人們偏好持有實質資產而非現金。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: When unanticipated deflation occurs, which of the following people will lose? people paying a fixed amount of rental payment people receiving interest from their savings deposits people repaying a mortgage loan at a floating interest rate people working under a fixed nominal wage contract
questions.zh: 當非預期的通縮出現，下列哪些人士會受損？ 支付定額租金的人 收取儲蓄存款利息的人 償還浮息按揭貸款的人 在固定名義工資合約下工作的人

questions.en: Which of the following people will gain in times of unexpected deflation? holders of i-bonds issued by the Hong Kong Government flat owners repaying floating rate mortgage loans pensioners receiving fixed pensions (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在非預期通縮期間，下列哪些人士會得益？ 香港政府發行的通脹掛鈎債券的持有人 正償還浮息按揭貸款的樓宇業主 正收取固定長俸的人士 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: When there is unexpected inflation, which of the following individual(s) will lose? A firm owner paying his workers a fixed wage A flat owner charging a rental with adjustment according to the change in price level A retired civil servant receiving a fixed monthly pension All of the above individuals will lose because the purchasing power of money will be lower.
questions.zh: 當非預期通脹出現，下列哪 (幾) 位人士會受損？ 一位向工人支付固定工資的廠家 一位根據價格水平的轉變而調整租金的業主 一位領取每月定額長俸的退休公務員 以上三位人士均會受損，因為貨幣的購買力會下降。

questions.en: Under unexpected deflation, which of the following persons will lose? Ms Mok holds a time deposit of one million dollars in a deposit taking company. Mr Lo receives interest from Silver Bond of which the rate of return is linked to the inflation, subject to a minimum return of 3%. Mr Chan signs a two-year contract with an online TV company to subscribe to its service by a fixed monthly payment. (1) only (2) only (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 在非預期通縮下，下列哪（幾）位人士會有所損失？ 莫女士在一家接受存款公司持有一百萬元定期存款。 盧先生持有銀色債券收取利息，債券的回報率和通脹掛勾，最低回報為 3%。 陳先生與一家網絡電視公司簽約兩年，每月以固定費用訂購其服務。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: When there is unexpected inflation, which of the following persons will gain? a landlord who adjusts his rental according to the price index a creditor who has loaned out a sum of money at a floating interest rate an employer who signs a fixed nominal wage contract with his employees a retired civil servant who receives a fixed monthly pension
questions.zh: 當非預期通脹出現，下列哪位人士會得益？ 一位根據物價指數調整其租金的業主 一位以浮動利率借出一筆款項的債主 一位與僱員簽訂固定名義薪酬合約的僱主 一位領取每月定額長俸的退休公務員

questions.en: If there is unexpected inflation, which of the following persons will lose? a consumer who used credit cards to buy goods an employer who signed fixed nominal wage contracts with his employees a holder of certificate of deposits an investor of bonds with the rate of return adjusted according to the inflation rate
questions.zh: 若出現非預期通脹，下列哪位人士會有損失？ 一位以信用卡購物的消費者 一位與僱員簽訂固定名義薪酬合約的僱主 一位存款證的持有人 一位持有回報率按通脹率調整的債券的投資者

questions.en: The table below shows the Composite Consumer Price Index of Hong Kong. questions.en: In Hong Kong, salaries tax is normally paid by two instalments and the tax payment can be made through the post. This practice agrees with the ______ principle of taxation. equality convenience certainty economy
questions.zh: 在本港，薪俸稅通常分兩期繳交，而稅款可以通過郵寄方式繳付。這種做法符合徵稅的 ______ 原則。 公平 方便 確定 經濟

questions.en: A Japan electronics firm produces and sells its products in Hong Kong. Therefore, it has to pay profits tax to the Hong Kong government. Hong Kong is applying the source principle. Residence principle. Equity principle. Convenience principle.
questions.zh: 某日本電子廠在香港生產及銷售其產品，故須向香港政府繳交利得稅。香港奉行什麼徵稅原則？ 來源原則 居民原則 平等原則 方便原則

questions.en: The payment of salaries tax and profits tax can be made by the Payment by Phone Service (PPS) by which taxpayers can transfer money from their bank accounts to the government. This practice satisfies the ________ principle of taxation. source certainty convenience equity
questions.zh: 納稅人可透過繳費聆服務將金錢由自己的銀行戶口轉往政府的戶口，用來繳付薪俸稅和利得稅。這種做法符合賦稅的 __________ 原則。 來源 確定 方便 公平

questions.en: Suppose the government of an economy announces that the people will have to pay a general sales tax of 2% of the selling price when they purchase any goods and services. The government also launches a series of programmes to make sure that the public understands the new tax. Which of the following taxation principles is illustrated by the above measures of the government? equality certainty convenience economy
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的政府宣佈每當國民購買貨品或服務時，他們便須繳付一項普及銷售稅，而稅率是售價的 2%。該政府同時推行一系列推廣項目，以確保公明瞭該新稅項。 上述政府措施說明了下列哪一項賦稅原則？ 公平 肯定 方便 經濟

questions.en: In Hong Kong, citizens are allowed to make their tax payments through the Internet. This practice is in line with the ______ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith. equity certainty convenience source
questions.zh: 香港政府容許市民透過互聯網繳交稅款。該措施符合亞當史密斯提出的______賦稅原則。 稅率相等 確定 方便 收入來源地

questions.en: The Inland Revenue Department will inform every salaries tax payer of the amount of tax payable either by mail or by the etax account. This practice is in line with the ________ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith. equity certainty convenience economy
questions.zh: 稅務局會透過郵件或稅務易戶口通知每位薪俸稅納稅人應付的稅款總額。這項安排符合亞當史密夫所提出的 ______ 賦稅原則。 公平 明確 方便 經濟

questions.en: In July 2009, the government introduced an environmental levy of 50 cents on each plastic shopping bag at the retail level, with the first phase covering chain or large supermarkets, convenience stores and personal health and beauty product stores. Small shops are exempted in the first phase. Customers can pay the levy, with the original amount of purchase of goods, by credit card, Easy Pay System (EPS) or cash. The collection of the above environmental levy is LEAST in line with the ______ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith. equality economy convenience certainty
questions.zh: 在二零零九年七月，政府在零售層面開徵每個塑膠購物袋5角的環保費，首階段範圍包括連鎖或大型超市、便利店及個人護理和美容產品店。在首階段小商戶獲得豁免。顧客可使用信用卡、易辦事（EPS）或現金一併支付原初購物金額和環保費。 徵收上述的環保費最不符合亞當史密所提出的 ________ 賦稅原則。 公平 經濟 方便 明確

questions.en: The following is an extract of the mission of the Inland Revenue Department. Our Mission We are committed to collecting revenue efficiently and cost-effectively enabling staff to acquire the necessary knowledge, skills and attitude so that they can contribute their best to the achievement of our vision The above mission is in line with the ______________ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith. equality certainty convenience economy
questions.zh: 以下為稅務局使命的撮要。 我們的使命 我們致力 以有效率及有成本效益的方法收取稅款 協助員工具備應有的知識、技巧和態度，從而竭盡所能，實踐我們的抱負 上述使命符合亞當史密夫所提出的徵稅________原則。 公平 確定 方便 經濟

questions.en: Mei Ling's income has increased from $50 000 to $60 000 this year. The income tax is progressive if it increases from $1 000 to $1 200 $2 000 to $2 500 $3 000 to $3 600 $4 000 to $4 700
A sales tax on food is regarded as ______ tax. a direct and regressive an indirect and regressive a direct and proportional an indirect and progressive
questions.zh: 對食物徵收的銷售稅是一種________稅項。 直接和累退的 間接和累退的 直接和比例的 間接和累進的

questions.en: Income ($) Tax Amount ($) Policy A Policy B 10 000 1 000 1 000 50 000 5 000 4 000 100 000 10 000 7 000 500 000 50 000 30 000 Which of the following is likely to take place if the government changes from Policy A to Policy B? less incentive to work more uneven income distribution a lower rate of economic growth a fall in the consumption expenditure
questions.zh: 稅額（$） 甲政策 乙政策 10,000 1,000 1,000 50,000 5,000 4,000 100,000 10,000 7,000 500,000 50,000 30,000 政府政策有所改變，由甲政策轉為乙政策。以下哪一項可能會發生？ 工作熱誠下降 國民收入分配會更不平均 經濟增長率較低 消費支出下降

questions.en: Suppose the government asks everybody to pay a tax of $100 a year. This is an example of regressive tax. proportional tax. income tax. indirect tax.
questions.zh: 設政府要求每年繳付$100 稅款。這是一項 累退稅。 比例稅。 入息稅。 間接稅。

questions.en: Taxpayers with the same net chargeable income paid different amounts of tax in the two fiscal years 1990/91 and 1991/92. Several examples are shown below to illustrate this: Total net chargeable income ($) Total tax payment ($) for the fiscal year of 1990/91 1991/92 10 000 200 200 20 000 600 400 30 000 1500 1300 40 000 2700 2200 50 000 4200 3900 60 000 6000 5600 70 000 8100 8100 80 000 10600 10600 How does the change in the total tax payment affect the income distribution in Hong Kong? It gives a more even income distribution. It gives a more uneven income distribution. it has no effect on income distribution. The effect on income distribution is uncertain.
questions.zh: 在 1990/91 及 1991/92 兩財政年度，應課稅入息相同的納稅人須繳稅款總額並不相同。我們可用若干例子來加以說明： 須繳稅款總額 ($) 1990/91 財政年度 1991/92 財政年度 10,000 200 200 20,000 600 400 30,000 1,500 1,300 40,000 2,700 2,200 50,000 4,200 3,900 60,000 6,000 5,600 70,000 8,100 8,100 80,000 10,600 10,600 須繳稅款總額的改變如何影響香港的所得分配？ 所得分配較平均 所得分配較不平均 對所得分配沒有影響 對所得分配的影響不明確

questions.en: If the amount of tax increases as income increases, the tax may be considered a ______ tax. progressive proportional regressive (1) only (1) or (2) (2) or (3) (1) or (2) or (3)
questions.zh: 若繳交的稅款隨著收入的增加，則該稅項可能是一種 累進稅。 比例稅。 累退稅。 只有 (1) (1) 或 (2) (2) 或 (3) (1) 或 (2) 或 (3)

questions.en: Study the following information carefully: Taxable income ($) Total tax payment ($) 10 000 1 000 20 000 3 000 30 000 X If the tax is progressive, X must be larger than 3 000. 3 500. 4 000. 4 500.

The following diagram shows the tax structure of Tax X: Tax X is ______ within the income range 0Y₁, and ______ within the income range Y₁Y₂. proportional ... progressive proportional ... regressive progressive ... proportional progressive ... regressive
questions.zh: 下圖顯示 X 稅項的稅項結構： 在入息範圍 0Y₁ 內，X 稅項屬______稅；在 Y₁Y₂ 範圍內，它屬______稅。 比例...累進 比例...累退 累進...比例 累進...累退

questions.en: Which two of the following diagrams describe a progressive tax? (1) (2) (3) (4) (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪兩幅圖描繪了累進稅項？ (1) (2) (3) (4) 只有(1)及(3) 只有(1)及(4) 只有(2)及(3) 只有(2)及(4)

questions.en: Which of the following statements is true about progressive tax in Hong Kong? It will lead to a more uneven distribution of income. It is a tax levied on goods and services. The tax burden can be shifted It may discourage working incentive.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於香港的累進稅的描述是正確的？ 它會引致收入分配更不均。 它是對貨物及勞務徵收的稅項。 可以將它的稅項負擔轉嫁給別人。 它可能減低工作熱誠。

questions.en: A progressive tax is more effective than a proportional tax in achieving the following aim: to increase government revenue to lower the administrative costs of the government to achieve a more equitable income distribution to reallocate the resources of the economy
questions.zh: 累進稅較比例稅更能有效地達致以下的目的： 增加政府收益。 減低政府行政費用。 達致更公平的收入分配。 將經濟體系的資源重新分配。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about tax is correct? Progressive tax has a higher tax rate than regressive tax. Progressive tax is a tax on income while regressive tax is a tax on goods. The tax payment of a regressive tax decreases as the taxable income increases. The percentage of income as tax of a progressive tax increases when taxable income increases.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於稅項的描述是正確？ 累進稅稅率較累退稅的為高。 累進稅對收入徵稅而累退稅則對物品徵稅。 應課稅收入增加時，累退稅應繳稅款下降。 應課稅收入增加時，累進稅應繳稅款佔收入的百分比也增加。

questions.en: The following diagram shows a tax system: Which of the following statements concerning the above tax is correct? It is a progressive tax as tax payment increases when income increases. It would lead to an uneven distribution of income. It would encourage the working incentive of workers. The progressivity of the tax rate will increase when income rises.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某稅項的稅款與納稅人收入的關係： 下列哪一項對上述稅項的描述是正確的？ 它是一項累進稅，因為稅款隨收入增加而增加。 它使收入不平均分配。 它會鼓勵工人更努力工作。 收入增加時，該稅項的稅率累進程度更大。

questions.en: Which two of the following diagrams illustrate a regressive tax measured in terms of an average tax rate? (1) (2) (3) (4) (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 以平均稅率計算，下列哪兩幅圖所顯示的稅項屬於累退稅？ (1) (2) (3) (4) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Taxable income ($) Tax payment ($) 200 000 22 000 250 000 25 000 300 000 27 000 From the above information, we can conclude that the tax is a progressive tax as the tax payment increases with taxable income. the tax payment takes a decreasing portion of taxable income as taxable income increases. the taxation system helps to reduce the income gap. the taxation system reduces the work incentive.
questions.zh: 應課稅收入（$） 稅款（$） 200 000 22 000 250 000 25 000 300 000 27 000 由以上資料，我們可得的結論是： 該稅項屬於累進稅，因爲稅款隨應課稅收入增加而增加。 該稅項所徵收的稅款佔應課稅收入百分比隨應課稅收入的增加而遞減。 該稅制有助於縮小收入差距。 該稅制會減低工作熱誠。

questions.en: Taxable Income ($) Tax payment Under Tax A ($) Tax payment Under Tax B ($) 10 000 1 500 2 000 20 000 3 800 3 800 30 000 6 600 5 400 From the above data, we can conclude that Tax A is a direct tax and Tax B is an indirect tax. there would be a more even income distribution under Tax A. the tax rate of Tax A is lower than that of Tax B for all levels of income. the fluctuations of government tax revenue would be smaller under Tax A than under Tax B when income fluctuates.
questions.zh: 應課稅收入 ($) 在甲稅項下的應繳稅款 ($) 在乙稅項下的應繳稅款 ($) 10 000 1 500 2 000 20 000 3 800 3 800 30 000 6 600 5 400 從上表資料，我們可得以下結論： 甲稅項是一直接稅而乙稅項是一間接稅。 在甲稅項下的收入分配會較平均。 在所有的收入水平，甲稅項的稅率均低於乙稅項。 當收入出現波動時，政府稅收在甲稅項下的波動會較在乙稅項下的波動爲小。

questions.en: Tobacco duty in Hong Kong is a kind of direct and proportional tax. direct and regressive tax. indirect and proportional tax. indirect and regressive tax.
questions.zh: 香港的煙草稅是一種 直接稅及比例稅。 直接稅及累退稅。 間接稅及比例稅。 間接稅及累退稅。

questions.en: Which of the following taxes are progressive? (1) (2) (3) (4) (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only

The following table describes a tax: Taxable Income ($) Tax Payment ($) 10 000 2 000 20 000 3 800 30 000 5 400 40 000 6 800 50 000 8 000 The above tax would lead to a less even distribution of income. reduce the working incentive of workers. improve the resource allocation of the economy. increase the consumption expenditure of the lower income group.
questions.zh: 下表描述某稅項： 應課稅收入($) 稅款($) 10 000 2 000 20 000 3 800 30 000 5 400 40 000 6 800 50 000 8 000 上述稅項會 導致收入分配較不平均。 減低工人的工作意欲。 改善經濟的資源分配。 增加較低收入人士的消費支出。

questions.en: Taxable income ($) Tax payment ($) Tax A Tax B Tax C 10 000 500 800 1 000 20 000 1 000 1 700 1 000 30 000 1 500 2 700 1 000 According to the above table, which of the following statements is correct? None of the above taxes is a regressive tax. The taxation principle of equity put forth by Adam Smith applies to all the above taxes. Tax A is the most effective in achieving a more even income distribution. Tax B is a progressive tax.
questions.zh: 稅款 ($) 甲稅項 乙稅項 丙稅項 10 000 500 800 1 000 20 000 1 000 1 700 1 000 30 000 1 500 2 700 1 000 根據上表，下列哪一項是正確的？ 以上的稅項都不是累退稅。 亞當史密夫提出的平等賦稅原則適用於以上各稅項。 要達致收入分配更平均，甲稅項最爲有效。 乙稅項屬累進稅。

questions.en: Study the following data: Taxable income ($) Tax amount ($) 0 0 10 000 1 500 20 000 X If the above tax is progressive, the value of X must be smaller than 3 000. equal to 3 000. greater than 3 000. There is not sufficient information to do the calculation.
questions.zh: 細閱下列資料： 應課稅入息 ($) 應繳稅款 ($) 0 0 10 000 1 500 20 000 X 若上述的稅項是累進的，則 X 的值必須 小於 3 000。 等於 3 000。 大於 3 000。 沒有足夠資料以供計算。

questions.en: Refer to the following relationship between the tax payment and the taxable income of a certain tax. Which of the following is correct? The above tax would lower the working incentives of workers. The above tax is in accordance with the equality principle put forth by Adam Smith. The tax allowance for the above tax is zero. Every employee has to pay the above tax.
questions.zh: 參閱下列某稅項的應繳稅款與應課稅收入的關係。 下列哪一項是正確的？ 上述稅項會減低工人的工作熱誠。 上述稅項符合亞當史密夫提出的稅率相等賦稅原則。 上述稅項的免稅額是零。 每一位僱員都必須繳交上述稅項。

questions.en: The following lines A, B, C and D indicate different relationships between tax payment and taxable income. Which of these four lines shows a relationship in accordance with the taxation principle of equality put forth by Adam Smith? line A line B line C line D
questions.zh: 下列 A、B、C、D 四線顯示稅款與應課稅收入之間的不同關係。哪條線顯示的關係符合亞當史密夫提出的稅率相等賦稅原則？ A線 B線 C線 D線

questions.en: Taxable Income ($) Tax Payment ($) Tax System A Tax System B 100 000 6 000 5 000 200 000 12 000 12 000 300 000 18 000 21 000 Refer to the above data. When the tax system changes from A to B, the income gap between the rich and the poor will be reduced. the work incentive of workers will increase. the tax base of the economy will be widened. the government budget position will be improved.
questions.zh: 所繳稅款 ($) 甲稅制 乙稅制 100 000 6 000 5 000 200 000 12 000 12 000 300 000 18 000 21 000 參閱上表資料，若稅制由甲稅制轉為乙稅制， 貧富之間的收入差距會減少。 工人的工作熱誠會增加。 稅基會擴闊。 政府財政狀況會得到改善。

questions.en: Which of the following diagrams describes a regressive tax?
questions.zh: 下列哪幅圖描述一項累退稅？

questions.en: An economy levies a 5% general sales tax on all goods and services. This tax is a/an proportional tax as everyone will pay 5% of their expenditure on goods and services as tax. progressive tax as the tax payment increases with the price of the goods and services. regressive tax as the proportion of tax payment to income decreases when income increases. indirect tax as consumers indirectly bear all the tax burden.
questions.zh: 某經濟向全部貨品及服務徵收 5% 的普及銷售稅。該稅項屬於： 比例稅，因爲每個人在貨品及服務的消費上都要繳付 $5\%$ 的稅款。 累進稅，因爲稅款隨貨品及服務的價格上升而增加。 累退稅，因爲在收入上升時，稅款佔收入的比例下降。 間接稅，因爲消費者間接地承受了全部賦稅負擔。

questions.en: Refer to the following relationship between the tax rate and the taxable income of a certain tax. Which of the following statements is correct? The taxation principle of equity put forth by Adam Smith applies to this tax. The tax rate remains constant when the taxable income increases. The imposition of this tax would lead to an increase in the ratio of indirect tax revenue to direct tax revenue. When the taxable income increases, the percentage increase of the tax payment is greater than the percentage increase of the taxable income.
questions.zh: 參閱下列某稅項的稅率與可稅收入的關係。 下列哪項是正確的？ 該稅項符合亞當史密斯提出的稅率相等賦稅原則。 可稅收入增加時，稅率維持不變。 開徵該稅項會令間接稅稅收與直接稅稅收的比上升。 可稅收入增加時，稅款上升的百分比大於可稅收入上升的百分比。

questions.en: Taxable income ($) Tax payments ($) Tax system A Tax system B 100 000 4 000 5 000 200 000 4 000 10 000 300 000 4 000 15 000 Refer to the above data. Tax system A is ________ while tax system B is ________. proportional ... progressive progressive ... proportional regressive ... proportional regressive ... progressive
Which of the following diagrams shows a tax system that would lead to a more uneven income distribution?
questions.zh: 下列哪幅圖顯示一個會導致收入分配更不平均的稅制？

questions.en: Which of the following is a direct and proportional tax in Hong Kong? hotel accommodation tax property tax salaries tax general rates
questions.zh: 在香港，下列哪種稅項屬直接稅和比例稅？ 酒店房租稅 物業稅 薪俸稅 差餉

questions.en: The government plans to impose a new tax under which the tax payment drops when taxable income drops. Which of the following statements about the new tax is correct? The tax is regressive as the tax rate increases when the taxable income drops. The tax is proportional as the taxable income and the tax payment are positively related. The tax cannot be progressive as the tax rate increases when the tax payment drops. The tax can be progressive, proportional or regressive.
questions.zh: 政府計劃開徵一項新稅：當應課稅收入下降，它的稅款亦下降。下列哪項有關該項新稅的陳述是正確的？ 該稅屬累退稅，因爲隨著應課稅收入下降，稅率會上升。 該稅屬比例稅，因爲應課稅收入和稅款金額有正向的關係。 該稅不會是累進稅，因爲隨著稅款金額下降，稅率會上升。 該稅可能是累進稅、比例稅或累退稅。

questions.en: Suppose the post-tax Gini coefficient of an economy is larger than its pre-tax Gini coefficient. This implies that the government has increased the amount of transfer payment to the poor. the tax system of the economy is likely to be regressive. the problem of income inequality is worse than that in the previous year. the government should reform the tax system.
questions.zh: 假設某經濟除稅後的堅尼系數比稅前的堅尼系數高，這意味著 政府增加了給窮人的轉移支付的金額。 該經濟的稅制很可能是累退性的。 收入不均的問題比去年差。 政府應該改革稅制。

questions.en: Which of the following diagrams describe a regressive tax? (1) (2) (3) (4) (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (4) only (3) and (4) only

The following diagram shows the relationship between taxable income and tax payment in a tax system. Which of the following statements about the above tax system is correct? The lower income group pays a smaller percentage of their taxable income as tax payment. It violates the tax principle of equity put forward by Adam Smith. It is a proportional tax. It leads to a more even income distribution.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某稅制中應課稅收入和稅款的關係。 下列哪項有關該稅制的陳述是正確的？ 低收入組別以其應課稅收入中較小的百分比支付該稅款。 它違反了亞當史密夫所提出的公平賦稅原則。 它是一項比例稅。 它令收入分佈更平均。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the relationship between taxable income and tax payment in a tax system. Which of the following statements about the above tax system is correct? The tax system narrows the income gap between the rich and the poor.
