questions.zh: 假設香港政府提高薪俸稅的免稅額 5%，而同年全港工資率與通脹率都上升 10%。結果， 更多人被納入稅網。 納稅人所繳稅款與收入之比會下降。 稅收會增加，而收入分配會更為平均。 除稅後，人民的實質收入維持不變。

questions.en: When the profits tax rate decreases, the government revenue will decrease. the government expenditure will decrease. the incentive of investment will increase. the unemployment rate will increase.
questions.zh: 當利得稅率下降時， 政府收益會下降。 政府支出會下降。 投資意欲會增加。 失業率會上升。

questions.en: If the government of Hong Kong raises the tax allowance on the salaries tax, the income distribution will be more uneven. less people will fall into the tax net. the working incentive of those paying at the standard tax rate will increase. the tax bands will be widened.
questions.zh: 若香港的政府提高薪俸稅的免稅額， 收入分配會更不平均。 較少人會被納入稅網之內。 以標準稅稅率繳稅人士會有更多工作熱誠。 稅階會擴闊。

questions.en: The following graph shows the relationship between tax payment and income before and after a change in the structure of a tax. Compared to the old tax structure, the new tax structure results in a less even income distribution. has a lower tax rate for the same level of income. has a larger tax allowance. has no effect on working incentive.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某稅項在結構改變前後，應繳稅款與收入的關係。 與舊稅制比較， 新稅制導致收入分配較不平均。 在同一收入水平，新稅制的稅率較低。 新稅制的免稅額較大。 新稅制並不影響工作熱誠。

questions.en: Which of the following will widen the tax base of Hong Kong? an increase in the tax allowance a decrease in the standard tax rate an increase in the profits tax rate the introduction of a sales tax
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會擴闊香港的稅基？ 提高免稅額。 降低標準稅率。 提高利得稅率。 開徵銷售稅。

questions.en: If a general sales tax is introduced in Hong Kong, the tax base would be widened. the wealth gap would be reduced. less Hong Kong people would shop in Shenzhen. the proportion of direct tax in the government tax revenue would increase.
questions.zh: 若香港開徵普及銷售稅， 稅基會擴闊。 貧富差距會縮窄。 到深圳購物的港人數目會減少。 直接稅佔政府稅收收益的比例會增加。

questions.en: Suppose the government of an economy cuts the salaries tax allowance by 10% while both the wage rates and the general price level in the year fall by 5%. It follows that the tax revenue would increase. more people would fall into the tax net. the real income of people before tax would generally increase. the ratio of people's tax payment to their nominal income would generally decrease.
questions.zh: 假設某經濟的政府將薪俸稅的免稅額削減 10%，同年工資率及一般物價水平皆下跌 5%。因此， 政府的稅收收益會增加。 較多人會納入稅網之中。 除稅前，市民的實質收入會普遍增加。 市民所繳稅款與其名義收入之比會普遍下降。

questions.en: Suppose the salaries tax allowance in Hong Kong decreases and the salaries of taxpayers remain constant. It results that some taxpayers paying at the standard tax rate may pay at a lower tax rate. the middle-income group would have to pay a larger proportion of their income as tax. less people would fall into the tax net. the after-tax income of all taxpayers would decrease.
questions.zh: 假設香港的薪俸稅免稅額下降，而納稅人的薪酬維持不變，結果 有些以標準稅率納稅的人可能以較低稅率繳稅。 中等收入人士須以他們收入的較大比例繳稅。 較少人跌入稅網中。 全部納稅人的除稅後入息會減少。

questions.en: If the government raises the profits tax rate, the government revenue will increase. the unemployment rate will fall. the incentive for investment will decrease. the general price level will rise.
questions.zh: 若政府提高利得稅稅率，則 政府收益會增加。 失業率會下降。 投資意欲會降低。 一般物價水平會上升。

questions.en: Suppose the government of Hong Kong introduces a general sales tax. It follows that the sales revenue net of tax to the sellers will decrease. there will be a persistent increase in the general price level. income will be redistributed from the rich to the poor. the consumption expenditure of Hong Kong will increase.
questions.zh: 假設香港政府加徵一項普及銷售稅。這會導致 賣家除稅後的銷售收益減少。 一般物價水平持續地上升。 收入從富人轉移至窮人。 香港的消費支出增加。

questions.en: Suppose there is a change in an income tax as follows: Marginal Tax Band Marginal Tax Rate (%) Old System New System First $30 000 taxable income 2.0 2.0 Next $30 000 7.5 8.0 Next $30 000 13.0 14.0 Remainder 18.5 20.0 Under the new system, the ratio of direct tax revenue to indirect tax revenue will decrease. the government will have a budget surplus. more people will fall into the tax net. the income gap will be reduced.
questions.zh: 假設某項入息稅更改如下： 邊際稅率 (%) 舊制 新制 第一個 $30 000 應課稅收入 2.0 2.0 下一個 $30 000 7.5 8.0 下一個 $30 000 13.0 14.0 其餘 18.5 20.0 在新制度下， 直接稅收益與間接稅收益之比會下降。 政府會有財政盈餘。 更多人會被納入稅網。 收入差距會下降。

questions.en: Which of the following government policies would lead to a less even income distribution of Hong Kong citizens? raising the standard tax rate of the salaries tax reducing the personal allowance of the salaries tax raising the profits tax rate lowering the excise tax rate of tobacco and wine
questions.zh: 以下哪一項政府政策會導致本港市民的收入分配更不平均？ 提高薪俸稅的標準稅率。 減少薪俸稅的個人免稅額。 提高利得稅稅率。 降低煙酒的消費稅稅率。

questions.en: The introduction of a general sales tax would lead to inflation. lower output. higher consumption expenditure. higher GDP.
questions.zh: 開徵普及銷售稅會導致 通貨膨脹。 產出下降。 消費支出增加。 本地生產總值增加。

questions.en: Which of the following would widen the tax base of Hong Kong? a reduction in the tax allowance abolition of the first registration tax on motor vehicles an increase in the progressivity of salaries tax an increase in the profits tax rate
questions.zh: 下列哪項會擴闊香港的稅基？ 減少免稅額。 取消汽車首次登記稅。 薪俸稅的累進程度增加。 利得稅稅率增加。

questions.en: In order to increase the competitiveness of Hong Kong, some businessmen propose to reduce the profits tax rate. When the profits tax rate decreases, the foreign exchange and gold reserve of Hong Kong would increase. the investment incentive would increase. the government tax revenue would decrease. the size of the public sector would decrease.
questions.zh: 為了提高香港的競爭力，若干商人建議減低香港的利得稅稅率。若利得稅稅率減低， 香港的外匯及黃金儲備會增加。 投資意欲會增加。 政府稅收收益會下降。 公營部門的規模會縮小。

questions.en: When the government reduces the profits tax rate, the unemployment rate will increase. the investment incentive will increase. the government tax revenue will decrease. the income inequality will be reduced.
questions.zh: 政府降低利得稅稅率會 增加失業率。 增加投資意欲。 減少政府稅收。 減少收入不均。

questions.en: Suppose the salaries tax system of Hong Kong changes as follows: Old System New System Marginal Tax Band Tax Rate (%) Marginal Tax Band Tax Rate (%) First $30 000 taxable income 2.0 First $40 000 taxable income 2.0 Next $30 000 7.0 Next $40 000 7.0 Next $30 000 13.0 Next $40 000 13.0 Remainder 19.0 Remainder 19.0 Standard Rate 16.0 Standard Rate 16.0 Under the new system, with the salaries of all taxpayers unchanged fewer people will fall into the tax net. fewer people will have to pay at the standard rate. the income gap will not be affected. the government will run into a budget deficit.
questions.zh: 假設香港的薪俸稅制改變如下： 舊制 新制 邊際稅階 稅率(%) 邊際稅階 稅率(%) 首 $30 000 可稅收入 2.0 首 $40 000 可稅收入 2.0 其次 $30 000 7.0 其次 $40 000 7.0 再其次 30 000 13.0 再其次 $40 000 13.0 其餘 19.0 其餘 19.0 標準稅率 16.0 標準稅率 16.0 在新稅制下，若全部納稅人薪酬不變，則 更少人會被納入稅網。 更少人須按標準稅率繳稅。 收入差距不會受影響。 政府會有財政赤字。

questions.en: In the financial year of 2008-09, the standard rate of salaries tax was reduced from 16% to 15%. Other things being equal, the above measure would reduce the number of people falling into the tax net. increase the progressivity of the salaries tax system of Hong Kong. increase the consumption expenditure of people in Hong Kong. increase the after tax income of low-income people in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 在2008-09財政年度，薪俸稅的標準稅率由 16% 降至 15% 。若其他因素不變，上述措施會 減少跌入稅網的人數。 增加香港薪俸稅稅制的累進程度。 增加香港人的消費開支。 增加香港低收入人士的除稅後收入。

questions.en: There was a one-off tax reduction up to a maximum of $6 000 on the salaries tax and the tax under personal assessment for 2008-09. This would reduce the income gap between the rich and the poor. narrow the tax base of Hong Kong. increase the working incentive of those paying at the standard tax rate. increase the consumption expenditure of those entitled to the tax reduction.
questions.zh: 在2008-09財政年度，有一項一次過的稅款寬減，薪俸稅稅款或個人入息課稅稅款最高可減免 $6 000。此單會 縮窄貧富之間的收入差距。 縮窄香港的稅基。 提高以標準稅率繳稅人士的工作熱減。 增加可獲稅項寬減人士的消費支出。

questions.en: Suppose in Hong Kong the general price level and the nominal wage rates of workers both increase by 5% in a certain year. Which of the following statements are correct? The real wage rates of workers would remain unchanged. More workers would fall into the tax net. Government tax revenue would increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設香港在某年的一般物價水平及工人的名義工資率皆上升 5%。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 工人的實質工資率會維持不變。 更多工人會被納入稅網。 政府的稅收收益會增加。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: If the government of Hong Kong introduces a general sales tax, the real GDP would increase. inflation would occur. the total consumption expenditure would increase. the tax base would be widened.
questions.zh: 假若香港政府開徵一項普及銷售稅， 實質本地生產總值會增加。 通脹會出現。 總消費支出會增加。 稅基會擴闊。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the change in the salaries tax structure of an economy. Compared to the old salaries tax structure, the new tax structure has a smaller personal allowance. has a lower standard tax rate. will narrow the income gap between the rich and the poor. will widen the tax base.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟薪俸稅制的轉變。 與舊薪俸稅制相比，新稅制 的個人免稅額較少。 的標準稅率較低。 會收窄貧富之間的收入差距。 會擴闊稅基。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the changes in the salaries tax structure of an economy. Compared to the old tax structure, the new tax structure will _______. result in a more even income distribution reduce the work incentive of all workers broaden the tax base lead to an increase in total tax revenue
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟薪俸稅制的轉變。 與舊稅制相比，新稅制會 ________。 令收入分布更平均 減低所有工人的工作意慾 擴闊稅基 令總稅收上升

questions.en: Suppose the salaries tax system in Hong Kong has the following changes: Old system New system Net chargeable income Tax rate Net chargeable income Tax rate First $50 000 2% First $60 000 2% Next $50 000 7% Next $60 000 7% Next $50 000 12% Next $60 000 12% Remainder 17% Remainder 17% Standard rate 15% Standard rate 15% If the basic tax allowance remains unchanged, which of the following is most likely to be a result of the above changes in the tax system? Fewer people will fall into the tax net. Fewer people will have to pay at the standard tax rate. People’s work incentive will decrease. Consumption expenditure will decrease.
questions.zh: 假設本港的薪俸稅制有如下的改變： 舊制 新制 應課稅入息 稅率 應課稅入息 稅率 首 $50 000 2% 首 $60 000 2% 另 $50 000 7% 另 $60 000 7% 另 $50 000 12% 另 $60 000 12% 餘額 17% 餘額 17% 標準稅率 15% 標準稅率 15% 若基本免稅額維持不變，下列哪項最有可能是上述稅制改變的結果？ 更少人會跌入稅網。 更少人須繳付標準稅率。 人們的工作意慾會減少。 消費支出會減少。

questions.en: Both the wage rate and general price level increase by 8% in a certain year. If the government increases the salaries tax allowance by 5%, more people will fall into the tax net. income distribution will become more even. government's tax revenue will decrease. people's real income after tax will increase.
questions.zh: 某年的工資率和一般物價水平均上升 8%。若政府增加薪俸稅免稅額 5%， 更多人會跌入稅網。 收入分佈會變得更平均。 政府的稅收會減少。 人們的稅後實質收入會增加。

questions.en: In 2019, the Japanese government increases the general sales tax rate on most of the goods and services from 8% to 10%. As a result, income inequality will be higher. the fiscal deficit will be eliminated. the invisible trade deficit will decrease. (1) only (2) only (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 在2019年，日本政府調高了向大部分物品和服務所徵收的普及銷售稅，稅率由 8% 調高至 10% 。其結果是， 收入不均會擴大。 財政赤字會消除。 無形貿易赤字會下降。 只有 (1) 只有 (2) 只有 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: In the case WITHOUT tax exemption, John needs to pay $15000 and Mary needs to pay $35000 as income tax. Suppose the government proposes the following income tax exemption measures: Amount of tax exemption Measure I 75% of income tax, maximum $30000 Measure II 100% of income tax, maximum $20000 John will prefer ________ while Mary will prefer ________. measure I ... measure I measure I ... measure II measure II ... measure I measure II ... measure II
questions.zh: 在沒有稅項豁免的情況下，約翰需繳付入息稅 $15000，而瑪莉則需繳付 $35000。假設政府建議以下入息稅的豁免措施： 豁免稅額 措施 I 入息稅的 75%，最高 $30000 措施 II 入息稅的 100%，最高 $20000 約翰會偏好________，而瑪莉會偏好________。 措施 I……措施 I 措施 I……措施 II 措施 II……措施 I 措施 II……措施 II

questions.en: Study the following data about an economy. 2016 2021 Gini coefficient based on post-tax post-social transfer household income 0.398 0.407 Which of the following are possible explanations for the above change from 2016 to 2021? The progressive tax system changed to a regressive one. The tax bands of the progressive salaries tax are widened. The transfer payments provided to the low-income households increased. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 細閱以下有關某經濟的資料。 2016 2021 按除稅及福利轉移後住戶收入計算的堅尼系數 0.398 0.407 以下哪些有可能解釋以上從2016年到2021年的改變？ 稅制由累進稅變成累退稅。 累進薪俸稅的稅階擴闊。 向低收入住戶發放的轉移支付增加。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: The diagram below shows the change in the salaries tax structure of an economy. As a result of the above changes, ______. the tax base will be broadened the income gap between the rich and the poor will be narrowed the total tax revenue of the government will increase (1) only (3) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某經濟薪俸稅制的轉變。 因應上述轉變，______。 稅基會擴闊 貧富之間的收入差距會收窄 政府的總稅收會增加 只有 (1) 只有 (3) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(3)

questions.en: The table below shows the production of two goods in two countries: One unit of resources can produce clothes (units) toys (units) Country X 10 OR 5 Country Y 2 OR 1 Suppose there are no barriers to trade between the two countries. X will export clothes and toys to Y. X will export clothes and import toys from Y. Y will export toys and import clothes from X. Neither country will benefit from their mutual trade.
questions.zh: 下表顯示兩個國家兩種物品的生產： 一單位資源可生產 衣服 (單位) 玩具 (單位) X國 10 或 5 Y國 2 或 1 假設兩國之間沒有貿易障礙。 X 國會向 Y 國出口衣服和玩具。 X 國會向 Y 國出口衣服，並從 Y 國入口玩具。 Y 國會向 X 國出口玩具，並從 X 國入口衣服。 兩國均不會從其相互貿易中獲得利益。

questions.en: The following table shows the number of man-hours required for the production of two goods X and Y in Countries A and B. Country A Country B 1 unit of X 1 man-hour 2 man-hours 1 unit of Y 3 man-hours 4 man-hours According to the principle of comparative advantage, Country A will export X and import Y. Country A will export Y and import X. Country A will import X and Y from Country B. Country A will export Y and import Y to Country B.
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產兩物品 X 和 Y 所需的工時數目。 甲國 乙國 1 單位 X 1 工時 2 工時 1 單位 Y 3 工時 4 工時 根據比較優勢原理， 甲國會出口 X 和入口 Y。 甲國會出口 Y 和入口 X。 甲國會從乙國入口 X 和 Y。 甲國會出口 Y 和入口 Y 往乙國。

questions.en: Suppose in Country A one unit of resources can produce either 1 unit of X or 3 units of Y. If from trade 1 unit of X can exchange for 2 units of Y, Country A will export _______ and gain _______ for each unit of export. X ... 1 unit of Y X ... 1/6 units of Y Y ... 1 unit of X Y ... 1/6 units of X
questions.zh: 設甲國用一單位資源可生產 1 單位 X 或 3 單位 Y。若在對外貿易時 1 單位 X 可換取 2 單位 Y，甲國會出口____及從每單位出口中賺獲____。 X...1 單位 Y X...1/6 單位 Y Y...1 單位 X Y...1/6 單位 X

questions.en: Suppose the output per man-hour of China, Japan and the US are as follows: DVD (units) VCD (unit) China 10 OR 30 Japan 20 OR 20 US 30 OR 50 According to the table, The US has a comparative advantage in producing both goods. The US has a comparative advantage in producing VCDs only. China has a comparative advantage in producing DVDs only. Japan has a comparative advantage in producing DVDs only.
questions.zh: 假設中國、日本和美國的每工時產出如下： DVD 影碟 (單位) VCD 光碟 (單位) 中國 10 或 30 日本 20 或 20 美國 30 或 50 根據上表， 美國生產兩種物品皆有比較優勢。 美國只在生產 VCD 光碟享有比較優勢。 中國只在生產 DVD 影碟享有比較優勢。 日本只在生產 DVD 影碟享有比較優勢。

questions.en: Suppose country X can produce either 200 units of clothing or 400 units of food with all its resources while country Y can produce 150 units of clothing or 275 units of food with all its resources, we can conclude that country X has absolute advantage in the production of both goods. country X has comparative advantage in the production of food. country X has both absolute and comparative advantages in the production of clothing. Both A and B are correct.
questions.zh: 假設X國利用其所有資源可生產200單位衣服或400單位食物，而Y國利用其所有資源可生產150單位衣服或275單位食物。我們可以得出結論： X國在生產兩種物品方面均擁有絕對優勢。 X國在生產食物方面擁有比較優勢。 X國在生產衣服方面同時擁有絕對優勢及比較優勢。 A及B均正確。

questions.en: Good X Good Y Country A 1 2 Country B 3 4 With 1 unit of resources, country A can produce either _______ unit(s) of X or _______ unit(s) of Y while country B can produce either _______ unit(s) of X or _______ unit(s) of Y. 1 … 1/2 … 1/3 … 1/4 1 … 2 … 3 … 4 1 … 1/2 … 1 … 3/4 2 … 1 … 3/4 … 1
Good X Good Y Country A 1 2 Country B 3 4 Both countries will gain from trade if 1 unit of X can be exchanged for 0.5Y 0.6Y 0.75Y 1Y
questions.zh: 物品 X 物品 Y 甲國 1 2 乙國 3 4 若 1 單位 X 可與 ________ 單位 Y 交換，兩國皆可從貿易得益。 0.5 0.6 0.75 1

questions.en: When resources are fully utilized, country A can produce either 20 units of good X or 10 units of good Y and country B can produce either 15 units of good X or 5 units of good Y. Which of the following is correct? Country A has both absolute advantage and comparative advantage in the production of good X. Country A has both absolute advantage and comparative advantage in the production of good Y. Country A has comparative advantage in the production of good Y. Country A has absolute advantage in the production of both good X and good Y.
questions.zh: 當資源被充分利用時，A國可生產20單位物品X或10單位物品Y，而B國可生產15單位物品X或5單位物品Y。以下哪項是正確的？ A國在生產物品X方面同時擁有絕對優勢和比較優勢。 A國在生產物品Y方面同時擁有絕對優勢和比較優勢。 A國在生產物品Y方面擁有比較優勢。 A國在生產物品X和物品Y方面均擁有絕對優勢。

questions.en: The number of workers required to produce one unit of T-shirts or one unit of pants in country A and country B are given below: Country A Country B T-shirts 15 60 Pants 10 X Suppose the mutually beneficial terms of trade for the two countries is that 1 unit of T-shirts can be exchanged for 1.8 units of pants. X could be 30 60 90 120
questions.zh: A 國及 B 國生產一單位 T 恤或一單位長褲所需的工人人數如下： A國 B國 T恤 15 60 長褲 10 X 假設兩國互利的貿易價格比率為 1 單位 T 恤可交換 1.8 單位長褲。X 可以是 30 60 90 120

questions.en: The production cost of 1 unit of food in country X is 3 units of clothing. When country X trades with country Y, it can obtain 1 unit of clothing import by exporting 0.2 units of food. What is country X's total gain from trade if it exports 10 units of food to country Y? 20 units of clothing 30 units of clothing minus 10 units of food 50 units of clothing 50 units of clothing minus 10 units of food
questions.zh: 甲國生產 1 單位食物的機會成本是 3 單位的成衣。當甲國與乙國通商時，它每出口 0.2 單位食物便可換取 1 單位進口成衣。 若甲國出口 10 單位食物往乙國，則甲國的貿易總得益是 20 單位的成衣。 30 單位的成衣減去 10 單位的食物。 50 單位的成衣。 50 單位的成衣減去 10 單位的食物。

questions.en: Good X (Units) Good Y (Units) Total output with no international trade 40 and 60 Total output with specialization and international trade 0 and 110 Total consumption with international trade 50 and 80 After specialization, country A produces ______ units less of good X and ______ units more of good Y. Therefore the opportunity cost of producing 1 unit of good Y is ______ units of good X. 40 ... 50 ... 4/5 40 ... 50 ... 5/4 50 ... 30 ... 3/5 50 ... 30 ... 5/3
questions.zh: 物品 X (單位) 物品 Y (單位) 沒有外貿時的總產量 40 和 60 有外貿及專門生產時的總產量 0 和 110 有外貿時的總消費量 50 和 80 實行專門生產後，甲國生產物品 X 減少了______ 單位和生產物品 Y 增加了 ______ 單位。由此可知，生產一單位物品 Y 的機會成本是 ______ 單位的物品 X。 40 ... 50 ... 4/5 40 ... 50 ... 5/4 50 ... 30 ... 3/5 50 ... 30 ... 5/3

questions.en: Good X (Units) Good Y (Units) Total output with no international trade 40 and 60 Total output with specialization and international trade 0 and 110 Total consumption with international trade 50 and 80 In trading, country A exports ______ units of good Y and imports ______ units of good X. Therefore the terms of trade is ______. 20 ... 10 ... 1 Y = 1/2 X 20 ... 10 ... 1 Y = 2 X 30 ... 50 ... 1 Y = 3/5 X 30 ... 50 ... 1 Y = 5/3 X
questions.zh: 物品 X (單位) 物品 Y (單位) 沒有外貿時的總產量 40 和 60 有外貿及專門生產時的總產量 0 和 110 有外貿時的總消費量 50 和 80 在貿易時，甲國出口 ________ 單位的物品 Y 和進口 ________ 單位的物品 X。故此，交易比率是 ________。 20 ... 10 ... 1 Y = 1/2 X 20 ... 10 ... 1 Y = 2 X 30 ... 50 ... 1 Y = 3/5 X 30 ... 50 ... 1 Y = 5/3 X

questions.en: The following table shows the output of X and Y per unit of resources in countries A and B. Country Goods X (units) Goods Y (units) A 1 OR 3 B 2 OR 4 Which of the following is/are the terms of trade under which trade between the two countries is mutually beneficial? 1 X = 2 Y 1 X = 3 Y 2 X = 5 Y All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國每單位資源產出 X 及 Y 的數量： 物品 國家 X (單位) Y (單位) 甲 1 或 3 乙 2 或 4 下列哪項貿易比率可使兩國從貿易中互利？ 1 X = 2 Y 1 X = 3 Y 2 X = 5 Y 以上答案皆正確。

questions.en: Before trade, the actual output of Country A and Country B with all their resources evenly allocated between the production of Good X and Good Y are shown below: Good X (Units) Good Y (Units) Country A 100 AND 250 Country B 100 AND 50 Which of the following about the two countries is correct? Country B has a comparative advantage in producing Good Y. Country A can produce the same amount of Good Y with fewer resources. Trade between the two countries would not be mutually beneficial if the transportation cost of trading 1 unit of Good X is 2 units of Good Y. Country A would have a larger gain than Country B from each unit of Good X traded.
questions.zh: 通商前，甲國和乙國各自將全部資源平均分配，以生產 X 物品和 Y 物品。兩國的實際產出如下表所示： X 物品(單位) Y 物品(單位) 甲國 100 和 250 乙國 100 和 50 下列哪一項關於上兩國的描述是正確的？ 乙國生產 Y 物品有比較優勢。 甲國可以較少資源生產同一數量的 Y 物品。 若每交易 1 單位 X 物品的運費是 2 單位 Y 物品，則通商不會對兩國都有利。 每交易 1 單位 X 物品，甲國比乙國賺得更多。

questions.en: Before trade, the actual output of Country A and Country B with all their resources evenly allocated between the production of Good X and Good Y are shown below: Good X (Units) Good Y (Units) Country A 100 AND 250 Country B 100 AND 50 Suppose each country has to pay a transportation cost of 0.5 units of Good X in trading 1 unit of Good Y. Which one of the following terms of trade is mutually beneficial? 1Y = 0.5X 1Y = 1X 1Y = 1.5X 1Y = 2X
questions.zh: 通商前，甲國和乙國各自將全部資源平均分配，以生產 X 物品和 Y 物品。兩國的實際產出如下表所示： X 物品(單位) Y 物品(單位) 甲國 100 和 250 乙國 100 和 50 若每交易 1 單位 Y 物品，每國都要付出相等於 0.5 單位 X 物品的運費，則下列哪一項是互利的交易比率？ 1Y = 0.5X 1Y = 1X 1Y = 1.5X 1Y = 2X

questions.en: Both country A and country B produce rice and wine. Suppose country A has ONE unit of resources while country B has TWO units of resources. Each country allocates half of their resources in the production of each product. The amounts of output in country A and country B are shown below. Rice (Units) Wine (Units) Country A 6 AND 9 Country B 10 AND 8 With ONE unit of resources, country A can produce either 6 units of rice or 9 units of wine. country A can produce either 12 units of rice or 18 units of wine. country B can produce either 5 units of rice or 4 units of wine. country B can produce either 10 units of rice or 8 units of wine. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 甲、乙兩國皆生產米和紅酒。假設甲國有1單位資源，乙國有2單位資源。每國用一半資源生產每一種物品。兩國的產出如下： 米 (單位) 紅酒 (單位) 甲國 6 及 9 乙國 10 及 8 以 1 單位資源生產， 甲國可生產 6 單位米或 9 單位紅酒。 甲國可生產 12 單位米或 18 單位紅酒。 乙國可生產 5 單位米或 4 單位紅酒。 乙國可生產 10 單位米或 8 單位紅酒。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Both country A and country B produce rice and wine. Suppose country A has ONE unit of resources while country B has TWO units of resources. Each country allocates half of their resources in the production of each product. The amounts of output in country A and country B are shown below. Rice (Units) Wine (Units) Country A 6 AND 9 Country B 10 AND 8 Which of the following statements is correct? According to the principle of comparative advantage, country A will import wine. According to the principle of comparative advantage, country B will import rice. Country A has an absolute advantage in the production of wine. Country B has an absolute advantage in the production of rice.
questions.zh: 甲、乙兩國皆生產米和紅酒。假設甲國有1單位資源，乙國有2單位資源。每國用一半資源生產每一種物品。兩國的產出如下： 米 (單位) 紅酒 (單位) 甲國 6 及 9 乙國 10 及 8 下列哪一項是正確的？ 根據比較優勢原理，甲國會進口紅酒。 根據比較優勢原理，乙國會進口米。 甲國生產紅酒有絕對優勢。 乙國生產米有絕對優勢。

questions.en: The following table shows the number of man-hours required by Country A and Country B in the production of toys and watches. 1 unit of Toys 1 unit of Watches Country A 1 man-hour 3 man-hours Country B 2 man-hours 4 man-hours Which of the following descriptions are correct? Country A enjoys an absolute advantage in the production of both goods. Country A enjoys an absolute advantage only in the production of toys. Country B enjoys a comparative advantage in the production of toys. Country B enjoys a comparative advantage in the production of watches. (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產玩具和手錶所需的工時數目。 1 單位玩具 1 單位手錶 甲國 1 工時 3 工時 乙國 2 工時 4 工時 下列哪幾項描述是正確的？ 甲國生產兩種物品都享有絕對優勢。 甲國只於生產玩具享有絕對優勢。 乙國生產玩具享有比較優勢。 乙國生產手錶享有比較優勢。 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: The following table shows the number of man-hours required by Country A and Country B in the production of toys and watches. 1 unit of Toys 1 unit of Watches Country A 1 man-hour 3 man-hours Country B 2 man-hours 4 man-hours According to the principle of comparative advantage, when the two countries trade with each other, Country A will export ______ and import ______, and a mutually beneficial terms of trade can be 1 unit of toys equals ______. toys ... watches ... 0.4 units of watches toys ... watches ... 2.5 units of watches watches ... toys ... 0.4 units of watches watches ... toys ... 2.5 units of watches
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產玩具和手錶所需的工時數目。 1 單位玩具 1 單位手錶 甲國 1 工時 3 工時 乙國 2 工時 4 工時 根據比較優勢原理，在兩國貿易時，甲國會出口 ________ 和進口 ________，而一個令兩國皆得益的交易比率可以是 1 單位玩具等於 ________。 玩具 ... 手錶 ... 0.4 單位手錶 玩具 ... 手錶 ... 2.5 單位手錶 手錶 ... 玩具 ... 0.4 單位手錶 手錶 ... 玩具 ... 2.5 單位手錶

questions.en: By using one unit of resources, Country A can produce 10 units of good X or 5 units of good Y. We can then conclude that Country A has a comparative advantage in producing good X. Country A has a comparative advantage in producing good Y. Country A may benefit from exporting good X if the international exchange ratio is 1X = 1Y. Country A may benefit from exporting good Y if the international exchange ratio is 1X = 1Y.
questions.zh: 甲國使用一單位資源可生產 10 單位物品 X 或 5 單位物品 Y。我們可推論 甲國生產物品 X 享有比較優勢。 甲國生產物品 Y 享有比較優勢。 若國際交換比率是 1X = 1Y，甲國有可能因出口物品 X 而得益。 若國際交換比率是 1X = 1Y，甲國有可能因出口物品 Y 而得益。

questions.en: The table below shows the amount of resources required to produce good X and good Y by Country A and Country B respectively. 1 unit of good X 1 unit of good Y Country A 20 units 25 units Country B 10 units 25 units Which of the following can be a mutually beneficial terms of trade? 1X = 0.4Y 1X = 0.5Y 1X = 0.8Y 1X = 0.9Y
questions.zh: 下表分別顯示甲、乙兩國生產物品 X 及物品 Y 所需要的資源數量。 1 單位物品 X 1 單位物品 Y 甲國 20 單位 25 單位 乙國 10 單位 25 單位 下列哪一項是互利的交換比率？ 1X = 0.4Y 1X = 0.5Y 1X = 0.8Y 1X = 0.9Y

questions.en: The following table shows the amount of garments and shoes that country A and country B can produce with ALL of their resources. Garments (units) Shoes (units) Country A 10 OR 30 Country B 10 OR 20 Which of the following statements are correct? Country A has an absolute advantage in producing shoes. According to the principle of comparative advantage, country A will export shoes. Country B would gain from exporting garments if 1 unit of garments can be exchanged for more than 2 units of shoes. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 甲國和乙國以全部資源生產成衣和皮鞋的產量如下： 成衣 (單位) 皮鞋 (單位) 甲國 10 或 30 乙國 10 或 20 下列哪項是正確的？ 甲國生產皮鞋有絕對優勢。 根據比較優勢原理，甲國會出口皮鞋。 若乙國可以 1 單位成衣交換多於 2 單位皮鞋，乙國會從出口成衣中得益。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: The table below shows the amount of labour input required to produce watches and oranges by Country X and Country Y respectively. Watches (units) Oranges (units) Country X 2 man-hours 2 man-hours Country Y 4 man-hours 8 man-hours Based on the above information, ______ has an absolute advantage and ______ has a comparative advantage in producing watches. Country X ... Country X Country X ... Country Y Country Y ... Country X Country Y ... Country Y
questions.zh: 下表分別顯示 X、Y 兩國生產手錶及橙所需的勞力投入數量。 手錶 (單位) 橙 (單位) X 國 2 工時 2 工時 Y 國 4 工時 8 工時 根據以上資料，在手錶生產方面，______享有絕對優勢和______享有比較優勢。 X 國 ... X 國 X 國 ... Y 國 Y 國 ... X 國 Y 國 ... Y 國

questions.en: The following table shows the output per unit of resources in Country A and Country B. Tablet computers (Units) Mobile phones (Units) Country A 8 12 Country B 10 30 If Country A exports 10 units of tablet computers to Country B in exchange for 25 units of mobile phones, the total gains from trade of Country A will be ____________ unit(s) of mobile phones. 1 5 6.667 10
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國每單位資源的產出： 平板電腦（單位） 手提電話（單位） 甲國 8 12 乙國 10 30 若甲國出口 10 單位的平板電腦至乙國，以換取 25 單位的手提電話，甲國的貿易總得益是 ________ 單位的手提電話。 1 5 6.667 10

questions.en: The following table shows the number of toys or clothes that Country A and Country B can produce with one unit of resources. Toys (units) Clothes (units) Country A 10 10 Country B 4 10 If the terms of trade is 2 units of clothes = 1 unit of toys, Country A will gain 5 units of toys per unit of imports. Country A will gain 0.6 units of clothes per unit of exports. Country B will gain 0.5 units of clothes per unit of imports. Country B will export toys and gain 0.6 units of clothes per unit of exports.
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國一單位的資源可生產玩具或成衣的數量。 玩具（單位） 成衣（單位） 甲國 10 10 乙國 4 10 若貿易比率是 2 單位成衣 = 1 單位玩具， 甲國每一單位進口可獲利 5 單位玩具。 甲國每一單位出口可獲利 0.6 單位成衣。 乙國每一單位進口可獲利 0.5 單位成衣。 乙國會出口玩具，每一單位出口可獲利 0.6 單位成衣。

questions.en: The following table shows the number of man-hours required by Country A and Country B in the production of Good X and Good Y. 1 unit of Good X 1 unit of Good Y Country A 10 units 25 units Country B 5 units 15 units Trade is mutually beneficial between Country A and Country B when the terms of trade is _________. 1X = 0.35Y 1X = 0.4Y 1X = 1.25Y 1X = 2.75Y
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產物品 X、Y 時所需的工作時數。 一單位物品 X 一單位物品 Y 甲國 10 單位 25 單位 乙國 5 單位 15 單位 當貿易比率是 ________，甲、乙兩國之間的貿易是互惠互利的。 1X = 0.35Y 1X = 0.4Y 1X = 1.25Y 1X = 2.75Y

questions.en: The following table shows the data about Country A. Petroleum (unit) Rubber (unit) Total output with no international trade 60 and 90 Total output with specialization and international trade 0 and 210 Total consumption with international trade 90 and 120 Which of the following statements about Country A is correct? Country A has both absolute advantage and comparative advantage in producing rubber. The gain from trade of exporting 1 unit of rubber is 1 unit of petroleum. The opportunity cost of producing 1 unit of rubber(R) is 2/3 units of petroleum(P) and the terms of trade is 1R=3/4 P. Country A can benefit from trading with Country B, whose opportunity cost of producing 1 unit of rubber is 2 units of petroleum.
questions.zh: 下表顯示有關甲國的資料。 石油 (單位) 橡膠 (單位) 沒有國際貿易時的總產量 60 和 90 專門化生產並進行國際貿易時的總產量 0 和 210 進行國際貿易後的總消費 90 和 120 下列哪項有關甲國的陳述是正確的？ 甲國生產橡膠有絕對優勢亦有比較優勢。 出口 1 單位橡膠的貿易得益是 1 單位石油。 生產 1 單位橡膠(R)的機會成本是 2/3 單位石油(P)，而貿易比率是 1R = 3 / 4P。 若乙國生產 1 單位橡膠的機會成本是 2 單位石油，甲國可從與乙國貿易得益。

questions.en: Assume the labour input requirements for the production of computers and toys in Japan and Hong Kong are as follows: 1 unit of computers 1 unit of toys Japan 2 man-hours 6 man-hours Hong Kong 4 man-hours 8 man-hours Suppose there is no transportation cost. Which of the following can be the terms of trade so that trade is mutually beneficial to Japan and Hong Kong? 1 unit of computers exchanges for 0.4 units of toys 1 unit of computers exchanges for 0.5 units of toys 1 unit of computers exchanges for 1 unit of toys 1 unit of computers exchanges for 2.5 units of toys
questions.zh: 假設日本和香港生產電腦和玩具須投入的勞力如下所示： 1單位電腦 1單位玩具 日本 2工時 6工時 香港 4工時 8工時 假設沒有運輸費用。要使日本和香港均可從貿易得益，下列哪項是可能的貿易率？ 1單位電腦交換 0.4 單位玩具 1單位電腦交換 0.5 單位玩具 1單位電腦交換 1單位玩具 1單位電腦交換 2.5 單位玩具

questions.en: The following table shows the amount of toys or cars that Country A and Country B can produce with the same amount of resources. Toys Cars Country A 50 or 80 Country B 20 or 60 The transportation cost for 1 unit of toy is 0.4 units of car and it is borne by the importing country. Which of the following is the mutually beneficial terms of trade between Country A and Country B? 1 unit of toy = 1.6 units of car 1 unit of toy = 2 units of car 1 unit of toy = 2.6 units of car 1 unit of toy = 3 units of car

questions.zh: 下表顯示甲國和乙國生產玩具和手錶所需的工時： 每單位玩具 每單位手錶 甲國 4 8 乙國 5 20 假設每單位玩具的運輸成本是 0.1 單位手錶，並且由出口國家負擔。下列哪項是能令甲乙兩國互利的貿易比率？ 1 單位玩具 = 0.3 單位手錶 1 單位玩具 = 0.4 單位手錶 1 單位玩具 = 2.5 單位手錶 1 單位玩具 = 6 單位手錶

questions.en: Both Country A and Country B produce only toys and computers. The table below shows the amount of inputs required by Country A and Country B in the production of toys and computers. 1 unit of toys 1 unit of computers Country A 2 5 Country B 2 2 Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct? Country A has an absolute advantage in the production of computers over Country B. Country B has no comparative advantage in producing any goods as its opportunity cost of producing toys equals that of producing computers. If a transportation cost of 1 unit of computers is required to trade 1 unit of toys, it is impossible to have mutually beneficial trade. It is impossible to have mutually beneficial trade as the two countries have equal productivity in producing toys.
questions.zh: 甲、乙兩國只生產玩具和電腦。下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產玩具和電腦所需的投入數量。 每單位的玩具 每單位的電腦 甲國 2 5 乙國 2 2 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 相對乙國，甲國生產電腦有絕對優勢。 乙國生產兩種物品均沒有比較優勢，因為它生產玩具的機會成本與生產電腦的相等。 若交易1單位玩具需要1單位的電腦作為運輸費用，則互利貿易沒有可能出現。 由於該兩國生產玩具的生產力相等，所以沒有可能出現互利貿易。

questions.en: The following table shows the production and consumption data in Country A, which only produces and consumes clothing (C) and food (F). Clothing (units) Food (units) Total production WITHOUT trade 10 60 Total production with specialisation 60 0 Total consumption with trade 20 120 The terms of trade is ___________. 1C = 2F 1C = 3F 1C = 5F 1C = 6F
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲國的生產和消費數據。該國只生產和消費成衣(C)和食物(F)。 成衣（單位） 食物（單位） 沒有貿易時的總生產量 10 60 專門化生產時的總生產量 60 0 有貿易時的總消費量 20 120 貿易比率是 ________。 1C = 2F 1C = 3F 1C = 5F 1C = 6F

questions.en: The following table shows the amount of apples or peaches that Country A and Country B can produce with one unit of resources. Apples (units) Peaches (units) Country A 100 OR 80 Country B 180 OR 90 According to the above table, which of the following statements are correct? The opportunity cost of producing 1 unit of apples is 0.8 units of peaches in Country A. Country B has an absolute advantage in producing apples. A mutually beneficial terms of trade can be 1 unit of apples = 0.7 units of peaches. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下表顯示甲國和乙國以一單位的資源可生產的蘋果或桃子數量。 蘋果（單位） 桃子（單位） 甲國 100 或 80 乙國 180 或 90 根據上表，下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 甲國生產 1 單位蘋果的機會成本是 0.8 單位桃子。 乙國生產蘋果有絕對優勢。 一個互惠互利的貿易比率可以是 1 單位蘋果 = 0.7 單位桃子。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)及(3)

questions.en: Suppose Country X and Country Y both allocate half of their resources in producing clothing and half in producing toys. Their total output is shown below. Clothing (units) Toys (units) Country X 5 25 Country Y 20 10 Based on the above information, which of the following is/are correct? Country Y enjoys an absolute advantage in producing clothing. Country Y enjoys a comparative advantage in producing clothing. If the transportation cost for importing each unit of clothing is 4 units of toys, mutually beneficial trade is still possible between the two countries. (1) only (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only
questions.zh: 假設 X 國和 Y 國都是分配一半資源生產成衣，而另一半資源則生產玩具。他們的產出總量如下： 成衣（單位） 玩具（單位） X 國 5 25 Y 國 20 10 根據以上資料，下列哪項／些是正確的？ Y 國在生產成衣方面享有絕對優勢。 Y 國在生產成衣方面享有比較優勢。 若進口每單位成衣的運輸成本是 4 單位玩具，兩國之間仍可能出現互利貿易。 只有(1) 只有(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3)

questions.en: Country A employs labour to produce good X and good Y. Its labour input requirements for the production of one unit of good X and good Y are 1 man-hour and 2 man-hours respectively. Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct? Country A will specialise in producing good X because it can produce more units of good X per unit of labour. Country A will export good X because it has a lower opportunity cost in producing good X than good Y. If the terms of trade is 1 unit of good X equals 1 unit of good Y, Country A will gain 1 unit of good X per unit of its imports. If the terms of trade is 1 unit of good X equals 1 unit of good Y, Country A will gain 1 unit of good Y per unit of its exports.
questions.zh: 甲國使用勞力生產物品 X 和物品 Y。該國生產一單位的物品 X 和一單位的物品 Y 須分別投入 1 工時的勞力和 2 工時的勞力。 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 甲國會專門化生產物品 X，因為該國每單位的勞力可生產更多物品 X。 甲國會出口物品 X，因為該國生產物品 X 的機會成本比物品 Y 低。 若貿易比率是 1 單位物品 X 等於 1 單位物品 Y，甲國每一單位進口可獲利 1 單位物品 X。 若貿易比率是 1 單位物品 X 等於 1 單位物品 Y，甲國每一單位出口可獲利 1 單位物品 Y。

questions.en: A country gains from trade because it obtains goods at a lower opportunity cost. It collects tariff revenue. It exports more than it imports. It specializes in producing goods in which it enjoys an absolute advantage.
questions.zh: 一國從貿易中獲益，是因為 它以較低的機會成本獲得物品。 它收取關稅收入。 它的出口多於入口。 它專門生產其享有絕對優勢的物品。

questions.en: Suppose a country has an absolute advantage in good X. Which of the following is correct? It is possible that the country has a higher opportunity cost of producing good X than another country. The country can produce a greater amount of good X than another good with the same amount of resources. The country will also have a comparative advantage in good X. The country will have an absolute disadvantage in another good.
questions.zh: 設某國生產貨品 X 享有絕對優勢。下列哪一項正確？ 該國生產貨品 X 有可能較另一國家的機會成本高。 用同樣資源，該國家生產貨品 X 的數量可比生產另一貨品為多。 該國生產貨品 X 亦會享有比較優勢。 該國生產另一貨品會有絕對劣勢。

questions.en: A country will gain from international trade if it specializes in producing goods in which it enjoys comparative advantage. The price of its exports is higher than that of its imports. The quantity of its exports is greater than the quantity of its imports. The price of its imports is less than the unit cost of producing these goods itself.
questions.zh: 在下列哪一種情況下，一國家會從國際貿易中得益？ 專門生產它享有比較優勢的貨品。 它的出口貨品價格高於入口貨品價格。 它的出口量大於入口量。 它的入口貨品價格低於在本國生產這些貨品的單位生產成本。

questions.en: Which of the following economic principles can best explain why a doctor, who is the fastest typist in town, chooses to employ a typist to do all the typing for him? economics of scale comparative advantage diversification of work law of diminishing returns
questions.zh: 下列哪一個經濟原理最能解釋為何一名城中打字最快的醫生，僱用一名打字員替他做全部打字工作？ 規模經濟 比較優勢 工作多元化 報酬遞減定律

questions.en: The production of good X involves two different tasks. When Mary focuses on one task and Peter on another, their total daily output is greater than that when each of them has to do both tasks. This can be explained by economies of scale. the principle of comparative advantage. the advantages of division of labour. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2), and (3)
questions.zh: 物品 X 的生產過程涉及兩個工序。當秀麗只參與其中一個工序，而小明則只做另外一個工序，兩人的每日總產出，多於他們每人都要做兩個不同的工序的每日總產出。這現象可用下列的原因解釋： 規模經濟 比較優勢原理 分工的好處 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: If Country X can produce the same amount of each good with less resources than Country Y, then there is no favourable terms of trade between Country X and Country Y. Country Y may still produce some goods at a lower opportunity cost. trade can still take place based on absolute advantage. Country X possesses comparative advantage on all goods.
questions.zh: X 國與 Y 國相比，若 X 國在每一種物品的生產上都能用較少資源生產出相同的數量，則 在 X 國與 Y 國之間，並不存在對雙方都有利的交易比率。 Y 國仍可能以較低機會成本生產部分物品。 兩國仍可能基於絕對優勢而通商。 X 國在所有物品上都享有比較優勢。

questions.en: If a country specializes and exports good X, it implies that this country needs to give up less of other goods than other countries in order to produce good X. this country has more resources than other countries for producing good X. this country uses less resources than other countries for producing the same amount of good X. this country can produce good X at a lower cost than other goods.
questions.zh: 若某國專門生產及出口物品 X，這意味著： 與別國比較，該國生產物品 X 可以放棄較少其他物品。 與別國比較，該國有更多資源可以生產物品 X。 與別國比較，該國可用較少資源生產相同數量的物品 X。 與生產其他物品比較，該國可用較低成本生產物品 X。

questions.en: Suppose there are good X and good Y only. If a country has a comparative advantage in good X, it will have an absolute advantage in Y. an absolute disadvantage in Y. a comparative advantage in Y too. a higher opportunity cost in producing Y.
questions.zh: 假設只有物品 X 和物品 Y。若某國生產物品 X 有比較優勢，它生產物品 Y 會有絕對優勢。 會有絕對劣勢。 也會有比較優勢。 的機會成本較高。

questions.en: Suppose Mrs Wong, a sole proprietor of a garment factory, is the best cook in town, but she leaves all the cooking to her domestic helper at home. Which of the following would be correct? The domestic helper has a comparative advantage in cooking. Both Mrs Wong and the domestic helper provide a labour service and receive wages. Complex division of labour is illustrated in this case. Both Mrs Wong and the domestic helper are tertiary producers.
questions.zh: 假設王太是某家成衣廠的獨資擁有者，她的廚藝全城最佳，但她把家中的烹飪工作全都留給女傭去做。下列哪一項會是正確的？ 該女傭在烹飪方面有比較優勢。 王太與該女傭都提供勞力服務及獲取工資。 該個案說明了複雜分工。 王太與該女傭都是第三級生產者。

questions.en: Consider the trade between two countries X and Y, both of which produce garments and computers only. If country X has the comparative advantage in producing garments, then country X produces more garments per unit of resources than country Y. produces better quality garments than country Y. gives up a smaller amount of computers in order to produce a unit of garments than country Y. gains more from their trade than country Y.
questions.zh: 考慮 X、Y 兩國間的貿易，兩者只生產成衣及電腦兩種物品。若 X 國生產成衣有比較優勢，則 X 國 每單位資源可生產成衣數量較 Y 國為多。 所生產成衣的品質較 Y 國爲高。 為了生產一單位成衣所須放棄的電腦數量較 Y 國爲少。 在兩國貿易中的賺獲較 Y 國的爲多。

questions.en: Both countries A and B produce goods X and Y. Under which of the following conditions does country A have a comparative advantage in the production of X? One unit of X can be exchanged for more units of Y in country A than in country B. In producing one unit of X, country A forgoes a smaller amount of Y than country B. The opportunity cost of producing X in country A is smaller than that of Y in country B. The amount of resources used in producing one unit of X is less in country A than in country B.
questions.zh: 甲、乙兩國皆生產物品 X 及 Y。在下列哪一種情況下，甲國生產 X 享有比較優勢？ 一單位 X 在甲國較在乙國可換得更多 Y。 為了生產一單位 X，甲國較乙國放棄較少 Y。 甲國生產 X 的機會成本低於乙國生產 Y 的機會成本。 甲國生產一單位 X 所用的資源數量少於乙國。

questions.en: Comparative advantage determines the _______ between two trading countries. direction of trade terms of trade volume of trade gains from trade
questions.zh: 比較優勢決定兩個貿易國家之間的_______。 貿易方向 貿易價格比率 貿易量 貿易得益

questions.en: Under free trade, a country exports computers and imports cars. Which of the following statements about the country must be correct? The country has an absolute advantage in producing cars. has an absolute advantage in producing computers. has a comparative disadvantage in producing cars. requires less resources to produce each unit of computers.
questions.zh: 在自由貿易下，某國出口電腦和進口汽車。下列哪項對該國的描述必然正確？ 該國生產 汽車有絕對優勢。 電腦有絕對優勢。 汽車有比較劣勢。 每單位電腦所需資源數量較少。

questions.en: If Country X is more productive in producing every good than Country Y, then the two countries may still trade with each other. the gain from trade of Country X will be greater than that of Country Y. Country X will have a lower opportunity cost in producing every good than Country Y. no trade will take place between the two countries.
questions.zh: 若 X 國生產任何物品的生產力都比 Y 國高，則 兩國仍可能會進行貿易。 X 國從貿易中的得益較 Y 國爲多。 X 國生產任何物品的機會成本都比 Y 國低。 兩國不會進行貿易。

questions.en: Which of the following is a necessary condition for mutually beneficial trade between two countries? The two countries have different opportunity costs of producing goods. The two countries have different absolute advantages. There are no transaction costs. All of the above.
questions.zh: 以下哪項是兩國之間進行互惠貿易的必要條件？ 兩國生產貨品的機會成本不同。 兩國擁有不同的絕對優勢。 沒有交易費用。 以上皆是。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about international trade is correct if transportation cost increases? The price of exported goods will increase if the exporting country has to bear the transportation costs. The net gains from trade of the trading partners will remain unchanged as long as trade continues. Comparative advantages will disappear if the transportation costs are higher than the total gains from trade. Mutually beneficial trade is possible only if the transportation costs are lower than the total gains from trade.
questions.zh: 若運輸費用增加，下列哪一項對國際貿易的描述是正確的？ 若出口國要負擔運輸費，出口貨品的價格會增加。 若貿易夥伴繼續通商，他們從貿易中獲得的淨收益會維持不變。 若運輸費用高於貿易總得益，比較優勢會消失。 只有當運輸費用低於貿易總得益，才有可能出現互利的貿易。

questions.en: The comparative advantage determines the pattern of international division of labour. the terms of trade among the trading countries. the volume of exports and imports of the trading countries. the gains from trade of the trading countries.
questions.zh: 比較優勢決定 國際分工的模式。 貿易國之間的貿易價格比率。 貿易國的出口及入口量。 貿易國的貿易得益。

questions.en: Country A is said to have a comparative advantage over Country B in producing good X when Country A produces a greater amount of good X than Country B with all their resources Country A gives up a smaller amount of other goods than Country B in producing 1 unit of good X Country A's total output of good X is higher than Country B's total output of good X Country A requires a greater amount of resources to produce 1 unit of good X than Country B
questions.zh: 在下列哪種情況下，與乙國相比，甲國享有生產物品 X 的比較優勢？ 若以全部資源來生產，甲國較乙國生產更多數量的物品 X。 若生產 1 單位物品 X，甲國較乙國犧牲較少數量的其他物品。 甲國的物品 X 總產量高於乙國的物品 X 總產量。 若生產 1 單位物品 X，甲國較乙國需要使用更多數量的資源。

questions.en: If Country X is more productive in producing every good than Country Y, the gain from trade of Country X will be greater than that of Country Y. mutually beneficial trade between the two countries is still possible. Country Y will import every good from Country X instead of producing these goods by itself. Country X may have a lower opportunity cost in producing every good than Country Y.
questions.zh: 若 X 國在生產每種貨品上的生產力都比 Y 國高， X 國的貿易得益將大於 Y 國。 兩國之間互惠互利的貿易仍然可能。 Y 國將會從 X 國入口所有貨品，而非自行生產這些貨品。 X 國在生產每種貨品上的機會成本可能比 Y 國低。

questions.en: Assume both Country A and Country B produce and consume Good X and Good Y only. If Country A can produce a unit of Good X with less resources than Country B, Country A has an absolute advantage in producing Good X. Country A has a comparative advantage in producing Good X. Country B has an absolute advantage in producing Good Y. Country B has a comparative advantage in producing Good Y. (1) only (1) and (2) only (2) and (4) only (1), (2), (3) and (4)
questions.zh: 假設甲、乙兩國只生產及消費物品 X 及物品 Y。若甲國比乙國可用較少資源生產一單位的物品 X， 甲國生產物品 X 有絕對優勢。 甲國生產物品 X 有比較優勢。 乙國生產物品 Y 有絕對優勢。 乙國生產物品 Y 有比較優勢。 只有 (1) 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (2)、(4) (1)、(2)、(3) 及 (4)

questions.en: Consider the trade of a good between two countries. Suppose we know their opportunity costs of producing the good. Without knowing the terms of trade, we can determine the possible range of the terms of trade. the gain of each country from trading one unit of the good. the total gain of both countries from trading one unit of the good. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 兩國對某物品進行貿易。假設我們知道兩國各自生產該物品的機會成本，在不知道貿易比率的情況下，我們可以判斷 貿易比率的可能範圍。 兩國交易一單位該物品各自的得益。 兩國交易一單位該物品的總得益。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A country has an absolute advantage in producing good X. Which of the following statements about the country is correct? The country can produce a greater amount of good X than another good with the same amount of resources. The country has a comparative advantage in producing good X. The country has an absolute disadvantage in producing another good. The country may import good X from the international market.
questions.zh: 某國生產物品 X 擁有絕對優勢。下列哪項有關該國的陳述是正確的？ 運用相同數量的資源，該國可生產的物品 X 數量較另一種物品多。 該國生產物品 X 擁有比較優勢。 該國生產另一種物品有絕對劣勢。 該國可能從國際市場進口物品 X。

questions.en: A country has a comparative advantage in producing good X. Which of the following statements about the country is correct? With the same amount of resources, it can produce more of good X than another good. Its output of good X is higher than other countries. It requires a smaller amount of resources to produce one unit of good X than other countries. It gives up a smaller amount of another good than other countries in producing one unit of good X.
questions.zh: 某國擁有生產物品 X 的比較優勢。下列哪項有關該國的陳述是正確的？ 運用相同數量的資源，該國可生產的物品 X 數量較另一種物品多。 該國物品 X 的產量較其他國家高。 在生產一單位的物品 X 時，該國所需的資源較其他國家少。 在生產一單位物品 X 時，該國放棄另一種物品的數量較其他國家少。

questions.en: Country A prefers to impose quotas rather than tariffs in restricting the amount of imports. Which of the following is a possible reason? The government wants to increase its revenue. The effect of quotas on the amount of imports will be more certain. Local consumers can enjoy cheaper imports. It will lead to less retaliation from the exporting countries.
questions.zh: 甲國認為採用配額比採用關稅來限制入口數量較為適當。下列哪一項是這種想法的可能原因？ 政府希望增加稅收。 配額對入口數量有較明確的影響。 本地消費者可享用較廉價的入口。 可減低出口國對甲國的報復。

questions.en: If a country imposes a per-unit tariff on its imported computers and reduces the quantity of imported computers by half, the tariff revenue of the country will increase. the demand for domestically-produced computers will increase. the balance of trade will improve. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 若一個國家對入口電腦徵收從量關稅，令入口電腦的數量減半，則 該國的關稅收益會增加。 本土生產的電腦的需求會增加。 貿易差額會改善。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(3) 只有(2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: A major difference between a quota and a tariff on imports lies in their effects on the price of imports. the quantity of imports. domestic production of import substitutes. wealth redistribution.
questions.zh: 入口配額與關稅的主要區別，在於它們對以下哪項的影響？ 入口貨物的價格。 入口貨物的數量。 入口代替品的本地生產。 財富再分配。

questions.en: A small country imposes tariffs on good X. Suppose the demand of the country for good X increases, the government revenue from tariffs will increase. the price of good X in the country will rise. the consumption of good X in the country will increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 一個細小國家對貨品 X 徵收關稅。假設該國對貨品 X 的需求增加， 來自關稅的政府收入將會增加。 該國貨品 X 的價格將會上升。 該國對貨品 X 的消費將會增加。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: If a country reduces a per-unit tariff on its imported garments, the quantity of imported garments would decrease. local consumers’ expenditure on imported garments would increase. the sales revenue of domestic garment producers would decrease. the tariff revenue of the country coming from imported garments would decrease.
questions.zh: 若某國減低徵收進口成衣的從量關稅，則該國 進口成衣的數量會減少。 本地消費者在進口成衣方面的支出會增加。 本地成衣生產者的銷售收益會減少。 從進口成衣所收取的關稅收益會減少。

questions.en: Consider a country imposing a quota on an import. The diagram below shows the country's supply of and demand for the good. If the quota raises the domestic price of the good from Pw to Pw’, total loss in consumer surplus is equal to the sum of areas 1, 2 and 3. total quota rent is equal to area 3. total deadweight loss is equal to area 4. None of the above.
questions.zh: 考慮某國家對某一入口物品實施配額。下圖顯示該國對該物品的供應及需求。 若該配額將該物品的國內價格由 Pw 提高至 Pw’， 消費者盈餘的總損失相等於面積 1、2 及 3 的總和。 總配額租值相等於面積 3。 總效率損失相等於面積 4。 以上皆非。

questions.en: A country imposes a tariff on good X. Which of the following will be a result of the tariff? The domestic production of good X will decrease. The domestic price of good X will increase. Total expenditure on the import of good X will decrease. The quantity of import of good X will increase.
questions.zh: 某國對物品 X 徵收關稅。以下哪項會是該關稅的結果？ 物品 X 的本地生產將會減少。 物品 X 的本地價格將會上升。 物品 X 的入口總開支將會減少。 物品 X 的入口數量將會增加。

questions.en: Consider a small open economy with an import quota imposed on a good. If the domestic cost of production for the good increases, the domestic price of the good will rise. the quantity of the good consumed domestically will fall. the quantity of the good produced domestically will remain unchanged. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 考慮一個對某物品設有入口配額的小型開放經濟。若該物品的本地生產成本增加， 該物品的本地價格將會上升。 該物品的本地消費量將會減少。 該物品的本地生產量將維持不變。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (3) 只有 (2) 及 (3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Which of the following is an advantage of imposing a quota instead of imposing a tariff on imports? The quantity of imports can be more effectively controlled. The value of imports can be more effectively reduced. Local consumers can buy imported goods at a lower price. There is less chance of facing retaliation from trading partners.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是向進口實施配額限制而非徵收關稅的一項好處？ 進口數量能更有效地受到控制。 進口價值能更有效地減少。 本地消費者可以較低價格購買進口貨。 遭到貿易夥伴報復的機會較低。

questions.en: Suppose a country imposes a quota on an imported good. The diagram below shows the country's supply of and demand for the good. If the quota raises the domestic price of the good from Pw to P1 the decrease in consumer surplus is area a. the increase in local producer surplus is area a. the decrease in total expenditure is the sum of areas b, c and d. the quota rent earned by the government is the sum of areas b, c and d.
questions.zh: 假設某國對某種入口貨品實施配額。下圖顯示該國對該貨品的供應和需求。 若該配額將該貨品的本地價格由 Pw 提高至 P1， 消費者盈餘的減少為面積 a。 本地生產者盈餘的增加為面積 a。 總支出的減少為面積 b、c 和 d 的總和。 政府所得的配額租值為面積 b、c 和 d 的總和。

questions.en: If a small country reduces the tariff rate of its imported good X, the local producers will reduce their production. the producer surplus of the local producers will increase. the tariff revenue of the government will decrease. the world price of good X will decrease and its import volume in the country will increase.
questions.zh: 若一小國減低其入口貨品 X 的關稅稅率， 本地生產者將會減少其生產。 本地生產者的生產者盈餘將會增加。 政府的關稅收入將會減少。 貨品 X 的國際價格將會下降，而該國對其入口量將會增加。

questions.en: Suppose a country imposes a tariff on an import. The diagram below shows the country's supply of and demand for the good. If the domestic price of the good increases from Pw to Pw’ as a result of the tariff, the total deadweight loss is equal to area 4. the total loss in consumer surplus is equal to the sum of areas 2, 3 and 4. the increase in producer surplus is equal to area 1. the effect on consumer and producer surpluses is uncertain.
questions.zh: 假設某國家對一項入口物品徵收關稅。下圖顯示該國對該物品的供應和需求。 若因徵收關稅，該物品的國內價格由 Pw 上升至 Pw’， 總效率損失等於區域 4。 消費者盈餘的總損失等於區域 2、3 及 4 的總和。 生產者盈餘的增加等於區域 1。 對消費者和生產者盈餘的影響是不確定的。

questions.en: If a small open economy reduces the tariff on an imported good, both domestic production and consumption of the good will increase. both tariff revenue and import volume will decrease. the consumer surplus will increase while the producer surplus will decrease. the world price of the good will fall while the total social surplus will increase.
questions.zh: 若某小型開放經濟減低一進口物品的關稅， 該物品的本地生產量和消費量均會增加。 關稅收益和進口量均會減少。 消費者盈餘會增加，而生產者盈餘則會減少。 該物品的全球價格會下跌，而總社會盈餘則會增加。

questions.en: The following diagram shows the imposition of an import tariff on a good in a small open economy. After the imposition of the tariff, which of the following statements about the good in this economy is INCORRECT? The volume of imports is (Q₃ – Q₂) units. The domestic consumption is Q₃ units. The increase in producer surplus of the domestic producers is area a. The total amount of tariff is the sum of areas b, c and d.
questions.zh: 下圖顯示一小型開放經濟對某物品開徵進口關稅。 在這經濟開徵進口關稅後，下列哪項有關該物品的陳述是不正確的？ 進口物品的數量為 Q3 – Q2 單位。 本地消費量為 Q3 單位。 本地生產商生產者盈餘的增加為面積 a。 關稅總額為面積 b、c、d 之和。

questions.en: The supply curve of a certain good is upward-sloping in a small open economy. What is the main difference between imposing an effective import quota and a tariff on the good? Imposing an effective import quota will lower the volume of import while imposing a tariff will not. Imposing an effective import quota will result in a rise in consumer surplus of the good while imposing a tariff may not. Imposing a tariff will raise the world price of the good while imposing an effective import quota will not. Imposing a tariff will result in an increase in the government revenue while imposing an effective import quota may not.
questions.zh: 在一個小型開放經濟內某物品的供應曲線是向右上斜的。對該物品實施有效進口配額和徵收關稅的主要分別是什麼？ 實施有效進口配額會降低進口量，而徵收關稅則不會。 實施有效進口配額會令該物品的消費者盈餘上升，而徵收關稅可能不會。 徵收關稅會提高該物品的國際價格，而實施有效進口配額則不會。 徵收關稅會令政府收入增加，而實施有效進口配額可能不會。

questions.en: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram about Good X in a small country. The country has imposed an import quota on Good X and the price and quantity transacted are P0 and Q0 respectively. If the demand for Good X in the country increases, the import volume will increase. the price of Good X in the country will increase. the quantity sold of Good X in the country will increase. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 參閱以下有關某小國物品 X 的供需圖。 該國對物品 X 實施進口配額，而價格和交易量分別是 P0 和 Q0。若物品 X 在該國的需求上升， 進口量會上升 物品 X 在該國的價格會上升 物品 X 在該國的銷量會上升 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: A small open economy increases the import quota for Good X. Which of the following diagrams best illustrates the effect of this change?
questions.zh: 某小型開放經濟增加對物品X的入口配額。下列哪圖最能說明該轉變的影響？

questions.en: The following diagram shows an imposition of import tariff on a good of a small open economy. Referring to the above diagram, which of the following statements are correct after the imposition of import tariff(t)? The total amount of tariff received by the government is $105. The revenue of domestic producers will increase by $110. The volume of imports drops by 15 units. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下圖顯示一小型開放經濟對某物品徵收進口關稅的情況。 參考上圖，在徵收進口關稅 (t) 後，下列哪些陳述是正確的？ 政府收取的關稅總金額是 $105。 本地生產商的收入會上升 $110。 進口數量下降 15 單位。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: The following is the supply-demand diagram of Good X in a small open economy. Initially the economy imports Good X at the world price Pw and the government imposes an import quota of (Q2 – Q1) units. Suppose the world price of Good X drops. Which of the following statements is correct? The domestic price of Good X will remain atPw The domestic price of Good X will fall. The domestic supply curve will shift to the right. The quantity of domestically produced Good X will increase.
questions.zh: 以下是某小型開放經濟中物品 X 的供需圖。 原初該經濟以國際價格 (Pw) 進口物品 X，而政府實施的進口配額為 (Q2 – Q1) 單位。假設物品 X 的國際價格下跌。下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 物品 X 的本地價格會維持在 Pw。 物品 X 的本地價格會下跌。 本地供應曲線會向右移。 本地所生產的物品 X 的數量會增加。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market situation of Good X in a small open economy. P0 is the price before trade and P1 is the price after trade. Which of the following statements about Good X are correct after the economy opens up for international trade? The total expenditure on Good X of domestic consumers would be P1 x Qd The value of domestically produced Good X would be P1 x Qs The shortage of Good X would be (Qd – Qs) (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 下圖顯示在某小型開放經濟中物品X的市場情況。 P0 是貿易前的價格，而 P1 是貿易後的價格。在該經濟開放國際貿易後，下列哪些有關物品X的陳述是正確的？ 本地消費者對物品X的總支出會是 P1 x Qd。 本地生產物品X的價值會是 P1 x Qs。 物品X的短缺會是 Qd - Qs。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose the world price of soybeans is $20. A small open economy imposes a per-unit tariff of $5 on imported soybeans. The diagram below shows the economy's supply and demand curves of soybeans. Which of the following statements about soybeans is correct? The total revenue of domestic producers is $400 after the imposition of tariff. The total import value inclusive of tariff is $500. If the tariff is raised to $15, this economy will become an exporter of soybeans. If the tariff is abolished, the total import value will be $400.
questions.zh: 假設大豆的國際價格是 $20。某小型開放經濟對進口大豆徵收從量關稅 $5。下圖顯示該經濟的大豆的供應和需求曲線。 下列哪項有關大豆的陳述是正確的？ 在徵收關稅後，本地生產商的總收入是 $400。 包括關稅在內的進口總值是 $500。 若關稅調高至 $15，該經濟會變成大豆出口國。 若取消關稅，進口總值會是 $400。

questions.en: The diagram below is about a small open economy imposing an import quota on Good X. If the world price of Good X drops, the quota will become ineffective. the quantity of Good X produced domestically will decrease. the quantity of Good X consumed domestically will increase. the domestic price of Good X will remain unchanged.
questions.zh: 下圖是關於某個對物品 X 實施進口配額的小型開放經濟體。 若物品 X 的世界價格下降， 該配額會變得無效。 物品 X 的本地生產數量會下降。 物品 X 的本地消費數量會上升。 物品 X 的本地價格會維持不變。

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market of Good X in a small open economy. The economy has imposed a per unit tariff on Good X. If the world price of Good X decreases, _______. the tariff revenue of Good X will remain unchanged the domestic price of Good X will increase the quantity of Good X consumed domestically will remain unchanged the quantity of Good X produced domestically will decrease
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某小型開放經濟中物品 X 的市場。該經濟對物品 X 徵收了從量關稅。 若物品 X 的世界價格下降，________。 物品 X 的關稅收入會維持不變 物品 X 的本地價格會上升 物品 X 的本地消費量會維持不變 物品 X 的本地生產量會下降

questions.en: The diagram below shows the market of Good X in a small open economy. A per-unit tariff is imposed on Good X in the economy. If the world price of Good X increases, __________. the domestic price of Good X will remain unchanged the import value net of tariff of Good X will increase the quantity of Good X produced domestically will increase the tariff revenue of Good X may increase
questions.zh: 下圖顯示某小型開放經濟中物品X的市場，該經濟向物品X徵收從量關稅。 假如物品X的世界價格上升，______。 物品X的本地價格會維持不變 物品X除稅後的進口總值會上升 物品X的本地生產量會上升 物品X的關稅收入可能上升

questions.en: A small open economy has imposed an effective quota on imported red wine. If the world price of red wine decreases, _____. the volume of red wine imported by the economy will increase the quantity of red wine domestically produced in the economy will increase the quantity of red wine consumed in the economy will remain unchanged the price of red wine sold in the economy will decrease
questions.zh: 某小型開放經濟一直對進口紅酒實施有效配額。若紅酒的國際價格下降，____。 該經濟的紅酒進口量會上升 該經濟的本地紅酒生產量會上升 該經濟的紅酒消費量會維持不變 該經濟中銷售的紅酒的價格會下降

questions.en: A small open economy has imposed an effective import quota on wheat. If the domestic production cost of wheat decreases, _____. the quantity of wheat produced domestically will increase the import quantity of wheat will increase the domestic price of wheat will decrease the world price of wheat will decrease (1) and (3) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (2) and (4) only
questions.zh: 某小型開放經濟對小麥實施一項有效進口配額。若小麥的本地生產成本下降，______。 小麥的本地生產量會上升 小麥的進口量會上升 小麥的本地價格會下降 小麥的世界價格會下降 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (2)、(4)

questions.en: Which of the following will have favourable effects on the current account of Hong Kong’s balance of payments? A Japanese tourist spends a day in the Ocean Park. An American bank sets up a representative office in Hong Kong. The Hong Kong government buys a computer system from the U.S.A. A Hong Kong resident receives dividends from his U.S. stocks. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪項會對香港國際收支平衡的經常帳產生有利影響？ 一名日本旅客在海洋公園遊玩一天。 一間美國銀行在香港設立代表處。 香港政府向美國購買電腦系統。 一名香港居民收取其美國股票的股息。 只有 (1) 及 (2) 只有 (1) 及 (4) 只有 (2) 及 (3) 只有 (3) 及 (4)

questions.en: The rental income earned from a property in Canada and remitted to Hong Kong by a Hong Kong citizen is included in the GDP of Hong Kong. has a favourable effect on Hong Kong's balance of visible trade. has a favourable effect on Hong Kong's balance of payment. is taxable in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 香港市民從加拿大物業中賺取的租金收入在匯返香港後 包括在香港的本地生產總值之內。 對香港的有形貿易平衡有利。 對香港的收支平衡有利。 須在香港繳稅。

questions.en: Answer Questions 39 and 40 by referring to the following data of an economy in a certain year: $ million Private consumption expenditure 40 Government consumption expenditure 10 Gross domestic fixed capital formation 10 Change in stocks 1 Total exports of goods 80 Domestic exports 70 Re-exports 10 Imports of goods 60 Exports of services 20 Imports of services 30 Inflow of capital 30 Outflow of capital 15 The balance of payments of the economy in that year is $10 million. $15 million. $20 million. $25 million.

questions.en: Which of the following has a favorable effect on the current account on Hong Kong's balance of payments? A Macau citizen leaves Hong Kong by using the service provided by a Hong Kong hydrofoil company. A businessman from Mainland China invests in the real estate market in Hong Kong. A local bank pays interest to an overseas depositor. A company in mainland china issues shares in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項對本港國際收支帳項中的經常帳有利？ 一位澳門市民使用本港汽墊船公司的服務離開香港。 一位中國商人在本港地產市場投資。 一間本地銀行支付利息予一位海外存款客戶。 一間中國公司在本港發行股票。

questions.en: Mr. Chan, who is an imported worker in Hong Kong, remits his income to his family in China. Which of the following statements is correct? Mr. Chan’s income is included in Hong Kong’s GNP. The remittance has an unfavorable effect on Hong Kong’s balance of visible trade. The remittance has a favorable effect on Hong Kong’s balance of invisible trade. The remittance has favorable effect on China’s balance of payments.
questions.zh: 陳先生是本港一位輸入勞工，他將收入匯給在中國的家人。下列哪一項正確？ 陳先生的收入包括在本港國民生產總值內。 該筆匯款對本港有形貿易差額不利。 該筆匯款對本港無形貿易差額有利。 該筆匯款對中國國際收支有利。
