questions.zh: 細閱下列某經濟體系的國際收支帳： 百萬元 貨物及服務出口 2,800 貨物及服務進口 3,200 流入資金 Z 流出資金 700 外匯及黃金儲備的增加 40 Z 值是 260。 340。 1,060。 1,140。

questions.en: If an American tourist gives money to local beggars, Hong Kong’s GDP will _______ and its balance of payments will _______. increase ... be improved increase ... remain unchanged remain unchanged ... be improved remain unchanged ... remain unchanged
questions.zh: 若一美國遊客施捨金錢予本地一些乞丐，香港的本地生產總值____，而國際收支____。 會增加...會改善 會增加...維持不變 維持不變...會改善 維持不變...維持不變

questions.en: Which of the following will worsen the balance of payments but not the balance of trade of Hong Kong? A Japanese pop singer cancelled his concerts in Hong Kong. A charity organization in Hong Kong reduces its donations to Mainland China. U.S. businessmen reduced their investment in Hong Kong. Re-export from Hong Kong to mainland China decreased.
questions.zh: 下列哪一事項不會使香港的貿易差額變壞，但卻會使它的國際收支差額變壞？ 一名日本流行歌手取消他在香港舉行的音樂會。 香港某慈善機構減少對中國大陸的捐款。 美國商人減少在香港投資。 香港輸往中國大陸的轉口減少。

questions.en: Which of the following is favorable to the capital account of Hong Kong’s balance of payments? An American firm buys some certificates of deposit issued by a bank in Hong Kong. An American firm donates money to a charitable organization in Hong Kong. A Hong Kong firm buys a hotel in Canada. A Hong Kong firm receives interest and dividends from its investment in the U.S.A.
questions.zh: 下列哪一事項對香港國際收支帳中的資本帳有利？ 美國一廠商購買香港某銀行發行的存款證。 美國一廠商捐款予香港某慈善機構。 香港一廠商在加拿大購買一間酒店。 香港一廠商從投資美國賺獲利息和股息。

questions.en: Which of the following will produce a favourable effect on the balance of payments of Country A? The citizens of Country A increase their investment abroad. The government of Country A abolishes the tariffs on imports. The citizens of Country A receive interest from the US government bonds they hold. The government of Country A pays for the service of a foreign consultant firm.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項會對甲國的國際收支差額有利？ 甲國國民增加在外國的投資。 甲國政府取消徵收入口關稅。 甲國國民從他們所持有的美國政府債券收取利息。 甲國政府支付費用予外國顧問公司。

questions.en: Which of the following is an invisible export in Hong Kong’s balance of payments accounts? A Japanese firm buys shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. A Hong Kong citizen buys tickets from Japanese airlines. A Hong Kong citizen remits money to his son in Japan. A Japanese tourist consults a local doctor in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項是香港國際收支帳中的一項無形出口？ 一間日本公司在香港股市購買股票。 一位香港市民購買日本的航空公司的機票。 一位香港市民匯錢給他在日本的兒子。 一位日本遊客在香港向一位本地醫生求診。

questions.en: The following information shows the trade statistics of an economy in a certain year: $ million Domestic export of goods 30 Re-exports 40 Import of goods 50 Export of services 60 Import of services 80 According to the above data, the economy has a visible trade surplus. has a visible trade deficit. has no visible trade surplus or visible trade deficit. There is not enough information to obtain the answer.
questions.zh: 以下資料顯示某年某經濟的貿易數據： $百萬元 本地貨物出口 30 轉口 40 貨物進口 50 服務輸出 60 服務輸入 80 根據以上資料，該經濟的有形貿易 順差。 逆差。 不是順差，亦非逆差。 沒有足夠資料找出答案。

questions.en: Being a Hong Kong resident, Mr Wong earns a living in Hong Kong. He gets married to Mei-ling who lives in Mainland China. Which of the following events will NOT affect the balance of payments of Hong Kong? He buys a wedding ring in Hong Kong and takes it to her by himself. He remits a sum of money as the betrothal gifts (聘禮) through a bank to Mei-ling’s parents. He pays for the honeymoon trip to Thailand. He rents a residential apartment for her in Shenzhen.
questions.zh: 王先生是一位香港居民。他在香港工作，賺取收入。他與在中國內地居住的美玲結為夫婦。下列哪一項對香港的國際收支並無影響？ 他在香港購買結婚戒指，親自送給美玲。 他經銀行匯一筆款項給美玲的父母作為聘禮。 他支付往泰國度蜜月的旅費。 他在深圳租賃一個住宅單位給美玲居住。

questions.en: Which of the following is NOT included in the calculation of the balance of Hong Kong's current account? the investment of a U.S. company in a Hong Kong computer firm Japanese cars sold in Hong Kong a drama performance attended by the tourists in Hong Kong the exports of China handled in the container port of Hong Kong
questions.zh: 在計算香港的經常帳差額時，下列哪一項並不包括入計算之內？ 某美國公司對香港一間電腦公司的投資。 在香港銷售的日本汽車。 遊客在香港所觀看的一場戲劇表演。 利用香港貨櫃港口設施所處理的中國出口貨物。

questions.en: Suppose country A has a balance of payments deficit in Year 1. In Year 2, the changes in the balance of payments are as shown below: $ Billion Export of goods +28 Export of services +7 Import of goods +35 Import of services +13 Capital inflows +5 Capital outflows +8 Based on the above information, we can conclude that in Year 2, the visible trade deficit has increased. in Year 2, the visible trade deficit has decreased. in Year 2, the balance of payments deficit has increased. in Year 2, the balance of payments deficit has decreased.
questions.zh: 假設甲國在第 1 年有國際收支赤字。在第 2 年，國際收支項目的變動如下所示： 以十億元為單位 貨物出口 +28 服務輸出 +7 貨物進口 +35 服務輸入 +13 資金流入 +5 資金流出 +8 根據以上資料，我們可得結論如下： 有形貿易赤字在第 2 年上升了。 有形貿易赤字在第 2 年下降了。 國際收支赤字在第 2 年上升了。 國際收支赤字在第 2 年下降了。

questions.en: Which of the following should be included in the calculation of the balance of Hong Kong's current account? A company in Hong Kong pays interests for loans from a bank in the U.K. A Hong Kong resident purchases a new flat in Shenzhen. A U.S. investor purchases 5 000 units of the Tracker Fund of Hong Kong. An author in Hong Kong sells the copyright for his new book to a publisher in Taiwan.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項應包括入香港經常帳差額的計算之內？ 一家香港公司向英國某銀行借款所支付的利息。 一名香港居民在深圳購置一層新樓。 一名美國投資者購買 5 000 個單位盈富基金。 一名香港作家售賣他一本新書的版權予一名台灣出版商。

questions.en: Hong Kong's Balance Of Payments Account $ million Current Account 72 000 Goods -25 000 Services 81 000 Factor income 27 000 Current transfers -11 000 Capital and Financial Account -76 000 Net errors and omissions 4 000 Total sum = 0 According to the above data, the visible trade deficit is $25 000 million. the invisible trade surplus is $81 000 million. the balance of payments account is in balance. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 香港國際收支平衡表 百萬元 經常帳 72 000 貨物 -25 000 服務 81 000 要素收益 27 000 經常轉移 -11 000 資本及金融帳 -76 000 淨誤差及遺漏 4 000 總額 = 0 根據上表資料， 有形貿易赤字是 25 000 百萬元。 無形貿易盈餘是 81 000 百萬元。 該國際收支平衡表達致平衡。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: Which of the following should be included in the calculation of the balance of Hong Kong's current account? A Hong Kong resident buys a life insurance policy from an insurance company in the US. A company in Hong Kong purchases the copyright of a film from a British film producer. A Hong Kong resident purchases a house in the US. A Hong Kong investor buys a number of shares of a listed company in the US.
questions.zh: 在計算香港的經常帳時，下列哪一項應包括入內？ 一位香港居民向美國一家保險公司購買了人壽保險。 香港一家公司從一家英國製片商購入一套影片的版權。 一位香港居民購買一所在美國的房子。 一位香港投資者購買在美國的一家上市公司的股票。

questions.en: Refer to the data of an economy in a certain year below: $ Billion Domestic export of goods 20 Imports of goods 50 Visible trade balance -5 The re-exports (in $ billion) are 15 25 30 35
questions.zh: 參閱以下某經濟在某年的資料： $10 億 本地出口貨物 20 進口貨物 50 有形貿易差額 -5 其轉口(以 10 億元為單位)為 15 25 30 35

questions.en: According to the above diagram, from Year 4 to Year 6, the economy has suffered from visible trade deficit. the value of import of goods has decreased. the value of total export of goods has increased. the visible trade deficit has improved.
questions.zh: 根據上圖，從第 4 年到第 6 年， 該經濟出現有形貿易赤字。 進口貨物的價值減少了。 總出口貨物的價值增加了。 有形貿易赤字改善了。

questions.en: Many foreign tourists cancelled their holiday trips to Hong Kong during the SARS infection. This would worsen Hong Kong's visible trade balance. worsen Hong Kong's invisible trade balance. make Hong Kong's balance of payments imbalanced. All of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 「沙士」疫症期間，不少外國遊客取消前來香港度假。上述事件會 令香港的有形貿易差額惡化。 令香港的無形貿易差額惡化。 令香港的國際收支帳不平衡。 以上各項皆正確。

questions.en: Mr Wong, a Mainland resident, comes to visit Hong Kong for a week. Which of the following should be included in Hong Kong's current account? the transport service he bought from a Mainland airline the accommodation service he bought from a Hong Kong hotel the residential flat in Tsim Sha Tsui he bought the Bank of China (H.K.) Ltd shares he bought
questions.zh: 王先生是一位中國內地居民，前來香港旅遊一個星期。下列哪一項應被包括在香港的經常帳內？ 他向內地一家航空公司購買的交通服務。 他向本港一家酒店購買的住宿服務。 他購買的一所位於尖沙咀的住宅。 他購買的「中國銀行 (香港)」股票。

questions.en: After the introduction of the 'individual visit' scheme, the Chinese government allows individuals from the mainland to travel in Hong Kong. This measure will increase Hong Kong's tertiary production. GDP. invisible trade surplus. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2), (3)
questions.zh: 在個人遊計劃實施後，中國政府容許內地居民以個人身份到香港旅遊。這措施會增加香港的 第三級生產。 本地生產總值。 無形貿易盈餘。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: According to the above diagram, from Year 2 to Year 5, the value of domestic exports of goods was decreasing. was increasing: remained constant. was indeterminate.
questions.zh: 根據上圖，從第2年到第5年，本地出口貨物的價值 正在減少。 正在增加。 維持不變。 未能確定。

questions.en: An Indonesian maid who works for a family in Hong Kong remits part of her wage earnings to Indonesia. In which component of the current account of Hong Kong’s balance of payments should the above remittance be recorded? goods services income current transfers
questions.zh: 一名印尼女傭在香港爲某家庭工作，將部分工資匯款至印尼。該筆匯款應記錄在香港國際收支平衡表下經常帳中哪一組成部分之內？ 貨物 服務 收益 經常轉移

questions.en: Refer to the data of an economy in a certain year: $ Billion Domestic exports of goods 20 Re-exports 25 Imports of goods 40 Exports of services 23 Imports of services 19 The visible trade balance is $ ________ billion. -20 -5 5 9
questions.zh: 參照下表某經濟某年的資料： 十億元 本地貨物出口 20 轉口 25 貨物進口 40 服務輸出 23 服務輸入 19 有形貿易差額是 ______ 十億元。 -20 -5 5 9

questions.en: An increase in the value of exports and a decrease in the value of imports in Country X would decrease its GDP. result in a surplus of its trade account. improve the balance of its current account. result in a depreciation of its domestic currency.
questions.zh: X 國的出口值增加和進口值減少會 減低它的本地生產總值。 導致它的貿易帳出現盈餘。 改善它的經常帳差額。 導致它的貨幣貶值。

questions.en: Which of the following should be included in the calculation of the invisible imports of Hong Kong? A Hong Kong citizen purchases shares in a state-owned enterprise on the Hong Kong stock market. A Hong Kong citizen buys some airtickets from a mainland Chinese airline. A mainland student pays tuition fees for his studies at a university of Hong Kong. A mainland investor purchases a residential apartment in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 下列哪項應包括入香港無形進口的計算之內？ 一名香港市民在本港股票市場購買國企股票。 一名香港市民購買中國內地航空公司的機票。 一名內地學生支付在香港一所大學學習的學費。 一名內地投資者在香港購買一間住宅。

questions.en: Refer to the data of an economy in a certain year below: $ Billion Domestic exports of goods 50 Re-exports 35 Imports of goods 60 Exports of services 25 Imports of services 10 There is a/an ________ of $ ________ billion. visible trade surplus...25 visible trade deficit...10 invisible trade surplus...40 invisible trade deficit...15
questions.zh: 參閱下列某經濟某年的資料： 十億元 本地貨物出口 50 轉口 35 貨物進口 60 服務輸出 25 服務輸入 10 該經濟有 ________ 十億元的 ________。 25 ... 有形貿易盈餘 10 ... 有形貿易赤字 40 ... 無形貿易盈餘 15 ... 無形貿易赤字

questions.en: Last year, a film crew came to Hong Kong to make a Batman movie. The shooting of the film in Hong Kong would improve the visible trade balance of Hong Kong. improve the invisible trade balance of Hong Kong. increase the GDP of Hong Kong. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 去年某電影公司的攝製組到香港拍攝一套蝙蝠俠的電影。在香港拍攝該電影會 改善香港的有形貿易差額。 改善香港的無形貿易差額。 增加香港的本地生產總值。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2)、(3)

questions.en: A US engineer is working in Hong Kong. Which of the following amounts should be included in the calculation of the balance of Hong Kong's current account? the part of her salary earnings that she deposits with a bank in Hong Kong the part of her salary earnings that she remits to her family in the US the money she pays to buy shares in Chinese state-owned enterprises quoted on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange the money she spends on buying clothes and toys in Hong Kong which are sent to her children in the US
questions.zh: 一名美國工程師在香港工作。下列哪筆款項應包括入香港經常帳差額的計算之中？ 她薪金收入的一部分，她將該筆款項存入本港一家銀行。 她薪金收入的一部分，她將該筆款項匯給她在美國的家人。 她支出的一筆款項，那是用來購買香港股票市場上的一些國企股票。 她支出的一筆款項，那是用來購買香港一些衣物及玩具，並送了給她在美國的子女。

questions.en: Mary is a fashion merchandiser for a department store in Thailand. She came to Hong Kong and purchased $300 000 worth of garments from a Hong Kong garment manufacturer. These garments were shipped directly from the garment manufacturer to the department store. During her stay in Hong Kong, she also bought a personal computer worth $10 000 from an electrical appliance shop for her own personal use. The $300 000 worth of garments would be regarded as a/an __________ export of Hong Kong and the $10 000 computer would be regarded as a/an __________ export of Hong Kong. visible ... visible visible ... invisible invisible ... visible invisible ... invisible
questions.zh: 瑪麗是泰國某百貨公司的時裝採購員。她前來香港，從一家香港成衣製造商購買了價值$300 000的成衣。該批成衣直接由製造商運往該百貨公司。在瑪麗留港期間，她又從電器店購買了一台價值$10 000的個人電腦，作私人用途。 該批價值$300 000的成衣被視爲香港的一項 ________ 出口，而該台價值$10 000的電腦被視爲香港的一項 ________ 出口。 有形 ... 有形 有形 ... 無形 無形 ... 有形 無形 ... 無形

questions.en: Refer to the following trade figures of an economy in a certain year: $billion Total exports of goods 140 Re-exports 50 Export of services 33 Import of goods 72 Import of services 20 The visible trade balance is $________ billion. 68 81 118 131
questions.zh: 參閱以下某經濟某年的貿易數據： 十億元 貨物總出口 140 轉口 50 出口服務 33 進口貨物 72 進口服務 20 有形貿易差額是 ______ 十億元。 68 81 118 131

questions.en: Which of the following should be included in the calculation of the invisible imports of Hong Kong? the money spent by a Hong Kong citizen to buy a ticket for a concert held in Macau the money spent by a Malaysian tourist to purchase a ticket for the 2009 East Asian Game held in Hong Kong the money spent by a Hong Kong citizen on donations to earthquake victims in Haiti the money spent by a Hong Kong citizen to purchase an RMB sovereign bond of mainland China through a Hong Kong bank
questions.zh: 下列哪項應包括入香港無形進口的計算之中？ 一位香港市民為購買一場在澳門舉行的音樂會的入場券所支出的款項。 一位馬來西亞遊客為購買在香港舉辦的 2009 年東亞運動會的入場券所支出的款項。 一位香港市民捐予海地受地震影響的災民的款項。 一位香港市民透過本港一家銀行購買人民幣國債所支出的款項。

questions.en: Referring to the following statistical data on an economy. Components $Million Private consumption expenditure 600 Gross domestic fixed capital formation 300 Decrease in stock 40 Government consumption expenditure 550 Depreciation 30 Total export of goods 85 Total export of services 115 Total import of goods 110 Total import of services 50 Re-export of goods 15 There is a visible trade ________ of $________ million. surplus ... 40 surplus ... 55 deficit ... 10 deficit ... 25
questions.zh: 參閱以下某經濟的統計資料，回答第27及28題。 成分 百萬元 私人消費支出 600 本地固定資本形成總值 300 存貨減少 40 政府消費支出 550 折舊 30 出口貨物總值 85 出口服務總值 115 進口貨物總值 110 進口服務總值 50 貨物轉口值 15 該經濟出現 ________ 百萬元的有形貿易 ________。 40 ... 盈餘 55 ... 盈餘 10 ... 赤字 25 ... 赤字

questions.en: During her stay in Hong Kong, a tourist from Mainland China spent $400 on transportation and bought a digital camera worth $2 000 from a shop. The $400 transportation cost would be regarded as a/an ______ export of Hong Kong and the $2 000 digital camera would be regarded as a/an ______ export of Hong Kong. visible ... visible visible ... invisible invisible ... visible invisible ... invisible
questions.zh: 某內地遊客在香港停留期間使用了$400 作爲交通費，又在一家商店購買了價值$2 000 的數碼相機。該筆 $400 的交通費被歸類為香港的 ________ 出口，該部價值$2 000 的數碼相機被歸類為香港的 ________ 出口。 有形 ... 有形 有形 ... 無形 無形 ... 有形 無形 ... 無形

questions.en: If a country is running a current account deficit, it must also be running a trade deficit. its capital and financial account must be in surplus. the foreign exchange reserves of the country must decrease. all of the above are correct.
questions.zh: 若一國出現經常帳赤字， 該國亦必定出現貿易逆差。 其資本及金融帳必定出現盈餘。 該國的外匯儲備必定減少。 以上各項皆正確。

questions.en: Which of the following is an invisible import in the current account of Hong Kong? In Beijing, a Hong Kong tourist purchases tickets to visit a local museum. A Mainland resident consults a doctor in a hospital in Hong Kong. A Mainland billionaire donates money to a university in Hong Kong. A Hong Kong manufacturer purchases raw materials from a Mainland firm.
questions.zh: 下列哪項是香港經常帳中的無形進口？ 一名香港旅客在北京購買門票遊覽當地的博物館。 一名內地居民在香港向醫院求診。 一名內地億萬富翁捐款予香港一間大學。 一家香港製造商向一家內地廠商購買原料。

questions.en: Which of the following is included in the calculation of the balance of Hong Kong's current account? A mainland investor purchases a house in Hong Kong. A Hong Kong investor buys shares issued by a mainland listed company. A mainland resident buys an air ticket to Hong Kong from a mainland airline. A Hong Kong resident buys a life insurance policy from a mainland insurance company.
questions.zh: 下列哪項包括在香港經常帳差額的計算之內？ 一位內地投資者在香港購買一間房屋。 一位香港投資者購買一家內地上市公司發行的股票。 一位內地居民從一家內地航空公司購買前往香港的機票。 一位香港居民從一家內地保險公司購買人壽保險。

questions.en: A lecturer from the US has been working in Hong Kong for 10 years. Which of the following would be included in the calculation of Hong Kong's current account balance? the money he gives to his wife in Hong Kong the money he uses to buy shares listed in the US stock market the money he donates to a charity organization in Africa the money he spends on visiting his parents in the US (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 一位來自美國的講師在香港已工作了 10 年。下列哪些會包括在香港經常帳差額計算之內？ 他給予在香港的太太的款項 他用來購買在美國股市上市的股票的款項 他捐給非洲慈善機構的款項 他到美國探望父母所花的款項 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(4) 只有 (2)、(3) 只有 (3)、(4)

questions.en: The following table shows some information about the balance of payments of Country A. Items $ million Balance on goods -1 200 Balance on services 700 Net factor income from abroad 200 Net current transfer -100 Increase in reserve assets 180 According to the above data, which of the following statements are correct? The current account deficit is $400 million. Country A's GDP is smaller than its gross national product. The balance of payments surplus is $180 million. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)

Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following would be results of the above change in the exchange rate? The volume of imported goods from South Korea to Hong Kong would increase. The price of exported goods from Hong Kong to South Korea in terms of HK dollar would increase. The number of tourists from South Korea to Hong Kong would decrease. (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 假設南韓圜兌美元貶值。在香港聯繫滙率制度下，下列哪些會是上述滙率改變的結果？ 從南韓進口至香港的物品數量會增加。 從香港出口至南韓的物品價格(以港元計算)會上升。 到訪香港的南韓遊客人數會下跌。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Suppose the countries in a certain region are competitors of exporting goods to the U.S.. The currencies of the countries in the region except that of Country X depreciate against the US dollar. As a result, the volume of Country X's exports to the U.S. will decrease. increase. remain constant. be indeterminate.
questions.zh: 假設某地區中的國家都是出口物品往美國的競爭對手。除了X國的貨幣外，在該地區中其他國家的貨幣兌美元均貶值。結果，X國出口往美國的物品數量會 下降。 上升。 維持不變。 未能確定。

questions.en: Date Exchange Rate 15 February 2015 US $1 = € 0.8773 15 August 2015 US $1 = € 0.8965 Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, the above change in the exchange rate of Euro (€) to the US dollar would lead to _______. an increase in the number of European tourists to Hong Kong an increase in the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of European exports to Hong Kong a decrease in the volume of Hong Kong exports to the U.S. a decrease in the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of Hong Kong exports to Europe
questions.zh: 日期 匯率 2015年2月15日 1美元=0.8773歐元 2015年8月15日 1美元=0.8965歐元 在香港聯繫匯率制度下，上述歐元兌美元匯率的改變會引致 ___________。 到訪香港的歐洲遊客人數上升 歐洲出口往香港的物品總值上升（以港元計算） 香港出口往美國的物品數量下降 香港出口往歐洲的物品總值下降（以港元計算）

questions.en: Date Exchange rates 22 November 2015 US$1 = RMB¥6.39 22 November 2016 US$1 = RMB¥6.89 The above change in the exchange rate between the US Dollar and the Renminbi would lead to a decrease in the number of Chinese tourists to the US. a decrease in the competitiveness of US exports to China. an increase in the total value of US exports to China (in terms of the US Dollar). (1) and (2) only (1) and (3) only (2) and (3) only (1), (2) and (3)
questions.zh: 日期 匯率 2015年11月22日 1美元=6.39元人民幣 2016年11月22日 1美元=6.89元人民幣 以上美元兌人民幣匯率的改變會令 到訪美國的中國旅客人數減少。 美國出口往中國的物品競爭力下降。 美國出口往中國的物品總值上升 (以美元計算)。 只有 (1)、(2) 只有 (1)、(3) 只有 (2)、(3) (1)、(2) 及 (3)

questions.en: Mr Wong used $10000 Hong Kong Dollars (HKD) to buy Renminbi (RMB) at Day 1 and sold the sum at Day 2 to obtain HKD at the exchange rates shown in the table below. Exchange rate Day 1 1 HKD = 0.83 RMB Day 2 1 HKD = 0.77 RMB Mr Wong ___________ approximately in the above transactions. lost HK$779 lost HK$600 gained HK$600 gained HK$779
questions.zh: 黃先生以港幣10000元在第一天購入人民幣，並在第二天出售該筆款項以獲取港幣，其兌換率如下表所示： 匯率 第一天 1港元 = 0.83 人民幣 第二天 1港元 = 0.77 人民幣 在以上的交易，黃先生大約 ___________。 損失了港幣 779 元 損失了港幣 600 元 賺取了港幣 600 元 賺取了港幣 779 元

questions.en: Study the prices of iPhone X in Hong Kong in terms of Hong Kong dollar (HKD) and in the Mainland in terms of Renminbi (RMB). Hong Kong The Mainland HKD 8588 RMB 8316 Given the exchange rate of HKD 1 = RMB 0.875, which of the following statements is correct? Travellers tend to buy an iPhone X in the Mainland instead of in Hong Kong. RMB is under-valued as the price of an iPhone X in the Mainland is lower than that in Hong Kong. If the transportation cost is HKD 950, buying an iPhone X in Hong Kong and re-selling it in the Mainland will no longer gain. The potential gain from ‘buy low, sell high’ will disappear when the price of iPhone X in Hong Kong is higher than HKD 9504.
questions.zh: 細閱 iPhone X 在香港的價格（以港元計算）與在內地的價格（以人民幣計算）。 香港 內地 8588 港元 8316 人民幣 已知匯率是 1 港元兌 0.875 元人民幣，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 遊客傾向於在內地而非在香港購買 iPhone X。 人民幣的幣值被低估，因為 iPhone X 在內地的價格比在香港的便宜。 若運費是 950 港元，在香港購買一部 iPhone X 並在內地轉售便再不能獲利。 當本港 iPhone X 的價格高於 9504 港元，「低買高賣」的潛在利益便會消失。

questions.en: The following table shows the change in the exchange rate of Euro against the US dollar. Date Exchange rate 22 September 2018 1 EUR = US$ 1.176 22 August 2019 1 EUR = US$ 1.109 The above change in the exchange rate will lead to a decrease in the number of European tourists visiting the US. the volume of goods exported from Europe to the US. the total value of US exports to Europe (in terms of Euro). the total value of European exports to the US (in term of the US dollar).
questions.zh: 下表顯示歐元兌美元的匯率轉變。 日期 匯率 2018年9月22日 1歐元=1.176美元 2019年8月22日 1歐元=1.109美元 上述匯率的轉變會引致____________________下降。 到訪美國的歐洲遊客人數 從歐洲出口至美國的物品數量 美國出口至歐洲的貨物總值（以歐元計算） 歐洲出口至美國的貨物總值（以美元計算）

questions.en: Study the following table. Exchange rate 3 December 2019 HKD 1 = RMB 0.902 3 December 2020 HKD 1 = RMB 0.923 On 3 December 2019, Mr Chan exchanged a total of RMB 300 000 from Hong Kong dollar and deposited the sum to a bank as time deposits at an annual interest rate of 0.8%. Suppose he withdrew the sum on 3 December 2020 and exchanged it back to Hong Kong dollar. From the above transactions, Mr Chan _______________. lost about HK$4 967 lost about HK$7 570 gained about HK$6 300 gained about HK$8 515
questions.zh: 細閱下表。 匯率 2019年12月3日 1港元 = 0.902 人民幣 2020年12月3日 1港元 = 0.923 人民幣 在2019年12月3日，陳先生用港幣兌換了300000人民幣，並將該筆款項存入銀行作定期存款，年利率 0.8%。假設他在2020年12月3日提取該筆款項，並把它兌回港幣。 在上述的交易後，陳先生 _______________。 損失了約港幣 $4967 損失了約港幣 $7570 賺取了約港幣 $6300 賺取了約港幣 $8515

questions.en: The following table shows the change in the exchange rate of Hong Kong dollar (HKD) against Renminbi (RMB). Exchange rate 11 August 2022 HKD 1 = RMB 0.86 11 August 2023 HKD 1 = RMB 0.92 The above change in the exchange rate would lead to ______. an appreciation of US dollar against Renminbi an increase in the total value of imports from the Mainland to Hong Kong in terms of Hong Kong dollar an increase in the competitiveness of the Mainland's goods exported to Hong Kong an increase in the production cost of construction companies in Hong Kong which import construction materials from the Mainland
questions.zh: 下表顯示港元（HKD）兌人民幣（RMB）的匯率變動。 匯率 2022年8月11日 HKD 1 = RMB 0.86 2023年8月11日 HKD 1 = RMB 0.92 上述的匯率變動會導致______。 美元兌人民幣升值 以港元計算，香港從內地的進口總值上升 內地出口在香港的貨物競爭力上升 從內地進口建材的香港建築公司的生產成本上升

questions.en: The diagram below shows the exchange rate between Japanese Yen (JPY) and Hong Kong Dollar (HKD) from 27 September to 23 October 2024. During the above period, if Japan's demand for imports from Hong Kong is _____, the total value of Japan's imports from Hong Kong (in terms of JPY) would _____. elastic ... decrease elastic ... increase inelastic ... decrease perfectly inelastic ... remain unchanged
questions.zh: 下圖顯示 2024 年 9 月 27 日至 10 月 23 日期間日圓和港元之間的匯率。 在上述期間，假如日本對從香港輸入的進口的需求是____的，日本從香港輸入的進口總值（以日圓計算）會____。 高彈性 …… 下降 高彈性 …… 上升 低彈性 …… 下降 完全沒有彈性 …… 維持不變

questions.en: Under the Linked Exchange Rate System of Hong Kong, when US dollar appreciates against British pound, _____. the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of Hong Kong exports to United States will increase the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of Hong Kong exports to United Kingdom will decrease the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of Hong Kong imports from United Kingdom will increase the total value (in terms of Hong Kong dollar) of Hong Kong imports from United Kingdom will decrease
questions.zh: 在香港聯繫匯率制度下，當美元兌英鎊升值，______。 香港出口往美國的物品總值會上升（以港元計算） 香港出口往英國的物品總值會下降（以港元計算） 香港從英國的進口總值會上升（以港元計算） 香港從英國的進口總值會下降（以港元計算）

questions.en: Which of the following about the linked exchange rate (聯繫匯率) in Hong Kong is correct? It is determined by market forces. It has been changed several times by the government. The linked rate system is used to stabilize the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar. It is an exchange rate between the Hong Kong dollar and a basket of foreign currencies.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項有關香港聯繫匯率的描述是正確的？ 它由市場力量所決定。 它曾多次被政府修改。 該匯率制度是用來穩定港元匯價的。 它是港元兌一籃子外國貨幣的匯率。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about Hong Kong's note-issuing system is correct? Any individual can exchange US dollars for Hong Kong dollars with the Monetary Authority at the rate US$1 = HK$7.8. Hong Kong dollar notes are issued by the Monetary Authority. Hong Kong dollars will always be fixed against the US dollar at the rate US$1 = HK$7.8 in the foreign exchange market. To issue Hong Kong dollar notes, the note-issuing banks have to surrender US dollars to the Monetary Authority in exchange for certificates of indebtedness.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於本港發鈔制度的描述是正確的？ 任何人都可用美元以 US$1=HK$7.8 的匯率向金融管理局兌換港元。 港元紙幣是金管局發行的。 在外匯市場中，港元與美元的兌換率被固定在 US$1=HK$7.8。 要發行港元紙幣時，發鈔銀行須向金管局交出美元以換取負債證明書。

questions.en: Hong Kong practices a linked exchange rate system. In the foreign exchange market the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the US dollar is __________ and that relative to other currencies is __________. fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8 … fixed fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8 … not fixed not fixed … fixed not fixed … not fixed
questions.zh: 香港實施聯繫匯率制度。在外匯市場上，港元兌美元的匯率_________而港元兌其他貨幣的匯率_________。 固定在 1 美元=7.8 港元 … 是固定的 固定在 1 美元=7.8 港元 … 不是固定的 不是固定的 … 是固定的 不是固定的 … 不是固定的

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is true? The exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to Renminbi is fixed. The market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US$ is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8. The competitiveness of Hong Kong exports decreases when the US dollar appreciates against other currencies. Hong Kong will not have a balance of payments problem.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪一項描述是正確？ 港元兌人民幣的匯率是固定的。 港元兌美元的市場匯率固定在美元$1=港元$7.8。 美元相對其他貨幣升值時，香港出口貨的競爭力減弱。 香港不會出現國際收支不平衡的問題。

questions.en: Suppose the Japanese Yen appreciates greatly against the US dollar. Due to the linked exchange rate system, the HK dollar will depreciate greatly against the Japanese Yen. the US dollar will depreciate greatly against the Japanese Yen. the US dollar will depreciate greatly against the euro. the HK dollar will depreciate greatly against the euro.
questions.zh: 假設日圓相對美元大幅升值。由於聯繫匯率， 港元相對日圓會大幅貶值。 美元相對日圓會大幅貶值。 美元相對歐羅會大幅貶值。 港元相對歐羅會大幅貶值。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system in Hong Kong, the market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed. the market exchange rates of the HK dollar relative to currencies other than the US dollar are fixed. The HK dollar will depreciate against the Australian dollar if the US dollar appreciates against the Australian dollar. The HK dollar will appreciate against the Japanese yen if the US dollar appreciates against the Japanese yen.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下， 港元與美元的市場兌換率是固定的。 除美元外，港元與其他貨幣的市場兌換率是固定的。 若美元對澳元升值，則港元會對澳元貶值。 若美元對日圓升值，則港元亦會對日圓升值。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct? The exchange rate of the Hong Kong Dollar (HKD) relative to the US dollar (USD) is fixed at USD1=HKD7.8 on the foreign exchange market. If Mainland China has a visible trade surplus, Hong Kong will also have a visible trade surplus. When the USD depreciates against the Euro, the HKD will also depreciate against the Euro. All of the above.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪項是正確的？ 在外匯市場裏，港元與美元之間的兌換率固定在 1 美元 = 7.8 港元。 若中國內地有形貿易出現盈餘，香港也會出現有形貿易盈餘。 當美元相對歐元貶值時，港元相對歐元也會貶值。 以上全部皆正確。

questions.en: Which of the following about Hong Kong's linked exchange rate system is INCORRECT? The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has to keep a great sum of foreign reserves. There is no independent monetary policy in Hong Kong. There will be an adverse effect on the real estate market in Hong Kong when the US keeps lowering the interest rate. Hong Kong will experience imported inflation when the US Dollar continuously depreciates against the Renminbi.
questions.zh: 下列哪一項關於香港聯繫匯率制度的敘述是錯誤的？ 香港金融管理局必須持有大量外匯儲備。 香港沒有獨立的貨幣政策。 當美國持續調低利率時，會對香港的房地產市場帶來不良影響。 當美元兌人民幣持續貶值時，香港會出現輸入性通脹。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar with the US dollar in the foreign exchange market is fixed. the Hong Kong government need not hold a large amount of foreign exchange reserves. Hong Kong citizens can give the Hong Kong government Hong Kong dollars in exchange for US dollars at the linked rate. the Hong Kong dollar banknotes are fully backed by foreign exchange reserves.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下， 港元在外匯市場上兌美元的匯率是固定的。 香港政府無須持有大量外匯儲備。 香港市民可按聯繫匯率從香港政府手上把港元轉換為美元。 港元現鈔有外匯儲備作出十足支持。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system in Hong Kong, the market exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8. the three note-issuing banks in Hong Kong have the obligation to the general public to exchange Hong Kong dollars for US dollars at the linked rate. the Hong Kong dollar banknotes do not have to be fully backed by foreign exchange reserves. the market exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the Euro will move in the same direction as the market exchange rate of the US dollar relative to the Euro.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下， 港元兌美元的市場兌換率被固定在 US$1 = HK$7.8。 香港三家發鈔銀行有責任為公眾按照聯繫匯率將港元兌換成美元。 港元紙幣毋須全部由外匯儲備作擔保。 港元兌歐元的市場兌換率會跟隨美元兌歐元的市場兌換率的變動方向來變動。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong is correct? Hong Kong dollar banknotes are fully backed by Renminbi and the US dollar. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority holds a considerable amount of foreign exchange reserves. All note-issuing banks can exchange for US dollars at the linked rate with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. The exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar to the US dollar in the foreign exchange market is fixed. (1) and (2) only (1) and (4) only (2) and (3) only (3) and (4) only
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關香港聯繫匯率制度的陳述是正確的？ 港元鈔票由人民幣和美元十足支持。 香港金融管理局持有相當數量的外匯儲備。 所有發鈔銀行可按聯繫匯率與香港金融管理局兌換美元。 港元兌美元在外匯市場的兌換率是固定的。 只有(1)、(2) 只有(1)、(4) 只有(2)、(3) 只有(3)、(4)

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct? The money supply (M1) of Hong Kong has to be fully backed up by the US dollar. The market exchange rate of the HK dollar to the US dollar is fixed at 1 USD to 7.8 HKD by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. Hong Kong's import volume will increase when the US dollar appreciates against other currencies. A current account deficit in the US will lead to a current account deficit in Hong Kong.
questions.zh: 在香港聯繫匯率制度之下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 香港的貨幣供應定義一 (M1) 必須全部由美元支持。 港元兌美元的市場匯率由香港金融管理局固定在 1 美元兌 7.8 港元。 當美元兌其他貨幣升值，香港的進口量會上升。 美國經常帳赤字會導致香港經常帳出現赤字。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct? The non-bank public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in exchange for US dollars at any time. It enables the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to carry out an expansionary monetary policy to stimulate private investment. The market exchange rate of the US Dollar against the HK Dollar is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8. There would be a downward pressure on the consumer price indices of Hong Kong when the Renminbi continuously depreciates against the US Dollar.
questions.zh: 在香港聯繫匯率制度之下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 非銀行公眾可以在任何時間將所持有的港幣賣給香港金融管理局以換取美元。 它讓香港金融管理局可以實施擴張性貨幣政策以刺激私人投資。 美元兌港元的市場匯率是固定於 1 美元 = 7.8 港元。 人民幣兌美元持續貶值，會對本港消費物價指數構成向下壓力。

questions.en: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct? The money supply M1 of Hong Kong has to be fully backed up by the US dollar. Hong Kong's export volume will increase when the US dollar depreciates against other currencies. The market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed. Hong Kong citizens can sell 1 USD to the three note-issuing banks for 7.8 HKD.
questions.zh: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？ 本港的貨幣供應定義一必須有美元的全數支持。 當美元兌其他貨幣貶值，香港的出口量會上升。 港元相對美元的市場匯率是固定的。 本港市民可以向三家發鈔銀行賣出1美元以換得7.8港元。

questions.en: Which of the following statements about the Linked Exchange Rate System of Hong Kong is correct? The public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in exchange for US dollars at the market exchange rate. The public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the three note-issuing banks in exchange for US dollars at the linked exchange rate. An appreciation of Hong Kong dollar against Japanese yen would lead to an appreciation of US dollar against Japanese yen. An appreciation of US dollar against Japanese yen would lead to an appreciation of Hong Kong dollar against Japanese yen.
questions.zh: 下列哪項有關香港聯繫匯率制度的陳述是正確的？ 公眾能以市場匯率向香港金融管理局賣出港元以兌換美元。 公眾能以聯繫匯率向三家發鈔銀行賣出港元以兌換美元。 港元兌日圓升值會令美元兌日圓升值。 美元兌日圓升值會令港元兌日圓升值。
